Job.JobTitle: Senior Underwriting Manager, Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions
Job.JobDescription:
Description

With ride-hailing, on-demand delivery, and autonomous vehicles, options for transporting people and goods have never been so plentiful or presented so many emerging risks. Drawing on Libertys vast commercial and personal lines expertise, Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions (LMMS) represents an underwriting model that brings a full range of tailored solutions and nuanced pricing approaches to the sharing economy and new mobility marketplace. This dedicated practice combines creative commercial underwriting with actuarial, product development, client, and claims teams to deliver a robust insurance experience. Join our expanding underwriting team to foster change and innovation and partner with brokers and sharing economy and new mobility businesses to help this segment grow and thrive.

As an LMMS Underwriting Manager, you will manage a team of underwriting professionals responsible for renewing and pursuing opportunities to achieve a balanced, profitable, and quality book while protecting company assets. In some cases, the accounts worked may be among the largest risk transfer opportunities or renewals in the company, with complex risk sharing structures and evolving coverage language.Responsibilities include risk assessment, coverage and pricing analysis, broker/partner communication and management, and industry thought leadership. This role requires strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills in order to thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You will develop and maintain effective business relationships with internal and external partners. You will apply an advanced level of expertise and judgment to evaluate scenarios, data, and recommendations prepared by underwriters, actuaries, and or cross-functional partners and provide guidance for risk selection and acceptance, coverage, and price for casualty business in select sharing economy and new mobility sectors.

Responsibilities:

  • Leadership: Responsible for the retention, acquisition, and development of senior level underwriting talent. Formally manage, guide, mentor, and coach underwriters in both technical and professional skills. Foster an environment conducive to innovation, continuous improvement and product development.
  • Risk Selection: Responsible for developing and implementing a strategy to better evaluate risk quality and further underwriters skillset in qualifying, selecting and assessing sharing economy and new mobility risks. In addition to managing staff, may also be responsible for underwriting complex accounts.
  • Agent/Broker Relationships: Establish and maintain high level of relationship management with key Agents and Brokers. Develop underwriters technical, negotiation, communication and general deal making skills.
  • Portfolio Management: Evaluate portfolio performance based on profitability metrics, evolving risk scenarios, outcome and volatility ranges, reinsurance, opportunity metrics, and industry trends. Define UW team execution strategy and oversee execution of continuously improving portfolio in alignment with team objectives. Be the lead custodial of capital for your team.
  • Quality Audit and Account Review: Collaborates with the LMMS SUO and the OOU to ensure files meet regulatory requirements and internal documentation standards. Coach underwriters to articulate thought process, decision making within both account reviews and file documentation.
Qualifications

  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 10 years progressive underwriting experience expected, including a minimum of 2 years of proven underwriting management experience, preferred
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate high impact underwriting risks within scope of responsibility
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex analyses and information
  • Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with internal and external partners required
  • Must possess the following skills, abilities and attributes: strong leadership skills, development of people, strategic thinking, sustained effective portfolio management and profitable growth, communications skills, decision-making skills, results-oriented, industrious, innovative, problem-solving skills, coaching and mentoring skills, and negotiating skills

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

  • Los Angeles Unincorporated
  • Philadelphia
  • San Francisco

Description

The North America (NA) Chief Reserving Actuary will lead the North America Reserving function. Position involves being responsible for the team performing thorough reserve analysis, maintaining reasonable and adequate reserves for this $20 Billion reserve base, clearly and transparently communicating results of reserve studies to key stakeholders, identifying elements of the reserve analysis that is particularly relevant to future business decisions by the NA business unit, effectively managing and leading a large team, and building strong relationships with business leaders and other key leaders throughout the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Provide an independent assessment of the NA reserves and associated reserve risks, ensuring the adequacy and accuracy of the NA reserves.
  • Ensure use of accurate, sound, and innovative approaches in projecting and setting reserving guidelines that are consistent with those of Global Risk Solutions (GRS).
  • Communicate the quarterly reserve analyses to the NA leadership.
  • Lead and develop a NA reserving capability that is technical and commercial-minded.
  • Be an inclusive leader committed to mentoring and developing team members to assume progressively senior actuarial and business leadership roles.
  • Provide proactive insights that are sought out by the business leaders.
  • Identify key trends, areas of uncertainty to monitor, and macroeconomic factors that are impacting the business.
  • Work in close collaboration with underwriting, pricing, claims and finance to develop a common view of the business.
  • Work in partnership with the various stakeholders to identify emerging trends that could impact results and propose corrective action in a timely manner.
  • Apply innovative approaches and leading-edge tools to analyze the business.
  • Ensure the quality of the data and its consistent application in the reserving process.
  • Foster a culture of technical rigor, transparency, and consistency.
  • Execute a governance framework that ensures that reserving guidelines are consistently applied and all processes comply with internal operational control requirements and all external regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with the broader actuarial organization and other strategic business units to share knowledge and advance the business.
  • Seek opportunities to continuously improve and streamline processes.
  • Keep abreast of new reserving methodologies, trends and product/ tort reforms and other external issues.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Insurance designations desirable
  • Fellowship in the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS) designation required, or comparable actuarial education/designation combined with relevant experience
  • Demonstrated expertise in financial management of a P&C business
  • Ability to participate effectively on the senior management team
  • Strong analytical skills with solid understanding of all casualty actuarial techniques, standards, and assumptions
  • Expert knowledge of insurance operations and P&C insurance business
  • Excellent management and communication skills
  • Strategic thinking and ability to set direction for team
  • Demonstrated ability to exchange ideas and convey complex information clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate areas of senior management concern, integrate different perspectives, and respond accordingly
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills required to establish and build effective relationships within and outside the organization
  • Ability to give effective training and presentations to senior management and other groups
  • Demonstrated ability to organize, lead, and get work done through others
  • Ability to develop staff and managers to support succession planning and address on-going talent needs
  • Ability to build and manage talent across the enterprise in conjunction with peers
  • Demonstrated ability to exert influence over senior managers, operating managers, and others on matters of importance to the SBU

About Us

The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Job.JobTitle: Remote Construction Program Manager, Manufacturing Sector
Job.JobDescription:
Siemens Government Technologies (SGT) is a dynamic and rapidly growing organization, and we are seeking a self-driven individual to complement our growing team.


As a Siemens Advanced Manufacturing Sector Program Manager, you will lead and manage a cross functional program delivery team to scope, design, procure, install and commission an advanced, digitally integrated manufacturing capability. You will establish and communicate clear program priorities and program activities. This role is the primary point of contact to align the customer, stakeholders, and the multiple Siemens business unit delivery teams.

As part of the Advanced Manufacturing team, you will lead, guide and work with Facility (SGT) , Digital Software (DI-SW), and Automation (DI AUT) Project Managers, integrating their team's efforts to achieve a One Siemens result for the Customer.


Responsibilities:

•Manage the Anniston Advanced Manufacturing program through the Project life cycle, leveraging PM Siemens project management framework and the Siemens Delivery Framework

•Lead Program wide governance approach. Coordinate with scope specific Project Managers to execute project governance.

•Manage customer requirements and program scope to achieve program objectives, effectively coordinating project expectations with customers and stakeholders in a timely and concise fashion.

•Manage and combine individual subproject schedules into an integrated Master schedule, coordinating interdependencies between sub-projects to ensure on time delivery.

•Manage cross functional, multi-team configuration and deployment activities including software, industrial equipment manufacturers and Facilities experts. These team members will be coordinated to complete the design, procurement, installation, configuration, validation, and acceptance of the facility improvements and planned Manufacturing Capabilities.

•Work with third-party contractors to ensure overall program execution and success including site safety planning, material ordering coordination, and solution/system validation.

•Provide program management activities to control scope, cost, schedule, and quality across all sub elements.

•Define and execute required processes in alignment with stakeholders including appropriate communication to all levels. Lead Internal Steerco communication development and presentation with responsibility for results.

•Perform program quality management, ensuring that the solution meets contractual requirements and is to the appropriate quality and management compliance for industry or customer protocols, regulations, and standards.

•Perform program reviews and retrospectives regularly and present the results and lessons learned to the program and organization.

•Ensure the projects in the program are meeting the approved budget and agreed margin and are reviewed on a regular basis.

•Conduct Stakeholder meetings to manage and guide stakeholders through scope clarification, design review and installation activities

•Set the standard and maintain project artifacts such as status, risk, issues, opportunities (RIO), schedule or IMS, decision log, program management plan, safety plan, FMEA, CAP, or other artifacts as needed to support project rigor as required by customer, PM@ Siemens, or industry standards.

•Perform project risk management including planning, identification, analysis, mitigation planning and controlling to include FMEA and CAP as required.

•Confidence creating and presenting content to all levels of management, both internal and external.

•Coordinate difficult scope, cost, resource conversations with customers.

•Lead successful project closeout and successful user-acceptance and adoption of deployed project capability; or participated in customer witness tests or similar events, industrial equipment validation and start up procedures. Coordinate integration of all Systems

•Manage contract acceptance and handover of projects to the customer. Develop proactive closeout procedures to avoid extended on site durations.

•In conjunction with Engagement Management, identify, and create new opportunities and renewals for current projects/programs.

•Mentor and support the development of team members.

•Perform duties in compliance with SGT Project Management Standards.

Required Qualifications:

•Bachelor's degree from an accredited university/college in Engineering, Technology, or equivalent years of experience (8+) in technical fields of work.

•Eight to ten years in a project manager/leadership role, guiding a cross-functional team of project managers and consultants during significant facility or industrial equipment implementation.

•Eight to ten years of experience working in a US Federal Government customer-facing environment with a focus on USACE/NAVFAC Construction processes. Including US Federal Government projects, contracts, policies, procedures and quality and safety programs.

•Knowledge of Change Management processes.

•Product Scheduling experience with Critical path method schedules using MS Projects, Primavera or similar software.

•Demonstrated experience operating within an industrial setting such as a plant, shop, building infrastructure, shipboard, or other industrial setting.

•Proactive self-starter who can build a team to meet project delivery requirements, performing independently in high-pressure situations with little supervision.

•Leadership skills and proven track record of leading multi-disciplinary teams, including services

•Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

•Experience working with third party contractors.

•PMP Certification, with working knowledge of project management processes and tools is highly preferred.

•Experience building effective project teams from separate organizations, establishing program governance, organizational effectiveness and program data interchange.

•Use of Program/Project management software a plus.

•Experience implementing industrial equipment such as CNC machine tools, conveyers, PLCs, plant automation, manufacturing centers, SCADA, cabling, electrical, or other industrial infrastructure.

•Experience connecting cloud infrastructure with on-premise IT/OT networks

•Proven experience working with distributed, remote teams across multiple disciplines and time zones.

•Ability to promote complex solutions and drive acceptance with confidence.

•Working knowledge of using AI tools to support project management execution.

Travel:

•Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%

Security Clearance:

•Candidate must be US citizen and have the ability to obtain and maintain a US federal agency security clearance.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?


Transform the everyday with us!


Our Siemens Grid Software team works to accelerate and secure the energy transition. We ensure a reliable, affordable energy supply in a decentralizing, decarbonizing, digitalizing, and all-electrifying energy world. No matter where power comes from or where it must go, we ensure it makes its way – every step of the way. Over 70% of the world's electricity flows through infrastructure planned or analyzed by Siemens Grid Solutions. This internship will allow you to work with experts in the energy industry who have developed the software, products, and services that electrify the world!


We are seeking qualified candidates for our Grid Software Internship Program as a Power Systems Technical Consultant beginning in May or June 2027. This Is a fully remote role.


You'll Make an Impact By:

  • Supporting the delivery of technical consulting solutions for industrial, commercial, and utility clients through power system analysis, modeling, simulation, and optimization projects.
  • Assisting in the modeling and simulation of electrical power systems using industry-standard tools such as PowerWorld, PSS®E, PSLF, ETAP, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD, and related platforms.
  • Analyzing system performance data and contributing to power quality, reliability, efficiency, and grid modernization initiatives, including exposure to energy automation and digital power system technologies.
  • Supporting the development of technical proposals, reports, presentations, and other client-facing deliverables.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to support project delivery and client engagements while staying current with industry trends, standards, and emerging power system technologies.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Energy Engineering, Energy Systems, or a closely related field and approaching completion of the required educational credentials for this opportunity.
  • Coursework and/or work experience in electrical power systems including generation, transmission, distribution, and protection.
  • Working knowledge of applications of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
  • Ability to work remotely full-time (40 hours per week) for the duration of the 12-week program.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.
  • This internship is a structured experiential learning program for individuals currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program who will continue their studies following the assignment. Current and continuing enrollment is a condition of participation. Applicants who have completed or expect to complete their educational program before or during the assignment period are encouraged to explore our Early Career Development Program opportunities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with power system simulation and analysis tools such as PowerWorld, PSS®E, PSLF, ETAP, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD, or MATLAB/Simulink.
  • Coursework or experience in power system analysis, protection, renewable energy integration, renewable generation, FACTS, or smart grid technologies.
  • Programming experience using tools such as Python, C++, or VBA for data analysis, automation, or tool customization.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, leadership, time management, and prioritization skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in diverse team environments.
  • Interest in sustainable energy, digital transformation, and emerging technologies within the power sector.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Location: This role is remote.


Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?


Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn't just about improving buildings; it's about creating perfect places that improve people's lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


Sr. Fire Alarm Systems Design Leads create unique design solutions to meet specific customer requirements for commercial building fire alarm systems. This candidate will focus on data centers. This team member makes recommendations for productivity improvements and cost reductions to increase customer satisfaction and job profitability.


As a Fire Alarm Systems Design Engineer, you will:

  • Choose the appropriate mix of products and installation methods to provide the most cost-effective solution.
  • Prepare submittals and schedules; handle the ordering of products and equipment.
  • Participate in sales-to-operations turnover meetings to evaluate accuracy of the sales estimate and job layout.
  • Design fire alarm systems for buildings, including floorplan drawings for system device locations, riser diagrams, device wiring details, panel mounting and wiring details, bills of materials, and sequences of operations to meet the intent of the project plans, specifications, and contract documents.
  • Provide general electrical calculations, including battery calculations, voltage drop calculations, conduit fills, power supply sizing, etc. and prepare engineering re-estimates and follow up with appropriate sales and management to ensure understanding of and satisfaction with job scope.
  • Follow up with sales and management to ensure job scope, specifications, and schematics will meet customer needs and provide start-up and checkout documentation to the Project Manager for use in commissioning and validation.
  • Perform quality assurance; peer-review engineering documents and mentor, train, and direct the design activities of the engineering team.


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED
  • 5+ years of experience engineering fire alarm systems
  • Must be able to demonstrate:
    • Knowledge of engineering fundamentals of fire systems or equivalent field experience with fire system controls
    • Knowledge of the following fire alarm system components: fire alarm panels, strobe booster panels, spot detectors (smoke, heat, carbon monoxide), duct-mounted smoke detectors, projected beam smoke detectors, aspirating smoke detectors (VESDA), monitor modules, relay modules (form A and form C), manual pull stations, notification devices (speaker/strobes, horn/strobes, strobes, bells), Class A/Class B/Class X circuits, state and local fire codes, and NFPA 72 national fire code
    • The ability to read and interpret electrical circuit diagrams
    • Knowledge of fire alarm system components
  • NICET II- Fire Alarm Systems certification and ability and willingness to obtain NICET III within 1 years
  • 5+ years of proficiency in AutoCAD and design; proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate or Bachelor's Degree
  • Highly detailed oriented
  • Data Center design experience
  • VESDA Fire Alarm Systems experience
  • EIT, ASHRE, NICET III or IV - Fire Alarm Systems, or CISSP certifications

Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for a Lead or Senior Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software's Power Technologies International (PTI) team. PTI is our trusted advisor that takes a holistic approach, providing business advisory, technical consulting, and simulation software solutions. This role is critical to planning and integrating renewables, storage, large loads, and FACTS devices into the electrical grid. The Lead or Senior Power Systems Consultant will perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations, while mentoring others on the team.

This is a remote position based in the contiguous U.S.

What you will be working on:

  • Performing and leading consulting engagements related to power grid analysis and design, system dynamics and transients, system interconnection, and grid code compliance.
  • Supporting and managing project execution, tracking project progress, and making necessary adjustments to maintain scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
  • Producing reports and presentations in collaboration with team members to communicate study results.
  • Maintaining relationships with clients to ensure satisfaction, analyzing clients' business requirements and identifying opportunities for further business.
  • Supporting and leading proposal preparation by developing project plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Supporting technical reviews of ongoing studies and contributing to the mentoring and development of junior consultants.
  • Developing automation scripts to streamline repetitive tasks, reduce errors, and boost overall efficiency.
  • Delivering on-site consulting and training services.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor's or postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience performing transmission power systems analysis, with demonstrated ability to independently execute and interpret power flow and dynamic stability studies.
  • Professional experience with at least one of the following: electric utilities, ISOs/RTOs, developers, electrical utilities consulting company, or national labs, including work involving at least one of PJM, MISO, ISO-NE, NYISO, ERCOT, or SPP.
  • Experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E, and experience with or working knowledge of at least one of TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, or PowerWorld.
  • Working knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards and an understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and listening skills with demonstrated ability to write effective technical reports.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior relevant consulting and/or business development experience.
  • Experience in distribution planning, DER integration, or microgrids, and familiarity with or experience using CYME, Synergi, or OpenDSS.
  • Industry experience performing power system transient analysis using PSCAD™.
  • Experience leading studies, managing budgets and schedules, and mentoring or developing others professionally.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Service (Lead) Consultant - Exposure Intelligence, Infrastructure & Systems (Servers / Containers / K8s / OS)

Job profile/ Business Title: Lead Consultant- Threat & Incident Response

Team and overall work scope

  • The team operates within a newly established Exposure Management function in the broader cybersecurity organization, focused on modernizing how the enterprise identifies, prioritizes, and mitigates security vulnerabilities shifting from traditional patch approaches to a more strategic focus on true business risk and exploitability

  • The Individual Contributor roles are designed to bring in deep domain expertise (network, endpoint, cloud, identity, infrastructure, etc.) to bridge the gap between security insights and practical remediation strategies

  • The Exposure Intelligence Analyst Infrastructure & Systems serves as the domain-aligned SME responsible for identifying, analyzing, and prioritizing exposure risk across enterprise compute platforms, including servers, virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, and operating system hardening.

  • This role operates within a CTEM model by turning technical findings into actionable exposure intelligence and partnering with engineering SMEs to accelerate risk reduction.

Whats exciting about this role : Directly identify and reduce real exposure across core infrastructure by validating exploitability and eliminating attack paths across servers, containers, and OS platforms, leveraging AIassisted analysis to focus on highsignal, highimpact risk.

Ideal Candidate:

  • Experienced infrastructure SME with a strong background in servers, operating systems, and platform engineering (Windows/Linux, virtualization, containers, Kubernetes).

  • Brings years of hands-on experience securing or building or operating core systems and is able to translate that experience into identifying, validating, and reducing real, exploitable infrastructure exposures.

  • Demonstrable experience within Server and OS platforms (Windows, Linux), Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), Infrastructure hardening and system-level security controls

Success Measures

  • Reduction in exploitable infra-layer exposure (misconfigs, weak baselines, patch gaps).

  • Improved prioritization accuracy (less noise, more real risk).

  • Faster mitigation outcomes through SME-to-SME partnering with platform engineering.

Key Responsibilities (Core + Domain) Exposure Intelligence (Core)

  • Analyze exposure signals (vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, control gaps) and translate them into exploitable exposure hypotheses.

  • Correlate findings across sources to identify attack paths and high-impact exposure conditions.

  • Prioritize work based on exploitability, blast radius, and business impact; produce clear remediation guidance.

Infrastructure & Systems (Domain)

  • Own SME coverage for servers (Windows/Linux), hypervisors, containers, and Kubernetes platforms.

  • Identify systemic risks: insecure baselines, patching gaps, insecure container images, cluster misconfigurations, weak segmentation at the host layer, privilege pathways.

  • Partner with platform teams to validate remediation effectiveness and ensure durable hardening outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years in security engineering, infrastructure engineering, vulnerability/exposure management, or related cyber operations.

  • Hands-on knowledge of server/OS hardening, virtualization concepts, and container/Kubernetes fundamentals.

  • Ability to interpret technical telemetry and translate into actionable risk decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes security controls, container runtime security, CIS benchmarks, and secure configuration management.

  • Scripting/query skills (PowerShell, Python, KQL, SQL) to enrich/validate exposure hypotheses.

  • Familiarity with attack techniques affecting infra layers (privilege escalation, lateral movement, persistence).

Skills

Cyber Incident Response, Docker (Software), Incident Response, Infrastructure Protection, IT Security Operations, Kubernetes, Linux, Operating Systems (OS), Remediation, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Security Controls, Security Engineering, Server Infrastructure, Systems Hardening, Threat Assessment, Virtualization

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 100,000.00 - 170,500.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job Description

Arity is a part of the Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We collect and analyze enormous amounts of data in order to provide cutting-edge solutions to companies invested in transportation.

The Team
The Arity Sales team plants the seeds of our companys success. Were looking for candidates who bring a unique concoction of consulting, business development, technology, andof coursesales experience to help our business take off. Innovation, transparency and a desire to do the right thing are essential for this position, because were not selling one specific productwere selling ideas and solutions we truly believe in. Team members are passionate about their job and excited about the opportunity to drive change not just for customers, but for an entire industry. Our ideal candidate has deep knowledge of transportation across multiple industries and thinks outside the box to help our partners solve their toughest transportation problems. Sound like you? Lets chat!

The Role
The Sales Engineering Senior Manager is an expert-level individual contributor who helps prospective customers evaluate, integrate, and realize business value from Aritys mobile experiences and performance marketing solutions. The role requires a business-savvy technical leader with hands-on experience in mobile application development and API-based data integration. This individual leads customer discovery, translates business objectives into solution architecture, and demonstrates how Arity products can create measurable value through our mobile SDK, API, and data-driven platform integrations. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders, the Expert Sales Engineer influences product direction, technical strategy, and go-to-market execution through technical expertise, customer insight, and quantified value assessments.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the technical subject matter expert for Aritys mobile SDK product and UI kits, integration of processes like real time bidding (RTB) models, consumer data pre-fill, and integration into Aritys and other performance marketing platforms; evaluate customer business goals, operating processes, technical architecture and integration needs to qualify product fit.
  • Be an inquisitive listener eager to challenge organizations to think differently and adopt new ideas.
  • Lead complex technical discovery engagements to understand customer objectives, business processes, technology ecosystems, implementation requirements, and success measures.
  • Design solution architectures that use Arity products, APIs and data assets to address customer business challenges, and clearly communicate technical trade-offs, dependencies and recommended approaches.
  • Assess gaps and opportunities in product features, API capabilities and integration patterns based on market demand; partner with product and engineering to prioritize the work with the greatest customer and business value.
  • Assess gaps and opportunities in product marketing, including business-value messaging, technical enablement and API integration guidance, and help prioritize the work needed to support market adoption.
  • Partner with business development representatives on strategic opportunities, leading technical discovery, solution design, feasibility assessment and value articulation from qualification through customer decision.
  • Act as a technical thought leader through customer workshops, industry conferences, webinars and market-facing presentations based on the individuals industry expertise.

Required Qualifications

  • Author request for information (RFI) and request for proposal (RFP) responses for prospective customers; assist with proposals and statements of work (SOWs), including solution architecture, API integration scope, assumptions, dependencies and value expectations.
  • Design, manage and execute evaluations and pilot projects for potential customers, including API-based prototypes, mobile or web application experiences, and REST API data integrations that retrieve or post data between systems.
  • Develop solution-level business cases by establishing a baseline, identifying measurable benefits and costs, defining assumptions, and estimating value such as revenue growth, cost reduction, risk reduction, productivity improvement or customer experience impact.
  • Partner with customer technology and business teams to map current-state and future-state processes, identify where API-enabled data or capabilities improve the workflow, and define success measures for implementation and adoption.
  • Build long-term business relationships and become a trusted advisor by connecting technology decisions to customer business processes, operating metrics and strategic objectives.
  • Create presentation assets, API-enabled prototypes and interactive product demonstrations; clearly explain both the technical approach and the expected business impact to technical and non-technical audiences; participate in conferences and events, including speaking and technical demonstrations, to generate leads.
  • Understand customer needs and business processes to advise product development teams on roadmap capabilities that are not currently available; provide leadership visibility into future-state requirements, integration needs, implementation effort, adoption considerations and potential value based on customer interaction and competitive research.
  • Experience or knowledge working with development teams building mobile applications on iOS and Android platforms.
  • Familiarity with Swift, Kotlin, Xcode, Android Studio, and modern mobile development frameworks.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs, SDKs, cloud services, and backend data platforms.
  • Understanding mobile application deployment, observability, security, and performance best practices.
  • Strategic sales and consultative discovery skills to evaluate customer requirements, business processes, technical constraints and value drivers to determine Arity product fit.
  • Strong technical fluency in API consumption and integration, including the ability to interpret API documentation, understand request and response structures, work with REST endpoints, and explain GET, POST and related patterns. Experience with API testing tools, mobile or web development, SQL, Python or Scala is valuable.
  • Ability to lead through expertise and influence, navigate organizational dynamics, and align business, product and engineering stakeholders around a practical solution and measurable outcomes.
  • Ability to design, estimate, manage and execute large projects and engagements, both internally and externally, including integration scope, implementation effort, dependencies, risks and expected business value.
  • Expert ability to map current-state and future-state business processes, establish measurable baselines, develop ROI and value models, and quantify expected outcomes such as revenue growth, cost reduction, productivity improvement, risk reduction or customer experience impact.
  • Strong oral and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate between executive business needs and detailed technical requirements.
  • Ability to build long-term business relationships with customers

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4-year Bachelor's Degree (Minimum)
  • 8 or more years of experience (Preferred)
  • Functional experience in insurance technology, mobility, advertising technology, or another data-intensive industry is strongly preferred.
  • Experience applying technology to business processes, identifying measurable outcomes, and building business cases is a critical component of this role.
  • Experience with API-based data consumption and integration is required, including REST APIs, HTTP methods, authentication, JSON payloads, error handling, API testing, and system-to-system data exchange. Experience with mobile or web application development that consumes APIs to power a user interface is highly valuable. Experience with big data analytics and leading cloud platforms is strongly preferred.

Job.JobTitle: Large Loss Contents Property Adjuster- Field Estimating - Cincinnati/Dayton, OH
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Coordinated Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Coordinated Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will be handling escalated claims files involving complex contents damage to ensure our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these claims.

  • Handle escalated claims files involving complex contents damage.
  • Conduct a thorough coverage investigation of the loss and ensure the policy was applied correctly.
  • Use advanced video technology to collaborate with onsite vendors to identify damages and write a contents damage estimate.
  • Communicate empathetically with customers and help them through their claim process in a fast, fair, and easy manner.
  • Negotiate claim settlements with customers in accordance with business unit standard methodologies.
  • Coordinate with structure and ALE adjusters to ensure holistic handling of the claim file.
  • Use data and analytics to tell a story and influence decision making.
  • If offered the role, you will go through virtual training. You will receive ongoing support, mentoring and coaching as you develop your career.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Schedule:

  • Monday Friday; 8 am - 5 pm with rotational weekend duty, Saturday or Sunday.
  • This role involves taking care of customers in their times of need. As a result, you must be willing to work some weekend and extended hours if necessary.

PreferredQualifications:

  • Reside in Cincinnati/Dayton, OH area.
  • 3+ years of previous experience handling property insurance claims preferred.
  • Have prior experience using estimating software like Xactimate for complex contents estimating.
  • Value providing an effortless customer service experience.
  • You enjoy the ability to work independently in the field or from your home office.
  • View problems and setbacks as opportunities for improvement and look forward to coming up with creative solutions.
  • Are organized and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
  • Are known for clear and professional communication both written and verbal.

Required Qualifications:

  • Required to have a valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.
  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership teamdeterminesthis based on annual work mileage for this location. You maybe requiredto use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:
  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit: www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job Description

**For this opportunity, the business is flexible to hire at Senior Consultant, Lead Consultant, and Expert level depending on qualifications & interview evaluation.**

The Senior Data Protection Security Engineer will lead the evolution of enterprise data protection from a traditional tool administration model to an engineering-driven security capability. This role is responsible for building scalable, automated, and measurable data protection solutions across cloud, SaaS, endpoint, email, and collaboration environments using Policy-as-Code, Security-as-Code, DevOps, and DevSecOps practices.

The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of modernizing Data Protection, DLP, CASB, or Information Protection programs by reducing manual processes, increasing automation, and implementing repeatable governance and deployment models. This individual will serve as a key contributor in advancing the organization's data protection strategy while driving operational excellence, security effectiveness, and business enablement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engineer enterprise DLP controls across endpoint, email, SaaS, cloud storage, collaboration platforms, network, and web channels.

  • Modernize DLP policy deployment by moving from manual console-based changes to version-controlled, automated, and repeatable policy-as-code workflows.

  • Build CI/CD pipelines for data protection policy lifecycle management, including peer review, automated validation, testing, approval, deployment, and rollback.

  • Develop reusable policy templates, detection logic, exception patterns, configuration baselines, and deployment standards across multiple DLP and CASB platforms.

  • Automate operational tasks such as policy promotion, configuration drift detection, control validation, reporting, alert enrichment, and recurring health checks.

  • Integrate DLP, CASB, data classification, cloud security, identity, SIEM, SOAR, and workflow platforms to improve visibility, response, and enforcement.

  • Tune detection logic using data-driven analysis to reduce false positives, improve signal quality, and increase confidence in policy enforcement.

  • Design guardrails for sensitive data usage across Microsoft 365, cloud platforms, source code repositories, collaboration tools, SaaS applications, and enterprise endpoints.

  • Partner with engineering, cloud, infrastructure, network, compliance, privacy, legal, and business teams to design practical data protection solutions.

  • Investigate data protection events, identify root cause, recommend control improvements, and convert lessons learned into automated prevention patterns.

  • Define and maintain metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and control evidence that demonstrate risk reduction, policy effectiveness, deployment quality, and operational maturity.

  • Support platform upgrades, capability expansions, vendor integrations, and new data protection control patterns using disciplined engineering practices.


Key Qualifications

  • 4+ years delivering enterprise Data Protection, Information Protection, Cloud Security, or Security Engineering capabilities within complex organizations.

  • Proven experience in Policy-as-Code, Security-as-Code, and DevSecOps methodologies, with a demonstrated ability to automate security control deployment and governance at enterprise scale.

  • Track record of replacing manual operational processes with engineering-driven solutions through automation, APIs, Infrastructure-as-Code, and platform engineering practices.

  • Advanced knowledge of Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data classification, information protection, and data governance principles.

  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Information Protection, Defender for Cloud Apps, and the Microsoft 365 security ecosystem.

  • Comprehensive understanding of cloud, SaaS, CASB, and enterprise data protection architectures.

  • Proficiency in scripting and automation technologies including PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, Terraform, Bicep, YAML, JSON, or comparable tools.

  • Demonstrated success in modernizing Data Protection, DLP, CASB, or Information Protection programs through automation, standardization, and engineering-driven operating models.

  • Proven ability to implement and scale DevOps, DevSecOps, or Platform Engineering practices within security organizations.

  • Track record of leading large-scale security initiatives that improve control effectiveness, operational efficiency, and measurable risk reduction.

  • Background supporting enterprise-scale cloud, SaaS, or Microsoft 365 environments.

  • Knowledge of regulatory, privacy, and compliance requirements and their implementation through scalable technical controls.

Job Description

In this role, you will lead a team of software engineers responsible for designing, building, and delivering the next generation of operational claims systems supporting Allstate Dealer Services. This platform is a strategic investment in the future of the business, enabling more efficient operations, faster service delivery, improved customer experiences, and long-term cost optimization.

As an engineering leader, you will provide technical and people leadership to multiple agile teams responsible for the development, implementation, and support of modern backend services and applications. You will partner closely with product management, architecture, engineering leaders, and business stakeholders to establish technical direction, deliver business outcomes, and cultivate a high-performing engineering culture.

This role is accountable for building and developing engineering talent, ensuring operational excellence, driving delivery commitments, and fostering engineering best practices. You will help shape the long-term technology strategy while creating an environment where teams can innovate, collaborate, and consistently deliver secure, scalable, and reliable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leads and participates in knowledge sharing activities and contributes to the overall growth of the engineering organization through mentoring, coaching, and the promotion of engineering best practices.

  • Participates in product discovery, portfolio planning, and strategic planning activities, providing technical leadership and helping translate business objectives into scalable technology solutions.

  • Leads, coaches, and develops software engineering teams by providing ongoing performance feedback, career development guidance, and growth opportunities.

  • Leads and participates in retrospectives, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and constructive feedback.

  • Partners with architects and technical leaders to establish and evolve the architecture, design, and technical roadmap of products and platforms supporting claims operations.

  • Leads and participates in inception, iteration planning, backlog refinement, and prioritization activities in partnership with Product Managers and business stakeholders.

  • Provides leadership and oversight across agile delivery teams, ensuring alignment on priorities, execution plans, and delivery objectives.

  • Serves as the technical and organizational leader for the team, helping resolve complex technical challenges, removing delivery impediments, and supporting effective decision-making.

  • Champions engineering excellence through the adoption of modern software development practices, including automated testing, code quality standards, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and DevOps principles.

  • Drives operational excellence by ensuring applications are secure, reliable, scalable, and effectively supported in production environments.

  • Collaborates with product, engineering, architecture, security, and business leaders to align technology investments with strategic business objectives.

  • Leads cross-functional and cross-product collaboration efforts to ensure consistency, reusability, and alignment across engineering teams and technology portfolios.

  • Supports workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, and talent management activities to build and maintain high-performing engineering teams.

  • Establishes and monitors key engineering metrics related to delivery, quality, reliability, and team health to drive continuous improvement.

  • Acts as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders, providing thought leadership on modern software engineering practices, cloud platforms, distributed systems, and organizational effectiveness.

Essential Skills

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including experience leading engineering teams delivering enterprise-scale applications and services.

  • Experience managing software engineers within Agile development environments.

  • Strong understanding of modern software architecture, microservices, distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native applications, and DevOps practices.

  • Experience delivering solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and related enterprise technologies.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and engineering delivery processes.

  • Experience supporting applications in production environments with a focus on reliability, observability, and operational excellence.

  • Strong leadership, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience leading technical planning, estimation, prioritization, and execution activities.

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, coach, and retain engineering talent.

  • Experience working closely with Product Management and business stakeholders to deliver customer-focused solutions.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience leading teams developing enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices architectures.

  • Experience managing engineers responsible for distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and high-volume transactional applications.

  • Experience with modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Kubernetes-based environments.

  • Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including object-oriented design, domain-driven design, API-first development, and secure coding principles.

  • Experience establishing and managing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, infrastructure automation, and DevOps practices.

  • Experience with messaging and event streaming technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar platforms.

  • Experience with modern data technologies, including relational databases, NoSQL databases, and data integration patterns.

  • Experience leading application modernization efforts, including monolith-to-microservice transformations and cloud migration initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of application observability, monitoring, logging, performance tuning, reliability engineering, and production support practices.

  • Demonstrated success building and leading Agile engineering teams while balancing technical excellence, delivery commitments, and organizational objectives.

  • Experience partnering with Product Management, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders to define technology roadmaps and deliver strategic business outcomes.

  • Experience within claims, insurance, warranty services, financial services, or other highly regulated industries preferred.

Experience

Universal Horror Unleashed is a terrifyingly unique experience that will bring haunts to Las Vegas year-round. Located at Area 15 is the heart of horror we would love to have you haunting alongside us! With the nature of this experience comes a unique working environment. You will find yourself working in dark environments around special effects including strobe lights, fog, artificial smells, and more. The working hours will be unique, typically spanning over late evenings/nights and weekends (holidays included). This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, and a variety of other discounts and perks.

JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for all aspects of exercise physiology and occupational health for the operation at Universal Horror Unleashed as it pertains to injury prevention, creating structured, goal-oriented, individualized programs designed to facilitate injury prevention and recovery processes. The role will understand the action and posture of Team Members inclusive of performance during the show and facility operations. Supports the assessment of the risk associated with the expected postures and movements. This role will also provide professional instruction to Performers for auditions, rehearsals, training, workshops, pre-show warm-ups and post-show stretching. Additionally, supports Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) activities, including basic safety training, safety inspections, hazard identification, safety walks, incident documentation, and follow-up on corrective actions.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identifies roles/tasks which pose a risk to Team Member health due to ergonomic and performance related hazards, using established ergonomic and other risk assessment tools. Provides mitigation guidance using the hierarchy of controls to include blocking, task configuration, repetitive postures/movements/forces, wardrobe/ costuming, material handling equipment, etc.
  • Develops fitness level parameters and specific training/work hardening programs for each identified at risk role/task in coordination with Entertainment Management and EHS. Evaluates individual fitness levels of each Team Member in these roles against established criteria parameters for the position.
  • Develops and oversee personalized exercise prescriptions and injury prevention training relating to speed, agility and strength as it relates to the job function with an overall focus on injury prevention and meeting the job parameters. Provides guidance and consultation on fitness, diet and health as well as instruction on the correct use of exercise equipment. Works with Entertainment Management to ensure equipment is appropriate, safe, and in proper working order.
  • Strictly adheres to and actively promotes all established UHU and Universal medical protocols, policies, procedures and Standing Orders while performing duties.
  • Examines and treats all Team Members injuries and illness according to company policies and procedures while using sound judgement based on established industry practice. Escalates first aid triage to UHU leadership to determine next level of occupational health intervention.
  • Provides timely and accurate documentation for each Team Member; documenting the appropriate assessment and treatment plans and maintaining the appropriate paperwork and electronic files.
  • Assists with EHS training and may provide basic EHS training to Team Members and leaders using established EHS policies, procedures, and training materials.
  • Supports the Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) program through completion of safety inspections, hazard identification activities, safety walks, incident documentation, and follow-up on corrective actions to promote a safe working environment.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY

  • Individual Contributor

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.

QUALIFICATIONS:  To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Experience with injury prevention and the development of structured, individualized fitness or recovery programs.
  • Experience working with high-caliber performers, artists, or athletes is preferred.
  • Understanding of exercise progression and preventive fitness practices is preferred.
  • Ability to assess situations, exercise sound judgment within established protocols, and escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Ability to meet daily departmental operational needs while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, care, and ethics.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, customer service, organizational, follow-through, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Ability to learn basic EHS, training, document-management, and incident-reporting systems.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • Nevada state certifications are required, including CPR/AED. Personal Trainer certification is preferred.
  • Obtain a non-gaming work card. 

EDUCATION

  • Bachelors Degree in Exercise Physiology or Science, or Athletic Training is required.

EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years in exercise physiology, fitness programming, or related physical fitness experience is required, experience working with athletes or performers is preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Partner with Sr. Manager of Marketing & Sales and various internal members to support, coordinate, and execute various sales initiatives to achieve the departments set objectives for Universal Horror Unleashed. Includes regular development of business summary reports, communication with cross functional teams and logistics coordination. Ability to communicate effectively and efficiently with sales clients. Actively train client employees in selling behavior and techniques. This role is responsible for qualified leads and conversations for our local timeshare offerings through targeted outreach channels. This role blends hospitality, relationship building, and sales support and executionengaging with existing owners, concierge partners, local colleges, and military bases.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Work with Sr. Manager to identify and qualify sales, promotional, pricing, and other opportunities to increase ticket sales and share of accounts with contracted clients through direct sales calls via phone and face to face. Collaborate with Manager to support sales volume and associated revenue objectives based on account business model, segment and buying /selling process.
  • Conduct face to face meetings with clients to grow partnership levels and working relationships with local concierge, resort front desk teams, tourism and military partners.
  • Support the coordination, development, and facilitation of FAMS, incentives, and product knowledge training for clients of Universal Horror Unleashed. Assist with sales collateral for UHU.
  • Continue to be well-versed in all Universal Horror Unleashed product offerings, procedures, and policies. Stay informed about local market trends, competitive offerings, and sales opportunities. Participate in ongoing training, internal briefings, and product updates to ensure accurate and current knowledge is applied in all client interactions.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in a related field, or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years of sales experience in the Las Vegas hospitality and/or event industry; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • LVMPD Non-Gaming Work Card.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Will require some domestic travel.
  • Ability to work nights and weekends as determined by business needs.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Exceptional communication and presentational skills.
  • Technical acumen to effectively navigate point-of-sale and CRM systems including Salesforce, Delphi/Amadeus (Space Management/BEO), and Horizon/SAP POS/ticketing system is desirable.
  • Knowledge and experience working in the Las Vegas hospitality and/or event industry.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and Outlook.
  • Uses sound judgment and escalates matters as appropriate.
  • Ability to review sales information and support reporting needs.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Our Systems Specialists participate in the installation, startup, and commissioning of building automation system equipment that has been newly installed and supports the verification of the system database and programming, ensuring consistency with the scope of work and sequence of operations. Our Systems Specialists are the face of Siemens, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customer will help them save energy and money, as well as create a more sustainable future for our environment. THIS POSITION REQUIRES 75% TRAVEL.


As a Systems Specialist, you will:

  • Commission new distributed digital control systems on construction sites within planned timelines. Documents commissioning details; communicates deficiencies and progress
  • Plan work with Lead Technician, and Team Leader
  • Network technologies: Assists with data back-up from data servers and the creation of automated back-up procedures. Supports troubleshooting and resolution of inconsistencies in the functions or sequence of operations. Assists with the set-up and configuration of PC workstations and user interfaces
  • Support the confirmation of proper network performance
  • Operational testing, verification, and acceptance: Runs routine reports to review system operation. Participates in final inspection and testing. Supports customer acceptance. Assists with customer training on system operations
  • Complete and submit routine written reports. Provides plans and control system documents to engineering for as-built drawings
  • Project site communication and coordination: May support others in the scheduling of trade contractors to coordinate startup services. Submits accurate time and expense reports
  • Work overtime when needed (Compressed schedule performance can be a factor and will require extended hours to meet commitments)
  • Work rotational on-call and/or minimal overnight travel
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures. Ability to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of experience installing and servicing electronic control or HVAC equipment
  • DDC (Direct Digital Controls) experience (either in a previous role or through education) and user PC/software skill
  • On-the-job experience reading, understanding, and interpreting design and construction documents
  • Ability and willingness to work in a variety of circumstances including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high lift equipment, working in ducts, crawl spaces, roofs, basements, above ceilings, and in various conditions
  • Must be able and willing to use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet as well as carrying and moving equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook)
  • Ability and willingness to work overtime as needed
  • Ability to travel 75% of the time
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate or Bachelor's degree in electronics, mechanical engineering, or related

Job.JobTitle: Specialty Vehicle Technical Lead - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

Responsible for training, mentoring, quality control, and technical assistance of material damage attributed to Specialty Vehicles. Directly handles assigned specialty vehicle material damage claims generally of a complex nature.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Handles complex material damage claims with little or no supervision

  • Conducts Training in areas of Specialty Vehicle material damage handling/appraising

  • Is a subject matter expert in areas of Specialty Vehicle material damage for staff and vendors

  • Has and maintains a high level understanding of National General Specialty Vehicle policies.

  • Develops and maintains a basic understanding of the insurance industry and the organizational relationships of the company

  • Able to determine subrogation or fraud potential with Specialty vehicle claims

  • Receive claim assignments and document all appropriate information

  • Review photos thoroughly and determines repairability and complete assessment and or, total loss evaluation

  • Evaluate settlement alternatives by reviewing regulatory compliance and fair claims practices; makes decisions on best option

  • Identify subrogation or fraud potential based upon physical evidence and refer to the appropriate claims representative when potential exists

  • Stay informed of changes in the collision repair industry including statutory and regulatory changes as they relate to specialty vehicle material damage

  • When appropriate, make contact with customers to discuss repair process, repair operations/techniques, settlements, extend an offer to appropriate party; document all file activity and payment/settlement information in file notes clearly outlining basis for settlement

  • Conducts file quality reviews of appraisal channels including staff, independent appraisers, DRP shops, other vendors.

  • Take ownership of any issue, problem, or error that could potentially impact the policyholder and or loss participant

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Specialty Claims staff (field and technicians), other field staff, and Specialty vendors.

  • Complete accurate estimates with little to no supervision up to $300,000

  • Ability to navigate and complete estimates of greater amounts as necessary
