Job.JobTitle: Business Development Underwriter - Dallas Metro Region
Job.JobDescription:
Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of this role is to develop and manage a profitable book of business within assigned line(s) of business, while building and maintaining strong agency relationships and driving production results. Business Development Underwriters are assigned primary underwriting responsibility for specific line(s) of business (e.g., Workers' Compensation or Commercial Package and its component coverages). In addition, this role supports broader Commercial Lines growth by identifying cross-sell opportunities and actively marketing all Company products in coordination with other underwriting partners. This role exists to ensure the Company achieves its underwriting profitability and distribution objectives through disciplined risk selection, pricing, and agency engagement.


Location: This is a remote/field role. Candidates ideally will reside in or near Dallas, Texas or the surrounding metro area or other nearby communities.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Underwriting & Portfolio Management

  • Underwrite, select, and price risks within assigned line(s) of business in accordance with Company guidelines
  • Maintain accountability for the profitability, growth, and retention of assigned portfolio
  • Evaluate risk characteristics including operations, financials, management, and loss history to determine acceptability
  • Apply appropriate pricing, credits/debits, and underwriting judgment to achieve target returns
  • Accept or reject risks within delegated authority while ensuring alignment with underwriting guidelines and profitability objectives
  • Monitor book performance and take corrective action as needed
  • Utilize underwriting authority to effectively price and manage business within assigned line(s)
  • Remain current on regulatory, rating, and coverage changes (e.g., WCIRB/NCCI, ISO/AAIS) impacting assigned line(s) of business

Business Development, Production & Distribution

  • Drive new business production and achieve growth objectives through proactive agency engagement, prospecting, and cross-sell execution
  • Develop, manage, and maintain a producer force capable of generating profitable business
  • Monitor production, quality, and profitability of assigned producers and hold producers accountable to expectations
  • Drive profitable sales of all Company products, including increasing penetration of existing products and supporting new product introductions
  • Actively identify and pursue cross-sell opportunities across all Commercial Lines products, regardless of primary underwriting assignment
  • Promote all Company Commercial Lines offerings in agency interactions, supporting a total account approach
  • Prospect, prequalify, and appoint new producers aligned with Company strategy
  • Set, communicate, and monitor production expectations with agency partners
  • Maintain thorough knowledge of assigned territory, including production sources, competitor activity, and market trends
  • Identify opportunities for growth, new distribution, and market expansion and provide feedback to leadership

Producer & Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary Company contact and representative for assigned and prospective producers
  • Build and maintain collaborative relationships through regular agency visits, meetings, and presentations
  • Provide underwriting and production support, including participation in account strategy and marketing discussions
  • Provide responsive, high-quality service to agents and insureds, resolving inquiries and coverage decisions promptly
  • Maintain consistent communication through in-person visits, calls, and Company technology
  • Present agency performance insights, opportunities, and agency management strategies to internal stakeholders and agency partners

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university with a major or emphasis in Business, Accounting, Statistics, or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 1 year of related experience and/or training required.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Current driver's license required.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with agents and brokers while delivering high-quality customer service
  • Ability to apply fundamental underwriting principles, concepts, and guidelines within assigned line(s) of business
  • Ability to evaluate and interpret submissions, financial information, loss control reports, and policy forms/endorsements
  • Working knowledge of commercial insurance products, including Workers' Compensation and/or Commercial Package and its component coverages (e.g., General Liability, Property, Commercial Auto, Inland Marine)
  • Ability to balance underwriting discipline within assigned line(s) of business with business development, production, and cross-sell expectations across Commercial Lines
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills
  • Ability to analyze risk, identify exposures, and make sound underwriting decisions aligned with Company objectives

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.
  • Role requires 40%-50% travel to meet with clients, attend industry events, and develop new business opportunities.
  • Travel is usually limited to automobile but occasional air travel is required.
  • Requires regular visits to outside locations such as producer's offices.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • This position operates in a home office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier and other standard office equipment.

This description is a general statement of essential job functions and responsibilities.

The position may include other duties as assigned.

WHY JOIN ICW GROUP?

Farmers– where ambition meets opportunity.

Farmers is known for more than its unforgettable jingle – it's a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. Farmers employees deliver peace of mind when it matters most. The organization's results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Here, growth isn't just a goal – it's a way of life for both the organization and every individual on the team. Farmers employees tackle challenges head-on, learn from every experience and measure their impact on the customers who trust them.

Join us and help power the success of Farmers. As a team member, you'll collaborate with Farmers' award-winning workforce, benefit from a culture of innovation and support and contribute to their mission of delivering protection and peace of mind to millions of U.S. customers.

Ready to make your mark? Discover Farmers' vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate.

Job Summary

Workplace: MEXICO - Remote ( #LI-Remote )

We are looking for a Predictive Analytics Manager to join a newly established, high-impact team focused on transforming enterprise decision-making. This team is at the forefront of delivering timely, accurate, and forward-looking financial and operational insights by combining advanced analytics, actuarial concepts, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities.

In this role, you will help build predictive analytics capabilities from the ground up in a fast-paced, “startup-like” environment within a large organization. You will play a key role in designing and implementing data-driven solutions that drive profitable growth, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen business intelligence across the enterprise.

This is an excellent opportunity for a data-driven professional who enjoys autonomy, thrives in ambiguous environments, and wants to influence how analytics is built and scaled.

Requirements

  • Years of experience in predictive analytics, data science, or related field
  • Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field
  • Professional experience in insurance or pricing analytics is a strong plus
  • Strong experience with:
  • Python, R, and SQL
  • Experience with SAS is a plus
  • Advanced knowledge of:
    • Predictive modeling and machine learning techniques
    • Statistical analysis and data mining
    • Data preparation and feature engineering
  • Strong understanding of data ecosystems and ability to navigate complex data environments
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present analytical findings to diverse audiences
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to work independently in a fast-evolving environment

Essential Job Functions

Job Description

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will investigate and evaluate homeowners property claims from start to finish. You will confirm the facts of loss, determine coverage, assess damages, and negotiate settlements within your assigned authority. In this role, you will manage the entire claim lifecycle, including supplements, Additional Living Expense (ALE) claims, contents, and personal property losses. A key part of this position is delivering excellent customer service through clear, timely communication, keeping customers informed and supported throughout the claims process.

We are seeking an experienced Field Property Adjuster located in Houston, TX or surrounding areas with proficiency in Xactimate and a strong foundation in claims handling, including supplements, ALE, contents and full claim ownership. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong organizational skills, a proactive approach, excellent customer service, and the ability to adapt in a fastpaced environment. Experience handling claims in both field and desk settings is strongly preferred. Holds an active adjuster license or possess a license that qualifies for reciprocity in the applicable states is strongly preferred.

Exhibits mastery estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on the most complex 1st party homeowner losses of all severities

Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers

Recommends process improvements

Job.JobTitle: Litigation Attorney - Special Investigations Unit (Remote - New York)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Join the legal frontline and put your litigation and investigative skills to work protecting The Allstate Company against insurance fraud. The ideal candidate for this role will have a passion for combatting fraud against the insurance industry. In this role, you will utilize your litigation and investigative experience to help defend the company against medical and other types of fraud. The successful candidate will be responsible for bringing affirmative actions, including RICO-based litigation, on behalf of the Company. You will apply your well-developed legal writing skills and negotiate a variety of complex matters within the state of New York. This role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by pursuing innovative legal strategies and helping protect the Company from fraudulent activity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the Claims/Special Investigation Unit (SIU) to combat fraudulent claims in No-Fault and other cases.

  • Research, prepare, file, and litigate fraud cases, including RICO and other Affirmative Actions.

  • Develop litigation strategies on legal matters.

  • Review case files and plan resolutions.

  • Draft discovery requests, motions, memorandums, and legal briefs.

  • Prepare for and conduct Depositions and Examinations Under Oath (EUOs).

  • Attend arbitrations, mediations, and trials.

  • Work with expert witnesses in the preparation of, or defense of litigation.

  • Represent the company in court appearances (conferences, hearings) in State and Federal courts.

  • Draft pre-trial and post-trial motions.

  • Negotiate settlements and prepare related documentation.

Education and Licensing

  • Juris Doctorate and active membership in good standing with the New York State Bar

  • Federal Court Admission or the ability to seek admission upon selection for this role

Experience

  • 4 or more years of experience

  • Ability to manage and oversee intermediate-level litigation matters.

  • Legal research and writing skills

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and related computer applications

  • Exercises discretion and maintains confidentiality

  • Demonstrates ethics and integrity

  • Knowledge of legal holds and discovery processes

  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with colleagues on a daily basis

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties

Explore the Benefits of Joining Allstate's Client Legal Services:

    • Exceptional Work-Life Balance:At Allstate, we understand the importance of achieving harmony between work and personal life. Our in-house litigation roles provide more predictable schedules and flexibility, allowing you to excel professionally while enjoying a fulfilling personal life.

    • Holistic Understanding of the Business:As part of the Allstate legal team, you'll gain invaluable insight into our diverse business operations, objectives, and culture. This comprehensive understanding enables you to align legal strategies closely with the company's goals, fostering impactful contributions and strategic partnerships across departments.

    • Direct Client Collaboration:Working in-house at Allstate means collaborating directly with internal stakeholders and business units. This close partnership cultivates deeper client relationships, facilitating a nuanced understanding of their needs and priorities. By providing proactive legal guidance and support, you'll play a pivotal role in driving the company's success.

    • Strategic Influence and Impact:As an integral member of our legal team, you'll have the opportunity to shape strategic decisions and risk management initiatives. Your insights and expertise will inform key business decisions, empowering you to mitigate risks effectively and drive positive outcomes that directly impact Allstate's bottom line.

    • Diverse Legal Challenges:In-house litigation roles at Allstate encompass a broad spectrum of legal work beyond traditional litigation, including regulatory compliance, risk assessment, and dispute resolution. This diversity of challenges ensures continuous professional growth and development, expanding your skill set and enhancing your career trajectory.

    • Professional Growth Opportunities:With ample opportunities for advancement and professional development, you'll have the support and resources you need to reach new heights in your legal career.

#LI-PC1

Cross-Team Collaboration, Defense Litigation, Insurance, Insurance Defense, Investigative Skills, Legal Document Preparation, Legal Investigation, Legal Research, Legal Writing, Litigation, Litigation Strategy, Microsoft Windows Office, Researching, Team Collaboration, Time Management, Torts

Job.JobTitle: Attendant, Ride Operations - Universal Kids Resort
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for the safe operation of attractions, shows, and water and dry play areas at Universal Kids Resort theme park while delivering exemplary Guest service. Ensures Guest service recovery standards are met and policies and procedures are followed. Supports effective teamwork across Operations in support of a seamless Guest experience at Universal Kids Resort.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensures the proper use of safety practices and procedures while operating the attraction, show or play area in addition to opening and closing procedures. In a friendly and professional manner, discreetly screens Guests for ride requirements, special access needs, and ushers Guests as necessary. Loads and unloads ride or show, checks ride restraints and lap bars, provides safety instructions, operates control consoles, dispatches vehicles and observes ride monitors to ensure the safe operation of the attraction. Safely evacuates the ride in accordance with operating procedures.
  • Welcome and engage Guests by delivering themed narrations or story lines and providing attraction or show information/times. Monitors the queue, makes appropriate adjustments and measures attraction wait times. Ensures kid-focused Guest service standards are met and all IBCCES standards are utilized. Assists with Guest flow and crowd control for show capacity and weather conditions.
  • Maintains a clean and safe work environment by constantly monitoring the immediate area and/or surroundings. Responsible for ensuring a neat and organized work area, trash removal and keeping the area free of debris to include the proper maintenance of equipment and/or props.
  • Supports seasonal and special events at Universal Kids Resort by assisting with arrivals and check-in of event Guests and facilitates movement of groups throughout the park while partnering with other departments for a seamless Guest experience. Assists with projects, initiatives and sustainment efforts as directed.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Must be able to work a flexible and varying schedule based on business needs.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment and operate ride vehicles and moving machinery.
  • Regularly required to ride the attraction/ride to ensure show quality and that special effects are in the proper working order including lighting, sound, animatronics and general maintenance.
  • Responsible for evacuating the attraction/ride and assisting Guests through various evacuation methods.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Previous theme park experience or hospitality is preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Universal is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Universal Kids Resort via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from Universal Kids Resort HR/Recruitment will be deemed the sole property of Universal Kids Resort. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Universal Kids Resort as a result of the referral or through other means.

Job.JobTitle: Commercial Lines Rater - Insurance Company - REMOTE
Job.JobDescription:
Put your Insurance Experience to work – FROM HOME!

At WAHVE, we value significant insurance experience and want to revolutionize the way people think about phasing into retirement by offering qualified candidates the opportunity to continue their career working from home. As we say – retire from the office but not from work.  Our unique platform provides you with real work/life balance and allows you to choose a full or part-time work schedule while continuing to utilize your insurance expertise in a remote, long-term position which includes company benefits!

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WAHVE

We created a welcoming place to work with friendly and professional leadership. We are known for the great care we take with our staff and our clients. We are passionate and determined about delivering the best customer service, preserving insurance industry knowledge, and making a difference by the work that we do.

WHAT WE ARE SEEKING

We have assignments available to help our Property & Casualty insurance carrier clients in Commercial Lines Rater and Rating Technician positions.  Responsibilities include:

  • Perform required support functions for Underwriting. Tasks may include ordering MVR's, inspections and reviews, financial reports, calculating / building cost estimates and other similar tasks as requested.
  • New business submission clearance, data entry of new business submission information and Broker of Record requests.
  • Process new business and renewal related transactions in a timely manner. Transactions may include, but not limited to, quoting, rating, or pricing revisions, policy issuance, endorsements, premium audits, cancellations, and reinstatements for multiple commercial lines of business.  
  • Work with underwriters and other functional areas to resolve any discrepancies.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of a quality product to be delivered to a company's customers.

TO BECOME A WORK-AT-HOME VINTAGE EXPERT, WE REQUIRE

  • 25 years of full-time work experience
  • 10 most recent years of Commercial Lines Property & Casualty insurance carrier experience

BENEFITS OF BECOMING A WAHVE VINTAGE EXPERT

  • Health insurance based on eligibility.
  • 401(k) with a 4% match based on eligibility.
  • Voluntary Dental, Vision, Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D).
  • Retire from the office but not from work.
  • Eliminate the office stress and the commute.
  • Choose the work you would like to do now.
  • Available in either full or part-time schedules.
  • Utilize your years of insurance industry knowledge.
  • Be part of our dynamic yet virtual team environment and connect with other experienced insurance professionals like yourself!

HOW TO GET STARTED

WE LOOK FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!

Job.JobTitle: Project Technical Lead - Mission-Critical Grid Software
Job.JobDescription:
Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are seeking a Project Technical Lead to drive the turnaround of a critical Grid Software initiative facing governance issues, technical challenges, and demanding expectations. This is a strategic leadership position requiring someone who can diagnose system problems, implement governance despite objections, and proactively partner with the Project Managers and Team Leads to build customer and team trust.

This is remote role within the contiguous U.S. requiring collaboration with U.S. colleagues in Central and Eastern time zones while providing global support across time zones up to 7 hours ahead of Eastern time.

We prefer that the person hired into this role be local to the Twin Cities to meet in person with our Minnetonka team—but this is preference, not a requirement.

You'll make an impact in these areas:

  • Strategic Leadership and Root Cause Analysis:
    • Diagnose root causes of underperformance (currently internal completion challenges) and implement systemic solutions, not quick fixes
    • Design and implement governance frameworks despite objections
    • Use data-driven decision making to drive improvements in sprint predictability and completion rates
  • Change Management and Resistance Handling:
    • Drive process changes by weighing objections and building trust within the team
    • Facilitate and redirect meetings independently when derailed
    • Influence without authority – build consensus while holding firm on critical governance principles
  • Technical Collaboration and Orchestration:
    • Leverage technical team leads effectively to manage complex Energy Market Management System architecture – you cannot be the technical expert on everything
    • Build technical contingency buffers to protect against infrastructure outages and blockers
    • Address chronic estimation inaccuracy through improved planning and risk management
    • Work effectively with technical experts – building trust within the team
  • Customer-Facing Leadership and PM Collaboration (CRITICAL):
    • PROACTIVELY partner with the Project Manager (not reactive)
    • Align with the project manager and take co-ownership of the successful execution of the project
      • Anticipate PM needs and provide clear technical input, options, and arguments for customer discussions WITHOUT being asked
      • Identify and mitigate technical risks BEFORE they become critical issues affecting customers
    • Navigate communication challenges: varying technical knowledge levels, and differences in communication styles
    • Explain complex technical topics pragmatically and simply to diverse customer collaborators
    • Build customer trust through transparency about risks and challenges, realistic expectation management, and consistent follow-through on commitments
    • Manage expectations realistically, discussing trade-offs, and communicating proactively about risks
    • Serve as credible technical voice in customer meetings, presenting options with pros/cons for decisions, bringing to bear subject matter experts within the team as necessary

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required –with a preference for majors in computer science, computer engineering, information technology, electrical engineering, or physics (master's degree preferred)
  • 5+ years in technical project leadership within software development, with at least 3 years in mission-critical or grid software systems (EMM, EMS, ADMS, SCADA, or similar)
  • Ability to travel 25% (including up to three months at a time of international travel outside of the U.S.)
  • Process Expertise:
    • Experience implementing governance frameworks
    • Experience managing meeting derailment independently
    • Experience with SCRUM
  • Customer-Facing and PM Partnership (CRITICAL):
    • Proven experience proactively partnering with Project Managers or Account Managers to realistically manage customer expectations
    • Track record of building customer trust
  • Leadership and Influence:
    • Ability to influence customers, senior leadership, and technical experts to change culture
    • Experience working effectively with and leading team members
    • Strong partner management skills – managing UP (to Engineering Manager) ACROSS (to PM, team leads), and DOWN (to team)
  • Must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization
  • Must be able to pass customer background check.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Managing Engineer (C#/ASP.NET) leads a team of software engineers while actively participating in the design, development, testing, and support of enterprise applications built with C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, and modern web technologies. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for balancing people leadership, technical leadership, and individual technical contributions to support strategic technology initiatives for Allstate's Individual Health business.

The Managing Engineer partners closely with Product Managers, Architects, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions while fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. In addition to managing and developing engineers, this role is expected to contribute code, participate in technical design decisions, perform code reviews, and help resolve complex technical challenges.

The internal job title for this role is Software Engineer Associate Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of software engineers.

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise applications using C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, and related technologies.

  • Contribute production-ready code and actively participate in feature development and system enhancements.

  • Review code and provide technical guidance to engineering team members.

  • Participate in iteration planning, backlog refinement, and Agile ceremonies.

  • Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

  • Lead technical design discussions and architectural decision-making.

  • Ensure the delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions.

  • Establish and maintain continuous integration and continuous delivery practices.

  • Support production applications, troubleshoot issues, and lead root cause analysis activities.

  • Collaborate with Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and Data teams to align solutions with enterprise standards.

  • Promote engineering best practices, test automation, code quality, and continuous improvement.

  • Monitor delivery commitments, operational metrics, and team performance.

  • Foster knowledge sharing, talent development, and technical growth across the team.

Essential Qualifications

  • 5 years or more of experience developing enterprise applications using ASP.NET and C#. (Or equivalent)

  • 1 year or more of experience leading or managing software engineers. (Or equivalent)

  • Experience actively designing, developing, and supporting production software applications.

Job.JobTitle: Field Property Adjuster - MA - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will investigate and evaluate homeowners property claims from start to finish. You will confirm the facts of loss, determine coverage, assess damages, and negotiate settlements within your assigned authority. In this role, you will manage the entire claim lifecycle, including supplements, Additional Living Expense (ALE) claims, contents, and personal property losses. You will work closely with customers, contractors, and other partners to ensure claims are handled accurately and efficiently.

A key part of this position is delivering excellent customer service through clear, timely communication, keeping customers informed and supported throughout the claims process.

We are seeking an experienced Field Property Adjuster located in preferably in the central or eastern parts of Massachusetts either. With proficiency in Xactimate and a strong foundation in claims handling, including supplements, ALE, contents and full claim ownership. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong organizational skills, a proactive approach, excellent customer service, and the ability to adapt in a fastpaced environment. Experience handling claims in both field and desk settings is strongly preferred. Holds an active adjuster license or possess a license that qualifies for reciprocity in the applicable states is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Exhibits mastery estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on the most complex 1st party homeowner losses of all severities

Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers

Interprets regulatory compliance and fair claims practices

Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files

Applies mastered content in interpretations of all policy types written by the company and assists leadership in formal and ad hoc training

Recommends process improvements

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.

Job Description

The Container Platform Technical Digital Product Manager will define, deliver, and manage the lifecycle of the Container Platform as part of the strategic Platform as a Service portfolio. This role owns product vision, discovery, roadmaps, and backlog prioritization to maximize the value delivered by the platform. Successful Product Managers identify assumptions, validate them through product discovery techniques, and translate insights into measurable outcomes. The Container Platform Digital Product Manager will build strong relationships with stakeholders and partners to support Allstates Kubernetes-based container platform across data centers, AWS, and Azure cloud environments.

The Container Platform product team integrates a wide variety of vendor and open-source technologies to create a self-healing, scalable, secure container platform. The platform delivers a consistent, frictionless hosting experience so digital products can thrive without boundaries. Technologies include Kubernetes, networking, DNS, servers, load balancers, service mesh, Flux, image management, CI/CD tools, scripts, YAML, Terraform Enterprise, security tooling, and related platform capabilities.

The Digital Product Manager role is highly technical and hands-on.

Digital Product Managers actively contribute to a learning culture by coaching and mentoring product teams, stakeholders, and peers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create, drive and execute product strategy for our expanding Kubernetes container platform.
  • Create and execute a comprehensive product roadmap that prioritizes platform features, enhancements, and measurable outcomes.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define success criteria, validate assumptions, and understand platform and digital product team needs.
  • Navigate complex container technologies, leveraging insights to inform product decisions.
  • Decompose complex problems into manageable work items and prioritize them based on value, risk, and stakeholder impact.
  • Develop and execute internal and external communication strategies that increase product awareness, adoption, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Define and manage metrics to measure the success of your efforts and to inform the overall product strategy.
  • Engage in discovery/test & learn activities to quickly validate assumptions and product direction.
  • Own and drive lifecycle management ensuring all stack components are regularly updated meeting vulnerability management standards without impacting hosted applications.
  • Manage your product backlog balancing feature delivery with lifecycle management to reduce operational and security risks.

Essential Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant new product or technology development experience working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with Platform as a Service or container orchestration software across multiple Kubernetes distributions, such as RKE2, EKS, AKS, or GKE.
  • Basic understanding of Kubernetes container platform concepts and experience executing kubectl commands.
  • Solid understanding of and experience with cloud services across multiple cloud service providers.
  • Solid understanding of infrastructure-as-code and immutable infrastructure concepts.
  • Clear passion for topics of technology products and an ability to identify possibilities to innovate in our product space.
  • Experience operating in an environment driven by KPIs where you have the accountability to determine the best course of action to meet your goals.
  • Ability to communicate complex and innovative concepts to a new product development team.
  • Proficiency in agile ceremonies and methodologies i.e. iterations, technical story writing, point systems and refinements.
  • Effectively lead and collaborate across boundaries with technical and non-technical resources to implement decisions and/or initiatives.
  • Excellent written/verbal communication and facilitation skills for communicating at all levels (employees and leaders); including strong presentation skills.
  • Strong interpersonal, analytical, time management and organizational skills.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and able to independently drive resolution of issues and challenges.
  • Ability to be self-directed and to proactively anticipate problems and seek opportunities.

Desirable Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of API development, API testing, and basic SQL database queries.
  • Entrepreneurial, action-oriented mindset, preferably with experience shipping software.
  • Experience working on projects that successfully leverage continuous integration and continuous delivery.

Teams typically work EST in order to collaborate with global partners.

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Knoxville, TN
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

This is a field adjuster role in Knoxville, TN area


A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on all property claims types, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

Previous experience in construction estimating or as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.

Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof.

Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.JobTitle: Auto Field Appraiser - Greensboro, NC - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

Responsible for creating or auditing a comprehensive estimate of damages for 1st and 3rd party material damage claims in either the auto or specialty lines leading to the proper disposition. Responsible for training, mentoring, controlling quality and providing technical assistance on material damage claims.

Looking for a role where your expertise makes a difference every day? National General is seeking a Field Auto Appraiser to support customers throughout the claims process by inspecting vehicle damage, preparing repair estimates, and delivering fair, accurate, and timely claim resolutions. This is an opportunity to work independently, leverage your estimating expertise, and build strong relationships with customers, repair facilities, and business partners throughout the Greensboro, NC territory. The ideal candidate will possess strong auto damage estimating experience, proficiency with CCC ONE or similar estimating software, experience negotiating repairs and supplements with collision repair facilities, and the ability to effectively manage an assigned territory while delivering an exceptional customer experience.


Responsible for investigating, evaluating, and resolving auto physical damage claims through vehicle inspections, damage estimation, settlement negotiation, and customer communication to support accurate and timely claim resolution.

Skills

Auto Insurance Claims, CCC ONE, Critical Thinking, Negotiation, Quality Management, Time Management

Compensation

Looking for a role where your expertise makes a difference every day? National General is seeking a Field Auto Appraiser to support customers throughout the claims process by inspecting vehicle damage, preparing repair estimates, and delivering fair, accurate, and timely claim resolutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong auto damage estimating experience, proficiency with CCC ONE or similar estimating software, experience negotiating repairs and supplements with collision repair facilities, and the ability to effectively manage an assigned territory while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Possesses strong estimating fundamentals in order to create or audit estimates of damages on 1st and 3rd party material damage losses of all severities

Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files across multiple lines

Job.JobTitle: Large Loss Contents Property Adjuster - Las Vegas, NV
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Large Loss Contents Property Adjuster:

  • You will be traveling to customers home to inspect large loss contents claims.
  • Handle escalated claims files that have complex contents.
  • Conduct a thorough coverage investigation of the loss and ensure the policy was applied correctly.
  • You will be on site inspecting as well as using advanced video technology to collaborate with onsite vendors to identify damages and write a contents damage estimate.
  • Communicate empathetically with customers and help them through their claim process in a fast, fair and easy manner.
  • Negotiate claim settlements with customers in accordance with business unit standard methodologies.
  • Coordinate with structure adjusters to ensure holistic handling of the claim file.
  • Use data and analytics to tell a story and influence decision making.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience using estimating software like Xactimate for complex contents estimating.
  • 3+ years of experience handling large loss property contents.
  • Value providing an effortless customer service experience.
  • You enjoy the ability to work independently starting your day from home.
  • View problems and setbacks as opportunities for improvement and look forward to coming up with creative solutions.
  • Are organized and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
  • Are known for clear and professional communication both written and verbal.

Required Qualifications:

  • Must have a valid drivers license.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

  • The first approximately eight weeks of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.
  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.
  • You willbe requiredto attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing anadditionalbackground check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you willbe requiredto secure license(s) within60 daysof hire.
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license mustterminateall existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license wheninstructed toby the licensing team. Byproceedingwith the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree tocomply.

Sign On Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.
  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

  • Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.JobTitle: AVP, Senior Underwriting Officer, Large Construction
Job.JobDescription:
Description

You'll work with some of the largest and most complex construction risks in the country, delivering primary casualty coverage (workers' compensation, general liability, auto) for annual practice and wrap-up programs. This role focuses on our Large Construction portfolio, which serves many of the largest contractors in the US, backed by more than 100 years of construction underwriting experience and deep OCIP and CCIP program expertise.

You'll partner with the leadership team, bring deep technical expertise to the table, and serve as the go-to point of contact for frontline underwriting teams on questions, key decisions, and referrals. You'll also help shape and carry out portfolio strategies that keep performance strong and moving in the right direction.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide expert technical underwriting guidance and formal referral approval across multiple lines of business (auto, general liability, workers' compensation, and lead/excess) in Large Construction. Work independently with field underwriters and directly with underwriting managers on mandatory referrals and voluntary consultations.
  • Keep primary casualty and excess placements aligned and consistent, including across owner-controlled and contractor-controlled wrap-up programs (OCIP/CCIP) where the entire job site is covered under one consolidated program. Support leadership on transactions and act as a trusted advisor on exposure, coverage analysis, and key pricing and financial decisions within your authority.
  • Monitor the frameworks that guide underwriting decisions, such as referrals and technical reviews, and recommend improvements. Regularly evaluate portfolio performance in Large Construction, working with underwriting leaders to spot what's driving results, risks, and opportunities.
  • Drive underwriting technical excellence across Large Construction, partnering with underwriting leaders to identify and resolve issues.
  • Work with underwriting leaders to spot opportunities for product and service improvements and underwriter development, such as new skills or tools, and coordinate the resources to make them happen.
  • Model strong collaboration across teams, stakeholders, and partners, including underwriting support, claims, actuarial, and NA product teams.

  • Build and maintain relationships with key brokers and reinsurance/facultative partners. Join customer meetings, stewardship discussions, and new business presentations as needed.

Qualifications
  • Expert-level knowledge of all aspects of coverage forms, exclusions, and exposure.
  • Pricing, structure, rating, rating plans, loss forecasting, credit risk, market knowledge, preferred.
  • Advanced knowledge of and experience operating within several different industry segments experience with and knowledge of Construction programs key; insurance operations; claims, finance and actuarial concepts; regulatory environment; loss control/risk engineering; reinsurance; account management; product development; and industry trends.
  • Must be a skilled collaborator who is willing to assess all sides of an issue, bring in others with expertise, and independently execute and advance the collaboration model.
  • Other professional skills required include: superior communication skills (written, verbal, presentation, listening); approachability; tact; coaching/development; analyzing and problem solving; relationship and service driven; clear solutions orientation and commitment to achieving segment operational and financial objectives; negotiation skills; and demonstrated ability to consistently and positively influence others both internally and externally (brokers/customers) as required.
  • As normally acquired through a related bachelor's degree, 10 or more years of relevant experience that includes underwriting, claims, reinsurance, coaching/developing others, working with brokers/agents and current with market trends and developments.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

Fair Chance Notices

  • California
  • Los Angeles Incorporated
  • Los Angeles Unincorporated
  • Philadelphia
  • San Francisco

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$52,600.00 - $86,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

LOCATON REQUIREMENT: This position services Insureds/Agents in the Northern Virginia and/or Washington, DC area. The selected candidate must reside in or be willing to relocate at their own expense to the assigned territory.

Ideal locations include: Chantilly, VA / Manassas, VA / Arlington, VA / Washington, DC, and surrounding areas.

As an Associate Claim Rep, Outside Property, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage 1st party property claims.

This program is typically 9-12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility.

This position is based remotely with work at residential and commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Review, investigate, and document 1st party property claims under close supervision.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third-party providers.
  • Learn to investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for building damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilizes as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, claimants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • In order to perform the essential functions of this role, acquisition and maintenance of Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification may be required to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements. Generally, required Insurance License(s) must be obtained within three months of starting the role, and ongoing continuing education requirements must be maintained as mandated.
  • This position requires participation in our Catastrophe Response Program, which could include deployment to assist our customers in other states.
  • This position requires the individual to access and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, which is physically demanding requiring the ability to carry, set up and climb a ladder weighing approximately 38 to 49 pounds, walk on roofs, and enter tight spaces (such as attic staircases and entries, crawl spaces, etc.). While specific territory or day-to-day responsibilities may not require an individual to climb a ladder, the incumbent must be capable of safely climbing a ladder when deploying to a catastrophe which is a requirement of the position.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); willingness to learn claims management and estimating software.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrated openness to continuous learning.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED and one year of customer service experience.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Position Location: This role supports our Southeastern region which serves customers throughout the territory. Ideal candidate will reside anywhere within the Southeast region.

*75% travel expected in this role*

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn't just about improving buildings; it's about creating perfect places that improve people's lives.

Transform the everyday with us!

The Building Automation Systems Specialist handles the centralized control of a building's heating, ventilation, air conditioning, lighting, and other systems through a building management system or building automation system (BAS).The objectives of building automation are improved occupant comfort, efficient operation of building systems, reduction in energy consumption and operating costs, and improved life cycle of utilities.


As a Building Automation Systems Specialist, you will:

  • Assist with building automation system startup, ensuring that all systems and components are designed, installed, tested, operated, and maintained according to the operational requirements of the customer.
  • Work well with others, take ownership, be a team player, and act with integrity. This position reports to the local Supervisor and takes direction from a mentor and Lead Technician.
  • Assist with commissioning new Distributed Digital Control System on construction sites. Commissioning is ensuring all systems and components are functioning as required.
  • Document commissioning details; communicate deficiencies and progress.
  • Plan work with mentor, Lead Technician, and Team Leader.
  • Complete commissioning within planned timelines.
  • Submit accurate time-keeping daily and expenses weekly.
  • Work overtime when needed.
  • Able to accommodate in an out of state overnight travel

You will make in impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Electro-mechanical experience (wither from a previous role or through education) and user PC/software skills
  • Must be able to demonstrate the ability to read and understand design and construction documents
  • Must be willing and able to work in a variety of circumstances, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high lift equipment, working in ducts, crawl spaces, roofs, basements, above ceilings, and in outside/inside/heat/cold/day/night conditions
  • Must be able to demonstrate the ability and willingness to differentiate types/colors of wire, use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet and the ability to carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Must be willing and able to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook)
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program

We are seeking a Power Systems Consultant to develop models for power systems elements (such as conventional and renewable generating plants, voltage support devices, etc.), perform model validation, perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for clients such as power producers, independent system operators, and transmission providers to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations. Job responsibilities will include the application of power systems planning principles, simulation and analysis of power system steady state, dynamic, and transient behaviors, development of mathematical models for reliability assessment of electrical networks, and delivery of on-site technical consulting/training services.

This is a remote position based in the Contiguous U.S.

You'll make an impact as you:

  • Drive execution of your assignments, deliver quality results on time and within budget through regular status reporting to satisfy the needs of our customers. The assignments can include steady-state, dynamic and transient analyses of electrical power transmission systems, modeling of renewable and conventional generation facilities and other elements of power systems, relay protection modeling, microgrid studies etc.
  • Create draft reports and presentations with study results for review by senior staff and managers.
  • Demonstrate strong analytical and critical thinking skills with a growth mindset as you participate in training and mentoring opportunities.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering with a focus in Power and Energy Systems and practical experience in using advanced power system analysis tools.
  • We will consider candidates with at least one year of relevant professional experience including engineering internships.

  • Advanced degree MAY be substituted for experience.
  • Ability to travel 10%

Preferred qualifications:

The Emulation Hardware Support Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering emulation hardware support projects across engineering, IT, facilities, and vendor teams. This role ensures emulation platforms are deployed, maintained, upgraded, and supported on schedule, within scope, and with minimal disruption to engineering users.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management skills with hands-on understanding of hardware labs, data center operations, overall Technology and Infrastructure knowledge, and semiconductor emulation environments.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Project & Program Management
    • Own end-to-end project execution for emulation hardware deployments, upgrades, migrations, and decommissions
    • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, and risk registers
    • Coordinate cross-functional teams including Emulation, IT, Facilities, Network, Security, and Vendors
    • Track dependencies, manage change requests, and communicate project status to stakeholders
  • Emulation Hardware & Lab Support
    • Manage support activities for emulation platforms (e.g., Strato product family, Primo-CS product family, ProFPGA-CS product family)
    • Coordinate hardware installs, rack/stack, power, cooling, cabling, and network connectivity
    • Oversee hardware break/fix, RMA processes, and vendor escalations
    • Ensure lab readiness, access control, and compliance with safety and security requirements
  • Infrastructure & Operations
    • Partner with IT teams on OS provisioning, firmware updates, storage, and network integration
    • Support data center and lab migrations (on-prem, colocation, or hybrid environments)
    • Ensure systems meet performance, availability, and reliability expectations
    • Drive standardization and documentation of emulation infrastructure processes
  • Stakeholder & Vendor Management
    • Act as the primary point of contact for emulation hardware support projects
    • Manage relationships with EDA vendors and hardware suppliers
    • Lead regular syncs, issue reviews, and post-mortems
    • Communicate clearly with engineering leadership and end users
  • Process Improvement & Reporting

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!Birmingham, AL

As a Field Property Adjuster, you willprovideexceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide,leveragingvarious platforms and software such as Xactimate andClaimsXVideo Collaboration. Yourexpertisewill be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'llwear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expertyoulllive into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you willaccomplishthat by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youllconfidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies todeterminecoverage.

  • The Effective Communicatoryoulluse phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process.Youllalso incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on theclaimprogress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants,in accordance withall legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solveryoullutilizemultiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, andadditionalsettlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorderyoullprotect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trainedin.Youllaccomplishthis by ensuringtimelyandaccuratedocumentation is completed as you work on each claim.
