Job.JobTitle: Senior Underwriter / Account Executive Officer - Agribusiness
Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$104,000.00 - $171,700.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Agribusiness offers a broad array of property and liability coverages for agricultural entities, such as family farms and ranches, commercial growers, vineyards, and wineries.

The Account Executive Officer (AEO), Agribusiness will partner with agents and brokers to provide coverage for new and renewal business based on customers' needs. This role is seen as a technical resource.

As an AEO, you are decisive, detail-oriented, and know how to build relationships internally and externally to drive results. Your ability to independently assess complex risk and sell our products in challenging markets will contribute to the profitability and success of Travelers.

This position is being offered as a work from home opportunity for candidates not local to a Travelers office in the Midwest or Great Lakes Territory.

This position is responsible for partnering with agents and brokers in the Midwest and Great Lakes Territories. All applicants are required to reside within the assigned territory for which this role will be responsible.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned book of business.
  • Underwrite and skillfully negotiate complex customer accounts to minimize risk and maximize profitability.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales plans and identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Foster and maintain relationships with external partners by regularly meeting in person with agents and brokers to market and sell Travelers products with a goal of writing and retaining accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to such meetings.
  • Identify and capture new business opportunities using consultative marketing and sales skills.
  • Independently develop and execute agency sales plans and frequently partner with your Managing Director (MD) to develop region/group sales plans.
  • May assist in the training and mentoring of less experienced Account Executives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Six to eight years of relevant underwriting experience with experience in commercial lines.
  • Deep knowledge of commercial lines products, the regulatory environment, and the local insurance market.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to proactively identify underwriting, marketing, or financial challenges and analyze available information to make timely decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate in difficult situations with agents and brokers.
  • Valid drivers license or alternate means of personal transportation.
  • CPCU designation preferred in some lines of business.

What is a Must Have?

  • Four years of underwriting, claim, operations, risk assessment, actuarial, sales, product, or finance experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Job.JobDescription:
Customer Solution Architect, Chemicals, Glass and Energy - Sales Acceleration

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. As a Customer Solution Architect within Sales Acceleration, supporting the Chemicals, Glass and Energy Sales Teams, you will be a key individual contributor reporting to the Manager of Sales Acceleration, Chemicals, Glass and Energy. You will empower vertical sales teams and customers by driving adoption of Siemens' Digital Industries (DI) portfolio, with a focus on automation and digitalization solutions. This role maximizes solution and product sales by applying the Digital Thread methodology and leveraging the Challenger Sales Approach to deliver meaningful outcomes and accelerate the sales process. You will translate customer insights into effective, cost-efficient solutions that align with the Siemens Sales Engagement Model, serving as a trusted advisor to vertical sales teams and customers.

This position is remote and can be located anywhere in the continental US.

You'll make an impact by:

  • Solution Development & Architecting: Translate complex customer challenges into clear, actionable requirements and work to deliver innovative automation and digitalization solutions that meet their evolving needs.
  • Driving Sales Engagement: Independently drive and apply a Sales Engagement Model with your assigned accounts to achieve the sales acceleration targets.
  • Trusted Advisory: Serve as a primary technical and strategic advisor to customers and internal sales teams, guiding them through the adoption of Siemens' cutting-edge technologies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster strong collaboration with Sales teams, Marketing & Communication, Product Management in the Zone, and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless value delivery and maximize market opportunities.
  • Market & Customer Identification: Identify key and emerging markets and support the definition and identification of target customers across the Digital Industries Automation portfolio nationwide.
  • Assessing portfolio/productmarket fit for the instrumentation portfolio: Having a strong knowledge on process industries is essential as you will own the process of portfolio fit with strategic customer markets that have a high willingness to buy.

You'll win us over by having the following qualiﬁcations:

Basic Qualiﬁcations:

  • 8+ years of proven experience in a technical sales, solution consulting, application engineering, or similar individual contributor role within industrial automation or digitalization
  • Solutions/portfolio expertise and customer positioning knowledge across the Measurement and Instrumentation layer/Level 0 as per ISA 95.
  • Experience working with End Users, primarily in process and energy-oriented industries, such as oil and gas, chemicals, hydrogen, carbon capture, LNG to name a few
  • Technical expertise in Siemens Industrial Automation and Digitalization Portfolio, with a proven track record of applying these technologies to solve complex customer problems
  • Comprehensive knowledge of industrial automation market drivers, trends, and evolving customer needs, particularly in the context of digital transformation
  • Exceptional customer interaction, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a strong customer-centric approach
  • Experience with various project collaboration models and sales processes
  • Excellent verbal, written and time management skills
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically up to 35%, with occasional international travel
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States permanently, without company sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualiﬁcations:

  • 10+ years of proven experience in a technical sales, solution consulting, application engineering, or similar individual contributor role within industrial automation or digitalization
  • Prior experience in developing and deploying customer-facing solutions across multiple channels to market
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • Strategic Agility: Ability to foresee future trends in industrial automation and digitalization, contributing to competitive and breakthrough strategies and plans, and influencing outcomes without direct authority
  • Business Acumen: Deep understanding of business operations and market dynamics, with knowledge of current and future practices, trends, and information impacting the industrial business landscape
  • Organizational Agility: Knows how to get things done through formal and informal networks. Works effectively in a matrix structure to exploit opportunities. Rallies the team behind the right opportunities and initiatives
  • Exceptional Customer Focus: A dedication to understanding and meeting customer needs, leveraging insights to drive continuous improvement in products, solutions, and services
  • High Degree of Professional Ownership: Demonstrate strong personal accountability and take initiative to drive projects to completion, even in large, complex working groups
  • Proven ability to work autonomously and thrive in a remote, virtual work environment

Key components to this position include troubleshooting complex browser and authentication problems with agents; assisting in data gathering (interviewing, document analysis, and group systems development sessions) and data analysis activities; assisting in the development of data and process models; identifying business problems and translates them into information needs; assisting in the definition of technology solutions; preparing analysis, design, and construction documentation; assisting in developing and performing of test scenarios; assisting in the planning for data conversions; participating in developing user documentation and conduction user training; assisting in the Model Office, as needed; providing monthly analysis of performance of various products/functions of e-business; and providing for quality assurance compliance to department procedures and industry standards. In addition, this position will handle other responsibilities as assigned.

Essential Job Functions

TECHNICAL SUPPORT Assist in data gathering (interviewing, document analysis, and group systems development sessions) and data analysis activities. Assist in the development of data and process models Identify business problems and translates them into information needs Assist in the definition of technology solutions Prepare analysis, design, and construction documentation Troubleshoot complex browser and authentication problems with agents TESTING Assist in developing and performing of test scenarios IMPLEMENTATION Assist in the planning for data conversions Participate in developing user documentation and conduction user training Assist in the Model Office, as needed PERFORMANCE MONITORING Provide monthly analysis of performance of various products/functions of e-business Provide for quality assurance compliance to department procedures and industry standards Perform other functions, as assigned.

Physical Environment

High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor's degree preferred. IIA Certificate of Insurance and two years of experience with Farmers/Foremost Specialty or commensurate with the Farmers Group.

Experience Requirements

Four years of experience with the Farmers Group, including experience in one or more of the project subject areas (e.g. Underwriting) with at least two years of experience as an Digital Customer Experience Analyst

Special Skill Requirement

Broad knowledge of Internet Explorer, other browsers and Adobe Acrobat Reader In depth knowledge of ForemostSTAR website and experience using ForemostSTAR Intermediate knowledge in Specialty Lines products and processing systems Broad knowledge of various agency management systems High level PC and internet skills including terminology and file downloading Intermediate skill level with MS office applications

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Job Summary

Analyzes, researches and consults on a variety of internal and external business information in support of planning and decision-making. Responsible for the development, maintenance, and distribution of timely and accurate reports for supported areas. Manages assigned ad hoc projects of a medium level of complexity using multiple data resources.

Essential Job Functions

Responsible for assigned projects that are critical to the business needs of the department/division. Handles all aspects of managing a project including researching, developing, planning, implementing (where applicable) and evaluating. Responsible for the development, analysis, maintenance, and distribution of reports for assigned departments. Prepares and presents information to introduce changes and new concepts and provides training as needed. Maintains and produces extensive reports as assigned. Works directly with clients to incorporate modifications as requested (i.e., production, licensing, and budget reports.) Resolves assigned ad hoc requests by writing or modifying simple queries and compiling the resulting information into reports, graphs or charts that can be used by supported areas to make informed business decisions. Assists in the maintenance of the processes, programs, databases, and other technical resources used to provide staff and management with efficient online access to forms, documents, and other information / tools necessary to service customers. May assist in the development / processing of change requests that impact technology, reporting, space / equipment, etc. for the assigned business unit(s). Provides research and consultative services to supported areas and offers recommendations that may result in gained efficiencies and improved productivity. Assists in the design and develop development of flowcharts of existing and proposed procedures / processes. Provides verbal or written status of assigned projects to all involved parties including, but not limited to, clients, outside accounts, and vendors. Schedules personal workflow to allow time for completion and follow through of assigned projects to ensure all requirements are met in a timely, controlled and quality manner. Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomic standards as outlined in relevant company published manuals. Performs other duties as assigned.

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Detroit, MI
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Reside within the greater metropolitan Detroit, MI area.

  • 2-3 years previous experience as outside adjuster is highly desired.

  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating preferred.

  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

Required Qualifications:

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on either a one to two-story roof.

  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job

** Please note, you will be required to attend 2-weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX **

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.

  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign On Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

#LI-DL1

Active Listening, Communication, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Empathy, Insurance Claims, Multitasking, Organizing, Working Independently, Xactimate

Job.JobTitle: Property Field Adjuster Farm & Ranch - Wyoming - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

As the Field Property Adjuster you are responsible for investigating and confirming the facts of loss for the most complex Homeowner's Claims. Determines coverage, damages and otherwise adjusts and negotiates claims within limit of authority. Responsible for creating a comprehensive estimate of damages for the most complex first party homeowner claims leading to the proper disposition. This role is utilized as peer mentor and may assign direction to more junior employees, having mastered our processes and obtained technical expertise

We are seeking a motivated and customer-focused Property Field Adjuster to join our team. The ideal candidate will reside in Wyoming, preferably near Laramie, Platte, Fremont or Campbell county and will play a key role in helping customers navigate the claims process with confidence and care.


In this role, you will investigate and manage moderate to complex residential property claims, as well as farm and ranch claims, through a combination of on-site inspections and virtual claim handling. The successful candidate will possess strong estimating skills, proficiency with Xactimate, and the ability to effectively manage challenging situations while delivering an exceptional customer experience. Experience handling agricultural, farm, and ranch claims is highly preferred.


If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy working independently, and are passionate about helping customers during critical moments, we'd love to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Exhibits mastery estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on the most complex first party homeowner losses of all severities
  • Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers
  • Interprets regulatory compliance and fair claims practices
  • Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files
  • Applies mastered content in interpretations of all policy types written by the company and assists leadership in formal and ad hoc training
  • Recommends process improvements


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

  • Identifies potential risk exposures and formulates strategic recommendations to mitigate identified risks.
  • Analyzes loss data to identify trends and implements tailored loss prevention programs.
  • Provides advanced technical guidance and conducts training for clients on safety practices and regulatory compliance.
  • Delivers joint marketing presentations in collaboration with underwriting, claims, and sales to accounts and agents.
  • May have responsibility for coaching of staff.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

#LI-Remote

Completion of or continuing progress toward a professional designation preferred, such as Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Associate in Risk Management (ARM), Certified Fire Protection Specialist (CFPS), Certified Safety and Health Management (CSHMS), Associate Loss Control Management (ALCM) or Occupational Health and Safety Technician (OHST).

Job.JobTitle: APD - Rideshare Commercial Claims Auto Physical Damage Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Description

At Liberty, you'll thrive in a hybrid setting that fosters in-person collaboration, innovation and growth. This approach optimizes both remote and in-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects.

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a claims team with a fast-growing company that has consistently outpaced the industry in year-over-year growth? Liberty Mutual has an excellent claims opportunity available. As a Commercial Insurance Claims Representative, you will review, and process simple and straightforward Commercial claims within assigned authority limits consistent with policy and legal requirements. In addition to a wide range of benefits, as a direct employee, your insurance education and training are paid by Liberty Mutual.

You will be required to go into the office twice a month if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices:Boston, MA; Westborough, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL;Weatogue, CT; Indianapolis, IN; Plano, TX;Suwanee, GA; orLake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Chandler, AZ. (Please note this policy is subject to change.)

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates claim using internal and external resources including speaking with the insured or other involved parties, analysis of reports, researching past claim activity, utilizing evaluation tools to make damage and loss assessments.
  • Extensive and timely direct interaction with Insured's, Claimants, Agent's and Internal Customers.
  • Determines policy coverage through analysis of investigation data and policy terms. Notifies agent and insured of coverage or any issues.
  • Establishes claim reserve requirements and makes adjustments, as necessary, during the processing of the claims.
  • Determines and negotiates settlement amount for damages claimed within assigned authority limits.
  • Writes simple to moderately complex property damage estimates or review auto damage estimates.
  • Takes statements when necessary and works with the Field Appraisal, Subrogation, Special Investigative Unit (SIU) as appropriate.
  • Maintains accurate and current claim file/damage documentation and diaries throughout the life cycle of claim cases to ensure proper tracking and handling consistently with established guidelines and expectations.
  • Alerts Unit Leader to the possibility of fraud or subrogation potential for claims being processed.

Qualifications
  • Bachelors Degree preferred. High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1-2 years of experience. Claims handling skills preferred.
  • Strong customer service and technology skills.
  • Able to navigate multiple systems, strong organizational and communication skills.
  • License may be required in multiple states by state law.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for a Senior Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software's Power Technologies International (PTI) team. This role is critical to the planning and integration of renewables, storage, and FACTS to the electrical grid and to perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for clients such as power producers, independent system operators, and transmission providers to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations.

This is a remote position based in the Contiguous U.S.

You'll make an impact as you:

  • Perform transmission planning through the application of power systems planning principles to simulate and analyze the power system steady state and dynamic behavior.
  • Prepare detailed written reports describing analyses performed, conclusions, and recommendations.
  • Work in small project teams, ensuring deliverables are of high quality and projects are completed within budget and schedule.
  • Develop automation scripts to improve the speed and accuracy of simulations and analysis.
  • Support proposal preparation by developing project plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Deliver on-site technical consulting/training services.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic qualifications:

  • Postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering with a specialization in Power and Energy Systems.
  • At least one year of relevant experience in the electric power industry (time earning an advanced relevant degree and relevant internships may be considered towards the one-year experience requirement).
  • Practical experience using advanced power systems analysis tools.
  • Candidate must have knowledge (through experience, coursework, or applicable related internship) of transmission system planning or operations with experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability.
  • Ability to travel 10% domestically.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior experience in Power System Consulting.
  • Prior experience in EMT study
  • Transmission system planning or operations experience.
  • Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a specialization in Power and Energy Systems.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

Job.JobTitle: Complex Litigation Attorney - Special Investigations Unit (Remote, NY Metro Area)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Join the legal frontline and champion your expertise for the Law and Regulation area of responsibility for the Allstate Company!

The ideal candidate for this role will have a passion for combatting fraud against the insurance industry.

In this role, you will utilize your strong litigation and investigative background to help defend against fraudulent medical and other claims filed against The Company, and to bring Affirmative Actions, including RICO based litigation, on behalf of The Company.

You will apply your strong legal writing skills, and negotiate on a variety of complex matters for this role within the New York Metro area!

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the Claims/Special Investigation Unit (SIU) to combat fraudulent claims in No-Fault and other cases.

  • Conduct complex investigations and aggressively pursue civil RICO litigation against medical providers, claimants, and other parties suspected of insurance fraud, false claims activity, and organized fraudulent schemes.

  • Research, prepare, file, and litigate fraud cases, including RICO and other affirmative actions.

  • Develop litigation strategies and negotiate complex matters.

  • Review case files and plan resolutions.

  • Draft discovery requests, motions, memorandums, and legal briefs.

  • Prepare for and conduct depositions and examinations under oath (EUOs).

  • Attend arbitrations, mediations, trials, and work with expert witnesses.

  • Represent the company in court appearances (conferences, hearings) in State and Federal courts.

  • Draft pre-trial and post-trial motions.

  • Negotiate settlements and prepare related documentation.

Education and Licensing

  • Juris Doctorate and active membership in good standing with the New York State Bar

  • Federal Court Admission required upon selection for this role

Experience

  • 7 or more years of experience

  • Federal Court experience

  • Ability to manage complex litigation

  • Strong research and writing skills

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and related computer applications

  • Exercises discretion and maintains confidentiality

  • Demonstrates ethics and integrity

  • Insurance industry experience

  • Knowledge of legal holds and discovery processes


Travel Requirements

  • This role is remote; however, in-person attendance is an essential function of the position.

  • The attorney will be required to travel within the New York Metro area for court appearances, hearings, trials and other legal matters, as well as periodic travel to the local Allstate office location.


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties

#LI-PC1

Skills

Affirmative Action Plans, Civil Litigation, Criminal Litigation, Examinations Under Oath, Federal Courts, Fraud Investigations, Insurance, Insurance Litigation, Investigative Research, Investigative Skills, Legal Document Preparation, Legal Investigation, Legal Research, Legal Writing, Litigation, Litigation Strategy, No-Fault Insurance, Special Investigations, State Court, Tile Work, Torts, Trial Practice

Job.JobTitle: Field Property Adjuster - Minnesota - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

As the Field Property Adjuster you are responsible for investigating and confirming the facts of loss for the most complex Homeowner's Claims. Determines coverage, damages and otherwise adjusts and negotiates claims within limit of authority. Responsible for creating a comprehensive estimate of damages for the most complex first party homeowner claims leading to the proper disposition. This role is utilized as peer mentor and may assign direction to more junior employees, having mastered our processes and obtained technical expertise.

We are seeking a motivated and customer-focused Property Field Adjuster to join our Western Minnesota team. The ideal candidate will reside in Minnesota, preferably near Roseau, East Grand Forks, Moorhead, Alexandria, Marshall or Worthington, and will play a key role in helping customers navigate the claims process with confidence and care.

In this role, you will investigate and manage moderate to complex residential property claims, as well as some farm and ranch claims, through a combination of on-site inspections and virtual claim handling. The successful candidate will possess strong estimating skills, proficiency with Xactimate, and the ability to effectively manage challenging situations while delivering an exceptional customer experience. Experience handling agricultural, farm, and ranch claims is highly preferred.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy working independently, and are passionate about helping customers during critical moments, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

Exhibits mastery estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on the most complex 1st party homeowner losses of all severities

Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers

Interprets regulatory compliance and fair claims practices

Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files

Applies mastered content in interpretations of all policy types written by the company and assists leadership in formal and ad hoc training

Recommends process improvements

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

#LI-AS2

Skills

Analytical Thinking, Customer Service, Farm and Ranch Insurance, Homeowners Claims, Homeowners Insurance Claims, Negotiation, Property Claims, Property Damage Claims, Xactimate

Field Property Adjuster Cons I: $53,500.00 - 77,800.00/salary

Job.JobTitle: SAP Accounting Master Data Senior Consultant
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Accounting / Finance / Banking, Human Resources, IT / Technology
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Drive the integrity of enterprise financial data and play a critical role in enabling accurate reporting, operational excellence, and strategic decision-making.

The SAP Accounting Master Data Senior Consultant serves as a subject matter expert overseeing the governance, maintenance, and optimization of financial master data within SAP. This role combines deep accounting knowledge with strong technical and business acumen to support enterprise-wide financial processes, system enhancements, and strategic initiatives. The successful candidate will partner across Finance, Technology, and Business Operations to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and effectiveness of key accounting structures and data frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for SAP Accounting Master Data, ensuring the integrity and governance of critical financial structures.
  • Manage and maintain financial master data, including General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Global Hierarchies, Validation Tables, and other SAP accounting objects.
  • Leverage accounting expertise and business insight to align financial data structures with organizational objectives and evolving business needs.
  • Analyze complex accounting, financial, and system-related issues, identifying root causes and implementing sustainable solutions.
  • Lead and support SAP enhancements, testing efforts, system upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with Finance, Technology, and business stakeholders to drive process improvements and optimize master data management practices.
  • Develop and implement controls, standards, and governance processes that ensure data accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
  • Translate complex financial and technical concepts into actionable recommendations for diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Lead moderately complex projects and initiatives, coordinating cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve reporting capabilities, and enhance operational efficiency across the enterprise.
  • Provide expert guidance and support in resolving accounting system and technology-related issues affecting multiple business areas.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and enterprise financial systems.
  • Experience managing and governing master data within SAP or similar ERP environments.
  • Proven ability to solve complex problems and navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong project management, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and explain complex concepts clearly.
  • Passion for continuous improvement, data quality, and operational excellence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in accounting, financial systems, SAP master data, financial reporting, or related disciplines.
  • Experience supporting SAP accounting processes, month-end close activities, testing, and system enhancements.
  • Knowledge of master data governance, internal controls, financial reporting structures, and process optimization.

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of Accounting, Data Governance, and Technology, helping shape the financial foundation that supports enterprise decision-making. You'll work with cross-functional leaders, drive meaningful improvements, and have a direct impact on the accuracy, efficiency, and effectiveness of core financial operations.

Skills

Accounting Processes, Financial Operations, General Ledger (GL), Key Accounts, Reporting

Job.JobTitle: Technician, Facilities Maintenance - Universal Kids Resort
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Construction & Skilled Trades, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for the facilities maintenance of Universal Kids Resort buildings and designated areas. Completes specific work orders, installations, routine/preventative maintenance and repairs as assigned including, but not limited to, masonry, tile, pavers, cubicle partitions, furniture, scenic paint, roofing, and woodwork. Handles daily repair and troubleshooting tasks from Technical Services leadership. Completes special projects and other shop work as directed by Facilities Management to uphold show quality and standards. 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Responsible for the maintenance and repairs for rough in carpentry to include, but not limited to, framing, sheet goods, wood decking and dock work as well as repairing wood metal stud work, and trim work including various moldings, turnings, laminate application, cabinet work, and window and door installation. Consistently provides routine/preventative maintenance in efforts to minimize the number of major repairs required, escalating to Facilities Management to address any major venue concerns when necessary. Ensures work area is clean and safe with tools and materials stored in designated storage areas and materials properly disposed of.
  • Performs routine inspection and maintenance of seating, furniture, restroom stall doors and partitions. Completes repairs and finishing to various walkways and roadways throughout the resort. Manages the preparation and painting of designated areas across UKR by determining color, mixing paint, prepping surface by cleaning, scraping, caulking, applying, putty, and sanding and applying paint. Maintains scenic aesthetic through painting techniques to include brushing, rolling, blending, spraying, and faux finishing based off of original creative intent.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$52,600.00 - $86,800.00

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Associate Claim Rep, Outside Property, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage 1st party property claims. This program is typically 9-12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility. This position is based remotely with work at residential and commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office. This is a field position with a territory in the Hudson area of Massachusetts.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Review, investigate, and document 1st party property claims under close supervision.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third-party providers.
  • Learn to investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for building damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilizes as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, claimants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • In order to perform the essential functions of this role, acquisition and maintenance of Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification may be required to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements. Generally, required Insurance License(s) must be obtained within three months of starting the role, and ongoing continuing education requirements must be maintained as mandated.
  • This position requires participation in our Catastrophe Response Program, which could include deployment to assist our customers in other states.
  • This position requires the individual to access and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, which is physically demanding requiring the ability to carry, set up and climb a ladder weighing approximately 38 to 49 pounds, walk on roofs, and enter tight spaces (such as attic staircases and entries, crawl spaces, etc.). While specific territory or day-to-day responsibilities may not require an individual to climb a ladder, the incumbent must be capable of safely climbing a ladder when deploying to a catastrophe which is a requirement of the position.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); willingness to learn claims management and estimating software.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrated openness to continuous learning.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED and one year of customer service experience.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Job Description

The Division Vice President (DVP) of Assurant Dealer Services leads the strategic and operational direction of a defined geographic business. This executive is responsible for achieving and exceeding revenue targets, growing market share, budget management, and ensuring exceptional client satisfaction across a portfolio of automotive accounts. The DVP oversees performance of the regional sales team, drives new business development, and builds strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Develop and execute sales strategies aligned with Assurant Dealer Services (ADS) goals based on expertise within the channel, participants, markets, products and competitive landscape (traditional and disruptive).
  • Drive revenue growth, margin performance, and cost management across the division, creating a roadmap for increased profitability and commercial excellence within their division.
  • Research and proposes innovative strategies for ADS sales strategic accounts growth for their division; monitor sales effectiveness in delivering points of difference to increase our position in value creation for AIZ and our partners.
  • Provides leadership in developing best practices for measuring and optimizing strategic activities to drive data-driven decision making and excellence in their division.
  • Proactively analyze segments of customer data to uncover insights and key takeaways that inform strategic planning, increase revenue and drives business value in their division.
  • Synthesize and present data on account performance, identify areas of potential income improvement, and implement strategies to cross-sell products in their division.
  • Ensures any service gaps are addressed quickly and effectively and in situations of conflict with the client, leads the management team(s) to resolution looking to accomplish a win-win situation. Measures client satisfaction and uses findings to identify and address areas of opportunities as well as build upon success stories in their division.
  • Collaborates with risk management team related to current clients to mitigate regulatory risk and manage client compliance and oversight requirements in their division.
  • Lead, mentor, develop and performance manage regional sales managers and support staff. Build a high-performance, results-driven culture.
  • Monitor division sales performance/pipeline metrics and provide coaching.
  • Creating a roadmap for increased profitability and excellence within their division.

Direct reports

Number of direct and indirect reports

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Marketing or related field.

  • Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values.
  • Strategic Thinking - Develops strategies to achieve business goals that support the overall organization's goals; Understands business strengths & weaknesses; Analyzes market and competition; Identifies external threats and opportunities; Adapts strategy to changing conditions.

  • Master's degree in Business Administration preferred.​

  • Up to 70% travel

Strong preference to candidates that reside or are open to relocation to the Dallas, Houston, Phoenix, Los Angeles, or Chicago markets.

Job Description

Aon is looking for a Privileged Access Management (PAM) Engineer to help strengthen and evolve our identity and privileged-access security capabilities.

In this role, you will engineer, implement and support PAM solutions, with a strong focus on CyberArk Cloud. You will work with engineering, architecture and business partners to onboard applications, maintain access policies, automate processes and deliver secure, scalable solutions.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Engineer, implement and support security technologies focused on Privileged Access Management.
  • Implement and integrate PAM solutions, with a strong focus on CyberArk Cloud, and support endpoint privilege capabilities using technologies such as BeyondTrust or CyberArk EPM.
  • Onboard applications, accounts and credentials into PAM platforms while maintaining appropriate access controls and security policies.
  • Maintain and enhance CyberArk policies and support endpoint privilege policies for workstation environments.
  • Contribute to the architectural design of access controls, user entitlements, application credentials and user access policies.
  • Partner with architecture and engineering teams to advance the Identity and Access Management strategy and related roadmap.
  • Develop automation using scripting languages such as PowerShell or Python to improve privileged-access processes and capabilities.
  • Configure and support API or programmatic access to managed credentials.
  • Troubleshoot PAM, authentication and access issues, identify root causes and implement practical solutions.
  • Use relevant security and SIEM data to support troubleshooting, monitoring and informed decision-making.
  • Keep technical documentation current as platforms, configurations and environments evolve.
  • Contribute to new PAM capabilities and product features while working within an Agile delivery environment.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering, architecture and business partners.

How this opportunity is different

You will help protect critical systems and identities by improving how privileged access is designed, managed and secured. Through thoughtful engineering, automation and collaboration, you will help make PAM capabilities more secure, scalable and effective for the teams that rely on them.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in privileged access, identity security or related security engineering.
  • Hands-on experience implementing, developing or supporting CyberArk, with experience in CyberArk Cloud strongly preferred for this role.
  • Experience with PAM operational activities such as credential onboarding, access administration, policy configuration and API-based credential access.
  • Experience with endpoint privilege management technologies such as BeyondTrust EPM or CyberArk EPM.
  • Hands-on experience supporting Windows and/or Linux infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of Active Directory, including users, computers, groups, Group Policy and trusts.
  • Understanding of broader Identity and Access Management concepts such as authentication, access certification and public key infrastructure.
  • Experience developing automation with scripting tools such as PowerShell, Python or comparable languages.
  • Familiarity with SIEM technologies and querying security data.
  • Understanding of web traffic and the ability to troubleshoot authentication flows.
  • Experience contributing to technical projects in an Agile environment.
  • Ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with both CyberArk and BeyondTrust technologies.
  • Exposure to emerging privileged-access use cases involving non-human identities (NHI) or AI-related security scenarios.
  • Broader experience across Identity and Access Management platforms and security technologies.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent years of relevant industry experience.

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

Job Description

IAM Engineer- Authentication

Are you passionate about building secure, seamless authentication experiences? Do you enjoy solving complex identity challenges while partnering across technology and the business?

Join Aon and help design, enhance, and support identity and access management solutions that strengthen security while creating a reliable experience for colleagues and clients.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

In this role, you will help design, implement, and support authentication capabilities across Aon's identity environment. You will partner with technology and business stakeholders to develop practical solutions that balance security, reliability, and user experience.

You will:

  • Design, integrate, test, and support Identity and Access Management (IAM) authentication solutions, with a focus on Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
  • Partner with technology, security, and business stakeholders to understand authentication needs, recommend appropriate IAM patterns, and guide solution implementation.
  • Configure and maintain authentication platforms such as Okta and Microsoft Entra, including policies, workflows, and integrations.
  • Help ensure authentication platforms remain secure, reliable, current, and well supported through effective monitoring, maintenance, and patching.
  • Design and refine SSO and MFA policies and controls that strengthen security while supporting a seamless user experience.
  • Develop and extend identity-platform capabilities using REST APIs, JSON, and customizable settings.
  • Analyze authentication and authorization logs to diagnose issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
  • Create clear IAM documentation, architecture diagrams, and process flows that support solution design and ongoing operations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve authentication controls, processes, and platform capabilities while balancing security, reliability, and user experience.

How this opportunity is different

This role gives you the opportunity to work at the intersection of identity, cybersecurity, technology, and user experience. Your work will directly contribute to protecting Aon's technology environment while enabling secure and reliable access for colleagues and clients.

You will serve as an IAM subject-matter resource and trusted partner, collaborating across teams to solve complex authentication challenges and continually improve identity capabilities.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Professional experience designing, implementing, or supporting IAM solutions.
  • Experience implementing and integrating SSO and MFA technologies for workforce and/or external user environments, including platforms such as Okta or Microsoft Entra.
  • Working knowledge of identity and authentication standards and protocols such as SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, LDAP, RADIUS, and Kerberos.
  • Experience analyzing authentication and authorization logs and troubleshooting complex identity issues.
  • Working experience with REST APIs and JSON.
  • Familiarity with applicable security and compliance frameworks, such as GDPR, SOX, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop practical solutions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to varied audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate across technology and business teams, manage competing priorities, and contribute effectively in a team environment.
  • Ability to create clear technical documentation, diagrams, and process flows.
  • 3 + years of relevant professional experience designing and implementing IAM solutions, including experience with SSO and MFA technologies.
  • Equivalent combinations of relevant experience, skills, and education may also be considered

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant industry experience.

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

A summary of all the benefits offered for this position:

Summary:We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Compensation Manager to lead the design, execution, and governance of our compensation programs. This role will partner closely with HR and business leaders to ensure competitive, equitable, and data-driven pay practices that support organizational growth and talent strategy.

What You'll Do

Own Compensation Strategy & Program Design

  • Partner with the CPO to define and evolve the company's compensation philosophy and pay practices.
  • Design, implement, and continuously refine compensation structures including base pay, incentive plans, bonus programs, and special pay arrangements.
  • Develop and maintain salary structures, pay grades, and job architecture frameworks.
  • Conduct market benchmarking and external salary survey analysis to ensure competitiveness and alignment with business strategy.
  • Evaluate and recommend enhancements to compensation programs based on workforce trends, market conditions, and organizational growth.

Lead Annual Compensation Cycles

  • Own the end-to-end annual merit, bonus, and promotion cycles — including planning, modeling, budgeting, system configuration (Workday), manager enablement, and final approvals.
  • Develop compensation modeling scenarios and provide executive-ready analytics and recommendations.
  • Ensure timely and accurate implementation of approved changes within HRIS and payroll systems.
  • Partner with Finance on budget alignment and accrual forecasting.

Ensure Pay Equity & Governance

  • Conduct internal equity analyses to prevent compression and ensure fairness across functions and levels.
  • Analyze compensation data to identify disparities, trends, and risk areas; provide data-driven recommendations.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, including pay transparency requirements.
  • Maintain documentation and governance standards for compensation processes and decisions.
  • Establish internal controls to mitigate risk and ensure consistency in pay decisions.

Support Talent Acquisition & Offer Governance

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR Business Partners to evaluate offers, sign-on bonuses, and promotional increases.
  • Review and approve compensation packages to ensure alignment with internal equity and market positioning.
  • Provide guidance on job leveling, salary bands, and offer strategy.
  • Verify compensation-related components of offer letters and ensure accurate system entry.

Oversee Compensation-Related Payroll & Adjustments

  • Partner with Payroll to ensure accurate processing of compensation changes, where applicable.
  • Review payroll data to validate compensation-related changes prior to final disbursement (e.g, mass merit uploads)
  • Collaborate with HR and Legal on severance modeling and payment processing.

Deliver Data-Driven Insights

  • Develop executive-level reporting and dashboards related to compensation trends, budget utilization, pay equity, and workforce analytics.
  • Conduct scenario modeling to support workforce planning and strategic decision-making.
  • Maintain data integrity within Workday and ensure alignment between HRIS and payroll systems.

Drive Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to streamline compensation workflows and enhance automation within Workday.
  • Develop SOPs and documentation to ensure consistency and audit readiness.
  • Stay current on compensation best practices, regulatory changes, and emerging market trends.
  • undefined

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business, or related field preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive compensation experience, including ownership of compensation cycles.
  • Experience designing and managing salary structures and incentive programs.
  • Strong expertise in market benchmarking and salary survey analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting pay equity and internal compression analyses.
  • Advanced analytical skills with strong Excel and data modeling capability.
  • Experience working within Workday Compensation module or similar HRIS platforms preferred.
  • Strong understanding of payroll processes and compensation compliance requirements.
  • Exceptional discretion and ability to manage highly confidential information.
  • Ability to operate independently as a function-of-one while influencing senior stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

  • CCP (Certified Compensation Professional)
  • PHR/SPHR or SHRM-CP/SCP

What We Offer:

Wealthspire Advisors is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Physical proximity to the East Coast preferred.

Essential duties and responsibilities

  • Perform compliance checklist reviews for key and national account clients, including pre-checklist review and detailed follow-up in coordination with account management teams.
  • Respond to benefits compliance questions in a timely manner, often within 24 hours.
  • Stay abreast of the changing legislative and regulatory landscape, to include statutory legislation and regulation impacting the Region.

  • Attend internal regional and office-specific meetings (Team Lead, office-specific, etc.) regularly.

  • Conduct or support benefits compliance seminars and webinars.
  • Contribute to the overall mission of the Benefits Compliance Department including other duties as assigned by the team and/or the Regional Leads.

Knowledge, skills, and/or abilities

  • Must have knowledge of laws and regulations governing health and welfare plans.
  • Must have clear communication skills and ability to explain compliance in easy to understand and accessible language to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Must be a self-motivated worker with strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks to meet deadlines
  • Must have excellent presentation skills
  • Must have a strong sense of business ethics and integrity
  • Must be able to maintain strict confidentiality in regard to work performed and access to information/data
  • Must maintain a professional and positive attitude

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None required, but there is opportunity for mentoring and cross-training with team members nationally.

Education and/or experience:

  • Brokerage/consultant account management experience preferred.
  • Law degree not required, but attorneys will be considered.
  • Prior experience with federal or state governmental regulatory body a plus.
  • CEBS designation (or equivalent industry experience) a plus.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in employee benefits and/or compliance.
  • Physical proximity to the Region preferred to support light travel to clients and offices.

Education

Bachelor's degree in business administration, business analytics, mathematical economics, finance, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

National General is seeking a Non-Standard Bodily Injury Claims Adjuster - Attorney Represented (Remote, PST).

In this role, you will investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve attorney-represented bodily injury claims arising from automobile accidents. The ideal candidate has experience handling complex bodily injury exposures, working with plaintiff attorneys, evaluating demands, and negotiating settlements within established authority levels.

This position supports a non-standard auto insurance book of business, requiring a strong understanding of liability investigations, injury evaluation, coverage analysis, and claims resolution strategies. Successful candidates are skilled at managing a high-volume caseload while delivering exceptional customer service and maintaining strong file quality. Candidates must be able to work 8am--5pm Pacific time zone hours.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Handles investigation regarding all aspects of bodily injury claims (coverage, damages, subrogation, litigation) with the exercise of discretion and independence within increased level of authority.
  • Applies intermediate understanding of insurance policies written by the company, the industry, and organizational relationships within the company and department.
  • Determines subrogation or fraud potential and how to handle.
  • Identifies customer needs and works to meet those needs using appropriate customer service skills.
  • Recognizes and identifies body parts of a vehicle and understanding of other potential property damage.
  • For claims involving fraud or subrogation, partners with assigned reps from those areas to achieve best outcome.
  • Supervisory Responsibilities:
  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.


Functional Skills

  • Customer service orientation.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong time management skills from a global case management and pending perspective (vs. transactional).
  • Effective problem solving and analytical skills; ability to detect differences and issue recognition from multiple sources.
  • Proficient in Word and Outlook.

Skills

Auto Insurance Claims, Bodily Injury Claims, Case Management, Casualty Insurance, Claims Resolution, Claims Review, Communication, Customer Service, Insurance Claims Investigations, Insurance Policies, Negotiation, Problem Solving, Time Management, Written Communication
