What Is the Opportunity?

Job Description Summary
LOCATION REQUIREMENT: This field position services Insureds/Agents in the Montgomery County, MD area. The selected candidate must reside in the assigned territory. Ideal locations include Rockville, Silver Spring, and Gaithersburg, MD.
*You will be issued a company vehicle for this position.*

As an Associate Claim Rep, Outside Property, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage 1st party property claims. This program is typically 9-12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility. This position is based remotely with work at residential and commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Review, investigate, and document 1st party property claims under close supervision.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third-party providers.
  • Learn to investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for building damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilizes as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, claimants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • In order to perform the essential functions of this role, acquisition and maintenance of Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification may be required to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements. Generally, required Insurance License(s) must be obtained within three months of starting the role, and ongoing continuing education requirements must be maintained as mandated.
  • This position requires participation in our Catastrophe Response Program, which could include deployment to assist our customers in other states.
  • This position requires the individual to access and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, which is physically demanding requiring the ability to carry, set up and climb a ladder weighing approximately 38 to 49 pounds, walk on roofs, and enter tight spaces (such as attic staircases and entries, crawl spaces, etc.). While specific territory or day-to-day responsibilities may not require an individual to climb a ladder, the incumbent must be capable of safely climbing a ladder when deploying to a catastrophe which is a requirement of the position.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); willingness to learn claims management and estimating software.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrated openness to continuous learning.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED and one year of customer service experience.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

Job Description Summary:

Our Mission is to equip students for success by developing and delivering highly effective digital learning through an intuitive online platform.

FLVS does not discriminate in admission or access to, or treatment or employment in its programs and activities on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, marital status, disability, genetic information or any other reason prohibited by law.

The Position:

Position General Summary:

The Paraprofessional, Florida Scholars Academy is a valued member of the educational team, providing essential support to instructors, instructional leaders, and students within the juvenile justice system. This role involves working closely with instructors, school counselors, and facility providers to create a positive and inclusive learning environment, assisting in classroom management, and providing individualized support to students.

Essential Position Functions:

  • Deliver feedback to students which contributes to a climate where they are actively engaged in meaningful learning experiences.

  • Maintain effective and efficient record keeping procedures in accordance with state statues.

  • Provide a positive environment in which students are encouraged to be actively engaged in the learning process; provide small group and/or individual instruction to students as needed.

  • Communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with students, parents/guardians, and other professionals on a regular basis.

  • Facilitate incoming parent questions and provide responses in a timely manner by conducting necessary research.

  • Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships by consulting regularly with internal and external stakeholders; collaborate with peers to enhance the overall quality of feedback.

  • Model professional and ethical standards when dealing with students, parents/guardians, peers, and the community.

  • Assume responsibility for meeting their grading assignments as set forth by the Instructional Leader.

  • Maintain a thorough understanding in the curriculum of course that is being supported and the school-wide student performance goals.

  • Provide services in person at the assigned facility to meet the needs of students under the supervision of the Department of Juvenile Justice (DJJ).

  • Serve as an instructional facilitator in the absence of an Instructor, Florida Scholars Academy at the discretion of the Instructional Leader.

  • Compile and organize notes, documents, and other relevant materials from instructional staff to present at meetings (i.e. treatment sessions, virtual transition, and community re-entry team meetings); attend the meetings.

  • Assist with student intake and exit processes, proctoring exams, and monitoring student progress.

  • Support other academic related topics established at the discretion of the Superintendent of Schools, Florida Scholars Academy, Regional Director, Florida Scholars Academy, or Instructional Leader, Florida Scholars Academy.

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of basic technology, including software applications, hardware, and navigating digital tools, with the ability to effectively apply them to daily tasks and troubleshoot common issues.

  • Meet professional obligations through efficient work habits such as, meeting deadlines, honoring schedules, coordinating resources and meetings in an effective and timely manner, and demonstrating respect for others.

  • All work responsibilities are subject to having performance goals and/or targets established

(These essential functions are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed. Employees will be required to perform other job-related duties as required.)

Minimum Requirements:

Education/Licensure/Certification:

  • Associate's degree or higher from an accredited college, two years of education from an accredited college or passing of any of the following examinations: CLAST (College Level Academic Skills Test), ETS Praxis Parapro, or another state-approved test, or equivalent years of experience

Experience:

  • One year of relevant experience

  • Prior experience working with special needs students, preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA's):

  • Operational knowledge of the Internet and Web-related technologies

  • Possesses strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to work independently with little direct supervision

  • Ability to work as part of a team

  • Ability to prioritize tasks and effectively manage time

  • Strong interpersonal skills

  • Excellent customer service skills

  • Strong organizational skills

  • Ability to understand and follow verbal and written instructions

  • Demonstrative skill in attention to detail

  • Ability to function effectively in a high demand environment

  • Ability to work independently and as a team member

  • Working knowledge of general office practices, methods, and equipment, including computer skills in Microsoft Office suite of products.

  • Ability to compile, review, categorize, prioritize, analyze, and interpret data and/or information

CORE COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS:

JOB KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Team member carries out essential job functions with accuracy, engages in ongoing and relevant professional learning, applies new knowledge effectively, and demonstrates mastery of job-specific skills

PRODUCTIVITY

Team member produces high quality work, meets organizational and departmental deadlines, balances multiple responsibilities, manages time effectively, and seeks ways to improve processes and productivity

COMMUNICATION

Team member communicates clearly in written and verbal formats, collaborates effectively, demonstrates professionalism in all interactions, exhibits strong interpersonal skills, and contributes to a positive team and professional community

CUSTOMER FOCUS

Team member addresses the needs of internal and external customers, analyzes problems effectively, contributes to innovative solutions, seeks opportunities for improvement, and successfully adapts to change

Physical Requirements and Environmental Conditions:

  • Frequency of travel: Daily travel is required to the assigned residential facility. Frequent travel is required for meetings, training, and conferences; location may vary and may require overnight stays.

  • Light physical activities and efforts required working in an office environment

Job Summary

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations and provide meaningful analysis to business unit leaders. This role combines financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, business modeling, and financial operations to help the business understand performance, identify trends, and make informed decisions.

You'll work closely with Finance, Accounting, and business stakeholders to maintain accurate financial information, support strategic planning, improve processes, and provide insights into the factors driving business performance.

Essential Job Functions

What You'll Do

  • Prepare and analyze monthly budget variance, forecasting, and KPI reports, identifying key trends and business drivers.
  • Develop financial and business models that provide insights to support business decisions.
  • Support annual strategic and financial planning, including consolidation and analysis.
  • Analyze expenses, vendors, and capital proposals, providing financial insights and recommendations.
  • Execute finance operations including AP/AR, reconciliations, banking transactions, and financial controls.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing accurate financial information and documentation.
  • Partner with Finance and business stakeholders on special projects, ad hoc analysis, and initiatives.
  • Lead or contribute to process improvement projects that improve efficiency and reduce operational risk.

Physical Actions

Physical Environment

Education Requirements

Experience Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in Accounting or Finance, preferably including financial analysis and finance operations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Fluent English.
  • Strong experience with financial analysis, reconciliation, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Experience with AP/AR, banking operations, and financial controls.
  • Advanced proficiency with ERP systems and Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively with business and Finance stakeholders.
  • Experience identifying and implementing process improvements.
  • CPA or CMA exam progress, MBA/Master's coursework, or Six Sigma Yellow Belt certification is a nice to have
  • Knowledge in SAP
  • Desired knowledge in Tax

Special Skill Requirement

Additional Qualification

Benefits

This position offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work–life balance. While specific benefits may vary by country and employee level, offerings generally include competitive salary opportunities, performance-based bonuses, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing training and development resources.

Any ownership, partnership, directorship, or participation in other businesses or companies must be fully disclosed and formally reviewed in accordance with FBS internal conflict‑of‑interest and external engagement policies prior to the start date or as soon as such circumstances arise.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Are you someone who enjoys being on the move, solving problems, and making a real impact for customers? As a Field Auto Appraiser, you'll be at the forefront of our claims processmeeting customers where they are, whether it's at their home, a repair shop, or a tow yard.

You'll take the lead in writing estimates and guiding customers through the repair or total loss process, using a mix of in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication. No two days are the samewhether you're evaluating damage on-site or collaborating with body shops and service providers, you'll enjoy a fast-paced, hands-on role that keeps you engaged and on your toes.

If you're looking for a career that blends technical know-how, customer service, and the freedom of field work, this is your chance to thrive in a role where your expertise truly matters.



Preferred Qualifications

  • You have 3-5 years' experience in auto collision estimating using CCC or Mitchell
  • You have a High School Diploma or a GED
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write precise and comprehensive estimates
  • Comfortable with utilizing technology and various platforms for claims processing
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills to manage multiple assignments effectively
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements

A day in the life of the Field Auto Appraiser, and what it takes to do the job!

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator you will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder Your Eye for Detail Keeps Everything on Track- in this role, youll ensure claims are documented accurately and in line with policy agreements. As you handle each case, youll maintain clear, timely records in our claims system (which well train you on). Your attention to detail helps keep the process smooth, organized, and transparent from start to finish.


Work Location

  • This position is a field-based role.To be eligible for this role, you must be located in the following locations: Pittsburgh, PA

Company Car
Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.


Training

The first approximately eight weeks of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.



Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjusters' and/or appraisers' license in multiple markets
  • All required licenses will need to be obtained within 60 days of hire
  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal
  • This role offers a sign on bonus of $1,000 if you have an active appraiser license or active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state (current employees and candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus)

Benefits

Allstate cares about you and your wellbeing. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that includes pay, benefits, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. You can choose whatever benefits are most important you. Here are some of our offerings:

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Allstate pension plan and 401(k) savings plan
  • Ayco financial coaching
  • Spring Health mental and emotional wellbeing resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Adoption reimbursement
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness incentives

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstates discretion.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously

Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement.
  • Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employees first 90 days of employment.
  • Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions.
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards.
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers.

This position is only available within theUS, but notcurrently available for Puerto Rico, California, New York, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington state residents.

Candidates who reside in locations where the local minimum wage exceeds the base pay for this position are also not eligible for consideration. This is due to compliance with wage regulations and internal compensation practices.


Reasonable Accommodation Statement

Allstate provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their role. During the first 90 days of employment, reasonable accommodations generally do not include removing essential job functions, creating new positions, or lowering performance or productivity standards.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstates discretion.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously

Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement.
  • Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employees first 90 days of employment.
  • Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions.
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards.
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers.

This position is only available within theUS, but notcurrently available for Puerto Rico, California, New York, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington state residents.

Candidates who reside in locations where the local minimum wage exceeds the base pay for this position are also not eligible for consideration. This is due to compliance with wage regulations and internal compensation practices.


Reasonable Accommodation Statement

Allstate provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their role. During the first 90 days of employment, reasonable accommodations generally do not include removing essential job functions, creating new positions, or lowering performance or productivity standards.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstates discretion.
  • Eligible licensed external candidates who complete licensing prior to hire or bring an active Property & Casualty or Personal Lines license before start date may be eligible for a bonus.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously


Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement.
    Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employees first 90 days of employment.
    Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions.
    Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs.
    Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards.
    Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers.

This position is only available within theUS, but notcurrently available for Puerto Rico, California, New York, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington state residents.

Candidates who reside in locations where the local minimum wage exceeds the base pay for this position are also not eligible for consideration. This is due to compliance with wage regulations and internal compensation practices.


Reasonable Accommodation Statement

Allstate provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their role. During the first 90 days of employment, reasonable accommodations generally do not include removing essential job functions, creating new positions, or lowering performance or productivity standards.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$63,800.00 - $105,400.00

Target Openings

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Outside Auto Appraiser, you are responsible for physically inspecting damaged vehicles, estimating repair costs, working closely with repair facilities, and determining and settling the actual cash value of total loss vehicles to ensure accurate and timely claim settlements. In this customer-facing role, you will need to have a high level of technical expertise in vehicle damage assessment, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. This position will serve as a technical resource for auto claim staff and will provide advice and direction to claim professionals on claim damages to achieve optimal outcomes. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Inspect and assess vehicle damage resulting from accidents, weather events, or other covered losses by conducting thorough virtual or on-site inspections at body shops or customer locations.
  • Perform estimate review work, conduct virtual inspections, and collaborate with repair facilities to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality across claims.
  • Prepare accurate repair estimates using industry-standard estimating software to determine the cost of parts, labor, and materials required to restore vehicles to pre-loss condition.
  • Evaluate and settle vehicle total losses by determining actual cash value (ACV) through market research, comparable vehicle analysis, and application of appropriate valuation tools and methodologies.
  • Negotiate repair costs and settlements with body shops, customers, and third-party claimants to reach fair and timely resolutions while maintaining quality repair standards.
  • Identify and document pre-existing damage, prior repairs, and potential fraud indicators to ensure accurate claim evaluation and protect company interests.
  • Collaborate with claim representatives, body shops, and vendors to coordinate repairs, authorize supplements, and resolve coverage or repair-related issues.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by explaining the appraisal process, answering questions, assisting in moving claims towards timely resolution, and keeping vehicle owners informed throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Two years of auto physical damage appraisal experience.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • One year of auto physical damage appraisal or comparable claim related experience or successful completion of required Travelers Claim Representative training program.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

ROLE:

Lead business user acceptance testing (UAT) activities supporting the implementation of Guidewire PolicyCenter and related systems for commercial property and casualty insurance operations. This role serves as the primary coordinator between business and technology teams to ensure system functionality aligns with approved business requirements and operational needs.

The Guidewire UAT Lead is responsible for establishing the structure, governance, processes, and reporting necessary to successfully execute UAT activities across multiple products and business functions. This position works closely with underwriting, insurance product, technology product, quality assurance, and implementation teams to define requirements, develop testing strategies, manage testing execution, facilitate issue resolution, and ensure business readiness prior to production deployment. The role provides leadership and influence across cross-functional teams without direct supervisory authority.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead UAT strategy, planning, preparation, execution, and completion for Guidewire PolicyCenter and related integrations supporting commercial property and casualty insurance products.
  • Partner with underwriting, insurance product, technology product, business analysis, quality assurance, development, and implementation teams to establish UAT scope, schedules, resource requirements, entry and exit criteria, and business sign-off expectations.
  • Facilitate working sessions with underwriting and product subject matter experts to define and refine business requirements, workflows, referrals, product rules, and expected system behavior.
  • Translate approved business requirements into acceptance criteria, end-to-end business scenarios, test cases, test scripts, expected outcomes, and reusable regression testing assets.
  • Establish and maintain a comprehensive UAT framework, including test inventories, traceability documentation, readiness assessments, tester assignments, schedules, execution tracking, and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate and lead business subject matter experts and UAT participants by assigning work, clarifying expectations, monitoring progress, and addressing resource constraints, dependencies, and testing gaps.
  • Coordinate test environments, system access, test data, integrations, documentation, and other prerequisites required to support successful testing execution.
  • Lead testing activities across policy lifecycle functions including submission, quote, underwriting, referral, rating, bind, issue, endorsement, renewal, cancellation, reinstatement, and associated integrated systems.
  • Validate configured workflows, screens, rating logic, product rules, documents, integrations, and migrated data to ensure compliance with approved business and operational requirements.
  • Document, assess, prioritize, track, and communicate defects, requirement gaps, and testing issues while coordinating appropriate resolution activities with business and technology teams.
  • Coordinate corrective actions, retesting, regression testing, and issue closure to ensure successful implementation outcomes.
  • Develop and communicate testing status, defect trends, risk assessments, readiness evaluations, dependencies, and recommendations to project stakeholders and leadership.
  • Facilitate business review and acceptance activities and support final business sign-off decisions based on testing outcomes, acceptance criteria, and residual risk evaluation.
  • Drive continuous improvement of UAT methodologies, testing standards, documentation practices, and governance processes to support future technology implementations.
  • Support organizational readiness by identifying operational impacts, process changes, and training considerations associated with new system functionality.
  • Build collaborative relationships across business and technology teams and provide leadership through influence, coordination, and effective communication.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; degree emphasis in insurance, risk management, information technology, business, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Five or more years of commercial property and casualty insurance experience in policy administration, business analysis, quality assurance, user acceptance testing, or a related discipline. Experience spanning underwriting, insurance product management, and technology product functions is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading business user acceptance testing efforts for complex enterprise system implementations, modernizations, or migrations.
  • Experience defining and documenting business requirements, workflows, acceptance criteria, business scenarios, test scripts, expected results, and regression testing materials.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial property and casualty insurance operations and policy lifecycle processes.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into structured testing methodologies and repeatable test conditions.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and project coordination skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate across all organizational levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and lead work across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, dependencies, and competing business needs in a fast-paced transformation environment.
  • Guidewire PolicyCenter experience strongly preferred. Experience with policy administration platforms, testing tools, defect management systems, agile delivery methodologies, and related insurance industry designations is preferred.
  • Advanced computer skills and the ability to learn and apply new technologies and tools.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Professional office environment.
  • Hybrid work arrangement with in-office days Tuesday through Thursday in Merrill, Madison, or Milwaukee.
  • Fully remote work may be considered for candidates outside commuting distance.
  • Occasional travel may be required to support project planning, testing activities, training, or implementation efforts.

 

NOTE: This job description does not state or imply that these are the only duties performed by this role.  This role may be requested to perform job related tasks other than those specifically presented in this job description.  The employer reserves the right to change or assign other duties to this position.

Project Management & Continuous Improvement (20%)

  • Assist in documenting underwriting processes, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
  • Support special projects related to portfolio management, risk assessment, business analytics, and operational improvements.

  • Advanced use of data analysis and reporting tools

  • Ability to develop business recommendations supported by data and research
  • Experience presenting findings and insights to stakeholders

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Ability to learn new systems and applications quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

Job.JobTitle: Senior Claims Consultant Mass Tort & Environmental
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Take your complex claims expertise to the next level in a highly specialized role focused on some of the most challenging exposures in the casualty space.

As a Senior Claims Consultant Mass Tort & Environmental, you will independently manage sophisticated legacy and long-latency claims involving asbestos, environmental contamination, talc, PFAS, and other mass tort exposures. You will apply advanced coverage analysis, strategic claims handling, negotiation, and litigation management skills to claims arising from historical CGL, umbrella, and excess liability policies.

This is an opportunity to join a specialized team where your judgment, technical expertise, and ability to navigate complex coverage issues will have a direct impact. The role supports claims across multiple U.S. jurisdictions and Canada and offers significant autonomy in managing complex matters from evaluation through resolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Complex Claims & Coverage Analysis

  • Independently manage complex, high-exposure casualty claims involving historical CGL, umbrella, and excess liability policies.
  • Analyze historical policy language, underlying facts, applicable law, and long-latency exposures to determine coverage positions and claims strategy.
  • Manage legacy runoff claims arising primarily from policies issued during the 1970s through the mid-1980s.
  • Develop thoughtful, well-supported strategies for resolving complex coverage and liability issues.

Mass Tort & Environmental Claims

  • Handle complex asbestos bodily injury, talc, PFAS, environmental contamination, and other mass tort claims.
  • Evaluate environmental exposures involving soil and groundwater contamination and remediation.
  • Manage claims involving large commercial and industrial insureds with significant liability exposure.
  • Navigate complex, multi-jurisdictional claims across the U.S. and Canada.

Litigation, Negotiation & Resolution

  • Manage litigated claims and coverage actions involving Allstate.
  • Partner with internal and external counsel to develop effective litigation and resolution strategies.
  • Participate in mediations, arbitrations, settlement negotiations, and other dispute-resolution activities.
  • Serve as a witness when required.

Financial & Strategic Management

  • Establish, document, and adjust case reserves and financial projections based on evolving claim exposure.
  • Develop and execute strategic action plans designed to move complex claims toward resolution.
  • Provide clear, well-supported analysis and recommendations to key stakeholders.

Caseload & Operational Excellence

  • Independently manage a diverse portfolio of complex claims while maintaining accurate and thorough documentation.
  • Ensure claim files comply with applicable internal guidelines and standards.
  • Work effectively across multiple claims systems and adapt to evolving technology and AI-supported workflows.
  • Communicate complex coverage and claim issues clearly and effectively in both written and verbal settings.

What You Bring:


Preferred Experience

  • 3+ years of experience handling mass tort, asbestos, environmental, or other long-latency claims.
  • Casualty claims experience involving complex coverage analysis, excess liability policies, or legacy runoff portfolios strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing claims across multiple U.S. jurisdictions and/or Canada.
  • Experience with litigation, negotiation, mediation, arbitration, or complex claim resolution.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong knowledge of complex casualty claims and coverage analysis.
  • Ability to interpret and apply historical insurance policy language.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven negotiation and settlement capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage complex, high-exposure matters and competing priorities.
  • Comfort working across multiple systems and adapting to new technology and AI-supported processes.
  • High level of ownership, sound judgment, and accountability in a remote environment.

Why This Role

This opportunity is ideal for a seasoned claims professional who enjoys digging into complex coverage questions, sophisticated litigation, historical policies, and high-exposure claims. You will have the autonomy to own challenging matters while collaborating with experienced claims professionals and legal partners on issues that require both technical expertise and strategic thinking.


Work Environment

  • Remote-friendly opportunity within a highly specialized claims team.
  • Independent role suited for a self-starter who is comfortable taking ownership of complex matters.
  • Collaborative environment with exposure to legal partners and sophisticated casualty claims.

Skills

Claims Administration, Claims Resolution, Complex Claims, Mass Torts, Settlement Negotiations

Job.JobTitle: Privacy Counsel, Law & Regulation - Remote (IL, NC, TX, AZ, NY, CA)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated, business-minded attorney with deep privacy expertise who is excited to work at the intersection of law, technology, data, mobility, and consumer innovation. This is a unique opportunity to join Arity's legal team and help shape the future of data-driven products and services in an increasingly complex and evolving regulatory landscape.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted legal advisor to Arity, Allstate's mobility and technology subsidiary, providing practical, real-time, and strategic counsel on a broad range of privacy, data governance, emerging technology, and regulatory compliance matters. You will partner closely with business, product, technology, marketing, and data teams to enable innovation while effectively managing legal and regulatory risk.

As a recognized subject matter expert in state privacy laws and emerging privacy regulations, you will play a key role in developing scalable compliance strategies, advising on novel business initiatives, new data models and products, and influencing cross-functional decision-making. The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and has a proven ability to drive solutions, build consensus, and deliver results across diverse stakeholder groups.

Key Responsibilities & Core Competencies


  • Serve as a trusted privacy advisor providing strategic counsel on U.S. state privacy laws, GDPR, and other global privacy frameworks. Conduct complex legal analysis to determine the applicability of laws, regulations, exemptions, and compliance requirements across evolving business models and technologies.

  • Partner proactively with privacy program leads to ensure ongoing compliance with existing legal and regulatory requirements while supporting the implementation of emerging privacy, data governance, and artificial intelligence (AI) regulations.

  • Provide legal counsel to advertising, marketing, and product teams across the audience lifecycle, including audience creation, activation, measurement, attribution, and the deployment of tags, pixels, SDKs, and related technologies. Advise on consent management, consumer choice mechanisms, and regulatory requirements governing data collection and use.

  • Advise on Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) matters related to the collection, use, and sharing of consumer report data, including permissible purpose requirements, notice obligations, and disclosure considerations.

  • Lead privacy support for complex data-driven transactions and commercial arrangements, including data licensing agreements, data supply agreements, clean room agreements, strategic partnerships, and other transactions where data rights and regulatory considerations are critical.

  • Counsel business stakeholders on data strategy and governance matters, including data provenance, permitted use rights, consumer-facing disclosures, data sharing practices, licensing rights, retention requirements, and data lifecycle management.

  • Collaborate effectively across Law & Regulation, product, technology, marketing, data, compliance, and business teams to support strategic initiatives and deliver practical, business-oriented legal solutions.

  • Anticipate legal and regulatory developments, identify potential risks, and develop creative, solution-oriented approaches that enable innovation while appropriately managing legal exposure.

  • Conduct risk-benefit analyses of key business initiatives, considering enterprise-wide implications and providing actionable recommendations to support informed decision-making.

  • Advise business partners on emerging legal, regulatory, technology, and risk management issues affecting the organization.

  • Play a key role in executing legal strategy, driving action plans, and fostering effective communication and alignment across business units and legal stakeholders.

Location & Travel Requirements


  • This role is fully remote and includes travel as needed to support business objectives and team collaboration. We welcome candidates from across the United States, with a preference for those located in Illinois, North Carolina, Texas, Arizona, New York, or California.

Education & Experience


  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree required; active license to practice law and in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive legal experience within a law firm and/or in-house legal department supporting a mid-sized to large organization.

  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following areas: privacy, advertising technology (AdTech), Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), technology transactions, commercial contracting, data governance, and/or other highly regulated industries.

  • Experience advising within corporate structures, including parent companies and affiliated entities, with the ability to navigate diverse business and regulatory environments.

  • Proven ability to provide strategic legal counsel that balances risk management with business objectives.

Key Competencies


  • Leadership capabilities, with experience building, developing, mentoring, and guiding high-performing teams.

  • Executive presence with strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders and translate complex legal concepts into practical business guidance.

  • Demonstrated business acumen with the ability to assess legal and operational risks, develop business cases, and quantify return on investment for strategic initiatives.

  • Effective budget management and resource planning experience.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

  • High degree of professionalism, integrity, and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and other technology tools relevant to the practice of law and business operations.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This job does not have supervisory duties

Job.JobDescription:
Become an integral part of our technical team as an Animations Technician, where youll play a vital role in maintaining and ensuring the safe operation of ride systems and show-quality elements across the theme park. Reporting to the Animations Foreman/Gang Boss, youll collaborate closely with team members to monitor technical equipment, conduct daily inspections, perform repairs, and complete preventative maintenance on show characters, effects, ride vehicles, and other animation elements.In this role, youll be responsible for maintaining the accuracy of parts and ensuring accountability while adhering to strict safety protocols, guidelines, and quality control standards. Your problem-solving skills will be essential for troubleshooting technical issues, resolving conflicts, and addressing challenges in high-pressure situations. Additionally, youll support the team by organizing and allocating resources, completing administrative tasks, and providing timely and precise communication to internal departments and external partners. A strong working knowledge of technical disciplinesincluding mechanical/structural, hydraulic/pneumatic, electrical/electronic systems, and program logic controllersis essential. Your dedication to teamwork, precision, and delivering exceptional results will ensure immersive and memorable experiences for guests of all ages.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in all attraction maintenance functions assigned. Respond and resolve maintenance issues that affect show quality of all characters, effects and ride vehicles in a timely manner.  Allocate resources as needed.  Ensure that work is performed correctly and follows approved procedures for ride system safety, show quality, operation and compliance of all rides, shows and effects in the park. 
  • Communicate accurately matters regarding the operational status of all attractions and show venues to the Gang Boss and/or Foreman as well as department heads as it pertains to the Animations department.
  • Support animations requests of all operating groups/departments within USH in a timely and professional manner.
  • Adhere to all Standard Operating Procedures within Technical Services and USH at large.  Understand and demonstrate the proper use of safety practices and ensure department standards are maintained and safety policies for the Park upheld. 
  • Maintains machines and equipment in safe, operating order. Complete daily inspection sheets and related repairs.  Ensure that work performed is correctly documented. Ensure that unscheduled work performed is correctly documented
  • Assist in the development and implementation of processes which enhance system efficiencies and increase productivity
  • Maintain proficiency in all areas as it pertains to his/her area(s) of responsibilities assigned.
  • Maintains and controls inventories at levels adequate to sustain efficient operations. 
  • Promote and provide extraordinary guest service for both internal and external guests; answer questions and offer information in a courteous manner.  Seek to provide assistance to guests, where appropriate.
  • Assist other technical staff in assessing and resolving technical failures.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Desired Characteristics

  • Theme Park Operations knowledge and experience
  • Excellent organizational, verbal and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to work with all levels of employees and management, and willingness to give assistance to co-workers.   Strong team player.
  • Strong interpersonal and analytical skills
  • Strong time management skills
  • Ability to multi-task and be flexible is essential

Requirements:

  • Eligible candidates must be fully available to work early mornings, mid-day, afternoon, evening, late night, and/or overnight shifts, including weekdays, weekends, and holidays.
  • College degree or Technical School Certification and/or Specialized Technical training in applicable disciplines
  • Must possess a broad knowledge of the following disciplines: Electrical/electronic, Hydraulic/pneumatic, Mechanical/Structural, Welding/Fabricating, Program Logic Controllers (PLC), Machining, Inventory Control Inspection, Quality control procedures
  • Experienced in metal fabrication, designs and technical blueprints for all the disciplines listed above
  • Must possess excellent interpersonal communication skills both verbal and written on a technical level
  • Flexible to daily/weekly schedule changes
  • Able to work independently
  • Requires moderate to heavy physical exertion
  • Must be able to lift, carry, push, pull heavy materials and objects up to 50lbs.
  • Must be able to stand, walk, bend, stoop, climb, etc. for extended periods of time
  • 1-3 years technical and trade experience
  • Basic understanding of the disciplines related to Electrical/Electronic Hydraulic/Pneumatic Mechanical/Structural and Program Logic Controllers (PLC)
  • Basic understanding of metal fabrication, designs and blueprints
  • Ability & willingness to work overtime, weekends and holidays.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint

Pay:

  • The pay rate for this role is $32.78 per hour

Job.JobTitle: Lead/Sergeant, Security Officer - Universal Kids Resort
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Supports leadership in directing and coordinating safety and prevention activities for Guests and Team Members at Universal Kids Resort (UKR). Oversees the daily Security Operations and serves as the first point-of-contact for Uniformed Security Officers, Guests, and interdivisional partners. Responds to situations and manages reporting of incidents, ensuring accurate information is represented. Accountable for Security Officer on-the-job training, daily placement, and feedback on security services performance.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assists in overseeing multiple shifts for Uniformed Security Officers who oversee security operations at Universal Kids Resort. Provides work direction to Uniformed Officers to respond and direct personnel during routine or emergency situations ensuring appropriate response and correct information is gathered for reporting purposes. Utilizes approved programs/technology for accountability of equipment, attendance, position assignment, and other functions as directed.
  • Serves as the first point-of-contact for Uniformed Officers and Guests, responding to escalated Guest situations, emergency situations, etc., and completing accurate reporting. Escalates to Security leadership for resolution as necessary. Communicates performance, behavior standards, and expectations; provides feedback for recognition and performance improvement. Completes and maintains daily incident reports for Guest situations/incidents, accurately representing witness statements documented throughout the operation and resort.
  • Responsible for the consistent execution of world-class Guest service, operational standards and motivating Team Members across Universal Kids Resort. Conducts daily shift meetings, engages in safety spot talks, and documents Team Member performance. Aids in the dissemination of general company information and resort-wide procedural changes. Effectively applies the Universal Destinations & Experiences (UDX) service model to satisfy and resolve the needs of Guests and Team Members.
  • Conducts on-the-job training, working closely with Management to ensure that Team Members have successfully completed their training plan. Monitors trainees throughout their onboarding and training to ensure operational proficiency. Meets with Team Members to review their training progress, addresses concerns, documents training-related issues, and ensures Team Member readiness for the job responsibilities.
  • Performs all administrative duties related to the daily operation including monitoring daily staffing levels and rotation schedules, ensuring they are adjusted according to park attendance, completing opening and closing checklists, safety procedures, and maintaining operating supplies. Maintains overtime reports and ensuring accurate daily incident reporting procedures are being met. Reviews timekeeping to ensure that time is properly entered based on job code and functional area and approves daily UKG scheduling request changes.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.
  • Must be able to work a flexible and varying schedule based on business needs.
  • A background check is mandatory, and results must meet Universal Destinations and Experiences background check criteria.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Ability to administer CPR and/or First Aid with proper operation of an AED (Automated External Defibrillator).
  • Basic computer proficiency and strong communications skills.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSES:

  • Required to successfully attend and pass all recurring mandatory/legal licenses and certifications as a condition of employment.
  • Level 2 (Non-Commissioned) Security License is required.

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED is required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years of relevant security or military experience is required; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobTitle: Assistant Manager, Security Operations - Universal Kids Resort
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for the management of Security Operations for Universal Kids Resort (UKR), including the theme park and hotel. Provides leadership to all hourly Team Members and Uniformed Officers, oversees all shifts, including 3rd shift and non-operating days. Partners across UKR with operational leaders as well as any third-party security who will oversee bag screening and Frisco law enforcement. Ensures implementation, communication and execution of operational plans and Company initiatives, ensuring security standards are in accordance with legal requirements and Universal Destinations and Experiences (UDX) standards.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Supervises hourly Uniformed Officers, including coordinating and overseeing Company and Departmental missions, initiatives, and oversight of third-party vendors handling Guest and Team Member screening areas. Acts as a liaison between Frisco law enforcement, fire and medical agencies and third-party security for shared intelligence and coordination for emergency response and planning in partnership with UKR Leadership and UDX stakeholders.
  • Responsible for enforcing all departmental policies as they pertain to the safety and security of Guests, Team Members, and company assets in alignment with UDX policies and procedures. Provides administration and management of automated and technical security systems and equipment designed to monitor, control, and safeguard Guests and Team Members, their property, and physical assets of UKR. Reviews Incident Reports and ensures they are thorough, concise and follow UDX standard for potential future litigation. Supports UKR partners in Incident Report processing, investigation procedures, and overall Security concerns to address escalations.
  • Responsible for the hiring, training and development of hourly Uniformed Officers and Area Supervisors including training, coaching, and mentoring. Manages and drives initiatives to increase Team Member Satisfaction (TSAT) and Guest Service (GSAT). Enforces department policies and procedures, inclusive of training and safety, while working with the Manager to identify and develop new departmental policies and procedures.
  • Ensures labor goals, efficiencies, safety and quality standards are being met and addressed consistently. Approves weekly schedules for distribution to Team Members. Effectively handles and properly reports any incidents, Team Member/ Guest issues and operational deficiencies. Plans for and efficiently executes events and requests made by other departments.
  • Responsible for providing resort-wide duty manager coverage depending on scheduled shift. Duties will include responding to escalated incidents, down times, weather conditions, and effectively communicating across Security, Operations, and UKR Leadership. Collaborates across departments to ensure operational decisions, changes to standard operating procedures, and focus on operational efficiencies are communicated and implemented.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Basic computer proficiency and strong communications skills.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
  • Vendor management experience is preferred.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSES:

  • Required to successfully attend and pass all recurring mandatory/legal licenses and certifications as a condition of employment.
  • Level 2 (Non-Commissioned) Security License is required.
