Job Description

A day in the life of a Large Loss Property Contents Adjuster:


  • Handle escalated claims files that have complex contents and ALE.
  • You enjoy working independently from home.
  • Conduct a thorough coverage investigation of the loss and ensure the policy was applied correctly.
  • You will be using advanced video technology to collaborate with onsite vendors to identify damages and write a contents damage estimate.
  • Communicate empathetically with customers and help them through their claim process in a fast, fair and easy manner.
  • Negotiate claim settlements with customers in accordance with business unit standard methodologies.
  • Coordinate with structure adjusters to ensure holistic handling of the claim file.
  • Use data and analytics to tell a story and influence decision making.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • 3 years experience handling Large Loss property contents claims and ALE expenses using Xactimate for complex estimating.
  • Previous experience handling property insurance claims.
  • Experience managing 100+ inventory property content items per claim.
  • Value providing an effortless customer service experience.
  • View problems and setbacks as opportunities for improvement and look forward to coming up with creative solutions.
  • Are organized and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
  • Are known for clear and professional communication both written and verbal.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Schedule:

  • Monday-Friday 8am-4:30pm, with rotational Saturday or Sunday duty.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:


  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign On Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.



Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job Description

Help Customers Navigate Their Health Coverage with Confidence

Are you passionate about helping people, building relationships, and making a difference in customers' lives? Join our team as a Licensed Customer Engagement Specialist, where you'll serve as a trusted guide for customers, agents, and prospective members seeking support with their Accident & Health insurance needs.

In this role, you'll combine your customer service expertise, communication skills, and insurance knowledge to educate customers, answer questions, support enrollment and retention efforts, and connect individuals with solutions that fit their unique situations. If you're a motivated professional who enjoys helping others, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and values meaningful customer interactions, we'd love to hear from you.

Why You'll Love This Role
Make a direct impact by helping customers understand and access important health insurance products and services.
Work from home in a supportive, team-oriented environment.
Expand your skills through continuous training, coaching, and cross-functional learning opportunities.
Be part of a collaborative team that values flexibility, customer advocacy, and professional growth.
Utilize your Accident & Health insurance license to make a meaningful difference in every customer interaction.

What You'll Do


As a Licensed Customer Engagement Specialist, you'll proactively engage customers through outbound outreach while delivering exceptional service and support. You'll help customers navigate their insurance options, answer questions, and ensure they have access to the resources they need.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct high-volume outbound outreach using approved dialing systems and customer lists.
  • Build rapport quickly and create positive customer experiences through professional, empathetic communication.
  • Educate customers about available programs, services, benefits, and next steps.
  • Follow approved scripts and compliance requirements while maintaining an authentic and conversational approach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and follow-up activities within company systems.
  • Address questions, identify customer needs, and escalate complex issues when appropriate.
  • Protect sensitive customer information and comply with all privacy, regulatory, and company requirements.
  • Support inbound customer calls and other service initiatives as business needs evolve.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and development activities to continuously strengthen your skills.
  • Collaborate with teammates and cross-functional partners to deliver a seamless customer experience.

What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications

  • Active Accident & Health Insurance License in your state of residence (required).
  • Bilingual Requirement: Fluency in Spanish and English (required)
  • Strong customer service background with a passion for helping others.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to build trust, demonstrate empathy, and navigate sensitive conversations professionally.
  • Comfortable working in a structured environment with established processes and scripts.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately document customer interactions.
  • Ability to work independently while remaining highly engaged with a team.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous call center, healthcare, health insurance, Medicare, sales support, or customer engagement experience.
  • Experience working remotely and maintaining productivity in a home-office environment.
  • Prior experience in high-volume outbound calling environments.

Success in This Role


The ideal candidate is:

  • Customer-focused and passionate about helping others.
  • Adaptable and comfortable shifting between outbound and inbound support as business needs change.
  • Open to cross-training and learning new responsibilities.
  • Coachable and receptive to feedback for continuous improvement.
  • Confident following required scripts and compliance guidelines while delivering a personalized customer experience.
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and able to stay productive in a remote work environment.
  • Resilient and professional when managing challenging conversations or customer concerns.

Work Environment


This position may be performed remotely, in a hybrid setting, or in an office environment based on business needs. Team members use company-provided technology and must maintain a secure, professional workspace that supports confidential customer conversations.


Join Us


If you're a licensed insurance professional who enjoys connecting with people, solving problems, and delivering exceptional service, this is an opportunity to build a rewarding career while making a meaningful impact on customers every day. We welcome motivated, customer-focused professionals who are eager to learn, grow, and contribute to a high-performing team.


Apply today and help customers navigate their health insurance journey with confidence.

Job Description

The Measurement Science Lead Consultant combines deep analytical expertise with strong consulting, communication, and stakeholder management skills. This role is responsible for defining and ensuring high-quality measurement practices across Claims. This role serves as a strategic leader and subject matter expert, partnering with business and analytics teams to ensure initiatives are measured accurately, enabling confident, data-driven decision making. Reducing the risk of misinformed decisions is critical to the future success of Allstate.
The role is guided by 3 core pillars.
Consult: We have short term consulting engagements with teams across claims. These engagements are used to provide feedback and course correct measurement on specific projects.
Embed: We have long-term engagements. This role periodically serves as a dedicated resource within business and product teams, providing hands-on analytical support, domain expertise, and partnership to help achieve strategic objectives.
Educate: We help educate claims leaders and employees on how to think about and execute with measurement science.

Communication & Stakeholder Influence

  • Translate complex analytical concepts into clear business recommendations.

What Success Looks Like

  • Measurement practices are consistently applied across high-impact Claims initiatives
  • Claims leaders trust measurement outputs and use them to drive decisions
  • Initiatives have clear, defensible impact assessments
  • Measurement risks are identified early and mitigated proactively

Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for ensuring a successful day-to-day operation of all Entertainment venues, shows, and events at Universal Kids Resort. Provides support and technical skills to ensure show quality and a positive Guest experience. Partners across Entertainment to communicate show or safety issues and ensures safety of self, Guests, and other Team Members by following Universal standards and procedures. Conducts daily venue startups and assessments, operates technical components, and performs routine preventative, diagnostic and corrective maintenance on a variety of platforms to include show control, communications, wireless audio systems, lighting, video, digital projection and similar. Reports technical issues to leadership in a timely manner to ensure show readiness.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for the operation of technical components within the assigned venue or event including but not limited to the operation of lighting, audio, show controls and special effects in a live show situation. Responsible for the successful operation of live performances and/or technical presentations, including completion of pre/post show presets and resets. Responsible for the careful execution of show elements/cues to preserve show quality. Maintains the proper show timing and levels as directed by show direction and venue training. Conducts daily startup, checks and shutdown for Entertainment venues to ensure the technical entertainment show systems and elements are ready for daily operation. Ensures readiness of supported by Operations teams including but not limited to prepping equipment and show elements and running shows as needed.
  • Facilitates communication and coordination with the Lead Technician and/or management as necessary. Conveys resource requirements and work plans to maintain effective communication between technicians, Tech Leads, and other management personnel. Responsible for effective and timely communication of pertinent information, both written and verbal, pertaining to the technical operation of the assigned entertainment venue/event to Leads, management, internal partners and Team Members of the venue/event. Ensures proper completion of all technical documentation to include daily checklists, pertinent information and other related documentation.
  • Assists with the appropriate maintenance and inventory of venue equipment/supplies as assigned for proper operation, organization, and cleanliness. Assists in the assembly of gear and routinely checking equipment for safe use. Notifies leadership of any materials needed and any repairs needed beyond basic maintenance of the venue/show.
  • Performs daily, weekly, monthly, semi-annual, and annual inspections, testing and preventative maintenance on technical entertainment systems and elements according to checklists for each milestone. Accountable to strictly adhere to all policies and procedures, as defined by the Entertainment Department, governing the safe operation of all technical equipment and special effects products within the assigned venue or event. Responsible for accurately and timely recording maintenance and any related activities in the requisite systems/platforms.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Individual Contributor.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

Preferred Certifications include:

  • Q-Sys Level 1 or 2
  • Q-Sys Control Training 201 and Control & UCI Fundamentals Certification
  • Dante Level 1, 2 or 3
  • Christie Certification Training
  • SMAART Technologies Software Certification
  • ETCP/Esta
  • Avixa CTS ANP

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED required. Associates or Bachelors degree in Theater/Entertainment Technical fields preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

  • 1+ years of experience in a Theatre or Stage Technician environment required; experience with Q-Sys systems preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Join us for a once in a lifetime opportunity.Play a vital role in our culinary team as a Steward, where youll thrive in a fast-paced and collaborative environment. In this position, youll be responsible for maintaining the cleanliness and organization of the kitchen and ensuring all equipment is properly cleaned and ready for use. Working closely with other team members, youll help support smooth kitchen operations by upholding the highest sanitation and safety standards. Your attention to detail and commitment to teamwork will contribute to an efficient workspace and exceptional guest experiences.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary admission to Universal Studios Hollywood and all Universal Theme parks
  • Earn complimentary tickets for your friends and family
  • Discounts on food and merchandise
  • Special events for employees (preview nights for new attractions/events)
  • Building lifelong friendships
  • Resume building workshops
  • Growth opportunities 
  • Wellness programs

Responsibilities:

  • Drain, clean out, and de-lime dish machine.
  • Stock cleaning supplies including, but not limited to, paper towel dispensers, J-fill stations, hand soap, and machine chemicals Clean loading docks; Sweep, mop and wash floors and walls in the kitchen areas.
  • Dispose of waste, garbage, and recyclable materials from kitchen area to appropriate receptacles.
  • Wash pots and pans, and kitchen utensils by hand or dish washing machine and return cleaned items to the proper storage location.
  • Promotes and provides extraordinary guest service for both internal and external guests; answers questions and offers information in a courteous manner.
  • Understands and demonstrates the proper use of safety practices and ensures department standards are maintained and safety policies for the Park upheld.
  • Monitor and maintain a safe and secure environment for both team members and guests of all ages, following all company guidelines and protocols.
  • Identify, de-escalate, and resolve conflicts or disturbances professionally and effectively to maintain a positive atmosphere.
  • Provide a positive and welcoming experience for guests of all ages while maintaining composure during difficult interactions.
  • Maintain a high level of trust and integrity to promote a safe, secure, and welcoming environment for customers and colleagues of all ages.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

  • Must be 18 years old or older
  • Previous Experience as a Steward and/or similar 

Job Demands:

  • Must be able to walk or stand for extended periods of time
  • Must regularly lift and/or move up to 25lbs, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 lbs with assistance
  • The noise level is generally moderate to high
  • Team Members are subject to a variety of weather conditions, including but not limited to: heat, sun exposure, cold, and inclement weather. Depending on the assigned location, work can be almost exclusively outdoors

Schedule:

  • Must be available to work at least 4 days per week throughout the peak seasons to include a rotation of mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays

Pay:

  • $19 per hour

Description

Independently plans and monitors the completion of bookclose processes and financial reports in a deadline focused environment, while ensuring that issues are escalated as needed. Uses increasing expertise to process detailed information with high levels of accuracy and to research and apply accounting policy. Communicates effectively with other units and management to plan work, gather information, and present results. Leads efforts to continuously improve processes to produce relevant financial reports in the fastest, most efficient means possible.


Responsibilities
  • Oversees functions of the monthly, quarterly and annual book close cycles, monitoring timely completion and escalating issues for resolution.
  • Accurately and efficiently performs accounting activities of increasing complexity.
  • Creates increasingly complex financial statement schedules, audit support schedules and other reports in a timely manner. May perform detailed review of other team members` schedules.
  • Researches and applies accounting policy to business issues that arise.
  • Establishes, documents and performs internal control procedures to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Understands how data flows through the financial systems to the accounting function in order to identify issues and take action to address them.
  • Continually assesses the business value and efficiency of the work performed, making suggestions for improvements and collaborating with others in implementing them.
  • Leads or actively participates in increasingly complex department projects and continuous improvement activities.
  • Fosters the development of teammates by sharing expertise and experience through training or reviewing their work. May provide feedback on performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor`s degree (Accounting or Finance) and a minimum of 3 years of accounting or finance experience preferred
  • Must demonstrate attention to detail in a fast-paced work environment and the ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously to achieve results
  • Must be able to communicate effectively with teammates and others, leading meetings and interacting with increasingly higher levels of management to gather information and effectively present results/recommendations
  • Advanced knowledge of Excel and Microsoft Word is preferred

JOB SUMMARY: 

Prepares and cooks food for multi-unit operation at Universal Kids Resort. May lead the Line Cook as directed by Sous Chef during service. Assists Sous Chef in ordering, receiving, and having a basic knowledge of the overall inventory process. Trains new Team Members in the Line Cook role and leading them when there is not culinary leadership available. Role will be cross trained at all food stations and have proficient knowledge of food preparation and food safety. 

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Performs Cook duties at all stations in the kitchen to ensure food preparation meets Universal Standards. Monitors Line Cooks to make sure proper food safety practices are followed at all times.
  • Performs duties of a Line Cook, including opening/closing procedures, interacting with guests when necessary, knowing allergen information, ensuring PPE is properly used, and maintaining cleanliness of the station. Ensures compliance of the State of Texas HACCP program and ServSafe certification.
  • Trains new Team Members on basic food safety and the overall process of food preparation/venue standards. Assists the Sous Chef with leading the Line Cooks workflow, helping them to manage their priorities and keeping preparation time efficient.
  • Assists the Sous Chef as directed in the ordering and receiving process, along with having a basic understanding of inventory, and accounting for spoilage and daily temperature logs.
  • Ensures that all preparations are in accordance with established recipes, menu and portion specifications based on business volumes. Supports Culinary leadership to ensure operational efficiencies and labor optimization.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Chefs Apprentice is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years of Line Cook experience is required; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • Certified Professional Food Managers certification is preferred.

 

  • Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$52,600.00 - $86,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

This position services Insureds/Agents in and around Prescott, AZ. The selected candidate must reside in or be willing to relocate at their own expense to the assigned territory.

This position is based remotely with work at residential and commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

As an Associate Claim Rep, Outside Property, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage 1st party property claims.

This program is typically 9-12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Review, investigate, and document 1st party property claims under close supervision.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third-party providers.
  • Learn to investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for building damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilizes as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, claimants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • In order to perform the essential functions of this role, acquisition and maintenance of Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification may be required to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements. Generally, required Insurance License(s) must be obtained within three months of starting the role, and ongoing continuing education requirements must be maintained as mandated.
  • This position requires participation in our Catastrophe Response Program, which could include deployment to assist our customers in other states.
  • This position requires the individual to access and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, which is physically demanding requiring the ability to carry, set up and climb a ladder weighing approximately 38 to 49 pounds, walk on roofs, and enter tight spaces (such as attic staircases and entries, crawl spaces, etc.). While specific territory or day-to-day responsibilities may not require an individual to climb a ladder, the incumbent must be capable of safely climbing a ladder when deploying to a catastrophe which is a requirement of the position.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); willingness to learn claims management and estimating software.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrated openness to continuous learning.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED and one year of customer service experience.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

Licensed Insurance Sales Representative (Remote / Home-Based)

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.


As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstates discretion.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously

Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of engagement
  • Maintain consistent availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations, especially during the first 90 days of employment
  • Conduct consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business needs
  • Meet or exceed established productivity, quality, and performance standards
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively assisting customers

This position is only available within theUS, but notcurrently available for Puerto Rico, California, New York, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington state residents.

Candidates who reside in locations where the local minimum wage exceeds the base pay for this position are also not eligible for consideration. This is due to compliance with wage regulations and internal compensation practices.


Reasonable Accommodation Statement

Allstate provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their role. During the first 90 days of employment, reasonable accommodations generally do not include removing essential job functions, creating new positions, or lowering performance or productivity standards.

Job Description

The Senior IT Director II, Operations Delivery & Reliability is a senior leadership role accountable for the platforms on which the enterprise builds, hosts, and runs software — and for the controls, lifecycle, and quality disciplines that keep the technology estate reliable, compliant, and current. The role owns Tower 4 (Application & Developer Platforms) and Tower 5 (Service Reliability & Technology Stewardship) of the IT Infrastructure Services operating model. This Level II Senior Director leads other director- and senior-manager-level leaders across application hosting and platform engineering, integration, DevOps and automation, observability, and the enterprise service-management, configuration, asset, lifecycle, and technology-controls functions.

This role pairs a build-and-run platform mandate with an independent stewardship mandate: enabling development teams to deliver software quickly and safely, while governing the change, incident, configuration, compliance, and lifecycle disciplines that protect service quality across every tower. The successful candidate is equally comfortable commanding a Sev-1 major-incident bridge, setting the roadmap for the enterprise ITSM and observability platforms, and briefing executive leadership on reliability, technical-debt, and license-compliance posture.

Key Responsibilities

Tower 4 — Application & Developer Platforms (build, host, and run software)

  • Own the application hosting and platform estate — web, database, and big-data hosting, PaaS, and middleware — ensuring the platforms that host enterprise software are secure, performant, and scalable.

  • Own support for SaaS and third-party applications, providing consistent operational ownership, vendor coordination, and service levels across the third-party application portfolio.

  • Own enterprise integration and batch services — APIs, messaging, ETL/ELT, and scheduled batch processing — as the connective tissue between applications and data.

  • Own the DevOps and CI/CD toolchain and the platform-engineering and automation function, giving delivery teams self-service pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and release automation to build, test, and ship software safely and quickly.

  • Own the enterprise GenAI platform — the shared, governed foundation for AI-enabled capabilities (model access, orchestration, and guardrails) — in partnership with the Office of the CTO on AI governance (AI TRiSM).

  • Own the observability platform — enterprise monitoring, logging, tracing, and telemetry — providing the signal that underpins reliability, capacity, and performance decisions across all towers.

Tower 5 — Service Reliability & Technology Stewardship (controls, lifecycle, and quality)

  • Own the enterprise ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow) as the system of record for IT service management, including its health, roadmap, and adoption across all towers and affiliate entities.

  • Own the core service-management processes — incident, problem, and change management — and lead the Major Incident Management function, including Sev-1/Sev-2 command, executive communications, and post-incident review.

  • Own configuration management and the CMDB, maintaining accurate, trusted service and asset relationships that underpin change, incident, and impact analysis.

  • Own IT asset and software license management — hardware and software inventory, entitlement and true-up positioning, and license compliance — in partnership with FinOps and vendor management on cost and renewal exposure.

  • Own the technology-lifecycle function — currency, end-of-life / end-of-support tracking, and remediation planning — to keep the estate supportable and reduce technical debt and risk.

  • Coordinate the technology-controls response for compliance, audit, and vulnerability management — evidence, control attestation, and remediation — partnering with Information Security and Internal Audit / Risk. (This role coordinates and remediates technology controls; it does not replace second-line security or audit functions.)

  • Own workforce IAM operations — joiner/mover/leaver provisioning, access-request fulfillment, and periodic access certification — partnering with the infrastructure towers that own the underlying identity infrastructure (Active Directory, DNS, federation) and with Information Security on IAM policy.

Cross-Tower Leadership, Sourcing & Governance

  • Lead and develop director- and senior-manager-level leaders across both towers; set clear accountability, coach for performance, and build bench strength.

  • Govern the internal-versus-partner-delivered sourcing mix: keep architecture, standards, platform ownership, and incident/change leadership internal, and direct commodity run, application support, and after-hours coverage to delivery partners under clear SLA and performance governance.

  • Own and mature the tower-level KPI/scorecard — platform availability and SLO attainment, MTTR, change success rate, major-incident frequency, CMDB accuracy, license-compliance position, and vulnerability-remediation SLA — and use the data to drive investment, staffing, and process decisions.

  • Partner with Finance and the Office of the CTO (Tower 6) on TBM cost pools and unit economics for these towers (e.g., cost per application, per pipeline, per license), supporting the transition from showback to chargeback.

  • Represent Operations Delivery & Reliability in the Architecture Review Board, Change Advisory Board, and Risk & Resilience Committee, and in executive and leadership forums, preparing clear, data-backed materials and recommendations.

  • Champion continuous improvement across both towers — modeling a culture of accountability and disciplined execution, and applying ITIL 4 continual-improvement and Lean practices.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, with direct experience in application platforms / platform engineering and/or IT service management and service reliability within a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Prior experience managing and leading other director-level or senior-manager-level technical leaders.
  • Hands-on depth in several of: application hosting (web/database/middleware), PaaS, enterprise integration / APIs and batch, DevOps / CI-CD and automation, observability/monitoring, and cloud-native application platforms.
  • Strong ITSM/ITIL foundation — incident, problem, change, configuration, and service-level management — with ServiceNow platform ownership experience strongly preferred; ITIL 4 certification a plus.
  • Demonstrated experience leading Major Incident Management (Sev-1 command) and running structured problem- and post-incident-review processes.
  • Experience with IT asset and software license management, technology lifecycle / currency management, and coordinating compliance, audit, and vulnerability remediation with security and audit partners.
  • Familiarity with IAM operations (joiner/mover/leaver provisioning, access certification) and its interplay with identity infrastructure and information security.
  • Exposure to GenAI platform enablement and AI governance (AI TRiSM) is a plus.
  • Demonstrated experience managing partner-delivered / outsourced application support and run operations, including SLA and performance governance; managed-services transition experience a strong plus.
  • Proven experience translating strategy into an execution roadmap, with strong business and financial acumen; TBM/FinOps familiarity a plus.
  • Excellent executive presence, written and verbal communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders.
  • Experience with Lean / continuous-improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean Six Sigma) is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, with direct experience in application platforms / platform engineering and/or IT service management and service reliability within a complex, matrixed organization.

Required Management Experience

  • 5+ years direct supervisory/management experience

Required Education

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience; Master's degree (MBA) and/or relevant certifications (ITIL 4, PMP) preferred.

General Physical Demands
Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required.

Physical/Environmental Activities
Must be able to travel to multiple locations for work (i.e. travel to attend meetings, events, conferences).

May be exposed to outdoor weather conditions of cold, heat, wet, and humidity. May be exposed to outdoor or warehouse conditions of loud noises, vibration, fumes, dust, odors, and mists. Must be able to ascend and descend ladders, stairs, or other equipment.

Posting Description

Surety Account Manager, Processor Team Lead

Summary

The Surety Account Manager is responsible for managing client relationships, overseeing surety account service activities, and providing leadership and direction to the Surety Processing team. This role serves as the primary point of contact for clients, carriers, and internal stakeholders while ensuring the accurate and timely issuance, renewal, and servicing of surety bonds. The Surety Account Manager drives operational excellence through workflow management, quality control, staff development, and process improvement while delivering exceptional client service and maintaining strong carrier relationships.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, surety carriers, producers, and internal business partners.
  • Participate in client meetings and provide consultative support regarding bond programs, renewals, and service needs.
  • Lead the review of surety proposals, bond documentation, renewal information, and carrier source documents for accuracy and completeness.
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of the Surety Processing team, including workflow distribution, prioritization, and quality assurance.
  • Provide guidance, training, and mentorship to surety processors to support performance, productivity, and professional development.
  • Monitor departmental service standards and ensure timely completion of bond issuance, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements.
  • Manage and maintain client records, bond schedules, policy information, and supporting documentation within agency management systems and carrier portals.
  • Review and approve bond requests, renewal processing, invoices, finance agreements, and related surety transactions.
  • Coordinate the issuance of new and renewal bonds, including bid, performance, payment, maintenance, and miscellaneous bonds.
  • Track bond renewals and ensure all required documentation and billing information is processed accurately and within established service timelines.
  • Address client service issues, billing inquiries, and bond-related concerns while collaborating with carriers and internal departments as needed.
  • Assist with process development, workflow enhancements, and operational efficiency initiatives to improve overall team performance.
  • Maintain compliance with agency procedures, carrier requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Support special projects and departmental initiatives as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of surety bonds, bond administration processes, and surety industry practices.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop team members.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong client relationship management and customer service skills.
  • Ability to make sound independent decisions and exercise professional judgment.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with clients, carriers, producers, and internal teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office products, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Experience working with agency management systems and carrier platforms preferred.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, processes, and technology.

Education and Experience

  • Associate's degree or equivalent experience required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 3+ years of insurance industry experience, including surety account management, surety operations, or related client service experience.
  • Previous leadership, supervisory, or team lead experience preferred.
  • Experience managing bond issuance, renewals, and surety servicing activities preferred.

Certificates, Licenses, and Registration

  • Property & Casualty Insurance License required or obtainable within 30 days of hire.
  • Surety-specific industry designations or advanced insurance certifications are a plus.

What we Offer:

Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. Summary:

The HR Operations Generalist is key to delivering HR services efficiently throughout the organization. Reporting to the Global HR Operations & Services Leader, this role acts as the initial contact for employee questions. It also supports HR operations across functions and maintains consistent compliance and policy standards.

This role bridges employee experience and operational success. You will manage case workflows, prioritize and increase inquiries, support large-scale lifecycle events, and help with HR compliance and policy updates. The ideal candidate is organized, diligent, and comfortable working within structured HR systems and processes in a fast-paced environment.

This role also supports the Payroll & Benefits teams, as well as M&A transactions.

This role can be performed entirely remotely.

What You'll Do

Manage HR Service Delivery & Case Management

  • Serve as the primary owner of HR ServiceNow ticket management, ensuring timely triage, categorization, assignment, and resolution of employee inquiries.
  • Act as Tier 1 support for employee questions related to payroll, benefits, time off, leaves, and general HR policies.
  • Advance complex inquiries to HR Business Partners, Payroll, Benefits, Compensation, or other Centers of Excellence (COEs) as appropriate.
  • Monitor case metrics and identify trends or recurring issues requiring process improvement.
  • Ensure service-level expectations are consistently met and detailed.

Support Employee Lifecycle Events

  • Support large-scale lifecycle transactions such as organizational restructures, acquisitions, and offboarding waves.
  • Coordinate cross-functional communication between HRIS, Payroll, Benefits, IT, and managers during major lifecycle events.
  • Assist in validating data accuracy during bulk updates or organizational changes within Workday.
  • Ensure uniform implementation of standardized lifecycle processes and documentation.

Support HR Compliance & Policy Governance

  • Support the development, documentation, maintenance, and updating of HR policies and procedures.
  • Partner with Legal and HR leadership to ensure policies align with regulatory requirements across relevant jurisdictions.
  • Support regulatory changes systemically, and lead the testing of updates to Workday compliance changes.
  • Ensure compliance documentation is audit-ready and centrally maintained.
  • Support internal audits and compliance reporting as required.

Partner Across HR & Operations

  • Offer operational assistance to the HR Operations Leader, HRIS Leader, Payroll Manager, and Benefits Manager, managing daily transactions within each of the functional areas.
  • Support integrations, data governance, and reporting needs.
  • Work with the Corporate Development team to support and coordinate the HR Integration process for newly closed acquisitions, working with Sellers and HR Operations team.
  • Assist with documentation of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and workflow improvements.
  • Support the rollout and integration of HR systems and tools.
  • Find opportunities to streamline service delivery and improve employee experience.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Maintain high standards of data accuracy and confidentiality.
  • Track and report on HR service metrics and process efficiency.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across HR operations.
  • Ensure consistent communication and transparency across collaborator groups.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience, preferred.
  • 3-5+ years of HR experience in operations, shared services, or generalist roles.
  • Experience managing HR case management systems.
  • Solid grasp of employee lifecycle procedures and HR regulatory requirements.
  • 1-2 years' experience with Workday or similar HRIS platforms preferred.
  • Familiarity with Payroll and Benefits processes.
  • Some experience in an M&A environment preferred.
  • Strong written communication skills, particularly in policy drafting and documentation.
  • Outstanding organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage sensitive information with discretion and integrity.
  • Comfortable working in a well-organized, methodical environment.
  • Learning agility, curiosity, and problem-solving skills preferred.

The Assistant Vice President – Commercial General Liability Claims is responsible for providing claims advocacy and account management services to clients involving moderate, complex and catastrophic claims. The Assistant Vice President is the contact/liaison/advocate between the client, carrier and NFP. The primary purpose is to assure clients receive exceptional service, maximization of policy coverage, in-depth advice and claims advocacy in a timely and effective manner. This will be accomplished by adhering to claims procedures, implementation of effective and consistent claims service programs and direct participation in and oversight of collaborative claims resolution strategies. This position requires significant commercial general liability claims experience, expertise in written and verbal communications, a high level of organization and the ability to work in an independent setting.

Principal Roles and Responsibilities

  • Senior technical specialist role involving complex and catastrophic claims, heavy litigation, in numerous State and Federal jurisdictions.
  • Serve as a trusted advocate for clients and key partners by delivering strategic guidance and expert oversight in the management of general liability claims.
  • Engage collaboratively with clients, their representatives, insurers, technical experts, consultants, producers, and account managers to effectively advocate for client interests and ensure alignment across all partners.
  • Take ownership of resolving client claim issues in a timely manner, ensuring clear and proactive communication of outcomes to all relevant partners.
  • Prompt notification to Claims Leaders, Sale and Service team, and others of large reserve changes in excess of $100,000.
  • Maintain thorough and timely documentation within the EPIC claim file system, including detailed updates on claim activity, client and carrier interactions, and supporting documentation. Ensure all correspondence and materials are accurately filed using established naming conventions to preserve a comprehensive and auditable claim history.
  • Conduct thorough coverage analysis and research to address claim-related issues and collaborate closely with clients and their representatives to develop and present well-reasoned coverage rebuttals when appropriate (on occasion may assist other lines of business, including but not limited to Commercial Transportation/Automobile, Private Client Group, Personal Risk Teams, etc.).
  • Attend (virtually or in-person) client meetings, including claim reviews, pre-renewals, renewal, etc.
  • Support the General Liability Claim Leader and Sales Team in resolving client claim issues by providing responsive assistance and collaborative problem-solving to ensure timely and effective outcomes.
  • Provide support to Claim Leadership on a variety of initiatives, including the development and refinement of procedures, enhancement of claim service programs, and execution of ad-hoc projects.
  • Occasionally author white papers and/or give presentations on topics clients are facings.

Education, Experience and Skills Requirements

Education: Bachelor's degree required. Additional insurance certifications and/or legal background are a plus.

Experience: A minimum of 15 years of experience in the commercial general liability claims industry is required. Candidates must have held a Senior Claims Analyst role or higher. Additional experience in commercial insurance sales, marketing, or other lines of business is considered a strong asset.

Skills:

  • Proficiency with general liability insurance products, contractual risk transfer, claims handling and management, and processes. Strong solid understanding of transportation/automobile liability, management liability (E&O, D&O, Cyber, Crime), property and workers compensation coverages a plus.
  • Proven background of working effectively with clients and partners in Claims Analyst, Service or Management capacity involving complex coverage, litigation, large and catastrophic general liability claims in jurisdictions across the United States.
  • High level of organizational skills with proven successful experience in managing multiple tasks and internal /external clients concurrently in a claims setting.
  • Demonstrated expertise in written and verbal communications.
  • Customer Service – Manages difficult or emotional client situations; Responds promptly to client needs.
  • Proficiency with using broker based and carrier claims software applications. Knowledge of the EPIC system is a plus.
  • Proficiency with all Microsoft Suite of products including excel, outlook, word and power point.
  • Proficiency in performing web-based meetings and with performing in person audio / visual presentations to small and large size groups.
  • Proficiency in coordinating and performing technical claims discussions with internal and external clients.
  • Proficiency in coordinating claims audits and reviews.
  • Collaboration - Balances team and individual responsibilities
  • Ethics - Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works with integrity and ethically; Upholds organizational values.
  • Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values.
  • Judgment - Exhibits sound and accurate judgment; Includes appropriate people in decision-making process.
  • Motivation - Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles.
  • Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Sets goals and objectives; Can assist with organization and schedules of other people and their tasks.

The Siemens Electrification and Automation business provides power distribution systems and service solutions that help customers improve the reliability, safety, and performance of their electrical infrastructure.

We are looking for a Project Manager, Customer Services to join our Project Management Office. In this customer-facing role, you will lead service projects from initiation through final closeout while managing safety, scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, and customer expectations.

You will work across a matrixed organization and coordinate with engineering, field service, commercial, finance, vendors, contractors, and customers. This position may be performed remotely or based in Wendell, North Carolina, with travel required approximately 10% to 25% annually.

You'll make a difference by:

  • Directing all phases of assigned service projects from initiation through completion, including project planning, execution, monitoring, closeout, and lessons learned.
  • Managing project scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, resources, revenue forecasting, and overall performance while developing recovery plans when projects are not meeting expectations.
  • Identifying project risks, including potential safety risks, and developing mitigation strategies that support the safe and successful completion of service activities.
  • Communicating project milestones, field activities, financial status, risks, changes, and performance updates to customers, project teams, leadership, finance partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Coordinating internal and external resources, including engineering teams, field service personnel, vendors, suppliers, consultants, and contractors, to support project requirements and site schedules.
  • Managing contractual requirements, change orders, claims processes, supplier agreements, requests for quotation, and customer expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

Project and system experience may include:

  • Installation, commissioning, maintenance outage testing, electrical retrofits, and electrical system emergency response or disaster recovery.
  • Turnkey, design-build, and engineer-procure-construct projects.
  • Power system studies and field service projects involving internal teams and third-party suppliers, consultants, and contractors.
  • Low-voltage and medium-voltage air-insulated switchgear, medium-voltage gas-insulated switchgear, switches, panelboards, and automatic transfer switches.
  • Transformers, motor control centers, medium-voltage contactors, integrated electrical house systems, cable systems, busways, connectors, and supporting systems.
  • Solar photovoltaic systems, inverters, battery systems, and related electrical infrastructure.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 5+ years direct project management experience supporting service projects involving low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear.
  • 3+ years experience working in field service operations or a field service environment, such as a field service technician, engineer, project manager, or project specialist.
  • Demonstrated experience with low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear.
  • Ability to travel approximately 10% to 25% annually.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, construction management, or a related field.
  • Project Management Professional certification. If not currently certified, ability to obtain the certification within one year of employment.
  • Project management experience in electrical switchgear field service, engineer-procure-construct projects, construction, energy, manufacturing, or a related industrial environment.
  • Experience leading cross-functional project teams that include engineering, field service, commercial, finance, suppliers, and contractors.
  • Experience interpreting project contracts and managing change orders, claims, liquidated damages, specifications, supplier scope, schedules, and budgets.
  • Experience using Microsoft Project to develop, maintain, and communicate project schedules.

As a Senior Building Automation Programmer – PLC & Industrial Controls create advanced programming solutions for complex building automation, HVAC controls, and PLC-based control systems in new and existing facilities. This role supports data centers, pharmaceutical facilities, laboratories, central utility plants, and other mission-critical environments by developing reliable control logic, PLC programs, system integration programming, point mapping, functional testing documentation, and technical solutions that meet customer requirements, improve operational performance, and support successful project execution.

As a Building Automation Programmer, you will:

  • Program large, complex, and custom projects using PLC-based programming platforms and control logic.
  • Develop and implement PLC programs using Siemens TIA Portal, including structured control logic for mission-critical building automation and industrial control applications.
  • Design, conﬁgure, and support visualization solutions, including HMI and SCADA interfaces, to provide operators with clear system status, alarms, trends, and control information.
  • Provide post-sale assistance for programming labor estimating.
  • Test PLC programs prior to initial release for quality assurance and functional performance.
  • Create functional testing and commissioning documents utilized to validate PLC logic, system integration, and ﬁeld performance.
  • Support commissioning, start-up, optimization, error analysis, and troubleshooting of PLC-based automation systems in coordination with project teams and ﬁeld resources.
  • Document PLC software solutions, system conﬁguration, testing results, revisions, and integration requirements to support quality control and long-term maintainability.
  • Assist the Graphics Design team by coordinating dynamic point information, alarms, trends, and PLC-integrated system data into graphics.
  • Collaborate with the Design Team to identify speciﬁcation discrepancies, coordinate PLC integration requirements, and request clariﬁcation as needed.
  • Work both independently and in team dynamics in a remote environment.
  • Mentor, train, and provide technical assistance to other team members.
  • Travel as needed up to 25%

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma, or state-recognized GED.
  • Demonstrated experience programming commercial building automation, HVAC, or industrial control systems using PLC-based control strategies.
  • Solid knowledge of Siemens PLC programming, especially Siemens S7-1200/1500 platforms and Siemens TIA Portal.
  • 5+ years of experience with structured programming methods aligned with IEC 61131-3 programming standards; ladder logic is the preferred programming language for this role.
  • 5+ years of demonstrated experience with Siemens or third-party PLC platforms, control logic development, and system integration.
  • Demonstrated electro-mechanical aptitude to read and understand design drawings, control schematics, sequence of operations, points lists, and construction documents.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Office.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualiﬁcations:

  • Associate or Bachelor's degree
  • 7+ years of experience with Siemens or third-party PLC platforms, control logic development, and integrated system programming
  • Demonstrated knowledge of PLC-based control systems, industrial communication protocols, and building automation system integration, including PROFINET, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP, or similar protocols based on applicable work experience
  • Experience with HMI/SCADA visualization platforms, drives technology, high-level programming languages such as Python or C#/.NET, robotics, or IT security in industrial systems

Finance Data Architect

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

Who are we?

At Siemens Grid Software, we accelerate and secure a successful Energy Transition

Today the energy world is changing to become carbon neutral. Distributed Energy Resources are growing rapidly and decentralized power generation is transforming how energy systems operate. Utility companies are rethinking their IT/OT landscapes and require agile, data-driven solutions to operate efficiently and securely.

At Siemens Grid Software, we are at the forefront of this transformation, enabling our customers through advanced digital solutions, analytics, and software platforms.

Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens Grid Software here:

https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/energy/topics/smart-grid.html

Our Culture

At Siemens Grid Software, we foster an ownership culture where employees take responsibility, collaborate openly, and continuously improve. We value innovation, transparency, and data-driven decision-making. Our teams operate globally and work closely across functions to drive meaningful business outcomes.

We have major locations in Minneapolis, MN; Foster City, CA; Schenectady, NY; Houston, TX; and Wendell, NC. This is a remote opportunity and is located in the United States.

Who are we seeking?

We are looking for a Finance Data Architect with a strong foundation in finance and a passion for data, analytics, and automation. This role is designed for a hands-on builder who enjoys creating scalable tools, data models, and reporting solutions that improve how finance operates.

While a portion of the role will support financial analysis and reporting, the vast majority of your time will be focused on developing and enhancing data infrastructure, dashboards, and automation solutions. We aren't looking for a historian to tell us what happened; we are looking for an architect to build the engine that shows us what is happening now and what will happen next.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

Data Modeling, Tool Development & Automation (~70%)

  • Build & Maintain: Design data models and datasets to support high-fidelity financial reporting and analysis.
  • Visualize: Develop scalable Power BI dashboards and semantic models for business-wide use.
  • Transform: Use Power Query and related tools to structure raw data into actionable insights.
  • Automate: Design repeatable reporting workflows and identify automation opportunities using Power Platform and AI-enabled tools.
  • Standardize: Improve data structures across Actuals, Forecast, and Planning datasets to ensure a "Single Source of Truth."

Finance Analysis & Reporting (~20%)

  • FP&A Support: Provide variance analysis and forecasting inputs to the controlling teams.
  • Targeted Analysis: Perform deep-dive data analysis to identify business trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Translate: Turn complex business questions into clear, data-driven narratives.

Strategic Project Support & Integration (~10%)

  • R&D / PLM Controlling: Assist in financial tracking and cost transparency for product development initiatives and resource allocation.
  • Ecosystem Integration: Work with SAP data (FI/CO, COPA) and support the integration of data sources into platforms like Snowflake.
  • Architecture Improvement: Assist in improving data pipelines and overall regional data architecture.

You will make an impact by:

Qualifications & Key Competencies

  • Analytical Rigor & Curiosity:You don't just "run" reports; you interrogate the data. You have a natural drive to understand the "why" behind the numbers and the "how" behind the data flow.
  • Self-Directed Ownership:As a "builder" in a remote environment, you must be a high-agency individual who can identify a problem, design a solution, and execute it with minimal supervision.
  • Data Storytelling & Influence:The ability to translate complex data models into clear, actionable business narratives.
  • Commitment to Data Integrity:You are the guardian of the "Single Source of Truth." You have an uncompromising eye for detail and understand that a dashboard is only as good as the governance behind it.
  • Resilience & Stakeholder Partnership:You possess the "strong resolve" necessary to partner with high-performing, autonomous teams. You can hold the line on data standards and financial discipline while remaining a collaborative business partner.
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset:You are never satisfied with "how we've always done it." You are constantly looking for ways to automate, simplify, and scale our financial operations.

Required Education & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Finance, Accounting, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or Engineering). We value candidates who can bridge the gap between financial logic and data architecture.

Must have 8plus years of the following:

  • The Architect's Toolkit: Expert-level Power BI (DAX) and Power Query (M).
  • Data Modeling: Proven experience building relational data models and semantic layers (Star Schemas).
  • SAP Core: Strong working knowledge of SAP FI/CO and COPA modules.
  • Advanced Analytics & Modeling (Excel): Expert functionality (Dynamic Arrays, Power Pivot, and complex logic).
  • Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Modern Data Stack: Exposure to Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms.
  • Code-Savvy: Basic SQL for data querying; Python is a significant plus.
  • AI-Forward: Familiarity with AI-enabled tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to drive development efficiency.
  • Domain Expertise: Experience in R&D, PLM, or project-based financial controlling.

Why this role is unique

  • Engineer the Finance Data Stack: A majority focus on building scalable data infrastructure, moving beyond traditional static reporting.
  • Architect the 'Single Source of Truth': Lead the effort to shape and standardize datasets across the entire business lifecycle.
  • Master the Modern Data Stack: Work at the cutting edge of finance technology, integrating enterprise ERP (SAP) with cloud-based analytics (Snowflake & Power BI).
  • Be the Architect, Not Just the Consumer: This is a "builder" role designed to develop a next-gen skillset at the intersection of Finance, Data Engineering, and Strategic Controlling.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.
