Job.JobTitle: Consulting Engineer for High Automation Complex Manufacturing Systems
Job.JobDescription:
Customer Solution Architecture – Consulting Engineer

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

We are seeking an experienced engineering contributor for a team of talented technology architects and supported sales teams focused on the deployment and support of full stack Siemens hardware and software technologies in complex machine building applications, including CNC lathes, mills, presses, robotics, 3D Printing, and novel multi-axis systems. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background, exceptional teaming skills, a passion for innovation in the industrial and manufacturing fields as well as empathy for the customer.

Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for Consulting Engineer This position will be remote based serving the continental US.

  • Technology Deployment and Support
  • Ensure the successful implementation and integration of Sinumerik and Siemens PLC technology in customer operations.
  • Develop and deliver hands-on training programs and workshops to educate customers on the effective use of Sinumerik technology.
  • Provide ongoing mentoring and support to adjacent engineering teams, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Collaborate with customers to understand their specific use cases and offer tailored solutions that enhance operational efficiency.
  • Stay updated on the latest advancements in Sinumerik and adjacent Siemens technology and its components, including motors, drives, numeric controllers, power management devices, and software for CAD, CAM, PLM, and MES.
  • Enablement Functions
  • Work in mixed compute environments to work on multiple VMs for technology demonstrators
  • Provide expertise in API integration for RESTFUL APIs and MQTT messaging integrating onto 802.11 defined network objects
  • Create and curate a comprehensive library of knowledge base articles to empower customers and reduce the need for direct support.
  • Provide use case and training data input to AI development teams to assist in relevant AI enabled technology roll outs
  • Leverage internal support products (e.g., XCare, Machine Care) to streamline support efforts, enabling the team to focus more on customer enablement and less on reactive support.
  • Team Leadership and Development
  • Contribute to, mentor, and inspire a diverse team of engineers, ensuring you and they are equipped with the skills and knowledge to excel in their roles as leading edge implementation in robotics and industrial automation.
  • Foster an inclusive and collaborative team environment that encourages innovation and problem-solving.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and conduct regular performance reviews, providing constructive feedback and support for career development.
  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration to enhance project delivery and technical excellence.
  • Strategic Planning and Execution
  • Develop and implement strategic initiatives to drive the adoption of Sinumerik and related technology across various industries.
  • Collaborate with product management and sales teams to align engineering efforts with business goals and customer needs.
  • Analyze industry trends and competitor offerings to identify opportunities for improvement and differentiation.
  • Oversee project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation to ensure successful project execution.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in an ABET Certified Engineering program in Computer Science or EE / ECE Master's degree preferred.
  • 8+ years in engineering environments, with a strong focus on motion control technologies, complex system design, and mixed control engineering, IT/OT integrations and SCADA systems.
  • In-depth knowledge of Siemens DI portfolio including Sinumerik technology and its applications in CNC machining and automation. Previous history around HMI development, system integration, software integration (IT/OT) preferred.
  • Familiarity with software development tools in .NET, ASP, Jquery, Rabbit MQ, mySQL, Odata 7, etc.
  • Demonstrated history of gathering / creating / and maintaining customer requirements
  • Ability to manage risks and issues in a rapid fashion for internal and external stakeholders
  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with a track record of developing high-performing teams.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders (Internal and External) at all levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with AI-driven support tools and automation technologies is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customer training and project deployment (>25%).
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Masters Degree in ABET accredited Engineering Discipline
  • Preferred experience of 10+ years
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders (Internal and External) at all levels.
  • Preferred experience with enterprise network architectures as it relates to industrial settings. DCS, SCADA, VLANs, VMs, IT/OT APIs.

Siemens Government Technologies (SGT) is a dynamic and rapidly growing organization, and we are seeking a self-driven individual to complement our growing team.


As part of the SGT Services organization, the Services Portfolio Program Manager (Services Program Manager) leads a services program consisting of related services projects driving customer value realization and business outcomes.


The Services Program Manager will lead the Services strategy, opportunity development and delivery of the program through realization of customer value. The Services Program Manager is responsible for managing the dependencies between projects, establishing and publishing clear priorities among projects and program activities, coordinating the projects effectively and establishing the required program governance model.


The Services Program Manager acts as the primary point of contact for the program and aligns Sales, Presales, Services Management and the customer to drive successful outcomes.


The Services Program Manager works under self-initiative to lead a portfolio of large size projects and complexity.


Responsibilities:

As part of the Services team, the Services Program Manager

•Develops the SGT Services strategy, plan and pricing to deliver customers and SGT value realization

•Leads the portfolio of deliveries to achieve the program vision and to realize business outcomes

•Together with Sales Account Management and SGT Management, sets and manages stakeholder expectations

•Together with Services Management, builds, inspires and motivate an effective team

•Ensures the team members have the resources and support to complete their tasks in a timely and high-quality manner

•Oversees the adoption of Digital Enterprise and Digital Manufacturing Solutions

•Identifies and create additional customer value opportunities within the portfolio

•Conducts stakeholder management through systematic identification, analysis and planning of actions and risk mitigations to positively influence success outcomes

•Enforce change management policies at the project level to ensure the dependencies of the change is reflected and understood on the program level

•Orchestrate program and project schedules to ensure on time delivery

•Agree to targets with the program staff and delegate defined responsibilities and authority

•Actively seek and provide feedback to and from program and project team members, managers, and customers

•Work with Services Management and Procurement to manage business partners and subcontractors

•Ensure the projects in the program deliver to the approved budget and agreed bid margin

•Measure program performance and provide the regular program forecast

•Work with Services administration and Finance to ensure accurate billing and revenue recognition for the entire program


Qualifications:

•Bachelor's degree in Mechanical and/or Manufacturing Engineering, Computer Science, Technology, Project Management or equivalent years of experience in the Digital Industry or related field.

•Minimum of eight (8) years in a project / program leadership position

•Experience with US Federal Government projects, contracts, policies, and procedures

•Working knowledge of the administrative functions of the Services business including project setup, contract structure, progress reporting, revenue recognition and billing


Preferred :

•Experience in implementing or familiarity with Digital Twin software, Manufacturing software, Manufacturing control systems or similar products is highly desired


Travel:

•Willing and able to travel to appropriate work locations, as required by SGT or specified by the customer program up to 40%

Security Clearance:

•Candidate must be a United States citizen, possess no dual citizenship or foreign ties (including foreign passports or visas), and be able to obtain a U.S. Department of Defense security clearance.

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided develop, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers compose better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating an elite software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Product Architect – Customer Outcomes

Are you a highly motivated individual with a passion for the latest engineering and manufacturing software trends including Edge Computing, IOT, and cloud-based solutions? Do you have the ability to guide customers through complex digital transformations? Are you looking for a fast-paced high growth career? If so, please apply for this outstanding opportunity at Siemens Digital Industry Software!

Our Customers:

Many companies are partnering with Siemens to build their Comprehensive Digital Twin; the virtual representation that give them the capability of linking develop and virtual simulations, to physical engineering and manufacturing. These companies are in the Aerospace, Automotive, Consumer Products & Packaging, Electronics, Medical Device, and Semiconductor industries where this technology gives them a competitive advantage. These companies are selecting Siemens because we have a Comprehensive Digital Twin, available today – from concept through manufacturing into field maintenance.

Your Challenge:

Can you be a creative and independent domain specialist?

Become a member of our Customer Outcomes team as a Product Architect. As a Product Architect you will work closely with customers to provide software solutions to help them realize their Comprehensive Digital Twin. Helping our customers blur the boundaries between industry domains by integrating the virtual and physical, hardware and software, design, and manufacturing worlds.

Who we are looking for:

A strong technical contributor that will implement our software solutions for our customers. As part of our team, you will work efficiently with Consultants, Solution Architects, Project Managers, and other internal and external interfaces such as Industry and Product Development teams to ensure that the customer succeeds in their objectives. Be responsible for providing specialist product expertise by consulting, advising, recommending, designing, and where appropriate deploying, specific technical solutions for the Siemens Digital industries Software solution to be delivered optimally and provide value to the customer. Support project/program management activities to control scope, cost, schedule, and quality and in line with program and project processes and messaging, interact with the customer to support the management of customer expectations and support customer adoption.

We need you to already have:

  • Graduated collage with a degree in engineering, computer science, etc.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Teamcenter ITK development, including custom handlers, exits, and BMIDE deployments is REQUIRED
  • Previous experience with implementing enterprise PLM, ERP or MES systems
  • Minimum five years of experience implementing moderately sophisticated Teamcenter solutions or similar products, such as Enovia, ePMD, Windchill, Aras Innovator or Agile
  • Minimum five years Teamcenter experience with specific PLM solution elements such as: Authoring Functional Specifications; Defining Work Streams, Work Breakdown Structures, Scenarios and Use Cases; Data Modeling; Management of CAD Data, Documents and Change Processes; Workflow creation, testing and solving.
  • Minimum five years of experience with Software Development Lifecycles (SDLC) tools, procedures, and standards.
  • Experience using programming languages and tools such as JAVA, C++, C#, SQL, VB, XML
  • General knowledge with Microsoft Windows administration
  • Experience with Windows and/or Linux operating system, Amazon Web Services and/or Microsoft Azure, server/client communications, VPN and reverse proxies and TLS (HTTP vs HTTPS), Docker or Kubernetes, Web Servers (IIS, JBOSS, Tomcat, WebLogic), databases (Oracle, SQL, Aurora, RDS)
  • Preferred experience with Technical Publications and knowledge of S1000D or DITA standards
  • Travel: up to 25%
  • Position can be based anywhere within the continental USA

Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States. his would include H1B, TN, OPT, F1, etc

Job.JobDescription:
Customer Service Project Manager – Data Centers

At Siemens, we live and foster an ownership culture, in which every employee takes personal responsibility for our company's success. We strive to transform the everyday for our customers, employees, and society by:

  • Trusting and empowering our leaders to act as owners, directing their teams, and innovating to succeed.
  • Communicating openly and honestly to learn from our failures and celebrate our successes.
  • Recognizing individual and team achievements frequently
  • Our focus on investment in our team members, offering a wide variety of internal and external development opportunities.
  • Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

Transform the everyday with us!

About Smart Infrastructure – Electrification and Automation:

The Electrification and Automation (EA) Business Unit offers the full range of energy distribution systems and solutions for all markets and through all sales channels. We provide reliable power distribution grids of today while investing into our Future Grids portfolio and applications to create the power distribution grid of the future. Our comprehensive portfolio meets the growing technical requirements of todays and tomorrow's power grid!

Siemens Project Management Office (PMO) is looking for a Customer Services (CS) Project Manager to join our Data Centers team. This position is remote.

Role Description:

As a CS Project Manager, you will be responsible for the successful execution of projects, from project initiation through final closeout. You will work in a matrix style organization requiring excellent coordination skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. Headquartered in Wendell, NC, the EA PMO executes a diverse portfolio of projects, and this position will be focused on service solutions within our Customer Services business. This role comes with ample opportunities for growth, reflective of Siemens mission to empower people with a growth mindset. As a customer facing team, we keep customer satisfaction at the forefront as we manage large projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • Project Management: Manage projects from inception to completion, ensuring safety, budget, schedule, quality, and performance objectives are met.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Communicate effectively with team members, stakeholders, and management, providing regular updates and managing customer expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Resource Management: Identify, assign, and manage project resources, including engineering, field personnel, vendors, and 3rd-party services.
  • Risk Management: Proactively identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and monitor/control 3rd-party vendors to ensure contract adherence.
  • Financial Leadership: Track project budget, schedule completion, and perform monthly revenue forecasting.
  • Contract Management: Review and understand contractual obligations, manage change orders, and participate in vendor negotiations.
  • Quality & Process Improvement: Develop project execution plans like quality & testing plans, schedules, and risk registers. Implement recovery plans to address performance issues.
  • Collaboration & Relationship Building: Collaborate with internal/external teams and clients to develop site schedules, maintain client relationships, and provide "Lessons Learned" feedback to improve project offerings.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 7+ years of direct service project management experience.
  • 7+ years of written and verbal communication skills, to present complex issues to multi-level audiences and effectively communicate progress, status and issues to internal and external Customers.
  • Applicants must be authorized for employment in the U.S. without the need for employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • PMP certification – while not required immediately for this role, for those who do not have it already, obtaining PMP certification is required within 1 year of employment
  • A degree in engineering or construction management
  • Experience in specific industry related to service project e.g., field service, EPC projects, construction, energy, manufacturing
  • An understanding of medium and/or high voltage electrical equipment
  • An understanding of datacenter construction projects
  • Experience with MS Project or other relevant scheduling software
  • Strong leadership skills with experience in leading cross-functional project teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, to present complex issues to multi-level audiences and effectively communicate progress, status, and issues to internal and external Customers.

Would you like to kickstart your career by applying your financial skills to managing complex projects and executing business solutions for a leading technology powerhouse while building your future in the industry of Commercial Project Management?

If so, you should join us here at Siemens to be a part of the Commercial Project Management Development Program (CPMDP)!

This is an entry-level full-time, two-year rotational development program that offers extensive exposure to the commercial side of project management and in-depth, hands-on experience with different facets of the end-to-end project lifecycle.

Over four, six-month rotations you will work in areas such as contract management, supply chain management, risk management, finance, and accounting. Each rotation is a new and exciting assignment that would require you to relocate to a new hub within the United State (relocation assistance will be provided).

The 4 rotations target to give you exposure to:

Project Bidding and offers (contract review, pricing, customer interface)

Financial Controlling (project forecasting revenue, cost, cash)

Project Execution (claims management, change order calculation)

Operations (manufacturing, procurement, logistics)

This program will provide you with a platform to explore different trajectories in commercial project management that span our diverse and extensive portfolio of businesses, products, and services; develop and learn new skills under the coaching of the industry's top professionals; work directly with internal and external key stakeholders all over the U.S.; create a vast and supportive cross-functional professional network; and accelerate your career growth. Upon graduating from the program, the experience will have allowed you to make a decision on what career path best align with your interest and career goals as either a: Commercial Project Manager, Project Manager, Financial Analyst, Accountant, or a Business Process Specialist.

The location of the CPMDP rotations will be anywhere across the U.S., contingent upon the demand of any one of the following Siemens USA Operating companies.

The program starts July 2027.

You will be provided the opportunity to learn the following:

  • How to apply the PM@Siemens process to Project Management and the basics of Commercial Project Management
  • Project Execution (claim management, change order calculation) and project bidding (analyze contracts, pricing, customer interfacing)
  • Operations (manufacturing, procurement and logistics) and Key financial metrics pertaining to Projects
  • How to accurately forecast a Customer Project and measure and lead project deliverables
  • Handle & forecast cash and risk & opportunity management
  • Initiation and implementation of new processes
  • Understanding various Project Management tools, Team Center, Primavera, Microsoft Project
  • Work in ERP Systems – SAP, JD Edwards, Oracle, etc along with CRM Systems – SalesForce.com, Philos, etc.
  • Collaborate with other business functions (legal, sales, finance, project management, business development, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and engineering)

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, Business Management or similar field
  • Be willing and able to relocate for the rotation assignment every 6 months based off of rotation needs (we will provide relocation assistance for those who need to relocate more than 50 miles from their permanent address)
  • Familiarity and comprehension of finance, accounting, procurement, manufacturing, contract review, logistics, negotiations and strategy
  • Work Authorization: Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

This Leadership Development Program is designed for individuals beginning their professional careers. Candidates must have completed, or will complete, the required educational credentials prior to the program start date. This program is intended for candidates at an early career stage. Current students seeking an experiential learning opportunity while continuing their studies should consider our internship and co-op programs.


As part of the application, you will be asked to confirm your enrollment status. If your application includes uploaded documents (resume, transcript, or other materials), you may redact any information identifying your age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. Redacting this information will not affect your candidacy.

We are a global technology company specializing in industry, infrastructure, transportation, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories and resilient supply chains to intelligent buildings and grids, as well as advanced healthcare and sustainable transportation, we create technology with purpose, adding real value for our customers. Job.JobTitle: Sr. Sales Executive - Select Outside Sales
Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$109,300.00 - $180,200.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

The Sales Executive Team is dedicated to navigating and managing a high performing sales culture in-person and/or virtually which contributes to the overall success of the Select business. The team executes on industry-leading sales strategies aligned with business objectives, builds effective relationships with customers, distribution partners and fellow employees, and creates tactical sales plans for profitable growth through extensive product knowledge and state of the art sales and influencing tactics. The team also uses digitally advanced strategies to move the business forward, leads the relationships with our aggregator/networking groups, and partners with the agent to imbed into higher producing revenue streams. As a Senior Sales Executive, Select, you will manage and develop a complex group of Travelers agency assignments/territories as a Subject Matter Expert, optimize growth within defined new business, retention and profitability goals and deliver success within Travelers' framework of Corporate values. You will act as a brand ambassador to sell the Travelers value proposition to distribution partners. You may also be responsible for mentoring, coaching or managing less experienced members of the team. This position is an outside sales position where assigned distribution relationships within the geographic territory tend to be best served through an in-person sales strategy.

What Will You Do?

  • Develop, influence, and implement advanced sales strategies to expand and manage a high-value portfolio of business, with the objective of driving profitable growth.
  • Own assigned territory, including business development, leveraging performance metrics to create annual plans and manage territorial performance.
  • Conduct comprehensive agency diagnostics to assess performance and identify strategic growth opportunities.
  • Facilitate high-level agency appointments and build long-term relationships through office visits (both in-person and virtual).
  • Prospect, onboard and set performance goals for new agencies, while providing training and support.
  • May pre-qualify accounts as needed.
  • Influence key agency partners through exceptional communication and negotiation skills.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, such as, Product, Underwriting, and Operations to ensure alignment of sales strategies with broader business objectives.
  • Understand Travelers Enterprise focus and seize opportunities to cross-sell Travelers products by initiating cross-functional meetings. Identify book transfer opportunities.
  • Maintain extensive knowledge of competitor products and capabilities and local market trends and understands impact of state regulatory environment on agency business.
  • Responsible for facilitating workshops and actively leading point of sale presentations for both internal and external audiences.
  • Participate in and may lead team, cross team and/or cross business related projects.
  • May provide training, coaching and mentoring to Associate Sales Executives and Sales Executives or manage staff on limited basis.
  • Utilize sophisticated data and analytics to guide strategic sales decisions, measure performance metrics and identify opportunities for additional products and services to maintain a balanced portfolio.
  • Leverage thorough knowledge of Travelers' systems and platforms to support the sales process.
  • Leverage AI technologies to optimize industry processes, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation, while continuously learning and adapting to emerging AI trends and tools.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in sales, marketing, business or related field.
  • Five or more years of insurance sales or related experience in managing a book of business, driving significant sales growth, achieving sales targets, conducting agency diagnostics and utilizing digital sales tools.
  • Certified Insurance Counselor (CIC) (or willingness to pursue).
  • Extensive knowledge of Travelers products and general Property & Casualty marketplace.
  • Extensive influencing and negotiation skills to encourage agency partners to adopt Travelers products and services.
  • Proven ability to collaboratively build and maintain relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to define goals and priorities and meet these goals in a timely manner.
  • Exceptional organizational skills to manage complex tasks and priorities and meet sales goals and deadlines effectively.
  • Demonstrated skills in coaching, training and mentoring others.

What is a Must Have?

  • Four years of sales experience within the insurance industry.
  • Must live in the territory that they manage and have the ability to travel up to 75% of the time.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Part- Time Teller
Reports to: Branch Manager

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt | Supervisory Role: No

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. Our part-time Tellers are key ambassadors of our brand, providing friendly, efficient service that makes banking easy and enjoyable for our customers.

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. As a valued team member, you will be eligible for a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, a health savings account with an annual employer contribution, a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous employer match, paid time off plus 11 paid federal holidays, training and professional development programs, tuition reimbursement, reduced fees and rates on certain loan products, and much more!

About the Part- Time Teller Role

Join our dynamic team as a Part-Time Teller, where exceptional customer service and operational excellence meet. Reporting directly to the Branch Manager, you'll play a vital role in delivering personalized banking experiences while ensuring the highest standards of security and compliance. If you're passionate about banking, detail-oriented, and eager to grow your career, we want to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Transactions: Accurately and efficiently process deposits, check cashing, and withdrawals, verifying cash and endorsements, and issuing receipts with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Product & Service Promotion: Cross-sell and educate clients on the Bank's diverse financial products and services, enhancing client relationships and fostering financial wellness.
  • Payment Processing: Handle credit card payments, issue money orders, bank checks, and accept loan payments, ensuring accuracy and security.
  • Secure Handling of Assets: Manage night deposit bags, admit clients to safe deposit boxes, and maintain confidentiality and security at all times.
  • Client Support & Inquiries: Respond promptly to customer questions, provide account balances, and assist with general banking needs, cultivating a welcoming environment.
  • Reconciliation & Record Keeping: Perform end-of-day balancing of transactions, verify cash totals, and reconcile Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Maintain detailed reports and logs to ensure compliance and accurate record retention.

This job description is not exhaustive; duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Prior experience in customer service and cash handling.
  • Strong verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized with the ability to multitask effectively.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within small teams.
  • Fluent in English; bilingual a plus

  • Access to reliable transportation
  • Willingness to participate in ongoing training and development.
  • Ability to lift 10–20 lbs., stand for extended periods.

Preferred

  • Previous banking or financial services experience.

Schedule

Part-time position with hours aligned to branch operations:

  • Mon–Wed: 12:30 PM – 5:00 PM
  • Thu–Fri: 12:30 PM – 6:00 PM
  • Sat: 8:30 AM – 1:00 PM (rotating schedule)
  • Sun: Closed

Employees may need to remain 15–30 minutes after closing.

Job Summary

Takes the lead in several areas of product development by following the principles of Agile to manage the team backlog, anticipate and prioritize needs, oversee development stages, act as a primary liaison and evaluate product progress. Serves as the customer proxy; works collaboratively with business owners and other stakeholders to accomplish these tasks. Utilizes basic understanding of the business vision and requires frequent support and direction from the Product Manager and/or Product Owner II or III.

Essential Job Functions

Applies basic scientific practice within iterations in order to routinely plan, do, check and adjust. Manages team backlog items and prioritizes based on business value. Outlines dependencies and informs stakeholders the necessary sequence of development to ensure optimized performance and outcomes. Holds a significant role in quality control and is the primary team member empowered to accept stories as done. Utilizes basic business knowledge and communication skills to anticipate problems, address them accordingly while working cross functionally in a self-organizing manner to accomplish tasks and effectively manage the backlog. Effectively applies critical thinking to identify flexibility in determining how and when each iteration and product element will be developed. Acts as primary communicator and connection between stakeholders, end users and teams determining if each story meets their shared e xpectations. Ensures collaboration from all stakeholders on decisions and strategy providing clear instructions and deliverables for developers. Takes ownership for each stage of the process and final product to ensure the goal and vision are correctly aligned with the work items on the backlog. Provides ongoing refinement of team backlog, coordinates dependencies and manages the inspection and evaluation of product progress through each iteration. Participates in PO and/or ART sync meetings in addition to the system demo to show critical aspects of the solution Participates in Inspect <(>&<)> Adapt (I<(>&<)>A) workshop to work across teams to define and implement improvement stories to increase program quality. A key member of the Agile team who utilizes perspective to define iteration goals and drives execution and delivery. Partners with the business owner to understand needs, manage scope and add/eliminate user stories. Communicates requirements to Agile Team in a clear and collaborative manner to determine new requirements, negotiate teams and dependencies. Regularly interacts closely with the Product Manager in order to discuss goals and vision of the business/value stream, actively gaining knowledge on the matter. Heavily involved in the Program Increment (PI) planning, story definition and assists team with story estimates and sequencing. Oversees the development of the product to include planning, refinement, review, and execution. Partners with stakeholders to identify and organize steps required for next iteration. Works to gain clarity on queries and participate in the demo of committed items. Participates in ceremonies within the team to coordinate efforts with team to refine the process, identify areas for improvement and support the execution of tasks. Continuously keeps the end-user needs in mind to ensure the solution meets expectations and the development delivers expected outcomes from the accepted stories. Performs other duties as assigned.

Job Summary

WORKPLACE: REMOTE

The Learning Experience Designer is responsible for designing, developing, and measuring learning and performance solutions that build capabilities, improve learner outcomes, and drive meaningful business results across University of Farmers.

This role owns learning solutions end to end — from needs analysis and consultation through design, development, launch, and evaluation. You will partner closely with business leaders, line-of-business representatives, trainers, and subject matter experts to understand business challenges and translate them into effective learning experiences.

Solutions may include instructor-led training, virtual learning, e-learning, video, interactive digital experiences, job aids, performance support, coaching materials, and content delivered through learning platforms and technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong instructional design expertise with consulting skills, creativity, visual and digital design capabilities, and a strong understanding of how learning can influence business performance.

Essential Job Functions

  • Conduct learning and performance needs analyses for new and existing programs, identifying capability gaps and opportunities for improvement
  • Design and develop end-to-end learning solutions aligned with business objectives and learner needs
  • Develop training curricula, certificate programs, instructor-led materials, virtual learning, e-learning, job aids, coaching resources, and performance support tools
  • Apply adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, and innovative learning techniques to create engaging and effective learning experiences
  • Create storyboards, learning journeys, course materials, interactive experiences, and digital learning content
  • Use tools such as Articulate 360, Rise, Storyline, Adobe Creative Cloud, video editing platforms, and AI-powered video tools to develop learning experiences
  • Recommend the most appropriate learning format, technology, and delivery approach based on the audience, business need, and desired outcome
  • Research emerging learning technologies, instructional design practices, and industry trends to continuously improve learning solutions
  • Partner with business leaders, school leads, subject matter experts, trainers, and other stakeholders to understand business challenges and design effective solutions
  • Lead consultations and business meetings to identify learning opportunities and recommend solutions that support business objectives
  • Analyze learner outcomes and business results to identify opportunities for improvement and recommend modifications to learning solutions
  • Support trainers and facilitators with learning materials, measurement approaches, facilitation resources, and evaluation activities
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of complex learning solutions and use findings to improve future programs
  • Establish measurement approaches to track learner success, learning effectiveness, and business results generated by learning initiatives
  • Collaborate with learning, performance, technology, and business teams to ensure solutions are scalable, sustainable, and aligned with organizational priorities
  • Develop recommendations based on data, learner feedback, business performance, and evaluation findings
  • Stay current with trends in instructional design, learning technology, adult learning, digital learning, and emerging AI capabilities
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of learning design standards, processes, tools, and best practices

Experience Requirements

  • Years of professional experience, with at least 3 years in instructional design, learning experience design, educational content development, or a related field
  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Design, Design, Technology, Communication, or a related field preferred
  • Fluent English, with the ability to communicate effectively with international stakeholders
  • Demonstrated experience designing scalable learning solutions across classroom, virtual, and online environments
  • Strong knowledge of instructional design methodologies and adult learning principles
  • Experience conducting needs analysis and translating business requirements into learning solutions
  • Experience with storyboarding, course development, visual design, and learning content production
  • Experience with Articulate 360, particularly Rise and Storyline
  • Familiarity with LMS/LXP platforms and digital learning technologies
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud or similar visual design tools
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining quality and deadlines
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to evaluate learning effectiveness and connect learning outcomes to business results
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative, and continuously evolving environment

Additional Qualification

Ability to work on multiple projects at the same time with coinciding deadlines. Strong interpersonal, communications, presentation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to use the suite of Microsoft Office products including Word, PowerPoint.

Benefits

This position offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work–life balance. While specific benefits may vary by country and employee level, offerings generally include competitive salary opportunities, performance-based bonuses, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing training and development resources.

  • [Preferred] Understanding of cloud and hybrid environment(s), including Azure, AWS, and various on-premises systems

Data Management

  • Experience with relational/NoSQL databases

  • Familiarity with schema standards (OpenAPI/JSON/AVSC)

  • [Preferred] Understanding of MongoDB Performance Tuning

DevOps & Infrastructure

  • CI/CD experience (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), Docker, Kubernetes

Development Practices

  • Practice Test-Driven Development (TDD)

  • Individual Contributor/ Lead Consultant roles are designed to bring in deep respective domain expertise (network, endpoint, cloud, identity, infrastructure, Databases & Data Stores, etc.) to bridge the gap between security insights and practical remediation strategies

  • The Exposure Intelligence Analyst Databases & Data Stores is the SME responsible for identifying and prioritizing exposure risk across data platforms, including RDBMS, NoSQL systems, data warehouses, object storage, and data permissions models. This role applies CTEM principles to identify exploitable exposure conditions that lead to unauthorized access, data exfiltration, or privilege misuse, partnering with data platform and engineering teams to reduce real enterprise exposure.

Success Measures

  • Reduction in high-impact data exposure conditions (permissions and access pathways).

Key Responsibilities (Core + Domain)

Exposure Intelligence (Core)

  • Correlate security signals into exposure narratives focused on exploitability and impact.

  • Identify attack paths that lead to data access, privilege expansion, and sensitive data exposure.

  • Provide clear prioritization and remediation guidance; track closure outcomes.

Databases & Data Stores (Domain)

  • Own SME coverage for data-layer exposure: insecure permissions, exposed storage, weak encryption posture, misconfigured access policies, risky service-to-service access.

  • Identify systemic patterns: over-broad access, stale entitlements, misconfigured storage endpoints, weak auditability.

  • Partner with data owners/platform teams to reduce exposure creation and improve prevention guardrails.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years in data platform security, cloud security, security engineering, or exposure management.

  • Understanding of data access models, permissioning, and common misconfiguration patterns.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with object storage security, database hardening concepts, and data access governance.

  • Familiarity with cloud data services and their permission models.

  • Strong analytical skills; ability to validate exposure hypotheses with queries/logs.

Skills

Cloud Data Storage, Data Applications, Data Management Platforms, Data Storage Platforms, Exposure Management, Object Storage, Threat Monitoring

Job Description

Consultant II / Senior Consultant I is responsible for investigating moderately complex and occasionally complex, represented and unrepresented claims. The individual also may handle moderate and occasionally complex CPL (comprehensive personal liability) claims. The individual takes recorded statements, resolves loss of use claims, makes payments to appropriate parties, and negotiates and settles property damage to third parties. This desk handles multiple types of homeowners, condos, boat, and ATV policies as well as all perils related to third party liability.

  • Sets initial reserve, updates reserve, documents rationale and claim summary notes.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for policyholder attorneys, leading direct negotiations to resolve disputes efficiently.

Job Description


At Allstate's Enterprise Architecture organization, we define the technology strategies, platforms, and standards that enable a data-driven enterprise. Our team partners across business and technology to modernize data platforms, accelerate cloud adoption, and advance analytics and AI capabilities that power smarter decisions across the company.

The Opportunity

  • Defining and socializing the data analytic practices across the Allstate corporation. This role will provide strategic guidance for technical and business teams on ingestion, integration, data visualization, and advanced analytics including generative AI, ultimately enabling our business to advance.

  • This role will focus on large scale data lake implementation and data lake house modernization through engagements that will focus on customer solutions such as data warehousing, business intelligence, and advanced analytics tools. You'll work with senior leaders, engineers, and architects across the organization to build solutions that make enterprise-scale analytics and intelligence possible. ,

  • You'll be expected to roll up your sleeves, develop prototypes, evaluate emerging technologies, and influence how the next generation of data and AI platforms are built across Allstate.

What We're Looking For

  • You are a senior data architecture leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong business influence. You have experience leading cloud and data modernization initiatives, remain close to the technology, and can confidently communicate architectural strategy to both engineers and executives. You thrive in fast-changing environments and are passionate about the future of analytics, cloud, and AI.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

  • Drive the evolution and data architecture for a scalable and secure data platform
  • Work closely with business partners, architecture, security, and engineering teams to design and implement a modern data lake and lake house architecture
  • Engage with strategic customers and ensure their future needs and vision are top of mind for a data-driven enterprise
  • Oversee deployment of long-term strategic data products and infusing key data and analytics services in applicable areas of business and IT
  • Build POCs of cloud native microservices architecture for data with focus on IaaS, metadata driven frameworks and DevOps
  • Design and guide practices for data models, data flows, and integration patterns for the data lake, lake house , and consumption data layers
  • Support delivery leaders and engineers in building and managing conceptual, logical, and physical architecture
  • Collaborate, design and provide hands-on development of high-priority prototypes in a cloud platform and demonstrate value and feasibility of the solutions and architecture
  • Be involved in all project phases and drive architecture initiatives
  • Communication with senior and executive leadership on architecture initiatives
  • Strong communicator individually, in groups and in presentations with a vision for how cloud data platforms can enable a better future powered by data

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent professional experience
  • Rich experience building POCs with at least 1-2 successful adoptions across Enterprise
  • 10 to 15 years of experience in at least two IT disciplines such as data architecture, technical cloud architecture, analytics & data science, big data technologies, database management, data governance & security in a heterogeneous environment.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in implementation and performance tuning MPP (Massively Parallel Processing) databases (Oracle Exadata, Teradata, Netezza, Greenplum, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience in lead roles architecting solutions at scale for cloud data platforms including experience with major cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Experience designing analytics environments for use with data visualization and model development tools and AI driven data agents
  • Hands-on experience with business intelligence tools (Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience in analyzing Data Warehouses such as Teradata, Netezza, Oracle, etc.
  • Experience in analyzing Cloud Data Warehouses such as AWS Redshift, Azure Synapse, or Snowflake, etc.
  • Experience designing database environments, analyzing production deployments, and making recommendations to optimize performance
  • Hands on experience architecting and building secure, scalable, and flexible enterprise data projects using AWS, Microsoft Fabric and other on-prem and cloud native platforms
  • Expertise in building secure and scalable data ingestion, ETL/ELT solutions using various server-based and serverless tools
  • Experience with data warehouse data structure and dimensional modeling and key definition with tools such as ERWIN or others
  • Experience with data structures and models for a microservices environment, data lake and cloud lake houses and supporting downstream applications based on various modeling tools and platforms
  • Hands on experience in leading large-scale enterprise data warehousing (EDW) projects
  • Strong SQL skills
  • Product development mindset and expertise in CI/CD pipeline
  • Experience with big data platforms, SQL & no SQL databases

Leadership & Communication:

  • Collaborative influence, intellectual humility, and enterprise-first decision making; demonstrate intellectual curiosity and humility, balancing conviction with flexibility by considering alternative viewpoints and championing solutions that best serve organizational goals, regardless of origin
  • Experience with prioritization of projects that mitigate trade-offs
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Experience driving architectural direction across multiple teams and organizations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and modern lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience building AI-enabled analytics platforms, AI agents, or generative AI solutions.
  • Experience leading large-scale cloud and analytics transformation programs. Cloud architecture certifications (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
  • Insurance or other highly regulated industry experience.
  • Working within a scaled agile program and collaborating with product managers in creating and managing technical backlog of stories and epics
  • Experience in cloud based services such as: S3, IAM, SNS/SQS

Skills

Analytics Architecture, Cloud Data Architecture, Data Lake, Data Lakehouse Architecture, Data Strategies, Enterprise Architecture (EA), Enterprise Data Architecture

Job Description

We are seeking Two Managing Engineers, Data Engineering to lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable data solutions that support digital products, analytics, and business decision-making.

Both opportunities combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership, team development, and delivery responsibility. You will partner with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Data Analysts, Architects, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and high-performing data products.

Based on an assessment of each candidate's experience, technical expertise, and leadership background, candidates may be considered for the opportunity that best aligns with their qualifications.

Key Responsibilities


People and Engineering Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and coach Data Engineers while supporting their technical and professional development.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish engineering standards and encourage consistent use of best practices.
  • Balance hands-on engineering with technical leadership, team development, and delivery responsibilities.
  • Depending on the position level, support or lead hiring, onboarding, performance feedback, career development, and workforce planning.

Data Solution Design and Development

  • Lead the design, development, implementation, and support of scalable batch and streaming data solutions.
  • Develop reusable patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, and access.
  • Integrate data from APIs, databases, event streams, third-party platforms, and enterprise systems.
  • Remain actively involved in architecture discussions, solution design, code reviews, troubleshooting, and complex problem-solving.
  • Ensure data solutions are reliable, maintainable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective.

Engineering Excellence and Production Support

  • Promote modern engineering practices, including version control, automated testing, continuous integration, automated deployment, and infrastructure automation.
  • Establish standards for data quality, validation, monitoring, lineage, and observability.
  • Optimize data pipelines, databases, queries, and storage solutions for performance and cost.
  • Support production operations and provide leadership during critical incidents, root-cause analysis, and preventative improvements.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and operational risk.

Product Collaboration and Delivery

  • Partner with Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, Analysts, and business stakeholders to understand priorities and deliver effective data solutions.
  • Translate business and product needs into technical roadmaps and clearly defined engineering work.
  • Lead or contribute to planning, prioritization, estimation, and delivery activities.
  • Manage risks, dependencies, resource needs, and competing priorities.
  • Communicate progress, technical recommendations, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders and leaders.

Data Governance, Security, and Standards

  • Promote data governance practices, including metadata management, data lineage, classification, and data quality.
  • Ensure solutions meet applicable security, privacy, governance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Architecture, Security, Risk, and Governance teams to align solutions with enterprise standards.
  • Support the responsible access, use, storage, and movement of enterprise data.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices that may improve data capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to increase automation, simplify development, and improve engineering productivity.
  • Support cloud modernization and data platform transformation initiatives.
  • Promote continuous learning and the responsible use of generative and agent-based artificial intelligence tools.

Managing Engineer: 5 or More Years of Experience

  • 5 or more years of experience designing, developing, and supporting data solutions, data pipelines, or enterprise software systems.
  • 1 or more years of experience providing technical leadership, mentorship, coaching, or project leadership.
  • Experience guiding engineers through technical mentorship and knowledge sharing.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing data pipelines using Python, Java, Scala, or a comparable programming language.
  • Experience designing and supporting batch or streaming data solutions.
  • Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, dbt, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL, NoSQL databases, data modeling, and data storage concepts.
  • Experience integrating data from APIs, databases, event streams, and third-party systems.
  • Experience with automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, deployment automation, and DevOps practices.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence technical outcomes and lead through expertise.

Managing Engineer: 7 or More Years of Experience

  • 7 or more years of experience designing, developing, and supporting data solutions, data pipelines, or enterprise software systems.
  • 3 or more years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical professionals.
  • Experience with coaching, performance management, career development, hiring, and team development.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing data pipelines using Python, Java, Scala, or a comparable programming language.
  • Experience designing and supporting scalable batch and streaming data solutions.
  • Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, dbt, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL, NoSQL databases, data modeling, and data architecture.
  • Experience integrating data from APIs, databases, event streams, and enterprise systems.

A day in the life of a Large Loss Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Large Loss Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.


You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

  • 4 years previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
  • Experience handling claims with multiple trades and over $100,000 in losses.
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.
  • Must be able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access roofs with up to a 6/12 pitch.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.
  • You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.


*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.


Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.


Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more. #LI-TW1

Communication, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Empathy, Multitasking, Working Independently

Job.JobTitle: Technician, Pool Maintenance - Universal Kids Resort
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Construction & Skilled Trades, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for the daily water quality operations across Universal Kids Resort water attractions, water play areas/splash pads, hotel onsite pool and any other assigned water area. Completes daily operations including but not limited to water quality parameter testing/verification, lift station/storm water station troubleshooting and sampling, chemical management, mechanical/electrical preventative and corrective maintenance. Installs, maintains, tests, and troubleshoots and repairs electrical and mechanical equipment including filtration and UV sterilization systems, centrifugal pumps/motors, pool/venue rehab and repairs, plumbing repairs and storm water infrastructure. Responds to and assists in recovery of attractions and water features during operation.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs inspections and daily operations by evaluating water conditions, chemical and/or waste for compliance by conducting sampling, performing inspection of equipment, tanks, and processes, evaluates data related to water and/or waste parameters. Manages and coordinates diverse technical support activities conducted through contractors. Provides evaluative field support per Environmental, Health & Safetys requirements under regulatory and/or corporate policy requirements. Collaborates with health department as directed for regulatory compliance and assists with annual renewal of permits.
  • Supports equipment operation and maintenance of chemical feeders, pumps, motors, UV systems, VFDs, electrical interfaces/cabinets and all supporting equipment, plumbing repairs, storm water infrastructure, lift station monitoring and repairs for storm/sanitary, tile and pool finish repair, confined space entries while performing work in space, direct read instruments, alarm systems, small combustion engines etc. Maintains proper instrument calibration, operation and establishes and maintains working relationships with equipment vendors for water and waste management equipment.
  • Maintains field-generated and office records, performs data entry, prepares logbooks, procedures, as-built drawings, O&Ms, safety training and ensures work order utilization. Completes PQS qualification of attractions, water play areas/splash pads, hotel pool and any other assigned water area. Creates and completes Maximo work orders and completion reports. Trains new Technicians to do venue-specific preventative maintenance work orders and recovery processes and procedures.
  • Assists with emergency response and incident prevention by inspecting for release controls to include secondary containments, spill equipment, response supplies, erosion control, storm conveyance systems, emergency pumps, and overfill protections. Responds to environmental incidents and takes immediate action to control and/or stop further release related to water, chemicals and/or waste and perform proper cleaning/remediation when necessary. Activates incident response as necessary and in accordance with EHS policy and regulation.
  • Performs modifications of electrical, mechanical and pool/venue systems as prescribed by OEM or engineering team, both internal and third-party specifications and direction. Assists with seasonal weather condition sustainment initiatives as directed.
  • Ensures proper chemical/waste management through proper labeling, handling, application, inspection, storage and disposal of water, aquatic pest control and regulated waste. Ensures water is prepared for proper transport as required.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Individual Contributor

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Must be able to work a flexible and varying schedule based on business needs.
  • Training is required and will be provided prior to performing the inspections.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Ability to work in a team environment.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • Certified Pool Operator license is required within 180 days of employment (company provided).
  • Aquatic Facility Operator certification, Aquatic Pesticide Applicators license, SCUBA certification, and 24-hour HAZWOPER training are preferred.

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED is required; Associates or Technical degree in related field is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of experience in water quality or related technical services required, previous water attractions or pool technical experience is preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Universal is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Job.JobTitle: Attendant, Guest Arrivals - Universal Kids Resort
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for supporting all aspects of Guest entry and exit to Universal Kids Resorts theme park. Provides exemplary Guest service for all Guests arriving at the Toll Plaza, using suggestive and persuasive upselling of parking options while providing parking directions in a safe manner. Responsible for transactions of pass sales and admission of Guests in and out of park through admissions area while maintaining the integrity of the front gate by verifying ownership and validity of tickets. Provides information, directions, and daily operational times to Guests as requested and assistance to Guests requiring rental services.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for welcoming Guests while processing parking pass transactions using an established computer system and department procedures. Practices proper procedures for detecting and reporting fraud to leadership as necessary. Performs up-selling for Guest transactions by using persuasive selling techniques to increase the sales of parking options. Provides directions to appropriate parking locations and directs cars in parking lot. Resolves Guest questions and concerns utilizing knowledge of operation and resort.
  • Supports Guest admissions into the theme park by scanning and verifying park admission tickets and their ownership upon Guest entry and re-entry into the park. Maintains the integrity of the front gate by verifying all Guests are using the same ticket on each visit and are not sharing tickets. Identifies instances of ticket sharing or fraud and notifies the proper UKR leadership to manage accordingly.
  • Assists Guests with rental services including answering Guest questions and explaining services and procedures regarding wheelchair, ECV, stroller, and other rentable items. Accurately processes all transactions and maintains a clean environment. Reports any issues and/or damage of rentals to leadership for repair.
  • Assists Guests with day-of ticket purchases by gathering detailed information to recommend products based on expected visit length and recommend add-ons to enhance the Guests visit using suggestive sales techniques.
  • Maintains a clean and safe work environment by constantly monitoring the immediate area and/or surroundings. Responsible for ensuring a neat and organized work area, trash removal and keeping the area free of debris to include the proper maintenance of equipment and/or props. Assists with project initiatives and sustainment efforts as directed.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Valid Texas Drivers License required.
  • Must be able to work a flexible and varying schedule based on business needs.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Experience in Guest service and resolving Guest complaints preferred.
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • High School diploma or GED is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 6+ months Guest Service experience is preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for the preparation and cooking food for multi-unit operation following all established standards across Universal Kids Resort.
