Job Description

The Vice President, Health Services Analytics is responsible for positioning the analytics functions as the engine behind the data-driven Health Services Operating System. This role refocuses existing analytics functions within Health Services on: implementing a Unified KPI & Operating Performance Dashboard, capturing automation/AI-driven efficiencies within the analytics functions, and identifying opportunities for business process improvement across Health Services Operations that drive improve member health outcomes, reduced administrative expense, reduced medical expense, and improve member experience.

Reporting to the COO of Health Services, the VP, Health Services Analytics ensures that data, advanced analytics, and AI-powered insights are translated into measurable business outcomes.

In partnership with the Chief Data Officer, this role ensures timely adoption of the Analytics Domain architecture within Health Services Analytics and leads the migration of Health Services analytical functions from legacy platforms to modern cloud-based solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
Analytics Engine North Star & Strategy
• Define and own the North Star for Health Services Analytics as a distinct operating engine, articulating the future-state vision: what the analytics function must become, the capabilities it must build, and the proving metrics that demonstrate it is getting there.
• Lead phased implementation of North Star vision: required capabilities, proving metrics, value drivers, organizational design, process maps, technology & data architecture, governance, strategic roadmap, maturity assessment, and management system.
• Align the analytics engine's strategic priorities to that of the functions within Health Services Operations, with quantified business impact across STARS, RAF, quality, cost, and experience dimensions.
Analytics Operating Model and Governance
• Establish and govern a unified analytics operating model with one intake process, one prioritization framework, one data product strategy, one governance model, one set of enterprise metrics, one transformation layer, and one AI enablement roadmap.
• Implement an “Analytics Product Roadmap” for the analytics engine: articulate demand, prioritize, manage capacity, justify budget, and track value realization — partnering with Technology's "Front Door" to ensure demand visibility (volume, type, requestor, status) across all analytics requests.
• Have representation in the operating rhythm governance forums for each operational engine, providing analytics inputs and ensuring decisions are data-informed.
• Operate a disciplined management system for the analytics engine: weekly staff meetings, direct report 1:1s, skip-levels, quarterly roadmap revisions, and a structured operating rhythm.
Unified KPI & Operating Performance Dashboard
• Design, build, and maintain a comprehensive KPI inventory for Health Services Operations, including leading indicators, activity metrics, outcome metrics, benchmarks, targets, Red/Yellow/Green status reporting, and automated corrective action triggers.
• Deliver the Unified KPI & Operating Performance Dashboard as the single source of truth for Health Services Operations, rolling into the enterprise Operating Performance Dashboard.
Standardized Transformation Layer & Data Modernization
• Build and own the standardized, governed transformation layer between enterprise data products and Health Services analytics products — encompassing metric definitions, transformation pipelines, business logic, enrichment layers, and quality checks — to eliminate duplicated pipelines, inconsistent outputs, and shadow data engineering.
• In partnership with the Chief Data Officer, lead the migration of Health Services analytical functions from legacy platforms to modern cloud-based solutions, ensuring data arrives at the point of use ready to be consumed without requiring secondary engineering.
Automation, AI & Advanced Analytics
• Shift the analytics engine's work mix from predominantly recurring reporting and ad hoc requests toward advanced analytics, predictive models, AI-enabled workflows, and proactive intelligence — and track that shift as a proving metric of the analytics engine's own maturity.
• Develop and execute the AI enablement roadmap for Health Services Analytics, embedding predictive models and AI into the standardized transformation layer in alignment with Enterprise standards.
• Identify and implement automation and AI-driven efficiencies within the analytics functions, including automated reporting, self-service dashboards, and decision-support tools.
• Lead development of predictive models and AI/ML use cases identified in each operational engine's tactics table, ensuring alignment with the enterprise AI roadmap.
TCOC Analytics & Affordability Connectivity
• Own the analytics capability for TCOC connectivity across engines: define how analytics identifies affordability opportunities, the recurring reviews needed, the prioritization method, calendarization, and impact tracking/validation.
• Maintain the connection between engine-level analytics and Medical Economics / Affordability, ensuring TCOC opportunities are quantified, tracked, and validated through recurring sustainable processes.
• Support subfunction lever playbooks by identifying the KPI(s) each lever moves, the TCOC cost category and cost mechanism affected, and the analytics cadence required.
People, Talent & Organizational Design
• Build, lead, and develop the Health Services Analytics team, including analysts, analytics engineers, data scientists, and reporting specialists.
• Define the staffing model for the analytics engine: FTE (filled/vacant), workforce mix, onshore/offshore/vendor split, and productivity expectations.
• Upskill, restructure, and rebuild the analytics talent pyramid — shifting from a reporting-heavy workforce toward analytics engineers, data scientists, and AI-enabled roles — and track that shift as a proving metric of the engine's maturity.
• Establish leadership development plans, talent assessments, and performance management systems for the analytics organization.

Job Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in actuarial science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Business, or a related quantitative field or additional related work experience.
• 15+ years of progressive experience in healthcare analytics, actuarial science, data science, or enterprise analytics leadership.
• 8+ years of senior leadership experience overseeing analytical teams and enterprise-scale initiatives.
• Demonstrated experience designing and implementing analytics operating models.
• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence cross-functional senior leadership.
• Demonstrated ability to translate analytical insights into measurable business outcomes.

Preferred:
• Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (F.S.A.) or equivalent advanced credential
• Advanced degree (master's or higher) in a quantitative or business discipline
• Experience within a health insurance payer organization
• Experience partnering with enterprise data organizations
• Experience with process improvement methodologies (LEAN, Six Sigma, etc.)
• Experience developing recruiting strategies, talent programs, and team members
• Experience implementing AI-enabled analytics solutions into business workflows

General Physical Demands: Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.

What We Offer:
As a Florida Blue employee, you will thrive in our Be Well, Work Well, GuideWell culture where being well as an individual, and working well as a team, are both important in serving our members and communities.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

• Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
• Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
• Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
• Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
• Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
• Additional voluntary benefits available; and
• A comprehensive wellness program

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Final pay will be determined with consideration of market competitiveness, internal equity, and the job-related knowledge, skills, training, and experience you bring.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to cultivating a work experience where everyone feels like they belong and can perform at their best in pursuit of our mission. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

Senseye global Sales and business development team (part of AI-driven Manufacturing – Availability and Maintenance) is seeking a passionate, self-driven, analytically minded Portfolio Sales specialist to support and meticulously drive growth strategy in Americas. This is not a direct sales role, but rather a critical support function designed to accelerate deal velocity and improve sales effectiveness across the Zone Americas.

We are looking for a Business Development Manager / Global Portfolio Sales Specialist. This position is remote and can be based anywhere in the continental, United States.

You'll make an impact by:

  • OPPORTUNITY QUALIFICATION & PIPELINE DEVELOPMENT

    • Support and conduct thorough qualification of sales opportunities using established frameworks (BANT, MEDDIC, or similar)
    • Validate opportunity fit against Senseye's ideal customer profile (ICP) with account managers
    • Educate, support, develop and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities aligned with the Sales acceleration team / account managers and Zone business volume targets
    • Assess deal complexity, timeline, and required resources to optimize sales team allocation
    • Prepare clear qualification summaries for account manager handoff/support

    SALES ENABLEMENT & SUPPORT

    • Develop and maintain account/prospect research summaries (company overview, pain points, decision-making structure)
    • Support sales presentations by gathering technical requirements (with solution engineering support), creating product fit analyses, and preparing ROI/business case materials
    • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering to ensure technical resources are aligned with deal requirements for account scoping
    • Assist in proposal development, pricing strategy, and deal structuring to support SAC and account managers
    • Prepare post-meeting follow-up materials, next-step documentation, and deal progression tracking

    DEAL PROGRESSION & CRM MANAGEMENT

    • Support and monitor accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce (or equivalent CRM) for all opportunities and accounts
    • Track deal progression against defined sales stages and ensure timely escalation of at-risk deals
    • Update weekly/monthly pipeline reports and forecasting summaries for Zone leadership
    • Identify bottlenecks in the sales process and recommend process improvements
    • Ensure all required documentation and approvals are in place before deal closure

    STAKEHOLDER COORDINATION

    • Liaise between SAC team, account managers and service delivery teams to align on deal strategy
    • Schedule and coordinate meetings, demos, and technical discussions
    • Manage communication timelines and ensure all stakeholders are informed of deal progression
    • Support proposal reviews and ensure alignment across teams before client submission
    • Facilitate escalation paths when deals require executive engagement or complex problem-solving

    CUSTOMER RESEARCH & INSIGHTS

    • Conduct discovery calls with prospects to understand business challenges, technical environment, and buying process
    • Document customer pain points, success criteria, and decision-making timelines
    • Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and flag to SAC/account managers
    • Gather customer feedback and case study materials to support marketing and sales efforts

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in business development, sales operations, sales development, or similar support function ideally in predictive maintenance
  • Proven ability to qualify opportunities and assess fit using established sales methodologies
  • Strong analytical and research skills; comfort working with data and CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to translate technical concepts for business audiences
  • Self-motivated and organized; ability to manage multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and Microsoft Office suite
  • Understanding of B2B SaaS sales cycles and enterprise software buying processes
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and support others' success
  • 20-30% travel for account site visits, SAC collaboration, quarterly Zone meetings
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in industrial software, predictive maintenance, IoT, or asset intelligence solutions
  • Familiarity with manufacturing, operations, or industrial verticals
  • Experience supporting sales acceleration or sales operations teams
  • Knowledge of Siemens products, solutions, or corporate culture
  • Experience with sales methodologies (MEDDIC, BANT, Sandler, Challenger Sale)

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Job Description

The Organizational Change & Transformation Manager plays a meaningful role in enabling successful enterprise transformation by ensuring operating model changes are understood, adopted, and sustained. This role partners closely with Enterprise Transformation Planning & Execution Leads and Transformation Strategy Analysts to translate target-state designs into clear change, communication, and adoption strategies. The role applies structured change methodologies to assess impact, readiness, and resistance, and works with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to drive behavioral and capability shifts required to realize intended business outcomes.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world!

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Core Responsibilities

  • Apply a structured, enterprise-defined change management methodology to support operating model transformation initiatives end to end.
  • Conduct change impact and readiness assessments across capabilities, roles, processes, and governance to inform adoption strategies.
  • Partner with Enterprise Transformation Planning & Execution Leads to surface change implications, adoption risks, and sequencing considerations embedded in operating model designs.
  • Identify, assess, and proactively manage resistance by developing targeted mitigation, engagement, and reinforcement strategies.
  • Develop actionable change strategies, communication, and training plans aligned to enterprise milestones and workstream priorities.
  • Support senior leaders and workstream sponsors with tailored messaging, talking points, and engagement approaches to reinforce change objectives.
  • Define success metrics for adoption and behavior change; monitor progress and recommend corrective actions as needed.
  • Track change-related risks, issues, and dependencies; raise concerns with clear impact articulation and recommended paths forward..

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 7 or more years of proven experience leading change management efforts for large-scale, multi-workstream transformations.
  • Strong business insight with the ability to understand operating model build decisions and translate them into adoption implications.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with senior leaders, cross-functional collaborators, and transformation teams.
  • Exceptional communication skills, including executive-level presentations and concise, decision-ready materials.
  • Ability to influence without authority and align diverse collaborators around shared outcomes.
  • Experience developing change, communication, and training content using tools such as PowerPoint and Excel. MS Project, Azure DevOps and JIRA is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis of adoption challenges and resistance drivers.
  • Comfort operating across strategy, design, and execution phases of transformation work.
  • Growth mindset toward emerging technologies, including the use of AI to enhance change enablement and ways of working.
  • Familiarity with transformation governance, operating model frameworks, and enterprise program environments.

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Gadsden/Anniston, AL
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Reside within 30 miles of the Gadsen/Anniston, AL area.

  • 2-3 years previous experience as outside adjuster is highly desired.

  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating preferred.

  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

Required Qualifications:

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on either a one to two-story roof.

  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job

** Please note, you will be required to attend 2-weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX. **

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.JobTitle: Lead Product Engineer (AIOps for Observability) - Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstate is seeking a forward-thinking Lead Product Engineer to drive innovation in its AI-powered Observability platform. This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, observability, and software development, with a strong focus on automation, intelligent insights, and self-healing systems across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

You will lead the design and development of next-generation observability solutions powered by agentic AI, enabling proactive detection, diagnosis, and remediation of issues. This role emphasizes building scalable platforms, intelligent automation, and developer-centric tooling that enhance reliability, performance, and operational efficiency.

As a technical leader, you will shape product strategy, drive engineering excellence, and deliver AI-driven monitoring and automation capabilities that transform how applications and platforms are operated across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

AI & Intelligent Automation

  • Design and build agentic AI solutions for observability, including autonomous agents capable of anomaly detection, root cause analysis, and automated remediation.
  • Embed AI/ML capabilities into observability platforms to enable predictive insights, anomaly detection, and intelligent alerting.
  • Develop AIOps frameworks that reduce noise, automate workflows, and improve incident response times.
  • Leverage LLMs and AI orchestration frameworks to create self-service diagnostics and operational assistants.
  • Architect and implement end-to-end observability solutions across logs, metrics, traces, and events.
  • Enhance observability platforms (Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, AppDynamics, OTEL) with custom integrations, automation, and AI enhancements.
  • Build real-time insights and health analytics to ensure system reliability, scalability, and performance.
  • Lead development of scalable, reusable platform components and APIs for observability and automation.
  • Build developer-first tools and frameworks that simplify instrumentation, monitoring, and diagnostics.
  • Apply modern software engineering practices including TDD, CI/CD, microservices, and cloud-native design.
  • Develop full-stack solutions (backend services, dashboards, automation tooling) using Java/Spring Boot, Python, Node.js, and React.
  • Drive automation-first strategies to eliminate manual operations and improve efficiency.
  • Build self-healing systems that automatically detect and remediate issues.
  • Lead initiatives in infrastructure-as-code, Observability-as-code and automated deployment pipelines.
  • Engineer highly resilient systems by focusing on performance, scalability, and fault tolerance.
  • Define and evolve enterprise observability architecture, incorporating AI and automation as core principles.
  • Collaborate with architecture, platform, and security teams to align solutions with enterprise standards.
  • Champion standardization, reusable patterns, and platform scalability across the organization.
  • Act as a technical leader and mentor, guiding teams in AI, observability, and engineering best practices.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated, high-impact platform solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts and strategies effectively to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.

Essential Skills

  • 5+ years of engineering experience building software, platforms, or automation solutions, with a strong emphasis on observability and distributed systems.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with observability platforms (Datadog, Dynatrace, OTEL).
  • 3+ years of software development experience using Java (Spring Boot), Python, Node.js, or React.

Job Description

Are you someone who enjoys being on the move, solving problems, and making a real impact for customers? As a Field Auto Adjuster, you'll be at the forefront of our claims processmeeting customers where they are, whether it's at their home, a repair shop, or a tow yard.

You'll take the lead in writing estimates and guiding customers through the repair or total loss process, using a mix of in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication. No two days are the samewhether you're evaluating damage on-site or collaborating with body shops and service providers, you'll enjoy a fast-paced, hands-on role that keeps you engaged and on your toes.

If you're looking for a career that blends technical know-how, customer service, and the freedom of field work, this is your chance to thrive in a role where your expertise truly matters.


Sign-On Bonus: A $5,000 sign-on bonus may be offered to qualified candidates who receive and accept an employment offer. Eligibility, payment timing, and conditions will be outlined in the official offer letter.


Preferred Qualifications

  • 18+ months experience in auto collision estimating using CCC One
  • You have a High School Diploma or a GED
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write precise and comprehensive estimates
  • Comfortable with utilizing technology and various platforms for claims processing
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills to manage multiple assignments effectively
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements

A day in the life of the Field Auto Damage Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder Your Eye for Detail Keeps Everything on Track- In this role, youll ensure claims are documented accurately and in line with policy agreements. As you handle each case, youll maintain clear, timely records in our claims system (which well train you on). Your attention to detail helps keep the process smooth, organized, and transparent from start to finish.

Work Location

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Join Allstate Technology Solutions as a Digital Product Manager building AI-powered insurance experiences. You will shape product direction, solve customer problems, and guide ideas from concept to launch. We are looking for a hands-on product leader who uses data, works well across teams, and thrives in ambiguity.

The Team

Allstate Technology Solutions is building a nextgeneration insurance platform by combining modern product design with advanced AIincluding Generative AI and agentic technologies. Our mission is to deliver transformational customer experiences while unlocking operational efficiency and personalized protection at scale.


Become a part of our story.

Youll join a collaborative, fastmoving team that continuously explores new ideas, tests assumptions, learns from data, and delivers real impact.


The Role

As a Digital Product Manager, you turn strategy into tangible outcomesstories, designs, and shipped capabilities. Youre comfortable working handson with data, using insights to influence direction, and navigating ambiguity to solve hard problems.

You value strong problem framing, clear success metrics, and effective stakeholder management. You collaborate easily across engineering, UX, architecture, and business, ensuring teams stay aligned and focused on outcomesnot just output.


Youre someone who....

  • Thrives in evolving problem spaces and continuously learns
  • Contributes meaningfully to design, data, and retrospective discussions
  • Uses AI and modern tools to innovate and problemsolve
  • Takes initiative and drives work through execution
  • Manages stakeholder expectations and demand by prioritizing highvalue work and making tradeoffs explicit
  • Partners closely with technical and nontechnical teammates toward shared goals

Responsibilities:

  • Product Direction: Own and execute a prioritized product roadmap aligned to strategy, customer value, and measurable outcomes
  • Stakeholder & Demand Management: Manage crossfunctional demand by clarifying intent, evaluating value, and driving transparent, outcomebased prioritization
  • Problem Framing: Define clear problem statements and success criteria in partnership with users and stakeholders
  • DataDriven Decisions: Use research, analytics, and raw data to surface insights, validate assumptions, and inform roadmap and delivery decisions
  • User Experience: Advocate for intuitive experiences and contribute to solution design from concept through execution
  • AI Innovation: Identify and apply AI (including GenAI and agentic tech), rapidly experimenting to responsibly scale ideas into production

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of handson product management experience with a strong execution track record
  • Experience working with AI technologies (Google, Anthropic, Azure, or AWS); scaling AIpowered products is a plus
  • Proficiency in Agile product development
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity
  • Strong data literacy with the ability to independently analyze and query data

Skills

Analytics, Business Case Analyses, Prioritization, Product Design, Product Development, Product Direction, Product Management, Product Roadmap, Product Roadmapping, Systems Thinking

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 110,000.00 - 181,025.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Joining our team isnt just a job its an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger a winning team making a meaningful impact.

Job.JobTitle: Distribution Service Strategy Business Architect Senior Consultant I
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Human Resources, IT / Technology, Marketing / Communications / PR
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstate Insurance Company is hiring an individual contributor-level Business Architect Sr. Consultant I within the Sales and Distribution business team. This role will leverage AI-enabled research, analytics, and productivity tools to assess service journeys, processes, operational data, and stakeholder feedback; identify priority service, process, and experience needs; and translate findings into clear, evidence-based outputs. These insights will support problem statement development, opportunity framing, and cross-functional solutioning aligned to the Service Simplification strategy.


The selected individual will partner with business, technology, data, and user experience stakeholders to document current and future states, develop recommendations, and help advance solutions that simplify service for customers and agents. Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, insurance business acumen, responsible use of AI tools, clear communication, and effective collaboration.


Key Responsibilities

Build knowledge of Service Simplification, business strategy, operating models, customer and agent service journeys, and enabling technologies to guide analysis and recommendations.

Use approved AI tools and analytical methods to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs, identify patterns and root causes, and surface unmet service, process, and experience needs.

Analyze customer and agent journeys; process flows; operational data; feedback; and research to identify friction, manual work, duplication, failure demand, and opportunities for simplification.

Develop AI-assisted research plans, prompts, and repeatable analysis approaches that improve the speed, consistency, and depth of discovery while validating outputs for accuracy, relevance, bias, and appropriate use.

Translate analysis into clear artifacts: including insight summaries, current-state assessments, opportunity areas, journey or process findings, and supporting evidencethat enable strong problem statement creation.

Partner with business, technology, data, operations, and user experience stakeholders to validate needs, clarify business outcomes, and frame solution options that advance the Service Simplification strategy.

Identify dependencies, constraints, risks, and impacts across people, process, experience, data, and technology to inform prioritization and solutioning decisions.

Create concise, audience-ready narratives and visual documentation that connect evidence, service needs, problem statements, and potential outcomes for decision-makers.

Maintain traceability from source inputs and analysis through identified needs, problem statements, recommendations, and solution concepts.

Contribute reusable AI-enabled analysis practices, templates, and knowledge assets that strengthen the teams ability to consistently identify and communicate Service Simplification opportunities.


Education

4 year Bachelors Degree (Preferred)

Experience

3 or more years of experience (Preferred)

Insurance business acumen (Preferred)

Ability to manage projects

Ability to analyze data (Preferred)

Functional skills:
Strategic thinking

Problem solving

Story telling with data

Consultative/collaboration skills

Education & Experience (in lieu)

In lieu of the above education requirements, an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.


#LI-DM1

Skills

Analytical Thinking, Collaboration, Communication, Problem Solving, Process Improvements, Stakeholder Engagement, Strategic Thinking

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 75,100.00 - 126,325.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

The Irrigation Specialist (classified as a Horticulturist) is responsible for maintaining, repairing, and optimizing irrigation systems across the property to support landscape health and water efficiency. The role works independently on assigned irrigation tasks while coordinating with landscape and operations teams to support daily park functions, seasonal needs, and special events.

Responsibilities Irrigation System Maintenance & Operations

  • Perform installation, repair, replacement, and adjustment of irrigation system components including valves, heads, piping, controllers, wiring, and related equipment.
  • Conduct routine system inspections, testing, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot issues and make necessary repairs to ensure proper coverage, pressure, and performance.
  • Map irrigation zones and assist with layout and preparation for new installations or system modifications.
  • Dig trenches and install irrigation piping, lines, pumps, controllers, and electrical timers as required.
  • Support irrigation scheduling and water-efficiency practices in accordance with established guidelines.
  • Complete required documentation, reports, and work orders using computerized maintenance systems.

Responsibilities Landscape & Horticulture Support

  • Coordinate with landscape teams to support plant health, show quality, and site standards.
  • Operate power equipment and hand tools safely, including trenchers and other irrigation-related equipment.
  • Perform limited landscape support tasks such as pruning, trimming, and general cleanup as related to irrigation work.
  • Follow all established safety, environmental, and operational procedures.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned within scope of classification.

Education, Experience & Qualifications

  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Associate degree in horticulture, irrigation technology, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum three (3) years of commercial irrigation system experience.
  • Knowledge of Calsense and Motorola irrigation systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret irrigation plans and measurements.
  • Ability to evaluate irrigation needs and apply waterefficient practices.
  • Strong knowledge of plant care and landscaping principles.
  • Ability to work varied schedules including weekends and holidays.
  • Ability to work in environments requires climbing, trenching, or fall protection.

Required Certification

  • Certified Landscape Irrigation Auditor (CLIA) or equivalent Irrigation Association certification active certification required.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate with employees at all levels.
  • Proactive, selfdirected, and able to work under pressure.
  • Ability to interpret technical documents, safety rules, and instructions.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook; familiarity with Maximo.
  • Experience in theme parks, resorts, campuses, or large-scale properties

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements

  • Exposure to weather, temperature extremes, noise, and hazardous materials.
  • Duties may include working in confined spaces or at heights.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, trench, and traverse uneven terrain for extended periods.

Pay rate starting at $32.78 per hour.

Job.JobTitle: Quick Service Associate - Universal Horror Unleashed
Job.JobDescription:
Universal Horror Unleashed is a terrifyingly unique experience that will bring haunts to Las Vegas year-round. Located at Area 15 is the heart of horror we would love to have you haunting alongside us! With the nature of this experience comes a unique working environment. You will find yourself working in dark environments around special effects including strobe lights, fog, artificial smells, and more. The working hours will be unique, typically spanning over late evenings/nights and weekends (holidays included). This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, and a variety of other discounts and perks.  

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for supporting the Food and Beverage operation including but not limited to operating the POS system, performing basic food preparation, providing exemplary guest service by greeting guests, helping with internal and external crowd control, and supporting mobile pick up. Assists with cleaning duties that include mopping floors, emptying trash, and wiping down tables and restocking condiments, bussing tables, and running food as necessary. Assists with the efficient flow of Team Member Dining for food and beverage orders, accurate pick-up dining process and queuing, and ensuring food station are properly stocked and maintained.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for basic preparation of light-bite food options, handhelds and/or preparation of food (i.e. operating fryers to handle fried food cooked on a timer or slicing meat carvings) for quick service locations within Universal Horror Unleashed.
  • Responsible for taking and filling orders of Food and Beverage requested by guests. Operates POS accurately and follows established procedures by properly processing credit card transactions, discounts, etc.
  • Supports Team Member Dining pick up by ensuring all food and beverage orders are correct, timely and all condiment stations are properly stocked and maintained. Assists with ensuring an efficient flow of dining options for Team Members during set pick up times.
  • Provides friendly and courteous assistance to guests while answering questions and directing guests within the venue. Maintains internal and external crowd control and line speed.
  • Assists with cleaning tables in the dining areas in an efficient and expedient manner. Maintain floors by sweeping and mopping. Empty garbage, stock and replenish condiment stand, and straighten chairs.
  • Ensures adherence to the Nevada State Liquor Statutes and food safety handling state requirements.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Individual Contributor

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.
  • Must be able to obtain LVMPD Non-Gaming Work Card upon hire.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

The Horticulturist is responsible for all aspects of installation, maintenance, inspection and/or repair of the grounds of property owned and operated by Universal Studios Hollywood and throughout the park and other duties assigned within the Landscaping department. Specific duties include, but are not limited to: irrigation repairs and maintenance, plant identification and proper planting and pruning techniques, along with pest and disease identification, specific water needs and identifying drought stress, chemical application and maintaining plant health and appearance standards to a high level.

Responsibilities

  • Prune and trim trees, shrubs, and hedges with hand-held tools and 2-cycle equipment. Trim and pick flowers, and clean flower beds. Use hand tools such as shovels, rakes, pruning saws, saws, hedge and brush trimmers.
  • Remove, install and maintain high visual standard of plant material in beds and containers, in addition to repairing/replacing damage and manual weeding.
  • Mow and edge lawns, using power mowers and edgers. Care for established lawns by mulching, aerating, weeding, grubbing and removing thatch, and trimming and edging around flower beds, walks, and walls. Fertilizer/weed control application and identify/communicate possible pest/disease presence.
  • Water lawns, trees, and plants, using primarily irrigation systems, plus hoses, or watering cans. Maintain and repair irrigation systems as necessary. Identify drought stress and correct in timely manner.
  • Assist in specimen tree relocation, including ball and burlap operation, jetting in, and staking and guying.
  • Equipment cleaning, care and maintenance.
  • Adhere to all Standard Operating Procedures within Technical Services and USH at large.
  • Promote and provide extraordinary guest service for both internal and external guests; answer questions, offer information, and provide assistance in a courteous manner.
  • Understand and demonstrate the proper use of safety practices and ensure department standards are maintained and safety policies for the Park upheld.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Desired Characteristics

  • Demonstrated ability to work with all levels of employees and management, and willingness to give assistance to co-workers.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently under pressure; proactive thinker/selfstarter
  • Excellent organizational, verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook; knowledge of inventory software, i.e. Maximo
  • Ability to contribute to system improvement process

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Associates degree (AA) from a two-year college/technical school in applicable discipline(s) or equivalent experience
  • Ability & willingness to work a variety of schedules, overtime, weekends and holidays with short notice
  • Ability and willingness to respond to incidents in locations requiring climbing, fall-protection, and other nontraditional work-environments.
  • Must possess excellent interpersonal communication skills both verbal and written on a technical level
  • Able to work independently
  • Requires moderate to heavy physical exertion
  • Must be able to lift, carry, push, and pull heavy materials and objects up to 50lbs.
  • Must be able to stand, walk, bend, stoop, climb, etc. for extended periods of time

 

Starting pay rate of $32.78 per hour

Develops and trains the team by administering Lead observations, providing feedback, and supporting management with growth opportunities for Cooks.

  • Must be able to work a flexible and varying schedule based on business demands.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • Professional Food Managers certification is required.

EDUCATION:

EXPERIENCE:

Description

When you enter a finance and accounting position at Liberty Mutual Insurance, you will find the same dynamic environment and challenges as within other organizations. Yet you will find something more: an opportunity to apply your analytic and technical skills to a company renowned for its integrity and focus on developing its employees' careers.

As a Lead Reinsurance Accountant, you will conduct complex assignments involving maintaining captive accounts and developing financial statements and reports

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare complex financial reports for Captive agreements and Reinsurance,utilizing a broad knowledge of accounting policies and procedures.
  • Prepare and/or input general ledger entries by utilizing set procedures and various accounting systems.
  • Research complex reinsurance accounting treatment and policies by utilizing available technology and other resources.
  • Research and resolve complex reconciling issues and discrepancies; take corrective measures to prevent.
  • Provide customer service to internal and external partners.
  • Review financial reports for accuracy and ensure timely preparation.
  • Prepare analysis and be prepared to provide explanations for unusual and/or inconsistent trends.
  • Suggest process improvement initiatives and provide solutions to enhance current processes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree (Accounting or Finance) required. CPA or advanced degree in Accounting preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of accounting or finance experience.
  • Must demonstrate attention to detail in a fast-paced work environment and the ability to adapt quickly to changing conditions to achieve results.
  • Communicates well with own team and across organizational boundaries to create alignment and ensure the successful completion of shared goals.
  • Comfortable leading meetings and able to communicate issues and trends to senior management and other groups at the appropriate level of detail.
  • Possesses a solid understanding of accounting principles.

Job Description

Job Summary

As a Risk Adjustment Coder, you will work independently in a remote environment and collaborate with our team to ensure accuracy and quality in our diagnosis coding work. We offer the opportunity to work with a dynamic team in a remote environmentCompetitive salary and benefits packageProfessional growth and development opportunitiesIf you are a motivated and detail-oriented coding professional looking for a new challenge, apply today!


Under the direction of the Sr. Manager Risk Adjustment Audit, the Risk Adjustment Coder is responsible for reviewing medical records to apply appropriate diagnosis coding in compliance with International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision (ICD-10) coding guidelines for the purposes of risk adjustment.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Review inpatient and/or outpatient medical records to identify and assign relevant diagnosis codes using ICD-10 classification systems to ensure accuracy and compliance of risk adjustment. This may be in the form of ad hoc projects, provider quality audits, vendor overreads or RADVs.
  • Review and validate provider-submitted and/or vendor-submitted medical record documentation and ICD-10 diagnosis codes to identify and correct any inaccuracies or discrepancies to ensure accuracy and compliance of risk adjustment.
  • Responsible for meeting production targets while adhering to strict quality audit accuracy of 95%.
  • Provide non-production level support by documenting coder observations that would not otherwise be captured through the diagnosis coding.
  • Assist Provider Educator during audit results presentation with provider groups by answering diagnosis coding questions.
  • Administrative duties including updating SOPs, DTPs and other related documents.
  • Participating in process improvement initiatives such as but not limited to coding tool enhancements.

What We Require

  • 2+ years related work experience

  • High school diploma or GED

  • Required active Certified Professional Coder American Association of Professional Coders CPC and/or CCSP OR (AAPC) or American Health information Management Association (AHIMA)

  • Ability to work independently in a remote work environment.

  • Proficient with ICD-10-CM Guidelines for coding and reporting.

  • Previous work experience in production-based environment.

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology, abbreviations, body systems/anatomy, physiology and concepts of disease processes.

  • Intermediate level of Microsoft Office proficiency (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).

What We Prefer

  • CRC - Certified Risk Adjustment Coder from American Association of Professional Coders (AAPC)

The AIF Liquid Cooling Expert is a Senior Technical contributor for Siemens AI Factory program, responsible for defining and advancing compute-side

liquid cooling architectures across AI Factory and data center environments. This role integrates physical and digital cooling technologies and collaborates
closely with multi-disciplinary teams to deliver scalable, reference-ready cooling solutions for Siemens portfolios and customers.

You'll make an impact by:

  • Leading the compute-side cooling strategy for the AI Factory (AIF) program, collaborating with business and technical experts across controls,
    simulation, air handling, power, and compute.
  • Designing and integrating both physical cooling infrastructure (primary and secondary loops, cold plates, manifolds, valves, pumps, CDUs) and
    digital simulations, including hydraulic system simulation, thermal/ CFD simulation.
  • Co-creating with peers across disciplines to optimize Siemens reference architectures and customer-specific AI Factory and data center designs.
  • Creating next-generation cooling concepts u sing simulation tools such as Amesim, Modelica, STAR-CCM+, leveraging automation and controls
    through PLCs.
  • Developing scalable system designs, reusable libraries, and automation-ready assets deployed across Siemens portfolios and customer solutions, including AI-assisted design workflows.
  • Incorporating emerging code and standards from OCP, ASHRAE, UL, etc. into forward-looking cooling designs while operating in fast-paced, multi-disciplinary environments.
  • Reducing complex cooling systems into reference designs and foundational guidelines enabling consistent execution across portfolio, advanced development, and R&D teams.


Core Competencies:

  • Liquid Cooling Systems Expertise: Deep expertise in direct-to-chip and immersion cooling technologies and cold plate, CDU
    architectures. Familiarity with hydraulic and CFD simulations.
  • Cooling System Architect: Leads physical and digital liquid cooling designs for AI Factory and data center environments, considering
    hydraulic and thermal performance, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Scalable Design Strategy: Translates complex cooling systems into reusable, reference-ready architectures.
  • Standards-Driven Design: Integrates emerging code and standards from OCP, ASHRAE, UL, etc. into future-ready solutions.
  • Collaboration & Influence: Operates effectively across fast-paced, multi-disciplinary teams.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in liquid cooling, thermal systems, or data center cooling design.
  • Hands-on experience with end-to-end compute-side cooling system design, hydraulics and thermal system modeling.
  • In-depth knowledge of control and monitoring requirements for data center cooling systems
  • Ability to travel domestically up to 90% in the first 6 months and internationally as required.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in thermal, mechanical, or related engineering discipline.
  • Experience designing liquid cooling systems for AI, HPC, or large-scale data center environments, both mechanical and controls.
  • Prior experience in modular construction methods for mechanical and/or cooling design in data centers
  • Hands-on experience with Siemens modeling, PLM, or automation platforms.

In this role, you'll work within a matrixed organization and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver medium-voltage power distribution solutions, photovoltaic inverter projects, and automation-focused systems.

You'll manage customer-facing projects in a fast-paced environment, balancing scope, schedule, budget, quality, and stakeholder expectations. This position offers strong opportunities for growth, aligned with Siemens' commitment to developing people with a continuous learning mindset.

Job Summary

At Farmers, data powers better decisions. As a Sr. Associate Decision Scientist, you'll help transform complex business questions into actionable analytical solutions that shape strategy across our Direct & Strategic Partnerships organization.

In this role, you'll leverage advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and data visualization to uncover insights, identify opportunities, and influence critical business decisions. Working closely with business leaders and cross-functional partners, you'll apply tools such as Python, SQL, Excel, and Power BI to analyze large datasets, develop predictive models, and deliver recommendations that drive growth, improve customer outcomes, and optimize business performance.

Success in this role requires a blend of technical expertise, intellectual curiosity, and business acumen. The ideal candidate thrives in solving ambiguous problems, translating data into compelling stories, and turning analytical insights into measurable business impact.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Apply moderately advanced statistical, mathematical, and analytical techniques to solve medium-to-large-scale business problems impacting current and future business strategies.
  • Build descriptive and explanatory models or leverage outputs from predictive and machine learning models developed by others.
  • Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, risks, and business opportunities.
  • Utilize data visualization tools and advanced analytical methods, including: Distribution analysis, Correlation analysis, Outlier detection, Multivariate analysis, Time-series analysis, Machine learning techniques.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA), test hypotheses, and validate findings with business stakeholders.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and develop data-driven solutions.
  • Collect, integrate, and transform data from multiple sources into cohesive datasets for analysis.
  • Evaluate data quality and apply data governance and hygiene practices to ensure reliability and accuracy.
  • Perform quality-control checks, document processes, and collaborate with peers on data validation efforts.
  • Work closely with IT, Data Engineering, Data Science, and other technical teams to optimize data pipelines and resolve data quality issues.
  • Support the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of predictive models within business workflows.
  • Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business leaders.
  • Utilize effective storytelling and visualization techniques to make analytical findings accessible and impactful.
  • Stay current on emerging data science methodologies, technologies, and industry best practices.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.
  • Provide informal coaching or mentorship to less experienced team members as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

First Year Success Factors

Within the first 12 months, a successful candidate can expect to have achieved the following:

  • Establish strong partnerships with business leaders and become a trusted advisor for data-driven decision-making across Direct & Strategic Partnerships.
  • Deliver actionable insights through advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and predictive techniques that solve complex business challenges and influence strategic outcomes.
  • Lead high-impact analytical projects from problem definition through implementation, driving measurable improvements in growth, customer experience, operational performance, and profitability.
  • Develop, validate, and deploy analytical models that identify key business drivers, improve forecasting capabilities, and support informed decision-making.
  • Leverage Python, SQL, Power BI, and other analytical tools to transform complex datasets into scalable analytical solutions and executive-ready insights.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations that influence leadership decisions and advance business objectives.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

Candidates would ideally reflect the following professional qualifications and experiences:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline. Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
  • Three or more years of experience applying advanced analytics, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, or quantitative problem-solving to support business decision-making. Experience in insurance, financial services, or other data-driven industries is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex or ambiguous business questions into analytical approaches, actionable insights, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong technical proficiency with Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, and other analytical tools used for data exploration, statistical analysis, modeling, and visualization.
  • Experience developing, validating, and deploying analytical models, including forecasting, segmentation, driver analysis, optimization, predictive modeling, and performance measurement.
  • Solid foundation in statistical methods and analytical techniques, including hypothesis testing, regression analysis, experimental design, forecasting, and trend analysis.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating data into clear recommendations that influence business strategy and decision-making.

And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly technical Software Engineering Manager to lead the engineering vision, development, integration, and support of our Legal Technology ecosystem.

This role is ideal for a hands-on engineering leader who enjoys building software, solving complex integration challenges, and applying Generative AI to transform legal operations. Unlike traditional management positions, approximately 80% of this role is dedicated to software development, solution architecture, production support, and technical leadership, with the remaining 20% focused on coaching engineers, resource planning, and stakeholder management.

The Managing Engineer will oversee critical legal technology platforms, including vendor-provided legal applications, enterprise integration and orchestration services, and emerging AI-powered legal solutions. This individual will be responsible for designing scalable cloud-native architectures, integrating legal products across the enterprise, and delivering innovative solutions using Agentic AI and Generative Intelligence platforms.

The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering expertise with strong product ownership, operational excellence, and a passion for modern AI technologies. They are equally comfortable debugging production issues, designing APIs, reviewing architecture, mentoring engineers, and collaborating with Legal, Compliance, Security, and Technology stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, development, integration, and support of Legal Technology products and platforms.
  • Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native applications, APIs, integrations, and event-driven services supporting Legal and Regulatory business capabilities.
  • Actively contribute to software development through hands-on coding, code reviews, architectural design, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Integrate and orchestrate vendor-provided legal applications with enterprise systems, ensuring scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
  • Drive technical decisions related to cloud platforms, application modernization, data management, integration patterns, and AI services.
  • Own product reliability, security, performance, and operational excellence, including incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Partner closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to deliver business outcomes.
  • Design and implement AI-powered solutions using Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and intelligent automation technologies to enhance legal operations and knowledge management.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance stakeholders to identify opportunities to leverage AI responsibly while maintaining governance, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead experimentation, innovation, and adoption of emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and legal technology solutions.
  • Own the reliability, supportability, security, scalability, and performance of Legal Technology products in production.

  • Define operational KPIs, service-level objectives, and engineering metrics to ensure platform health and business value realization.
  • Lead, coach, and mentor team of engineers while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous learning
  • Influence stakeholders and engineering teams to adopt modern engineering and AI best practices.

Functional Skills

Job.JobTitle: Bodily Injury Adjuster - Represented, Moderate (OH/CT) Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster Moderate, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair and timely injury settlements with all parties involved.

***The ideal candidate will be able to handle a high-volume of pending cases and have experience with not only third-party casualty adjusting, but also first-party collision and third-party property damage claims.***

Candidates for this role must reside in the Eastern or Central Time Zones.

Qualifications

  • Prior represented third-party casualty claim handling experience is required

  • OH or CT claims experience highly preferred

  • 2-5 years of moderate Bodily Injury claim handling experience is preferred

  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.

  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.

  • Proficient knowledge of insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination and state regulations.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.

  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite a plus


Youll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.*

**Candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.

Allstate Benefits

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit https://www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties.
