Job Description

The Core Engineering & Platform (CEP) provides a transformative platform ecosystem that empowers end users and digital product teams to innovate seamlessly and support Allstates Consumer Connected Cloud mission. The ecosystem is designed to create a frictionless experience for its user community.

As the Digital Product Manager Expert for a defined area of the enterprise Infrastructure as Code and Engineering as Code product, you will translate the broader product vision into a focused strategy, roadmap, prioritized capabilities and measurable outcomes. You will improve how infrastructure is created, changed, secured, operated and recovered by replacing manual and inconsistent work with reusable, tested and supported product capabilities.

You will work across infrastructure engineering, platform teams, operations, architecture, security and internal customers. The role requires sufficient technical fluency in cloud, infrastructure automation and modern engineering practices to evaluate options, make informed trade-offs, sequence work and guide delivery without acting as the hands-on engineering owner.

Success will be measured through practical improvements in infrastructure delivery, including fewer manual hand-offs, greater reuse of approved components, more consistent application of controls, simpler customer experiences, stronger recovery capabilities and increased adoption of code-driven engineering practices.

Key responsibilities

  • Own and communicate the product strategy, vision and roadmap for a defined Infrastructure as Code and Engineering as Code product area, aligned with enterprise platform, security and customer priorities.
  • Translate customer and engineering problems into prioritized capabilities, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria; author, test and accept stories across multiple Agile release cycles.
  • Lead discovery and test-and-learn activity with infrastructure engineers, platform teams, operations, architects, security partners and internal customers to validate assumptions and product direction.
  • Prioritize reusable, tested and supported capabilities that reduce manual hand-offs and inconsistency across infrastructure creation, change, security, operations and recovery.
  • Partner with engineering to assess and sequence solutions involving Terraform or OpenTofu, Ansible, source control, automated testing, delivery pipelines, configuration management and reusable infrastructure components.
  • Define and monitor product performance measures, including adoption, component reuse, delivery lead time, manual intervention, policy or control compliance, reliability and recovery outcomes.
  • Use customer insight, analytics, technical constraints and enterprise value to make transparent product trade-offs and guide incremental releases.
  • Drive adoption across teams with different levels of engineering maturity through clear onboarding, documentation, demonstrations, feedback loops and continuous product improvement.
  • Influence product, engineering and platform stakeholders across geographically distributed teams, and coach less-experienced product management colleagues.

Essential Skills

  • Minimum 5 years experience in digital product management, including independent ownership and execution of product strategy and roadmaps across multiple release cycles.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience coaching or mentoring product management colleagues and contributing expertise across a broader technology organization.
  • Demonstrable product experience in infrastructure, cloud, compute, platform engineering or Platform as a Service
  • Demonstrable knowledge of infrastructure automation and engineering practices, evidenced by product delivery involving Terraform or OpenTofu, Ansible, source control, automated testing, CI/CD or delivery pipelines, configuration management, or reusable infrastructure components.
  • Proven delivery across multiple Agile release cycles, with hands-on use of Jira, Azure DevOps or an equivalent tool to manage backlogs, prioritization, dependencies and delivery tracking.
  • Evidence of defining user stories and acceptance criteria, guiding technical trade-offs and partnering with infrastructure, platform, operations, architecture or security teams.
  • Proven use of product metrics and analytics to prioritize and improve products, with examples of tracking adoption, reuse, lead time, automation, reliability, control compliance or customer experience outcomes.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience managing an Infrastructure as Code, Engineering as Code, developer platform or internal platform product in a large enterprise environment.
  • Experience improving developer or infrastructure customer journeys through self-service workflows, reusable modules, policy-as-code, automated controls or platform APIs.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms and infrastructure lifecycle practices, including resilience, disaster recovery, observability, security or compliance requirements.
  • Experience in the insurance or financial services industry or delivering enterprise-scale software and platform solutions in a regulated environment.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

**For this opportunity, the business is flexible to hire at Sr Consultant, Lead Consultant, and Expert level depending on qualifications & interview evaluation.**

Product Security Engineering designs, builds, and operates enterprise security capabilities that integrate directly into cloud platforms, software development lifecycles, and enterprise engineering practices. The organization applies modern engineering approaches to embed security early in the development process, enabling teams to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable technology solutions.

The Platform Consultant Threat Modeling is a senior security consultant responsible for driving the adoption of secure-by-design principles across enterprise technology platforms through the application of advanced threat modeling practices.

The role focuses on embedding threat modeling into both new and existing applications, influencing architectural decisions, improving security posture, and guiding engineering organizations through complex security challenges. Working across Product Security, Engineering, Security Operations, and Architecture teams, the consultant helps ensure security is treated as a foundational element of platform design rather than a downstream activity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a trusted security consultant to engineering teams, providing guidance on secure architecture, platform design, and threat modeling practices

  • Lead andfacilitatethreat modeling engagements across multiple applications, platforms, and business domains toidentifyand mitigate security risks early in the development lifecycle

  • Embed secure-by-design principles into software delivery processes, ensuring security considerations are incorporated from discovery through production deployment

  • Define, communicate, and influence platform security strategies and architectural decisions with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Partner with engineering, architecture, and security teams to develop risk-based security recommendations that balance security, businessobjectives, and developer experience

  • Drive the adoption of modern engineering and security practices, including reusable security patterns, architectural standards, and secure development frameworks

  • Collaborate with Security Operations and Product Security teams to improve threat detection capabilities, breach modeling initiatives, and security resilience

  • Facilitate architectural reviews, discovery workshops, and threat modeling sessions that enable teams to make informed security decisions

  • Mentor engineers and technical leaders on systems thinking, threat identification, security architecture principles, and secure design methodologies

  • Champion emerging security capabilities including AI Security, API Security, SaaS Security, and threat modeling automation initiatives


Essential Skills

  • 3+years' experiencein software engineering, security engineering, solution architecture, technical project management, or platform engineering roles within complex enterprise environments

  • Experience acting as a technical advisor, consultant, architect, or security partner supporting engineering teams during design and implementation activities

  • Deep understanding of threat modeling methodologies such as STRIDE, Attack Trees, Kill Chains, or equivalent risk assessment frameworks

  • Demonstrated experienceidentifying, documenting, and mitigating security threats within cloud-native, distributed, API-driven, or enterprise applications

  • Practical experience with modern software development practices including CI/CD, source control, automated testing, and Agile delivery methodologies

  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated security considerations


Desirable Skills

  • Working knowledge of industry security frameworks and standards including OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML

  • Experience supporting Security Operations, Incident Response, SOC, or breach modeling activities

Job Description

This role is responsible for investigating moderately complex and some complex comprehensive personal liability (CPL) claims, including unrepresentative moderate and CPL losses. Responsibilities include analyzing coverage, obtaining recorded statements, evaluating liability and damages, handling demands, issuing payments to appropriate parties, and negotiating settlements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Negotiates and settles claims in accordance with business unit best practices.

  • Researches and responds to moderately complex and occasionally complex customer communications, concerns, conflicts or issues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2 or more years of experience.
  • Adjuster License.

This job does not have supervisory duties.

The Architecture Compute, and Engineering (ACE) organization provides a transformative platform ecosystem with a comprehensive set of capabilities that empowers end users and digital product teams to innovate seamlessly and drive growth for Allstate through the Consumer Connected Cloud mission. This ecosystem aims to provide an absolute frictionless experience for our user community.

As a Digital Product Manager on the Network Connectivity team, you will operate at the crossroads of business and technology. You will partner closely with Network Connectivity Engineering and other stakeholders to design innovative solutions, pilot new capabilities, and deliver products that meet evolving business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy and Vision: Develop, own, and communicate the vision and strategy for Network Connectivity capabilities.
  • Market Research: Conduct market and user research to identify trends, customer needs, and the competitive landscape. Stay ahead of industry shifts and emerging network communication technologies to uncover opportunities that drive innovation and deliver greater value to our customers.

  • Roadmap Management: Create and continuously maintain a product roadmap that aligns with business goals and customer needs.
  • Ongoing Management: Work with the Digital Product team to write & groom stories, prioritize, and manage the backlog.
  • Performance Monitoring: Definite product performance metrics & monitor product performance using analytics tools and make data-driven decisions.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicate product progress and updates to internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Budget Management: Manage product budgets and resources efficiently.
  • Customer Feedback: Gather and analyze customer feedback to continually improve the product.

  • Product management experience within Network Connectivity, Network Infrastructure, Cloud Networking, Telecommunications, or related enterprise technology domains.

  • Experience partnering with Network Engineering, Cloud, Infrastructure, Security, Server, and Storage teams to define product requirements, influence stakeholders, and deliver technology products using customer, operational, or business performance metrics.

  • Minimum 2 years' experience owning and executing product strategy independently, including prioritising investments and delivering outcomes across multiple release cycles.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring Product Managers, Product Owners, or cross-functional teams and acting as a recognised subject matter expert within the organisation.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with cloud networking technologies and platforms across AWS, Azure, GCP, or hybrid-cloud environments.
  • Experience with modern networking approaches such as SD-WAN, SASE, Zero Trust, Network Automation, or Network Observability.
  • Relevant industry certifications in Product Management, Agile, SAFe, Cisco (CCNA/CCNP), AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience working within large-scale, regulated enterprise environments.
  • Experience using customer research, market analysis, or technology trends to identify and validate new product opportunities.

Job.JobTitle: Area Supervisor, Food & Beverage Operations - Universal Kids Resort
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for revenue generation in multiple Food & Beverage venue locations, overseeing stock inventory, leading and overseeing the training of Team Members, ensuring Guest service standards are met and operational readiness of indoor and open-air locations.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assists Management with the consistent execution of Guest Service and operational standards. Performs all operational duties related to the daily opening and closing of locations to include but not limited to inventory, performing audits, and completing the end-of-day process.
  • Ensures the safety of Guests and Team Members working within the Food & Beverage department by reviewing and revising safety practices and procedures and responding to potentially unsafe conditions. Coach and use feedback forms to document and maintain safe Team Member actions in accordance with UDX policy.
  • Responsible for developing, coaching and training all Food & Beverage Team Leads and Team Members. Manages labor budgets for assigned venues. Creates venue schedules for Assistant Manager approval. Monitors, tracks and records overtime and training projections and results. Mitigates overtime by adjusting staffing according to daily attendance projections. Analyzes and responds to various reports including but not limited to Guest comments and incident reports.
  • Focus on Guest and Team Member satisfaction. Ensures that each Team Member is meeting UDX service standards and assisting Guests while maintaining an efficient, safe and pleasant environment. Ensure that Team Member Satisfaction (TSAT) and Guest Service (GSAT) initiatives and programs are followed to keep the workplace fun while increasing overall job satisfaction and efficiency.
  • Maintain positive relationships and partners with other departments to ensure that departmental goals are being met while maintaining company standards. Responsible for maintaining the quality, cleanliness and facility maintenance standards to ensure assigned venues are Show Ready for Guests at all times and in back-of-house areas for Team Members.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Supervises a Non-Exempt team.

Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for supporting the Revenue Operations division at Universal Kids Resort (UKR) in the day-to-day coordination of business operational activities, procurement of materials/supplies, maintenance of menu collateral and new menu items, and inventory support. Partners with Managers and Assistant Managers to coordinate and ensure an efficient operation of Food and Beverage and Merchandise operations, Team Member Dining and mobile food and drink ordering (MFDO). Assists in coordinating daily changes and labor shortages to ensure adequate staffing requirements for the daily operation and effectively communicates scheduling and staffing daily operational changes. Tracks and audits time and attendance reports to ensure compliance of UKR policies and procedures. Tracks training progress to ensure Revenue Operations Team Members are always current on required training including safety, sanitation, and responsible alcohol service. Completes reporting/audits in compliance with Frisco Health Department inspections.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Supports Revenue Operations teams including Culinary, Food & Beverage Operations, Merchandise, and Warehouse/Shared Services by organizing daily operational tasks.
  • Partners with front line Team Members to inform on key operational changes to ensure a seamless operation in alignment with Texas state specific requirements and Universal standards.
  • Works with Management to ensure Team Members are utilized in the proper roles in compliance with certifications.
  • Assists in the compilation of department labor information for the company Flash report.
  • Assists Management with rotations and grid creation as needed.
  • Maintains and updates all collateral and menus to ensure the accuracy and show quality standards.
  • Researches, documents, and pulls reports on Point-of-Sale (POS) transactions for accuracy, discrepancies, and routine audits. Informs leadership of any discrepancies in accordance to established procedures.
  • Coordinates and communicates Veritiv audits and records and tracks all health inspections.
  • Assists with communicating and compiling of food safety quality control of allergies to the appropriate teams following all UKR and Frisco policies and regulations.
  • Acts as first point of contact for all scheduling changes such as swaps, days off, vacation requests, callouts, special event coverage, etc.
  • Assists in the daily operations as needed by providing exemplary Guest service at all times.
  • Maintains awareness of potential service cues that could lead to a positive service experience.
  • Performs opening and closing duties such as assisting with daily tasks to front line Team Members, responds to escalated Guest situations as necessary, ensures the proper flow of the operation, and maintains a clean and safe work environment.
  • Assists with overseeing the completion of training checklists and partnering with Management to ensure a Team Member is fully signed off in all safety, sanitation, and responsible alcohol service, following all Frisco food safety handling requirements.
  • Provides daily in the moment feedback on training initiatives.
  • Supports training new and current Team Members on food and beverage policies and procedures and continuous learning initiatives.
  • Provides assistance with administrative functions of the Revenue Operations division including, but not limited to inventory, product assistance, sourcing, onboarding, coordinating regulatory training, compliance reporting, and audits of Frisco required licenses.
  • Assists with compiling new information related to new initiatives to drive the revenue across the theme park.
  • Supports food and beverage related information for special events, catering requests and reservations for private events.
  • Communicates with partners to coordinate functions including securing space, discussing menu options, confirming number of Guests, determining price of menu items, special menu themes, etc.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Individual Contributor

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.
  • Must be able to work a flexible and varying schedule based on business demands.

  •  Strong attention to detail is key and experience with administrative support.
  •  Basic understanding and experience of Top 9 food allergies and food safety knowledge is preferred.
  •  Proficient in Excel, Word, PowerPoint and other business solutions software.
  •  Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  •  Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • Professional Food Managers certification is required.

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  •  2+ years of related experience in scheduling, staffing, or administrative support is required; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$132,800.00 - $219,100.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of higher exposure cases and more complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

Venues for this role typical cover Southwest & Central Georgia including but not limited to Macon, Columbus, and Warner Robbins.

What Will You Do?

  • In the independent handling of a caseload of higher exposure cases and most complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including independent responsibility for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Initiate special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 7+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Strong aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Advanced oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Excels in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates strong leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 7 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and strategic leader to create and stand up a Professional Employer Organization (PEO) program, driving growth and revenue expansion. The successful candidate will be responsible for informing the design and development of the PEO program, owning sales and account management for PEO groups, and expanding into additional executive-level account management for other group segments. This is a high-growth opportunity for a seasoned professional to lead a critical business function and contribute to the company's overall success.

Key Responsibilities:
PEO Program Development and Launch:
• Design and develop a comprehensive PEO program, including services, pricing, and operational infrastructure.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, and operations, to ensure alignment and successful launch.

Sales and Account Management:
• Own sales and account management for PEO groups, driving revenue growth and customer acquisition.
• Develop and execute sales strategies to penetrate existing markets and expand into new ones.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders.

Growth and Expansion:
• Identify opportunities for growth and expansion into additional executive-level account management for other group segments.
• Develop and execute strategies to drive growth, increase revenue, and enhance customer value.

Leadership and Team Development:
• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing sales and account management team.
• Foster a culture of excellence, innovation, and customer-centricity.

Strategic Partnerships and Collaborations:
• Develop and maintain strategic partnerships with key stakeholders, including brokers, agents, and industry partners.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and effective execution.

Key Requirements:
• 10+ years of experience in sales, account management, or a related field, with a focus on PEO or similar industries (e.g., benefits, HR, or payroll services)
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent related work experience
• Proven track record of leadership and success in building and managing high-performing teams
• Strong sales and account management skills, with a focus on growing revenue and expanding customer relationships
• Excellent strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex data and develop actionable insights
• Communication: Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders

Preferred:
• Direct experience in the PEO industry or a similar field
• Experience in an executive-level role, preferably as a VP or SVP

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.

What We Offer:
As a Florida Blue employee, you will thrive in our Be Well, Work Well, GuideWell culture where being well as an individual, and working well as a team, are both important in serving our members and communities.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
  • Additional voluntary benefits available; and

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Job Description Summary:

Our Mission is to equip students for success by developing and delivering highly effective digital learning through an intuitive online platform.

FLVS does not discriminate in admission or access to, or treatment or employment in its programs and activities on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, marital status, disability, genetic information or any other reason prohibited by law.

The Position:

Position General Summary:

The Instructor, Florida Scholars Academy (FSA) provides an educational atmosphere where students have the opportunity to reach their full educational potential. The Instructor, Florida Scholars Academy exhibits a passion for, and dedication to, the remediation, acceleration, and academic growth of at-risk students. This position organizes and implements an instructional program resulting in students achieving academic success in accordance with state policies and laws. This position is responsible for teaching assigned academic subjects in residential facilities for the Florida Department of Juvenile Justice students.

Essential Position Functions:

  • Plan, prepare, and implement engaging instructional activities in assigned subject(s) that contribute to a climate where students are actively engaged in meaningful learning experiences.

  • Identify, select, create, and modify instructional resources to meet the needs of the students with varying backgrounds, learning styles, and special needs.

  • Be responsible for the supervision of students assigned to the class.

  • Conduct roll calls, counts, and maintains attendance records.

  • Maintain effective and efficient record keeping procedures.

  • Ensure that order and discipline are maintained in the classroom using effective classroom behavior management techniques.

  • Provide a positive environment in which students are encouraged to be actively engaged in the learning process.

  • Evaluate students and make determinations as to overall progress.

  • Grade student assignments and assessments and follows all grading procedures. Counsel and advise students regarding their academic and behavioral progress.

  • Collaborate with supervisor and peers to enhance the instructional environment for students by participating in activities which include, but are not limited to, team teaching, meetings, professional learning, and professional learning communities.

  • Communicate with students, parents/guardians, and internal and external stakeholders within established timelines.

  • Model professional and ethical standards when dealing with students, parents/guardians, colleagues, and other stakeholders.

  • Ensure that student's growth and achievement are continuous and appropriate for age group, subject area, and/or program classification.

  • Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with students, parents/guardians, colleagues, and other stakeholders measured by district/school survey results.

  • Meet specific course and school-wide student performance goals.

  • Demonstrate gains in student performance.

  • Participate in blended learning models, which includes both on-line and classroom instruction and interaction with students at various residential facilities across the state; required to report to an assigned facility.

  • Provide instructional tutoring as directed.

  • Provide services in person at the assigned facility to meet the needs of students under the supervision of the Department of Juvenile Justice (DJJ).

  • Support any other academic related topic established at the discretion of the Superintendent of Schools, Florida Scholars Academy, Regional Director, Florida Scholars Academy, or Instructional Leader, Florida Scholars Academy.

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of basic technology, including software applications, hardware, and navigating digital tools, with the ability to effectively apply them to daily tasks and troubleshoot common issues.

  • Meet professional obligations through efficient work habits such as, meeting deadlines, honoring schedules, coordinating resources and meetings in an effective and timely manner, and demonstrating respect for others.

  • All work responsibilities are subject to having performance goals and/or targets established.

(These essential functions are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed. Employees will be required to perform other job related duties as required.)

Minimum Requirements:

Education/Licensure/Certification:

  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college/university

  • Valid Florida Professional Teaching Certificate in content area assigned OR proof of active enrollment in a state-approved EPI or MAT program AND either a valid Florida state-issued Statement of Eligibility OR valid Temporary Certificate in content area assigned

  • Exceptional Student Educational (ESE) Certification, preferred

  • Gifted Endorsement, preferred

  • English for Speakers of Other Languages (ESOL) Endorsement, preferred

  • Reading Endorsement, preferred

Experience:

  • Teaching experience within subject area OR successful completion of an FLVS instructional internship program OR current enrollment in an approved EPI or MAT program

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA's):

  • Operational knowledge of the Internet and Web-related technologies

  • Possess strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal skills

  • Strong classroom management skills

  • Excellent customer service skills

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and work as part of a team

  • Must be responsible, accountable, and self-motivated

  • Demonstrated strong work ethic to achieve school goals

  • Display effective prioritizing, organizing, and time-management skills; ability to meet aggressive deadlines

  • Ability to learn and apply all required and recommended computer applications to create efficiency and consistency in internal workflows and instructional practices

  • Ability to function effectively in a high demand environment

  • Demonstrated ability to successfully support core competencies, values, and expectation for student-centered behaviors

CORE COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS:

JOB KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Team member carries out essential job functions with accuracy, engages in ongoing and relevant professional learning, applies new knowledge effectively, and demonstrates mastery of job-specific skills

PRODUCTIVITY

Team member produces high quality work, meets organizational and departmental deadlines, balances multiple responsibilities, manages time effectively, and seeks ways to improve processes and productivity

COMMUNICATION

Team member communicates clearly in written and verbal formats, collaborates effectively, demonstrates professionalism in all interactions, exhibits strong interpersonal skills, and contributes to a positive team and professional community

CUSTOMER FOCUS

Team member addresses the needs of internal and external customers, analyzes problems effectively, contributes to innovative solutions, seeks opportunities for improvement, and successfully adapts to change

Physical Requirements and Environmental Conditions:

  • Frequency of travel: Daily travel is required to the assigned residential facility. Frequent travel is required for meetings, training, and conferences; location may vary and may require overnight stays.

  • Light physical activities and efforts required working in an office environment

This role supports a customer service engineering team focused on migrating legacy FactoryLink (FLink) applications to Siemens WinCC platforms. The engineer will work as part of a dedicated migration team to analyze, convert, and validate customer projects while ensuring technical accuracy, consistency, and quality delivery.

We are looking for a Service Engineer. This position is remote and can be based anywhere in the continental United States.

You'll make an impact by:

  • Execute FLink to Siemens WinCC migration activities as part of a structured, team-based engineering environment
  • Analyze existing FLink applications and map functionality to WinCC equivalents under defined migration approaches
  • Develop, modify, and validate WinCC screens, scripts, and system configurations
  • Apply VBScript (VBS) and C to support migration logic, configuration changes, and routine troubleshooting activities
  • Collaborate with migration team members to meet project scope, quality, and delivery objectives
  • Participate in technical reviews, system testing, and issue resolution, escalating complex issues as appropriate
  • Contribute to engineering documentation and knowledge sharing, supporting standardized migration processes and best practices

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years demonstrated hands-on experience with Siemens WinCC, including configuration and basic system troubleshooting
  • Proficiency in VBScript (VBS) and C programming applied in WinCC automation environments
  • Experience working in a collaborative, team-based engineering environment
  • Ability to understand and convert legacy automation applications with established standards
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to follow structured approaches to issue resolution
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience with FLink systems
  • Experience with WinCC automation system migrations or modernization projects
  • Familiarity with customer-facing project environments

As the Vertical Sales Executive - Higher Education (Building Automation), you will identify, develop, and win large-scale capital projects valued at $3M+ across colleges and universities. This is a strategic, quota-carrying hunting role focused on creating opportunities before they reach procurement, building executive-level relationships, and leading complex pursuits involving building automation, digitalization, energy infrastructure, and smart campus modernization.

Successful candidates are energized by proactive prospecting, uncovering customer needs, influencing decision makers, shaping projects before RFP release, and orchestrating cross-functional teams to secure transformational projects. Higher Education experience is valued, but demonstrated success hunting and closing complex technical opportunities is the primary requirement.


As the Vertical Sales Executive – Higher Education (Building Automation), you will:

  • Identify, qualify, and pursue new capital-project opportunities valued at $3M+ across an assigned national or regional portfolio of Higher Education accounts.
  • Build a robust, self-generated pipeline through targeted prospecting, market intelligence, industry networks, construction and capital-plan signals, partner relationships, and direct executive outreach.
  • Create and advance opportunities before formal procurement or RFP release by shaping customer priorities, influencing solution strategy, and positioning Siemens as the preferred partner.
  • Lead complex pursuits from initial identification through qualification, solution development, executive alignment, commercial strategy, proposal, negotiation, and project award.
  • Develop executive relationships with university leaders across Facilities, Finance, Operations, Sustainability, Procurement, Research, and the C-suite.
  • Build compelling business cases that connect automation, digitalization, energy performance, resilience, deferred maintenance, and lifecycle outcomes to institutional priorities.
  • Orchestrate Siemens Area teams, operations leaders, technical specialists, Digital and Automation resources, partners, and executive sponsors around a clear win strategy.
  • Position Siemens building automation, Building X, digital services, energy optimization, infrastructure modernization, and related smart-campus capabilities as an integrated customer solution.
  • Own account and pursuit strategies while collaborating effectively within Siemens' matrixed sales model and respecting local customer relationships and execution responsibilities.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline, forecast, probability, next-step, and customer-engagement data in Siemens sales systems.
  • Use AI-enabled tools and data sources to accelerate account research, stakeholder mapping, outreach preparation, opportunity qualification, and pursuit planning.
  • Represent Siemens at targeted customer meetings, conferences, industry associations, and partner events.
  • Collaborate with delivery and operations teams to ensure commitments made during the sales process are executable, profitable, and aligned with customer expectations.

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of quota-carrying sales experience in building automation, controls, energy services, infrastructure modernization, performance contracting, digital buildings, or similarly complex technical solutions
  • Demonstrated success originating, developing, and closing large capital or enterprise opportunities valued at $3M+
  • Proven history of new-logo acquisition, proactive pipeline generation, and advancing opportunities without relying primarily on inbound demand or inherited accounts
  • Experience leading long-cycle, multi-stakeholder pursuits involving executive decision makers, engineering, operations, finance, procurement, and external partners
  • Ability to establish credibility with both technical and executive audiences and translate complex capabilities into measurable business outcomes
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including value-based selling, business-case development, forecasting, negotiation, and margin discipline
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional pursuit teams and influencing contributors without direct authority
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 50% based on customer, pursuit, conference, and team needs
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Current or prior Siemens sales experience, including working knowledge of Siemens Building Automation, Digital Buildings, Building X, energy, or related Smart Infrastructure offerings
  • Experience selling directly to colleges, universities, healthcare systems, government agencies, or similarly complex institutional customers
  • Experience with performance contracting, capital planning, deferred maintenance, central utility or energy infrastructure, modernization programs, or multi-building portfolios
  • Familiarity with consultant, architect, engineer, general contractor, mechanical contractor, electrical contractor, and partner-influence channels
  • Understanding of Higher Education capital approval, funding, procurement, governance, and consensus-driven decision making
  • Experience with Siemens sales and project governance processes, including SieSales and relevant milestones
  • Knowledge of digital building platforms, analytics, AI-enabled building services, energy optimization, and recurring digital-service models

Must be located within a commutable distance to a Siemens office location: Norcross, GA, Jacksonville, FL, Miramar, FL, Tampa, FL, Orlando, FL, Raleigh, NC, Charlotte, NC or Richmond, VA.

The Building Automation Systems Specialist handles the centralized control of a building's heating, ventilation, air conditioning, lighting, and other systems through a building management system or building automation system (BAS).The objectives of building automation are improved occupant comfort, efficient operation of building systems, reduction in energy consumption and operating costs, and improved life cycle of utilities.


As a Building Automation Systems Specialist, you will:

  • Assist with building automation system startup, ensuring that all systems and components are designed, installed, tested, operated, and maintained according to the operational requirements of the customer.
  • Work well with others, take ownership, be a team player, and act with integrity. This position reports to the local Supervisor and takes direction from a mentor and Lead Technician.
  • Assist with commissioning new Distributed Digital Control System on construction sites. Commissioning is ensuring all systems and components are functioning as required.
  • Document commissioning details; communicate deficiencies and progress.
  • Plan work with mentor, Lead Technician, and Team Leader.
  • Complete commissioning within planned timelines.
  • Submit accurate time-keeping daily and expenses weekly.
  • Work overtime when needed.
  • Able to accommodate in an out of state overnight travel of up to 85%

You will make in impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Electro-mechanical experience (wither from a previous role or through education) and user PC/software skills
  • 1+ year of experience with Building Automation systems or related job skill/industry experience
  • Must be able to demonstrate the ability to read and understand design and construction documents
  • Must be willing and able to work in a variety of circumstances, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high lift equipment, working in ducts, crawl spaces, roofs, basements, above ceilings, and in outside/inside/heat/cold/day/night conditions
  • Must be able to demonstrate the ability and willingness to differentiate types/colors of wire, use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet and the ability to carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Must be willing and able to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook)
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship
  • Must be willing to travel 85% of the time

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate degree in electronics or related field

We are looking for Machine Builder General, Business Developer Zone Americas. This position will be based in North America, preferred in USA at Alpharetta (greater Atlanta area).

You'll make an impact by:

  1. Market/customer engagement, opportunity mgmt. & deal support
    • Representing DI AUT to key regional market stakeholders in Zone Americas, e.g. at trade fairs, conferences and associations, in social media as Technology and Thought Leader AmbassadorsN
    • Actively driving new technologies and DI AUT offerings into Sales organizations e.g. to Sales Acceleration and/or OEM Sales channels
    • Supporting Zone Americas LCB Sales organization with W/WW OEM and Machine Builder industry expertise in the bid process for major new projects
    • Analyzing market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes to identify new business opportunities and areas for portfolio growth/ expansion and align closely with Account Manager and Technical Sales
    • Providing (top- and bottom-line) input for new feature business case and analyzing business performance and deriving impactful actions and segment-specific initiatives
    • Owning the business- & masterplan for dedicated industry assignment – focuson our W/WW OEM and machine builders' business out of discrete, process & infrastructure markets!
    • Providing customers with end-to-end solutions ranging from automation and drive technology to digitalization offerings, and actively drive the introduction of new DI AUT products & innovations
    • Contribution to the definition and implementation of a segment-specific marketing and use-case strategy
  1. Sales Enablement
    • Empowering sales teams by providing key tech. insights and sales narratives and having the domain technology expertise of the specific segment – focus on our W/WW OEM and Machine Builder market
    • Defining the business and sales strategy for the specific segment and passionately driving its execution in close collaboration with our LCB sales organizations
    • Supporting LCB sales representatives to optimally develop key customers within the industry segments esp. for our W/WWOEM and Machine Builder market
    • Orchestrating activities and strategies of international customers in close collaboration with the LCB Sales Acceleration & Channels
  1. Portfolio Expertise
    • Providing technical expertise on portfolio selection and fit, supporting both internal sales teams and external customers
    • Maintaining a strong overview of the international market and competitive landscape. Identifying and interpreting trends as well as market and business developments in the specific industry
  1. Post-Sales support & customer success
    • Ensuring a seamless handover to delivery teams, ensuring smooth service execution and solution delivery e.g., facilitate customer onboarding, adoption, and satisfaction to drive long-term customer retention and growth
  1. Customer & market feedback
    • Providing feedback to portfolio development teams based on market requirements and customer insights and translating those to global PLM- & application development teams
    • Advocating for technology and service adoption at executive levels, supporting long-term business transformation initiatives
    • Rolling-out focus initiatives

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline
  • 8+ years of related experience in sales management & Industry automation (Automation & Drive Systems)
  • Knowledge of SIEMENS DI AUT automation & drives products or competitors corresponding products for the discrete OEM industries
  • Solid technical background and hands-on engineering experience in DI AUT automation & drives portfolio
  • Strong customer relationship and business development capabilities.
  • Customer-focused mindset
  • Strategic business development capabilities
  • Ability to influence technical and commercial decision-makers
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3 years sales management experience, and at least 5 years working experience in Industry automation, especially in Automation & Drive Systems
  • Water/Wastewater background
  • Good communication skills internally and externally
  • Ability for structured & analytic approach to analyze status, propose measures, implement and follow-up.

Job.JobDescription:
Siemens Digital Industries Software

Strategic Student Program (SSP)

Discover your career with us at Siemens Digital Industries Software!

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

We're currently recruiting co-ops and interns for our Spring 2027 Strategic Student Program. Our opportunities will allow you to find a career path that most inspires you. Here, you will apply your education to solve real-world problems and turn theory into practice. At Siemens, our goal is to empower our students to become the next leaders of our company.

Baseline Program Requirements:

  • Currently enrolled as an undergraduate student at an accredited university
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship by the company
  • A minimum 3.0 GPA


Perks:

  • Employee discounts at our top customer sites
  • Networking with our global leaders
  • Mentorship from senior employees
  • Individual career development planning
  • Professional and technical workshops
  • Paid volunteer time off
  • Energetic student community
  • Leadership opportunities
  • Potential for full-time offers after university graduation and completion of the program


Position Overview:


Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a Digital Thread & Systems Engineering Intern to support the Capital PreSales organization. This role offers an opportunity to work on innovative digital engineering initiatives spanning aerospace, defense, automotive, and software-defined product development.

The intern will assist in the development of engineering datasets, digital thread demonstrations, and proof-of-concept solutions that connect systems engineering, software development, electrical design, and lifecycle management processes. Working alongside experienced mentors, the intern will contribute to customer-facing demonstrations and internal innovation projects focused on digital transformation and model-based engineering.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop aerospace and automotive engineering datasets used for demonstrations and technical enablement.
  • Support Digital Thread initiatives connecting requirements, systems, software, electrical, and lifecycle information.
  • Assist in building and validating proof-of-concept solutions using Siemens Capital and the Siemens Xcelerator portfolio.
  • Contribute to systems engineering and model-based systems engineering (MBSE) workflows.
  • Create technical documentation, presentations, and demonstration assets.
  • Participate in technical reviews, innovation projects, and customer-focused engineering initiatives.


Requirements:


  • Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Comfortable working in a fully remote environment within the United States of America.
  • Interest in digital engineering, systems thinking, and software-defined products.
  • Experience with Python, scripting, or data analysis is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

The SEWP VI Administrator will report directly to SGT Contracts leadership. This individual is responsible for the day to day administration, governance, and operational execution of Siemens Government Technologies' NASA SEWP VI contract.


The role manages SEWP workflows, maintains contract documentation, ensures compliance with NASA SEWP policies and Federal Acquisition Regulations, and serves as the primary operational interface with Siemens Industry, federal customers, and the NASA SEWP Program Office.


The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail oriented, self directed, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast paced federal contracting environment.


Responsibilities:

•Maintain SEWP VI contract files, catalogs, pricing tables, product lists, and required documentation.

•Perform SEWP contract administration, including review of incoming RFQs, timely submission of deliverables, and execution of task order workflows in accordance with corporate policies and SEWP requirements.

•Monitor SEWP portals for RFQs, catalog updates, vehicle modifications, and program office announcements.

•Serve as SGT's internal owner of SEWP VI operational activities.

•Coordinate quote development with Siemens Industry product owners, proposal teams, and distributors.

•Request and validate vendor/manufacturer special pricing as needed; maintain complete audit ready justification files.

•Verify product availability, lead times, configurations, CLIN/SKU accuracy, and compliance before submission.

•Review pricing and margins for compliance with SGT and Siemens governance requirements.

•Track, assemble, validate, and submit complete proposal packages within SEWP timelines.

•Stay current on SEWP policies, ordering procedures, rule interpretations, and vehicle changes.

•Support Federal Account Executives and Business Development teams by providing SEWP insights, identifying opportunities, and coordinating customer engagement activities.

About Siemens Digital Industries Software

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

Position Overview

As a Principal Infrastructure Architect, you'll play a pivotal role in translating business requirements into tailored infrastructure builds that leverage Siemens Digital Industries Software standard methodologies. You'll lead enterprise-scale solution deliveries, assess customer environments, and develop resilient, scalable infrastructures while ensuring compatibility with existing systems. You'll maintain critical customer relationships, establish architectural standards, conduct meticulous reviews, and uphold compliance and industry standards, driving continuous improvement and innovation that improve performance and scalability across our customer base.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture & Design Leadership

  • Own the design and delivery of enterprise-scale infrastructure architectures across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with long-term business objectives
  • Translate business, program, and technical requirements into end-to-end infrastructure architectures that follow industry guidelines, organizational standards, and customer IT strategies
  • Serve as the senior technical authority for infrastructure architecture, providing expert mentorship on system sizing, performance, availability, security, networking, operating systems, and database platforms
  • Ensure all solutions follow security, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements while upholding professional standards and organizational values

Multi-functional Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, Delivery, and Product teams to support pursuits, influence solution roadmaps, and guide customers through architectural options and trade-offs
  • Engage with customers to understand technical and business requirements, translating them into practical, value-driven infrastructure solutions
  • Maintain customer relationships and handle project documentation standards to ensure clarity and alignment across all project phases

Technical Leadership & Mentoring

  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and coaching to other infrastructure architects and consultants, elevating architectural maturity and guidelines across the organization
  • Conduct architectural reviews to ensure quality, compliance, and alignment to standards
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and innovative practices that improve organizational capabilities

Qualifications

Required

  • Extensive experience as an Infrastructure Architect or Consultant delivering enterprise-scale solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) and hybrid infrastructure designs
  • Deep knowledge and practical experience with performance tuning for enterprise infrastructure components, including compute, storage, networking, security, high availability, and disaster recovery
  • Proven experience with Windows and Linux operating systems and enterprise database platforms such as Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server
  • Proven customer-facing consulting skills, including partner engagement, expectation management, and technical communication with both technical and executive audiences
  • Experience with enterprise-grade software platforms in Product Lifecycle Management or Manufacturing Operations Management domains
  • Ability to work independently under self-management, providing leadership within project and program constraints

Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

Preferred

  • Demonstrated experience mentoring other architects or consultants and contributing to communities of practice or knowledge sharing initiatives
  • Experience with Siemens Digital Industries Software Teamcenter or Opcenter platforms
  • Familiarity with containerization and modern deployment approaches (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) in enterprise or cloud environments

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.


Position Overview:

Siemens DISW's Engineering Grid Computing Services team strategically supports over 3000 engineers located in R&D centers worldwide. The Engineering Grid Computing Service (EGCS) within GTI operates 18+ globally distributed high-performance computing grids across 7+ sites, currently provisioning 263,000+ CPU cores across four scheduler platforms (Altair Grid Engine, Altair Accelerator, IBM LSF, and SLURM). This infrastructure processes up to 12 million jobs per day at peak and serves approximately 3,000 engineers — it is the compute backbone that chip design, verification, and validation depend on. We are seeking a Grid Operations Architect to own the architectural vision and technical strategy for the next generation of this computing fabric. The immediate mandate: scale consolidated grid capacity from a quarter million cores to almost one million cores over the next five-six years while simultaneously transforming and modernizing the entire environment— the migration from Altair Grid Engine to Accelerator Plus, a hierarchical scheduler purpose-built for the throughput demands of EDA workloads This is a senior technical leadership role that bridges grid operations, infrastructure engineering, and strategic planning. Today, a lean team of 3 core grid administrators and 4 regional service delivery partners operate this global service — the Architect role is the structural investment that accelerates transformation and reduces key-person risk. You will define how Siemens DISW's compute infrastructure is designed, deployed, and operated on a world-class scale. The key purposes of this role are based on the following:

  • As EDA workloads grow and push the limits of what performance can be achieved with existing designs, a next generation architecture is the answer to meet the growing computing demands.
  • The Accelerator migration is the architectural response — and it needs a dedicated owner.
  • Key Technical/Strategic leadership need has been identified, providing depth and resilience to team
  • The path to 24x5 follow-the-sun coverage, >50% toil reduction through automation, and full-service excellence depends on an architectural foundation that today's operational team does not have the bandwidth to design.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the multiyear architectural roadmap for scaling grid compute capacity from 263K+ cores to 1M+ cores across 18+ globally distributed grids, consolidating across sites while maintaining availability and performance.
  • Design the phased migration plan from AGE to Accelerator's hierarchical scheduling platform
  • Design next generation grid topologies, scheduling frameworks, and resource management strategies that optimize utilization, throughput, and cost efficiency at a million core scale. One of the largest grids alone handles 60K+ cores and 2M+ jobs/dayarchitectures must perform at this density.
  • Develop consolidation strategies to reduce operational complexity rationalizing 4 scheduler platforms toward a unified Accelerator based model, standardizing tooling, and harmonizing operational policies across regions.
  • Lead capacity planning and forecasting models that project compute demand growth using linear, exponential, and flat percentage projections. Translate business requirements into infrastructure investment plans aligned with the 80% utilization ceiling and 72% procurement trigger governance model.
  • Architect hybrid and cloud burst strategies (e.g., NavOps ) to augment on premises capacity for peak demand and elastic workloads working with A&S and Networking teams while respecting the latency and data locality requirements of EDA workloads
  • Design fault - tolerant, self healing grid architectures that minimize downtime and reduce manual intervention critical for enabling 24x5 follow the sun coverage without proportional headcount growth.
  • Establish architectural standards, reference designs, and best practices for grid deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management across all 18+ grids and 9+ clusters.
  • Design and drive the evolution of the grid automation and tooling ecosystem — modernizing legacy Perl/Shell-based operational tools toward scalable, maintainable platforms (Python, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, GitLab CI/CD). Target: >50% reduction in manual operational toil across 8 identified operational areas.
  • Architect the observability and analytics stack (Elastic Stack with geo-redundant instances across Americas and Asia, Grafana, Power BI) to provide real-time visibility into grid performance, availability, utilization, and capacity across all grids.
  • Design AI-assisted alerting and auto-classification capabilities leveraging Elastic AI Agent and ServiceNow API integration to move from reactive monitoring to predictive operations.
  • Evolve SLA frameworks and operational KPIs from current state to improve reporting, performance: 99.97% availability per quarter, >97% SLO compliance, 30-minute MTTR, job wait time tracking at P50 and P95.
  • Lead proof-of-concept and pilot initiatives for emerging technologies (containerised workloads, GPU/accelerator scheduling, next-gen schedulers) and evaluate their applicability to Siemens EDA workloads.
  • Partner with engineering leadership, R&D teams, and business stakeholders to understand compute demand trends, workload characteristics, and evolving requirements.
  • Collaborate with A&S team, Infrastructure Technology Verticals — networking, storage, virtualization, and data center operations — to ensure end-to-end infrastructure coherence and performance.
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison with grid software vendors (Altair/Siemens, IBM, SchedMD) for roadmap alignment, escalation management, and strategic feature requests. Leverage Siemens' internal ownership of Altair for strategic advantage.
  • Present architectural proposals, trade-off analyses, and investment recommendations to senior IT leadership and executive stakeholders. Connect every infrastructure investment to a business outcome.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to grid administrators and operations engineers, elevating the team's architectural thinking and engineering practices. Drive cross-training from 2 to 3+ schedulers per person.
  • Establish and maintain grid operations governance — change management (moving toward Git-based infrastructure-as-code), configuration standards, security policies, and compliance frameworks for large-scale compute environments.
  • Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis of incidents, performance trends, and utilization patterns using Elastic dashboards and capacity modelling tools (Griddash).
  • Design self-service onboarding and provisioning workflows (ServiceNow catalogue items) to reduce manual provisioning overhead and improve time-to-compute for engineering teams.
  • Ensure software license compliance across all grid engines and associated tooling — particularly critical during the scheduler consolidation from 3 license agreements to 1.
  • Contribute to disaster recovery and business continuity planning for grid services.
  • Participate in daily operations standups, weekly staff meetings, and bi-weekly cadences with key customer teams. Provide architectural input on operational issues and escalations.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in systems engineering, infrastructure architecture, or HPC/grid computing environments, with at least 5 years in an architecture or technical leadership role.
  • Deep expertise with distributed computing platforms — hands-on experience architecting and operating at least two of: Altair Grid Engine, Altair Accelerator, IBM LSF, SLURM, or equivalent workload schedulers.
  • Demonstrated experience scaling compute infrastructure in large, multi-site, enterprise-wide environments (100K+ cores). Experience with scheduler migrations or platform consolidation at production scale.
  • Strong systems-level knowledge of Linux (RHEL/CentOS), including kernel tuning, performance optimization, and large-scale fleet management.
  • Proficiency in infrastructure automation and tooling — Python, Perl, Shell scripting — with experience in modern approaches (Ansible, Terraform, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Solid understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, NFS/GPFS, InfiniBand), storage architectures, and virtualisation as they relate to HPC and grid computing.
  • Experience in cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) and hybrid cloud/cloud-burst architectures for HPC workloads (e.g., NavOps, Cycle Cloud).
  • Proven ability to develop and communicate multi-year technical roadmaps and translate business requirements into architectural decisions with clear investment justification.
  • Strong project management, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills with experience presenting to senior leadership and executive audiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification in one or more of cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI)
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, Singularity) and their application in HPC environments.
  • Experience with observability and analytics platforms (Elastic Stack, Grafana, Prometheus,
  • Power BI) at scale — particularly geo-distributed deployments.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML operations and GPU/accelerator scheduling for heterogeneous computing architectures.
  • Experience with database systems (MySQL, MSSQL, PostgreSQL) for operational data management and reporting.
  • Understanding ITIL 4 processes — incident management, problem management, change control— in large-scale infrastructure operations.
  • Experience supporting EDA (Electronic Design Automation) workloads — simulation, regression,
  • DRC/LVS, benchmarking, and tape-out compute patterns.
  • Background in capacity planning, financial modelling for infrastructure investments, and TCO analysis.

This is not a traditional grid administration role. The Grid Operations Architect will shape the strategic direction of one of the largest compute fabrics in the industry — an infrastructure that processes up to 12 million jobs per day and directly enables the design and verification of next-generation

semiconductors. You will lead the most significant technology transformation in the service's history (the Accelerator migration), architect a 4x capacity scale-up across a globally distributed footprint and design the automation and observability foundations that make million-core operations sustainable.

If you thrive on solving complex scaling challenges, influencing technology strategy at the intersection of HPC and enterprise IT, and building infrastructure that operates at world-class scale — this role offers an exceptional opportunity to leave a lasting mark on Siemens' engineering capability.
