Job.JobTitle: Enterprise Software Sales Leader (Dept of Defense & DoW)
Job.JobDescription:
About Siemens Digital Industries Software

We are a leading global software company dedicated to computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company and the energy of a software start-up, we create a world-class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth.

Position Overview

Lead our Federal Aerospace & Defense sales team covering the U.S. Air Force, U.S. Army, and Department of Energy. You'll nurture executive customer relationships and develop multi-year sales strategies to drive adoption of our Xcelerator portfolio and core products—Teamcenter, NX, and related solutions. Managing five Client Sales Executives, you'll build a high-performing team focused on delivering innovative PLM solutions to federal customers and supporting the war-fighter mission. The Federal group generates significant revenue, and you'll play a critical role in expanding this presence across the Department of War and its supply base. You'll work collaboratively with Sales Managers covering Aerospace & Defense original equipment manufacturers to ensure coordinated strategy and seamless customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Relationship & Strategic Leadership

  • Build and maintain high-quality relationships with senior and executive leadership across federal agencies, including U.S. Air Force, U.S. Army, and Department of Energy
  • Lead the development and execution of long-term comprehensive strategies for customer retention and growth, ensuring continuous focus across cross-functional sales teams on identifying and executing new business opportunities
  • Nurture executive customer relationships and collaborate with sales and technical leadership to develop and implement high-impact multi-year sales strategies
  • Lead quarterly business reviews and strategic account planning with key federal customers
  • Navigate complex, sophisticated federal sales cycles and coordinate across federal contracting vehicles and procurement processes
  • Understand customer strategy, PLM solution strategy, and their alignment to drive value-based selling

Team Development & Sales Execution

  • Develop, motivate, and coach a high-performing team of five Client Sales Executives to progress and close business using standard sales methodologies
  • Supervise the development and implementation of in-depth account strategy plans aligned with federal customer requirements and strategic objectives
  • Provide mentorship and coaching to team members on complex deal negotiations and customer relationship management
  • Drive identification and execution of new business opportunities within the federal sector, ensuring quota achievement across the team
  • Foster a team culture that emphasizes high ownership, customer-first focus, fast-paced execution, high integrity, and an optimistic environment

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Growth

  • Work effectively in a matrixed environment with internal teams and external partners across the Aerospace & Defense organization
  • Collaborate with sales managers covering Aerospace & Defense original equipment manufacturers to ensure coordinated strategy and avoid conflicts
  • Build strong relationships and partnerships both internally and externally; quickly establish trust with senior leaders and empower cross-functional teams to develop solutions
  • Ensure alignment between company objectives and customer needs, balancing growth with customer success and optimizing results at the company level
  • Address competing priorities and solve complex problems in a timely manner
  • Support partner sales representatives in understanding federal customer needs and provide training on new initiatives, including perpetual-to-SaaS migration transactions

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 10 years' experience selling large strategic enterprise software solutions to the Department of War, with ability to navigate complex federal sales cycles. This software sales experience is a non-negotiable.
  • At least 2+ years of managing a sales team, directly or indirectly
  • At least 3-5+ years experience selling into the US Military sector.
  • Consistent track record of planning, negotiating, and closing deals with highly complex accounts
  • Proven quota achievement throughout career with demonstrated success delivering results
  • At least 3+ years' experience in large enterprise software, selling at the C-suite (CXO) level
  • Success leading a matrixed environment and building relationships and partnerships both internally and externally
  • Outstanding interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills with ability to engage customers at all levels, including executive and C-level leadership
  • Excellent business judgment and demonstrated success delivering results optimized at the company level (balanced between company and customer needs)
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Project), Salesforce.com, SAP, and other job-related software
  • Ability to understand federal customer strategy, PLM solution strategy, and their alignment
  • Ability to understand sophisticated and typically long sales cycles at the strategic level
  • Must currently reside in the continental USA (firm requirement)
  • 4-year college degree required

Job.JobTitle: Technical Marketing Engineer Advanced IC Packaging
Job.JobDescription:
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

Position Summary

The Technical Marketing Engineer is responsible for driving technical marketing and solution development for EBS-centered offerings in the area of Advanced IC Packaging, with particular focus on 2.5D and 3DIC design flows.

This role requires the ability to understand customer challenges and use cases, and to translate them into solution-oriented workflows by connecting planning, layout, and verification tools using scripting technologies such as Tcl and Python. The ideal candidate will be able to engage customers in technical discussions, articulate solution value, and help shape future workflow directions, including emerging approaches that may involve agent-based technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and deliver technical marketing materials such as videos, presentations, and lab/demo content for Advanced IC Packaging solutions.
  • Build and demonstrate solution workflows for 2.5D and 3DIC design by connecting multiple tools, including planning, layout, and verification tools, using Tcl and Python.
  • Engage customers in technical discussions to understand design challenges, workflow gaps, and use-case requirements.
  • Translate customer technical requirements and related business needs into actionable input for development teams.
  • Understand newly developed products and enhancement features, and communicate their technical value and applicability to customers.
  • Support the definition and evolution of solution concepts that address current and future customer workflows.
  • Collaborate with internal teams across product, development, and field organizations to align solutions with market needs.

Accountability / Expected Contributions

  • Understand the goals of each assigned project and the role expected within that project.
  • Proactively drive assigned responsibilities to support successful project execution and achievement of business objectives.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and contribute effectively in project-based activities.
  • Help identify and shape future solution opportunities based on customer engagement and market direction.

Required Qualifications

  • Native or near-native proficiency in English.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in 2.5D / 3DIC design, Advanced IC Packaging, or technically supporting such flows from an EDA perspective.
  • Strong understanding of design workflows spanning planning, layout, and verification.
  • Practical scripting experience using Tcl and Python to automate or integrate workflows across multiple tools.
  • Ability to engage directly with customers in technical discussions and help define solution use cases.
  • Ability to use Linux as an end user in a business or technical environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products for business use.
  • Formal academic background in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in technical marketing, application engineering, solution engineering, or other customer-facing technical roles.
  • Experience creating technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept workflows, or presentation materials.
  • Familiarity with EDA solution positioning for semiconductor or packaging design customers.
  • Interest in emerging workflow technologies, including AI- or agent-assisted solution approaches.

Travel Requirements

  • Customer visits are required.
  • Domestic travel will be the primary travel requirement.
  • International travel may also be required occasionally.

Work Environment / Additional Considerations

  • This role requires collaboration with teams in Asia and Europe.
  • As a result, work may occasionally take place during early morning or evening hours to accommodate global collaboration.

This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license.

Our comprehensive portfolio meets the growing technical requirements of today's and tomorrow's power grid!

The EA Business Unit in Wendell, North Carolina, which is its U.S. headquarters, focuses on photovoltaic inverters, medium-voltage power distribution equipment including packaging and services, and solutions, including automation.

We are looking for a Sr Applications Engineer. This Hybrid position (2-3 days in office / 2-3 days remote) will be based in Wendell, NC. Relocation assistance is available. This position could be fully remote for an experienced MV Switchgear Engineer.

We are seeking a Sr. Applications Engineer to support business growth within the EA Business Unit by delivering competitive, customer‑focused technical and commercial solutions.   • Technical experience with medium‑voltage power distribution, including switchgear and / or transformer applications

  • Technical Proposal experience
  • Ability to analyze customer's technical specifications & single line diagrams, apply appropriate product offerings to meet the customers' expectations in cost-effective and timely manner, offer alternative solutions to optimize profitability while meeting customer needs.

  • Proficiency with AutoCAD, Visio, or similar 2D layout tools

Job.JobTitle: Senior Energy Consultant - Power Market Modeling
Job.JobDescription:
Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Grid Software's Power Technologies International (PTI) Energy Business Advisory team is helping businesses navigate complexity, drive growth, and steer strategic direction in an evolving landscape. Our wide range of services offer solutions in planning, managing risk, improving operations, conducting custom market studies, supporting M&A activities, and developing infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Energy Consultant to deliver valuable solutions to utilities, investors, and project developers. We seek someone with deep expertise in power market modeling to support asset valuation, curtailment and congestion analysis, strategic market outlooks, and project siting decisions. Transform the everyday with us!

This is a remote position based in the Contiguous U.S.

You'll make an impact as you:

  • Develop and run production cost and market models to support Integrated Resource Planning (IRP) and broader integrated system planning studies.
  • Build power price forecasts and long-term market outlooks to inform utility, developer, and investor decisions.
  • Analyze system operations, resource adequacy, and portfolio performance under different planning scenarios and policy pathways.
  • Support clients in evaluating generation, storage, and transmission investments within integrated planning frameworks.
  • Deliver insights that help clients optimize portfolios, manage risks, and align with evolving market and regulatory conditions.
  • Prepare clear, data-driven reports and presentations that communicate technical results and strategic implications.
  • Mentor junior consultants in modeling, analytics, and interpretation of results.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in engineering, economics, operations research, finance, statistics, physics, or mathematics.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in production cost modeling and power market analytics (using Aurora, PLEXOS, PROMOD, or other production cost modeling tools).
  • Strong understanding of U.S. power markets, renewable integration, and transmission constraints.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% of the time, primarily within the U.S.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior consulting experience with utilities, developers, or investors.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical analyses in clear, client-ready deliverables.
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks, interconnection processes, and decarbonization policies.

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.


Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a Server Architect to join the Technology & Innovation (T&I) organization as part of the Architecture & Standards team. This role will work closely with, and under the direction of, the Senior Server Architect to define server standards and recommend compute technologies that best enable DI SW's global software development organizations.


The Server Architect will bring deep expertise in compute platforms and server hardware, with a strong focus on supporting scientific and engineering software development workloads. The role partners closely with software engineering organizations, service delivery teams, data center operations, facilities, and procurement to ensure scalable, efficient, and future-ready compute solutions.


Success in this role is measured by technical impact, operational efficiency, and the ability to become a trusted partner to engineering teams and infrastructure peers.


Key Responsibilities:

Architecture & Strategy

  • Partner with the Senior Server Architect to define and maintain enterprise server architecture standards, reference designs, and best practices for DI SW development environments
  • Evaluate and recommend compute technologies optimized for engineering, simulation, build, CI/CD, and high-performance development workloads
  • Align server architecture decisions with broader T&I infrastructure and services strategies

Engineering & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with software development organizations to understand strategic initiatives, performance requirements, and future compute needs
  • Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to engineering teams, translating workload requirements into scalable server architectures
  • Collaborate with service delivery teams to align architecture with operational realities and consumption models

Data Center, Power & Efficiency

  • Partner with data center operations and facilities teams to maximize efficiency across power, cooling, and rack density
  • Influence server platform choices and configurations to support sustainability, energy efficiency, and long-term capacity planning

Technology Evaluation & Vendor Management

  • Maintain deep awareness of server market trends, CPU/GPU roadmaps, accelerator technologies, memory, interconnects, and platform innovations
  • Manage relationships with server and component vendors, influencing roadmaps where possible to align with DI SW requirements
  • Lead or support proofs of concept (POCs), technology evaluations, and platform validations

Lab, Logistics & Procurement Support

  • Manage logistics for loaner systems, seed units, and evaluation hardware, including lab reservations, tracking, and lifecycle coordination
  • Partner with Procurement to support deep-dive quote requests, technical comparisons, and vendor evaluations
  • Provide architectural input to sourcing decisions and long-term supplier strategies

Capacity & Utilization Insight

  • Support capacity planning efforts by contributing to compute capacity and utilization reporting
  • Consult with service delivery teams on reporting requirements, trends, and opportunities for optimization

Required Qualifications:

  • Deep hands-on expertise in server and compute hardware architectures (CPU, memory, storage, accelerators, interconnects)
  • Strong understanding of compute platforms supporting scientific, engineering, and software development workloads
  • Experience working with enterprise data center environments, including power and cooling considerations
  • Proven ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into practical architectural recommendations
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage engineering teams, operations, and vendors


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting large-scale software development or HPC-adjacent environments
  • Familiarity with virtualization, containerized workloads, and hybrid deployment models
  • Experience leading or coordinating hardware POCs and technology evaluations
  • Prior involvement in vendor roadmap discussions or strategic sourcing initiatives

What Success Looks Like:

  • Well-adopted, forward-looking server standards that meet current and future engineering needs
  • Strong partnerships with software development organizations built on trust and technical credibility
  • Efficient, scalable compute platforms that optimize cost, power, and performance
  • Clear influence on vendor technology direction and internal infrastructure strategy

Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for a Lead Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software's Power Technologies International (PTI) team. PTI is our trusted advisor that takes a holistic approach, providing business advisory, technical consulting, and simulation software solutions. This role is critical to the planning and integration of renewables, storage, and FACTS to the electrical grid. The Senior Power Systems Lead will perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations, while mentoring others on the team.

This is a remote position based in the contiguous U.S.

What you will be working on:

  • Performing/leading consulting engagements related to power grid analysis and design, system dynamics and transients, system interconnection, and grid code compliance.
  • Managing/supporting project execution, tracking project progress, and making necessary adjustments to maintain scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
  • Producing reports and presentations with study results in collaboration with team members.
  • Maintaining relationships with clients to ensure satisfaction, analyzing clients' business requirements and identifying opportunities for further business.
  • Supporting proposal preparation by developing project plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Providing mentoring and technical development to junior consultants.
  • Developing automation scripts to streamline repetitive tasks, reduce errors, and boost overall efficiency.
  • Delivering on-site consulting and training services.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor's or postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience performing power systems analysis for electric utilities, ISOs, RTOs, developers, or national labs; 5+ years preferred.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing others professionally.
  • Experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E required; additional experience with TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, or PowerWorld. preferred.
  • Good knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards with understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and listening skills with demonstrated ability to write effective technical reports.
  • Ability to travel 10% domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior relevant consulting experience.
  • Experience working in the ISO-NE, PJM, and/or SPP regions
  • Experience in distribution planning.
  • Industry experience performing power system transient analysis using PSCAD™ or EMTP-RV

About the IRA Coordinator Role

The IRA Coordinator assists in overseeing the operations and transactions involving IRAs and HSAs. Monitors opening and closing of accounts, account distributions, rollovers, and customer inquiries. Ensures compliance with governmental regulations regarding IRAs and HSAs.


Assisting with the administration of the Financial Services Department through the handling and oversight of daily and monthly reports, the processing of new and closed accounts, working with account administrators and investment advisors on daily tasks associated with estates, trusts and investment accounts, working with staff members on the factoring of mutual fund postings, working with trust administrators in the processing and filing of annual tax returns and various tax forms, assisting with IRA and employee benefit accounts and working with internal and compliance departments on various request and matters presented to the department.


Key Responsibilities

  • Reviews forms from branches and operations to ensure accuracy.
  • Ensures compliance with government regulations, including account over-contributions, early distributions and required minimum distributions.
  • Maintains records and is responsible for timely reporting.
  • Process data into the Bank's system as needed.
  • Schedules and organizes activities such as meetings, conferences and department activities for all members of the department.
  • Performs desktop publishing.
  • Establishes, develops, maintains and updates filing system. Retrieves information from files when needed.

About the Branch Manager Role

Reports to: Branch Manager

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. Our part-time Tellers are key ambassadors of our brand, providing friendly, efficient service that makes banking easy and enjoyable for our customers.

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. About the Part- Time Teller Role

Join our dynamic team as a Part-Time Teller, where exceptional customer service and operational excellence meet. Reporting directly to the Branch Manager, you'll play a vital role in delivering personalized banking experiences while ensuring the highest standards of security and compliance. If you're passionate about banking, detail-oriented, and eager to grow your career, we want to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Transactions: Accurately and efficiently process deposits, check cashing, and withdrawals, verifying cash and endorsements, and issuing receipts with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Product & Service Promotion: Cross-sell and educate clients on the Bank's diverse financial products and services, enhancing client relationships and fostering financial wellness.
  • Payment Processing: Handle credit card payments, issue money orders, bank checks, and accept loan payments, ensuring accuracy and security.
  • Secure Handling of Assets: Manage night deposit bags, admit clients to safe deposit boxes, and maintain confidentiality and security at all times.
  • Client Support & Inquiries: Respond promptly to customer questions, provide account balances, and assist with general banking needs, cultivating a welcoming environment.
  • Reconciliation & Record Keeping: Perform end-of-day balancing of transactions, verify cash totals, and reconcile Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Maintain detailed reports and logs to ensure compliance and accurate record retention.

  • Ability to lift 10–20 lbs., stand for extended periods.

About the Assistant Branch Manager Role

Join Our Dynamic Banking Team and Lead with Excellence!

Are you a motivated leader with a passion for delivering exceptional customer service and driving branch success? We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Assistant Branch Manager to support our Branch Manager in orchestrating the seamless operation of our branch, fostering a trusted environment, and elevating the customer experience. This pivotal role offers the chance to influence our community's financial well-being and grow professionally within a reputable institution.

As the Assistant Branch Manager, you will be the vital right hand to our Branch Manager, overseeing daily operations, supervising staff, and ensuring our branch functions with efficiency, security, and warmth. Your expertise in residential mortgages, IRA services, and personal banking products will empower you to deliver tailored solutions that meet our clients' needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operational Leadership: Stepping into the Branch Manager's shoes during their absence, managing staff, and maintaining smooth day-to-day operations.
  • Team Supervision: Overseeing Head Teller and Teller teams, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.
  • Branch Branding & Growth: Building a strong branch identity, promoting sales initiatives, and championing exceptional customer service.
  • Customer Engagement: Personally, connecting with clients and prospects, resolving issues efficiently, and ensuring satisfaction aligns with our high standards.
  • Compliance & Accuracy: Reviewing and approving transactions such as large check cashing, bank checks, and ledger entries, while maintaining strict adherence to policies.
  • Performance & Standards: Striving to meet and exceed branch performance metrics, focusing on operational controls, security, and regulatory compliance.
  • Professional Development: Continually enhancing your banking acumen and sales techniques through training, workshops, and ongoing education.

About the Head Teller Role

The Head Teller provides exceptional customer service while accurately and efficiently completing customer transactions. This role ensures adherence to all bank operational, security, compliance, and privacy policies, maintaining the highest standards of confidentiality. The Head Teller oversees daily teller operations, supervises teller staff, and ensures that branch cash handling procedures are followed.


Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver Outstanding Customer Service: Create a warm, professional, and efficient environment where every customer feels valued. Proactively understand their needs and confidently recommend Trustco Bank products that support their goals.
  • Leadership & Team Growth: Supervise, mentor, and coach tellers to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and exceptional service. Uphold strict compliance with all policies, acting as a role model. Oversee daily cash balancing and maintain detailed audit logs for accuracy. Manage cash shipments, including ordering, verifying, and distributing funds as needed.
  • Transaction Handling: Process a variety of customer transactions—deposits, withdrawals, loan payments, check cashing—with precision. Handle verification, money orders, bank checks, and receipts efficiently. Manage credit card payments, safe deposit access, ATM maintenance, and night deposits smoothly.
  • Reporting & Compliance: Prepare and submit detailed reports accurately and on time. Keep thorough transaction records in line with audit standards and regulations.

About the Branch Performance Manager Role

The Branch Performance Manager is a dynamic, field-based leadership role responsible for supporting and strengthening performance across multiple branch locations. This position partners closely with branch leadership to reinforce sales expectations, professional standards, and operational consistency while driving deposit growth, loan production, and customer experience excellence.

About the Mortgage Originator Role

Unlock Your Earning Potential with the Area's Lowest Mortgage Rates


As a Mortgage Originator with Trustco Bank, you become the face of one of the region's strongest and most respected portfolio lenders. With consistently some of the lowest mortgage rates in the area and a long history of exceptional service, Trustco gives you a unique competitive edge to grow your business, expand your network, and build lifelong client relationships.


Highlights

• Portfolio lender advantages: Faster decisions + greater flexibility

• Some of the lowest mortgage rates in the area — a major selling point

• Strong brand reputation with decades of stability and trust

• Supportive internal mortgage team for seamless processing

• Relationship-driven culture where your growth is a priority

Key Responsibilities

• Business Development & Networking

Build a powerful referral network through targeted marketing, prospecting, and consistent community presence. Develop strong partnerships with real estate agents, builders, and local professionals to generate high-quality mortgage leads and elevate Trustco's presence as the go-to lender.

• Community Engagement

Act as a brand ambassador at community events promoting homeownership and financial literacy. Your involvement strengthens Trustco's legacy as a community-focused lender committed to helping families achieve their financial goals.

• Client Consultation & Loan Analysis

Meet and engage borrowers, assess financial and credit profiles, and understand their homeownership goals. As a portfolio lender, Trustco gives you flexibility, faster decisions, and the ability to offer clients tailored mortgage solutions that set you apart from competitors.

• Product Promotion & Client Education

Highlight Trustco's full suite of mortgage programs, emphasizing our low interest rates, transparent terms, and unmatched client support. Provide easy-to-understand guidance so clients feel confident and informed at every step.

• Loan Processing & Documentation

Gather and organize all required documentation with accuracy and attention to detail. Collaborate with our in-house Mortgage Department to ensure fast, smooth processing and an exceptional client experience from application to closing.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and Word.
  • Must be eligible and registered in the Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System & Registry (NMLS) in compliance with the SAFE Act.

Overview of Position


Reporting to the AVP, Connected Living Compliance, this position is responsible for leading Assurant's global trade compliance program and ensuring compliance with all applicable import, export, sanctions, and customs regulations. In addition to enterprise related trade activities, this role actively supports the movement of mobile devices, device components, service parts, accessories, and related technologies across global markets while enabling efficient customer, carrier, OEM, repair, refurbishment, and logistics operations.


The Director serves as a strategic advisor to Connected Living leadership and business stakeholders, balancing compliance obligations with customer commitments, operational efficiency, and commercial objectives.


This role will also partner, coordinate, and align global trade compliance activities and strategies with the Director, Global Supply Chain Compliance.


What will my duties and responsibilities be in this job?


Global Trade Compliance Leadership (45%)


  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve Assurant's global trade compliance program.
  • Establish governance, policies, procedures, and internal controls covering import, export, sanctions, and customs compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with:
    • U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR)
    • OFAC sanctions requirements
    • U.S. Customs regulations
    • International customs laws and regulations
    • Foreign trade regulations in countries where Assurant operates
  • Provide strategic guidance to executive leadership on global trade risks and opportunities.
  • Identify and implement value-creation opportunities, including duty drawback, free trade agreements, foreign trade zones, tariff engineering, and other lawful duty mitigation strategies.

Import Compliance and Customs Management (20%)


  • Oversee global customs compliance for mobile devices, service parts, accessories, and technology.
  • Ensure accurate:
    • HTS classifications
    • Country-of-origin determinations
    • Customs valuation
    • Duty assessment
  • Manage customs brokers and trade service providers.
    • Identify and implement duty savings strategies and opportunities.
  • Support optimization of global supply chain costs and customs efficiency.

Export Controls and Sanctions Compliance (20%)


  • Oversee export classification activities for devices, components, software, and technology.
  • Ensure compliance with export controls.
  • Lead restricted-party screening and sanctions compliance programs.
  • Provide guidance regarding cross-border shipments, technology transfers, and international business transactions.
  • Manage export licensing requirements and government authorizations when required.
  • Drive global alignment for HTS classification, country of origin, customs valuation, and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) determinations.
  • Maintain awareness of export-controlled technology, software, encryption, and restricted-access information requirements applicable to Assurant operations.
  • Assess and manage export control risks involving restricted destinations, restricted parties, military end users, military end uses, and controlled technologies, software, or technical data; develop procedures for end-use/end-user due diligence, escalation, licensing analysis, and transaction holds where required.

Risk Management and Compliance Governance (10%)


  • Conduct enterprise-wide trade compliance risk assessments.
  • Develop and maintain trade compliance controls and monitoring programs.
  • Lead internal audits and compliance reviews.
  • Establish compliance metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  • Investigate compliance incidents and manage corrective actions.
  • Lead government audits, inquiries, disclosures, and remediation activities.
  • Assists in remediating trade compliance issues as necessary, including but not limited to putting together project plans, connecting resources to find solutions, documenting resolutions, and documenting remediation plans.
  • Supports internal compliance audits and assists with managing external audits or inquiries from government agencies Maintains accurate data and recordkeeping to include collecting and retaining records in response to third-party inquiries relating to Assurant compliance practices and business activities.

Training and Culture (5%)


  • Develop and deliver trade compliance training and awareness programs.
  • Ensure employees understand their responsibilities related to international trade activities.
  • Maintain training records and support audit readiness.

Number of Direct Reports


  • 1-2 including a Compliance Analyst

Financial Responsibility


  • Signoff on responsible expenses, input on annual budget.

What are the requirements needed for this position?


Experience


  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in global trade compliance.
  • At least 5 years of leadership experience.
  • Experience supporting multinational import/export operations.
  • Experience managing customs and export compliance programs.
  • Experience supporting technology, telecommunications, consumer electronics, mobile device, repair/refurbishment, or logistics industries preferred.

Education & Certifications


  • Bachelors' degree required, Master's or JD preferred

Preferred Certifications


  • Licensed Customs Broker (LCB)
  • Certified Export Specialist (CES)
  • Certified Customs Specialist (CCS)
  • Certified U.S. Export Compliance Officer (CUSECO)

Preferred Technical Expertise


  • EAR
  • OFAC sanctions compliance
  • Customs valuation
  • HTS classification
  • Country-of-origin analysis
  • Free Trade Agreements
  • Duty drawback
  • Foreign Trade Zones (FTZ)
  • Reverse logistics operations
  • Mobile device repair and refurbishment supply chains

Leadership Competencies

The candidate will be able to provide examples of successfully demonstrating the following leadership competencies:


  • Internal client-orientation with a constructive approach to resolution of issues. A style which builds alliances within the organization.
  • Ability to establish credibility with business owners, including senior and executive leadership, and influence through professional communication, work product, etc.
  • Solutions-oriented, demonstrated growth mindset.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain effective cross-functional relationships with clients, colleagues and stakeholders of various levels and areas throughout the organization.
  • Ability to lead change efforts through effective communication and persuasion.
  • Creative, resilient, and flexible style and approach to handling complex issues with high tolerance for ambiguity
  • Demonstrated leadership experience on leveraging data to drive actionable insights for risk or compliance programs
  • Clear written, visual and verbal communication skills, including ability to adjust messages dependent on audiences ranging from front-line employees to executive
  • Cultural competency and executive-level presence to work with the business and regional leadership teams around the world
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and follow-up skills. Ability to interpret rules and guidelines, and then conceptualize and implement into policies, procedures, and controls.
  • Excellent and demonstrated project management skills, and attention to detail in leading projects and activities in a global organization. Ability to prioritize and simultaneously execute on multiple projects and ability to organize and analyze complex information and data
  • Sound and independent judgment, and demonstrated prudence and maturity
  • Commitment to driving a culture of ethics and integrity
  • Cultivate a high-performing trade compliance team through coaching, mentoring, accountability, and development of trade compliance professionals.

Skills


The candidate will be able to demonstrate proficiency in the following skills:


  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite with specific emphasis in Word, Excel, PowerPoint
  • The ability to work in a fast-paced environment with several simultaneous deliverables
  • Program of project management skills

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?


  • Experience in mobile or technology industries
  • Ability to use AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, etc
  • Supply chain and vendor risk management experience

At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. Learn more about why you want to be here!



​ Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of the Actuarial Specialist is to produce complex analyses, manage projects, and oversee team workload to meet high levels of service within the Actuarial department. This position exists to support and execute Company strategy as directed by the Chief Actuary, while acting as a team leader and as a trusted advisor to other business leaders.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Provides technical analyses and participates in process development.

  • Provides technical actuarial analyses in the areas of ratemaking, reserving, analytics, and systems integration.
  • Participates in the development and documentation of actuarial department processes.
  • Takes responsibility to modify processes in order to improve accuracy and efficiency.
  • Develops new business processes or comprehensive analytic efforts.
  • Initiates project design within system constraints and demonstrates an understanding of dependencies.

Works with business leaders to develop and implement new products and expand into new markets.

  • Acts in the capacity of a trusted advisor to other business leaders.
  • Ensures that the work product supports business growth and profitability.
  • Takes a prominent role in communicating and explaining actuarial findings to business leaders.
  • Fosters positive, collaborative working relationships with higher level experts across the organization.
  • Works with individuals in other departments in fulfilling the actuarial role within larger projects.

Assists in developing the actuarial team and oversees subordinates' work.

  • Maintains a positive work climate and fosters motivation and engagement.
  • Performs at the level of a subject matter expert and a team lead for a functional area (e.g. regulatory/filings, corporate including reserving, systems administrator, pricing, ratemaking).
  • Ensures soundness and integrity of actuarial analyses.
  • Reviews subordinate's work to uphold consistency with Standards of Practice and provides valuable feedback.

Excess & Surplus Specific:

  • Supports development and enhancement of pricing tools for E&S product lines.
  • Performs individual large complex accounts pricing review and works closely with E&S underwriters.
  • Provides business requirements for system integration and set up data export functions for data reporting.
  • Builds business reports to monitor rate change and profitability of the portfolio.
  • Evaluates and refines pricing assumptions based on industry benchmark data and competitive analysis.
  • Demonstrated success in Commercial Lines (GL, Commercial Auto, and etc.) and/or E&S market environments.
  • Proficient in Excel, Python and SQL; expert in actuarial and statistical modeling techniques. Experienced with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
  • Strong technical pricing skills with knowledge of exposure-based pricing, experience modelling, catastrophe modelling and stochastic simulation techniques.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities but may act as a team lead and mentor actuarial analysts.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university required in Applied Mathematics, Computer Science or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of related experience in actuarial roles required.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

ACAS designation highly desired but relevant work experience may be considered.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills and proven project leadership abilities.
  • Thorough knowledge of actuarial models and ability to assess results.
  • Thorough knowledge of broad segments of ICW systems and related business areas.
  • Experience managing multiple projects and resources.
  • Dedication to building a working knowledge of emerging analytic techniques.
  • Ability to work independently in deriving solutions to new business problems.
  • Comfortable and competent in client interaction settings.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment.

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are:

Diversified Brokerage Services (part of NFP, an Aon company) is one of the largest brokerage general agencies in the United States specializing in life insurance, and we're proud of our roots, starting as a family run business in 1968 and growing to where we are today. With over 50 years in the insurance industry, we've honed in on our strengths and perfected our processes, resulting in the best possible experience for the advisors we serve. We invite you to learn more about us and discover the “DBS Difference” for yourself! We're part of NFP, a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. NFP is an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers who help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach.

This position exists to provide DBS with a dedicated resource focused on acquiring and growing relationships with new individual brokers, producer groups and national accounts as well as growing relationships with existing brokers, producer groups and national accounts. This is an independent contributor role with no direct reports. The focus is on providing direction on production goals, account status, trends, and marketing initiatives. This will be accomplished by gaining and maintaining a deep understanding of the client organization's wants, needs, and processes. We work with insurance agents, brokers, and financial advisors across the country to help them secure life insurance products for their clients who want to protect their families or their businesses. We take pride in the fact that we are directly responsible for insuring thousands of people nationwide as one of the leading distributors of life insurance in the nation.

The Regional Sales Director will drive growth in an established, high-performing territory covering California (Orange County & Los Angeles) and Hawaii. The ideal candidate will have a strong life insurance background and experience in wholesale and point-of-sale strategies. They will be supported by an experienced internal team and have the opportunity to contribute to one of the nation's most established and successful brokerage agencies.

This is a fully remote with travel opportunity that offers a competitive base salary of $75,000 + overrides, with top performers capable of earning $250,000+ annually. Travel within the assigned region is required approximately 40% of the time to engage with clients, attend industry events, and actively drive business expansion.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

This job description is not intended to be a complete and exhaustive statement of the requirements of the job. It is more representative of what is typical of this job.

  • Implement key account strategies and processes with all accounts. Gold sheet, action plan, and strategic marketing plan
  • Develop existing broker/account relationships and manage recruiting for new broker/accounts
  • Regularly communicate the status of your accounts to the DBS team; keeping them informed of pertinent issues, especially during the onboarding process
  • Continued development of industry, concept, carrier, and product knowledge
  • Contribute to the overall success and profitability of the agency
  • Meet or exceed acquired and assigned account production goals
  • Implement key account strategies and processes with all accounts including Gold Sheet, action plan, and strategic marketing plan
  • Regularly communicate the status of your accounts to the DBS team, keeping them informed of pertinent issues, especially during the onboarding process
  • Continued development of industry, concept, carrier, and product knowledge

Education and/or Experience:

  • Past sales and relationship management experience in the life insurance industry required
  • FINRA: Series 6 or 7, or 63 is required
  • College degree or other higher education preferred
  • Life and Health License

Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities:

  • Leadership, organizational skills, people skills, flexibility, team orientation, ability to travel, ability to manage a budget, good written and oral communication, ability to plan and prioritize
  • Team Participation: Must work effectively in a diverse group of people as a team member
  • Must have the ability to travel within assigned region approximately 40-50% (typically, same-day or short overnight trips and others as required)
  • MS Office Suite and Salesforce (or similar CRM), Concur (or related expense management) required
  • Able to quickly learn new business/communications systems and technologies
  • Ability to communicate in a professional manner
  • High focus on quality and customer satisfaction
  • Flexible and able to react to change in a productive and positive manner
  • Strong work ethic and ability to work with a sense of urgency
  • Ensures that all DBS customers are provided service that is complete, accurate, prompt, confidential, and courteous

What We Offer:

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $64,000 to $75,000 plus overrides, with top performers capable of earning $250,000+ annually. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

Job Description

Positioned uniquely between strategic advisory and brokerage functions, this role is part of Aon's well-known construction and infrastructure platform. As a Senior Account Executive, C&I - South Region, you will employ Aon's rich data, analytics, and market connections to develop and execute integrated, multi-line insurance solutions for complex projects. You will lead specialist teams in different regions, influence risk management from project launch through completion, and provide outstanding solutions that surpass standard placements.

This position is hybrid, offering the option to work from Atlanta, GA, Houston, TX or one of our Florida offices in Tampa, Jacksonville, or Miami.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

As a Senior Account Executive, you will advise clients on effective risk transfer, insurance design, and contract risk oversight to deliver outstanding results. The position also acts as a client representative with contracting and financing partners and leads collaborative brokerage teams across various insurance lines, including Workers' Compensation or equivalent experience, General Liability, Professional Liability, Environmental Liability, and Builders Risk.

Strategic Advisory & Risk Management

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on construction-phase risk transfer, risk financing, and risk control strategies
  • Evaluate project-specific risks and provide assessments of risk allocation, insurability, and market appetite
  • Advise clients on value-for-money risk transfer strategies applying Aon's proprietary data, benchmarking, and analytics
  • Provide guidance to ensure seamless and effective risk transfer among all project collaborators
  • Establish and maintain insurance cost benchmarks to support informed client decision-making

Client Advocacy & Contract Advisory

  • Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for clients in discussions with contractors, lenders, and joint venture partners
  • Provide contract risk advisory services, including insurance and indemnity review and negotiation support
  • Deliver thought leadership and client education sessions, including insights on U.S. versus international construction risk and insurance practices

Insurance Program Development & Brokerage Delivery

  • Lead the design and placement of best-in-class, project-specific insurance programs in collaboration with Aon product and specialty leaders
  • Coordinate brokerage teams across multiple lines of coverage to provide integrated, efficient insurance solutions
  • Prepare and lead insurance market presentations and insurer engagement strategies
  • Collaborate with internal analytics teams and external experts on EML/PML analyses and related risk modeling

Project & Collaborator Management

  • Act as the project manager across Aon's brokerage, advisory, analytics, and global service teams
  • Drive alignment across geographies, fields, and service lines to deliver consistent client outcomes
  • Translate complex insurance structures and coverage concepts into clear, practical guidance for non-insurance collaborators

How this opportunity is different

This role sits at the dynamic intersection of strategic advisory and brokerage execution within Aon's global construction and infrastructure platform. As a Senior Account Executive, you will use Aon's comprehensive data, analytics, and market relationships to design and place integrated, multi-line insurance solutions for complex, large-scale projects. You'll coordinate specialist teams across geographies, influence risk outcomes from project inception through delivery, and deliver distinctive, impactful solutions that go well beyond traditional placement.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 10–15+ years of experience in construction risk advisory, insurance brokerage, or related project risk roles
  • Deep expertise across multiple construction-related insurance lines
  • Experience advising senior client collaborators on complex, large-scale construction and infrastructure projects
  • Strong understanding of construction contracts, risk allocation, and delivery models
  • An active P&C License is required, or you must be willing to obtain one within 90 days of your hire date.

Education: Bachelor's degree or relevant experience considered equivalent.

How we support our colleagues

Alongside our extensive benefits package, we promote a diverse and welcoming workforce. Additionally, our flexible work setting enables you to prioritize your wellbeing and maintain a healthy work/life balance, helping you be your best self at Aon. Moreover, every team member receives two “Global Wellbeing Days” annually, giving you the opportunity to concentrate on your personal needs. We also provide several options for different working styles to support our colleagues.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Aon provides equal access to employment for all employees and applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital or domestic partner status, or any other legally protected category. You can ask for accommodations by emailing ReasonableAccommodations@Aon.com or contacting your recruiter. We will collaborate with you to address your needs and provide a fair and just experience.

Job Description

Production Underwriting Professional

Commercial Property Catastrophe (Flood & Wind)

This is a remote position in the US

The Production Underwriting Professional is responsible for driving profitable growth and delivering specialized underwriting expertise for commercial property catastrophe exposures, with a primary focus on flood and wind coverages. This role evaluates, prices, and underwrites complex commercial property risks aligned with delegated underwriting authority while developing strong relationships with retail brokers, agents, and clients.

The ideal candidate combines technical underwriting expertise, strong sales and business development skills, and a disciplined approach to portfolio management. The position requires balancing new business production goals with underwriting profitability standards, ensuring that risks are appropriately structured, priced, and managed within established underwriting guidelines.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Production & Business Development

  • Manage and triage new business submissions to grow a profitable portfolio of commercial property catastrophe business. Including the prioritization of multiple submissions, outstanding quotes, additional information needed, and requests.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with insurance brokers, agents, and carrier partners.
  • Understand product features, underlying coverages, and authority limits to identify new business opportunities and expand existing client relationships.
  • Meet or exceed production, retention, and revenue objectives.

Underwriting & Risk Analysis

  • Understand multiple P&C coverage lines such as: Primary Flood, Excess Flood, Commercial Flood, NFIP guidelines, Deductible Buyback, and RCBAP
  • Analyze commercial property submissions with emphasis on flood and wind exposures. Including the evaluation of insurance applications and related documents, including Elevation Certificates, loss data, Flood Risk Scores/Surge Reports, statement of values and other information needed to accurately evaluate and classify the degree of risk in relation to proposed coverage limits.
  • Evaluate catastrophe modeling outputs, loss histories, construction characteristics, occupancy, protection, and exposure data to prepare insurance quotes and proposals.
  • Assess coastal, inland flood, named storm, hurricane, and severe convective storm risks to provide recommendations for referrals to markets.
  • Structure coverage solutions and recommend appropriate limits, deductibles, and terms in accordance with delegated authority.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain accurate documentation and underwriting files.
  • Utilize underwriting systems, catastrophe modeling platforms, and CRM tools effectively. Including the Microsoft suite of tools, AI platforms, Salesforce, Adobe Acrobat.
  • Ensure compliance with underwriting authority, regulatory requirements, and company standards.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance productivity and service delivery.
  • Candidate should be organized, able to prioritize work and possess effective time management skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work well with team members and co-workers in a virtual setting, participate in and support an underwriting team environment, advance your knowledge with formal educational courses, and interact with management.

Qualifications:

Required

  • Experience underwriting commercial property insurance risks.
  • Knowledge of catastrophe coverages, including flood and wind exposures.
  • Strong analytical, sales, and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to evaluate complex risk information and make sound underwriting decisions.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.

Preferred

  • Experience with CAT modeling tools and exposure management platforms.
  • Knowledge of coastal property risks, NFIP programs, excess flood markets, and wind underwriting practices.
  • Experience working with large schedule commercial property accounts.
  • P&C license preferred

Success Measures

  • New business premium growth
  • Renewal retention rate
  • Quote-to-bind conversion ratio
  • Portfolio profitability
  • Broker relationship development
  • Service level adherence
  • Quality and accuracy of underwriting decisions

Job.JobDescription:
Company Details

Why Join Berkley Select?

At Berkley Select, you'll join a high performing organization that combines the strength and stability of W. R. Berkley Corporation with the agility, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit of a specialty insurer.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Own and grow your territory with significant autonomy.
  • Partner with industry leading underwriting professionals.
  • Build meaningful relationships with top brokers nationwide.
  • Influence business strategy and market expansion initiatives.
  • Advance your career within one of the most respected organizations in specialty insurance.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary Range: $150,000 to $175,000 annually

Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location, experience, qualifications, and overall market factors.

Total Rewards Package

  • Annual performance-based incentive opportunity
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

  • Generous Paid Time Off and Holidays

Berkley Select delivers professional liability insurance solutions to individuals, businesses, professional services firms, and nonprofit organizations.

As a Berkley company, Berkley Select is staffed with a team of experts with a specific focus on Professional Liability. Berkley Select utilizes individual risk underwriting, loss control, and claims practices to provide superior products and services to its customers.

Berkley Select is a Berkley Company. W. R. Berkley, founded in 1967, is one of the nation's premier commercial lines property casualty insurance providers. W. R. Berkley Corporation (NYSE: WRB).

Company URL: https://www.berkleyselect.com

The company is an equal employment opportunity employer.LI - Remote

Responsibilities

Drive Growth. Build Relationships. Shape the Future of Professional Liability!

We are seeking dynamic, relationship focused sales professionals to join our growing team as Territory Sales Manager, ideally based in PA or FL, with addtional preferred states as follows: AZ, CO, GA, IL, IN, KY, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA.

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to influence strategy, drive profitable growth, and expand Berkley Select's market presence across your assigned territory.

If you thrive on building relationships, developing market strategies, creating growth opportunities, and collaborating with high performing underwriting teams, this opportunity is for you.

What You'll Do

As the primary field representative for Berkley Select, you will serve as a trusted advisor to brokers, producers, and distribution partners while driving profitable new business and strengthening existing relationships.

Strategic Broker Development

  • Develop and execute territory business plans focused on profitable growth and market expansion.
  • Build, strengthen, and manage executive level relationships with retail and wholesale broker partners.
  • Conduct strategic business reviews, planning sessions, and joint growth initiatives.
  • Identify and capitalize on cross selling opportunities across Berkley Select's product portfolio.
  • Recruit, evaluate, and appoint new agency and broker partners aligned with company growth objectives.

Territory Growth & Market Expansion

  • Analyze market trends, competitive intelligence, and distribution opportunities to uncover new business opportunities.
  • Expand Berkley Select's presence within key target industries and underserved markets.
  • Develop targeted growth strategies that align with corporate and regional business objectives.
  • Partner with underwriting leadership to identify and pursue high value opportunities.

Business Development & Pipeline Management

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified new business opportunities.
  • Leverage data, analytics, and market intelligence to prioritize production efforts and maximize territory performance.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed growth, retention, and profitability goals.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility, forecasting, and activity reporting through CRM and sales platforms.

Product Expertise & Market Leadership

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Management Liability and Professional Liability insurance solutions.
  • Maintain deep knowledge of competitive products, industry trends, and marketplace developments.
  • Deliver impactful broker training, product presentations, and educational sessions.
  • Collaborate with underwriting, claims, marketing, and leadership teams to drive strategic initiatives and solve complex challenges.

Relationship Management

  • Establish trusted advisor relationships with key broker partners and influencer stakeholders.
  • Lead stewardship meetings and executive level relationship reviews.
  • Represent Berkley Select at industry conferences, networking events, and broker functions.
  • Create meaningful engagement opportunities through regional events and flagship company programs.

What Makes You Successful

You are a strategic business builder who combines strong insurance expertise with relationship driven sales skills. You know how to create opportunities, influence decision makers, and deliver profitable growth while positioning yourself as a valued partner to brokers and clients.

Qualifications

  • Required Qualifications

    • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and insurance industry experience.
    • Minimum 5 years of experience within the insurance industry.
    • Demonstrated success in business development, territory management, or broker distribution sales.
    • Strong knowledge of Management Liability, Professional Liability, or other specialty insurance lines.
    • Proven ability to develop and manage high value broker relationships.
    • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship building skills.
    • Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to leverage data to make informed business decisions.
    • Ability to travel up to 50%.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Established broker and wholesale relationships within assigned territories.
    • Demonstrated history of generating significant new business growth and expanding distribution networks.
    • Extensive understanding of large and complex professional liability risk exposures.
    • Experience utilizing CRM platforms, sales analytics tools, and AI driven technologies to support business development strategies.
    • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and business intelligence tools.
    • Ability to thrive in both independent and highly collaborative environments.

Additional Company Details

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes from external recruiting firms.


Sponsorship Details

Sponsorship not Offered for this Role

Job Description

Data Science Lead

The Data Science Lead will be a lead member of the AGRC North America Data & Analytics (D&A) team, driving the evolution of our advanced analytics and AI capabilities. This role is focused on designing, operationalizing, and scaling analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions that power Risk Consulting engagements.

The Data Science Lead will build robust data pipelines and models, create reusable analytics assets, and enable consultants and analysts with tools and frameworks that elevate the quality, speed, and consistency of analytics across the business. This role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, strong business understanding, and a passion for innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Lead Advanced Analytics & AI DevelopmentCoordinate and contribute to the design and execution of advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions using claims, exposure, operational, and external data to generate high-value insights for use across Risk Consulting.
  • Operationalize Scalable Data & Analytics FoundationsBuild, maintain, and optimize scalable data pipelines, feature stores, and reporting frameworks using tools such as SQL, Python, Alteryx, Databricks, and Power BI/Tableau to support repeatable, production-grade analytics.
  • Develop Reusable Analytics AssetsDesign and productionize reusable analytics components (e.g., models, data products, templates, and automated workflows) that can be embedded into multiple client engagements and solutions.
  • Data Quality, Governance, and AutomationDrive innovation in data management by profiling, cleansing, and integrating disparate data sources; define and automate data quality rules; and contribute to proactive data governance and stewardship practices.
  • Continuous Improvement & Technology AdoptionEvaluate and introduce emerging analytics, AI, and automation tools and techniques to continuously enhance the team's capabilities and efficiency.
  • Mentorship & Best Practice DevelopmentMentor junior analysts and data professionals, promote coding and analytics best practices, and help shape standards for model development, documentation, testing, and deployment.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Analytical & Technical Skills
    • Advanced analytical capabilities with a proven ability to interpret complex datasets, identify trends, and develop robust statistical, ML, and AI-driven solutions.
    • Expertise in data profiling, cleansing, and transformation, including scripting and automation of data quality rules.
    • Strong proficiency in managing relational databases, cloud-based data environments, and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Tooling & Platforms
    • Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI/Tableau, and Excel/VBA.
    • Familiarity with Databricks and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
    • Experience working with Access and other legacy systems is a plus.
  • Communication & Collaboration
    • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-relevant explanations for non-technical stakeholders.
    • Strong collaboration skills, working effectively with consultants, product owners, and other technical teams.
  • Work Environment & Mindset
    • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
    • Demonstrates a growth mindset, curiosity about new tools and methods, and a passion for innovation and continuous learning.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, or Information Management
  • 5–7 years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data science, ideally within insurance, risk management, or consulting environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise in data modeling, statistical analysis, and predictive analytics, with hands-on experience using tools such as SQL, Python, R, and Alteryx.
  • Proficiency in data visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and experience designing client-facing dashboards and reports.
  • Strong understanding of ETL frameworks, data warehousing concepts, and cloud-based data ecosystems (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks).
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets, including structured and unstructured data from multiple sources
