Job.JobTitle: Principal Technical Program Manager – Data Center Strategy & Transformation
Job.JobDescription:
The Principal Technical Program Manager will lead complex, multi-year data center infrastructure, consolidation, migration, and technology-transformation programs across enterprise and cloud environments.


This role is responsible for translating business and technical requirements into executable infrastructure strategies, coordinating cross-functional engineering and operational teams, and maintaining control of scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and stakeholder expectations. The successful candidate will combine strong technical knowledge of data center, network, security, compute, storage, virtualization, and disaster-recovery environments with senior-level program leadership.


The position is best suited to an experienced infrastructure leader who can operate effectively in ambiguous environments, establish governance, challenge incomplete requirements, and guide programs from initial assessment and strategy through design, procurement, deployment, migration, commissioning, and operational handover. This closely reflects the candidate's demonstrated experience managing large data center portfolios, critical migrations, network and security architecture, and enterprise infrastructure programs.


Key Responsibilities:

Data Center Strategy and Program Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of complex, multi-phase data center and critical-infrastructure programs.

  • Develop data center consolidation, migration, modernization, capacity, resilience, and lifecycle strategies.

  • Establish program objectives, delivery roadmaps, workstreams, milestones, dependencies, governance structures, and success criteria.

  • Convert strategic requirements into executable project scopes, schedules, resource plans, budgets, and risk-management plans.

  • Lead infrastructure assessments to evaluate current-state architecture, operational maturity, service resilience, capacity, technical debt, and business-continuity risks.

  • Identify gaps between contracted scope, stated requirements, and discovered operational or technical needs.

  • Evaluate program alternatives and clearly communicate cost, schedule, risk, operational, and technical tradeoffs to leadership.

  • Maintain accountability for overall program performance while coordinating multiple projects, vendors, and technical disciplines.


Data Center Design and Infrastructure Coordination

  • Coordinate the development and review of high-level data center infrastructure architectures and design requirements.

  • Ensure that compute, storage, virtualization, network, cybersecurity, facilities, cloud, and application requirements are incorporated into the overall solution.

  • Facilitate technical alignment among data center architects, facilities engineers, network and security teams, platform teams, application owners, operations, and external consultants.

  • Support active-active, primary-secondary, disaster-recovery, high-performance computing, and critical-production infrastructure strategies.

  • Review design assumptions for availability, scalability, maintainability, redundancy, recoverability, capacity, and operational readiness.

  • Identify infrastructure dependencies and integration requirements across network, security, compute, storage, application, and facility environments.

  • Support the development of migration architectures, sequencing plans, coexistence strategies, rollback plans, and cutover requirements.

The role does not replace the licensed architects or engineers responsible for detailed electrical, mechanical, structural, fire-protection, or code-compliance design. It provides technical program leadership and ensures that those disciplines are properly coordinated.


Migration and Deployment Management

  • Develop and govern migration frameworks for critical applications, infrastructure platforms, and data center services.

  • Coordinate application discovery, dependency mapping, migration-wave planning, readiness reviews, cutover execution, rollback planning, and post-migration validation.

  • Lead deployment planning for greenfield and brownfield data center environments.

  • Ensure infrastructure, network, security, operations, facilities, and application teams are aligned before migration or production activation.

  • Establish formal entry and exit criteria for design, build, testing, commissioning, migration, and operational handover phases.

  • Track implementation defects, open risks, incomplete deliverables, and operational-readiness gaps through final closure.

  • Coordinate business-continuity and disaster-recovery planning for critical services.

The candidate's background includes leading active-active greenfield data center deployments, establishing migration processes for more than 10,000 critical applications, and managing major infrastructure programs with substantial budgets and extended delivery schedules.


Network, Security, and Technology Integration

  • Provide program-level oversight for enterprise data center network and security architecture.

  • Coordinate LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, software-defined networking, routing, firewall, remote-access, and unified-communications workstreams.

  • Ensure network and security designs meet availability, performance, segmentation, scalability, and operational-support requirements.

  • Facilitate coordination of routing, failover, connectivity, authentication, access-control, and security-zone requirements.

  • Ensure cybersecurity, governance, risk, and compliance requirements are incorporated into program planning and design decisions.

  • Guide technical teams in evaluating infrastructure standards, technology lifecycles, automation opportunities, and future-state roadmaps.


Commercial, Procurement, and Vendor Management

  • Support the preparation, evaluation, clarification, and negotiation of RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, SOWs, and vendor proposals.

  • Translate technical and operational requirements into clear procurement documentation and evaluation criteria.

  • Coordinate technical due diligence of data center operators, consultants, contractors, technology suppliers, and managed-service providers.

  • Evaluate vendor proposals for technical compliance, delivery risk, commercial assumptions, scalability, resilience, and operational suitability.

  • Monitor vendor performance against contractual milestones, deliverables, service levels, and quality requirements.

  • Identify scope gaps, exclusions, assumptions, change requests, and commercial risks before they affect delivery.

  • Support contract negotiations and change-control discussions by providing documented technical and program-impact analysis.


Governance, Risk, and Executive Communication

  • Establish and maintain program governance, reporting, escalation, decision-making, and change-control processes.

  • Maintain integrated RAID logs covering risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and decisions.

  • Track schedule, budget, scope, quality, resource capacity, benefits realization, and operational-readiness indicators.

  • Prepare executive-level reports, decision papers, program dashboards, and recommendations.

  • Clearly communicate complex technical issues to executive, business, operational, and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Escalate unresolved risks, scope conflicts, budget pressures, resource constraints, and delivery concerns in a timely manner.

  • Facilitate steering committees, design reviews, readiness reviews, risk workshops, and executive decision meetings.

  • Create consistent program-management processes and reusable organizational assets across portfolios and business units.

The candidate has demonstrated experience developing governance frameworks, managing program changes and tradeoffs, coordinating subject-matter experts, and reporting schedule, budget, quality, and risk to senior leadership.


Stakeholder and Team Leadership

  • Build strong working relationships with CIOs, directors, senior managers, engineering leaders, application owners, operations teams, facilities organizations, procurement, finance, and external partners.

  • Lead multidisciplinary teams without relying solely on direct reporting authority.

  • Clarify roles, responsibilities, interfaces, decision rights, and escalation paths across program participants.

  • Promote accountability, transparency, customer advocacy, continuous improvement, and high delivery standards.

  • Mentor project managers, technical leads, analysts, and other program team members.

  • Resolve conflicts constructively while protecting agreed program objectives, governance, and technical requirements.


Required Qualifications:

  • Ten or more years of progressive experience leading enterprise infrastructure, data center, network, cloud, or technology-transformation programs.

  • Demonstrated experience managing large, complex, multi-year infrastructure programs involving multiple technical disciplines and stakeholder groups.

  • Strong knowledge of data center architecture, enterprise network infrastructure, cybersecurity, compute, storage, virtualization, and disaster-recovery concepts.

  • Experience leading data center consolidation, migration, modernization, greenfield, or major infrastructure deployment initiatives.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop program strategies, scopes, schedules, budgets, resource plans, governance structures, and risk-management frameworks.

  • Experience coordinating architects, engineers, facilities teams, operations personnel, application owners, vendors, and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience managing program budgets, forecasts, commercial risks, and significant technology portfolios.

  • Experience supporting or leading RFI, RFP, SOW, vendor-selection, and contract-scope activities.

  • Strong executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.

  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally based on program requirements.

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with active-active data center architectures and large-scale application migrations.

  • Experience with high-performance computing and other business-critical infrastructure environments.

  • Experience with Cisco networking, SD-WAN, software-defined networking, Palo Alto security platforms, BGP, OSPF, and enterprise remote-access solutions.

  • Familiarity with IT service management, business continuity, disaster recovery, ERP, and infrastructure lifecycle management.

  • Experience working with colocation providers, engineering consultants, general contractors, cloud providers, and managed-service organizations.

  • PMP, PgMP, ITIL, TOGAF, CDCP, CDFOM, or comparable technical or program-management certification.

  • Experience working in global, matrixed organizations.

  • Experience managing programs valued at $100 million or more.

The resume supports extensive cross-functional leadership, formal project planning, RAID management, infrastructure assessments, executive reporting, and development of procurement documentation such as RFIs, RFPs, and SOWs.


Key Performance Indicators:

Success in the role will be evaluated through:

  • Achievement of program milestones within approved scope, schedule, and budget.

  • Quality and completeness of infrastructure requirements and delivery plans.

  • Timely identification and mitigation of program risks and dependencies.

  • Accuracy and transparency of executive reporting.

  • Successful completion of data center migrations and production cutovers.

  • Reduction of unplanned scope changes and unresolved design gaps.

  • Stakeholder confidence and effectiveness of cross-functional coordination.

  • Vendor performance and contractual compliance.

  • Operational readiness and successful transition to support teams.

  • Delivery of measurable improvements in infrastructure resilience, scalability, capacity, security, cost, or service performance.


Compensation & Benefits:

The salary range for this position is $154,200 to $277,600 and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation (10-15%). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/


Equal Employment Opportunity

The company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees. Employment decisions will be based on qualifications, experience, business requirements, and demonstrated ability to perform the responsibilities of the position.

Are you ready to prepare yourself for a career in helping to lead the financial success of an engineering, electrification, automation, and digital powerhouse? Then come join the Finance Leadership Development Program (FLDP)!


The Finance Leadership Development Program (FLDP) Internship gives you the opportunity to learn what it takes to analyze and manage the financial functions of a company ranked among the top 50 in sales in the world. You will receive mentoring from Siemens' team of business leaders and gain access to and network with Siemens' senior decision-makers.


Upon completion of the internship program, high-performing interns who are seniors will have the opportunity to interview for a fulltime position in the FLDP rotational program where you will have the opportunity to pursue a career path as a Financial Analyst, Accountant, Business Process Specialist/Auditor, Business or Plant Controller or Data Analyst for Siemens.


What is the FLDP Internship:

The Finance Internship is a 12-week summer internship program that allows the opportunity to experience the day-to-day functions of a wide range of businesses as you learn how to analyze and support the financial aspects of a multi-billion-dollar company. The program starts in May and ends in August. Individual assignments will take place at one of our nationwide offices.


In this program, participants observe and learn from Siemens' team of innovators as they hone their skills in business planning, financial analysis, cost analysis, corporate accounting, planning and forecasting, commercial project management, risk assessment, credit analysis, strategy, operational review/internal audit, and other corporate finance-based roles.


Apply the knowledge you gained in the classroom to help solve problems while acquiring hands-on experience in a real-world working environment!


The internship program is designed to identify top candidates for the full-time rotational Finance Leadership Development Program upon graduation.

Do you enjoy collaborating closely with the business rather than practicing law from the sidelines? As our Corporate Counsel (P&C), you'll support our evolving insurance businesses and work directly with the people making day-to-day decisions. The work ranges from high-volume contracts such as NDAs to more nuanced carrier, MGA/MGU and regulatory matters. You'll have room to take ownership, develop relationships and become a trusted legal resource for the businesses you support.

This role is a strong fit for an attorney who understands how the P&C insurance business operates and can turn legal analysis into practical guidance. Experience working with insurance carriers, MGAs/MGUs, brokers or related insurance businesses is especially valuable. Prior business-side insurance experience is also welcome.

What You'll Do

  • Draft, review and negotiate carrier agreements, MGA/MGU and program administrator agreements, client service agreements, NDAs and other commercial contracts.
  • Advise business teams on P&C insurance operations, regulatory matters, risk management and contract issues.
  • Review carrier and client agreements, identify meaningful legal and business risks, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Support MGA/MGU operations and carrier relationships as business needs and regulatory requirements evolve.
  • Partner directly with business leaders to understand their objectives and provide timely, business-focused legal guidance.
  • Handle routine agreements efficiently while knowing when an issue requires deeper analysis or escalation.
  • Ask questions, gather information and collaborate across legal and business teams to resolve issues.
  • Monitor relevant P&C insurance regulatory developments and help the business respond to changing requirements.
  • Contribute to legal team initiatives and share knowledge with colleagues across the organization.

Qualifications:

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and an active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • 5+ years of legal experience involving the property and casualty insurance industry.
  • Experience working with an insurance carrier, MGA/MGU, insurance broker, regulatory agency or insurance-focused law practice.
  • Experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements.
  • Strong solid understanding of P&C insurance operations and the relationships among carriers, brokers and insurance intermediaries.
  • Ability to identify legal and business risks and translate them into clear, practical recommendations.
  • Ability to independently manage priorities, follow through on commitments and seek additional information when needed.
  • Communication skills that build credibility with legal colleagues and business partners.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable:

  • Carrier agreements or carrier relationship management
  • MGA, MGU or program administrator operations
  • Commercial Lines insurance
  • Retail insurance brokerage
  • P&C insurance regulatory matters
  • Claims or related risk issues
  • Business-side experience within the insurance industry
  • Technology or AI tools used for legal research, drafting or workflow improvement

Client advisory & delivery

  • Speak about AI and transformation and facilitate workshops.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on AI and transformation.

Solution design & analytics

  • Apply AI sensitivity analysis, skills inference, and task decomposition to evaluate role changes and productivity outcomes; quantify value cases with supporting data.

  • Collaborate with colleagues across the firm to bring a unified AI perspective to client solutions; contribute to repeatable playbooks and assets.

Thought leadership & GTM support

  • Develop points‑of‑view, case studies, and client-ready content on AI's impact on talent and rewards; support targeted go‑to‑market initiatives and industry themes by sharing insights from delivery.

Risk, ethics & governance

  • Advise clients on responsible AI for HR—privacy, fairness, transparency, human oversight—and embed governance into solution design and change plans.

How you succeed:

  • Client development: Build a personal portfolio of clients and engagements.

  • Collaboration: Work across Talent Solutions practices to integrate advisory, analytics, and technology into cohesive offerings.

  • Quality & ethics: Uphold responsible AI standards and Aon's risk management principles in every client deliverable.

Experience

  • 5–8+ years in consulting, people analytics, HR technology, or adjacent fields; hands-on exposure to job architecture, rewards, or assessment programs is a strong plus.

Skills

  • Proficiency with analytics tools (e.g., Python/R, SQL) or enterprise HR platforms; familiarity with Aon's Compensation Manager and GenAI delivery tools is advantageous.
  • Clear, compelling communication—written, visual, and verbal—tailored to executive audiences.

Organization Overview, Function, Purpose & Platform Consultant Work Scope

  • The team supports Allstate Health Solutions (AHS) technology platforms, enabling Product delivery, Platform modernization, Secure integrations and Operational stability across key platforms (Quotit, AgentCubed, AHIT, Medicare Benefits)

Key deliverables

  • Active Azure cloud migration and platform modernization initiatives

  • Growing complexity of API integrations and third-party ecosystems

  • Support strong delivery support (environments, pipelines, cutover readiness)

  • Hands-on API + integration experience

  • Azure/cloud experience

  • Working knowledge of DevOps (CI/CD, repos, deployments)

  • Ability to execute within platform delivery (not just architect)

  • Strong communication + documentation skills

  • Work directly with engineers (debug, validate, iterate)

  • Communicate across technical and business stakeholders

  • Document risks, decisions, and dependencies clearly

Preferred Experience (Nice-to-Have)

  • Tech stack exposure:

    • .NET / C# / SQL / Cosmos DB

    • Azure DevOps, GitHub, Terraform, IaC tools

  • Experience with:

    • API tools (Postman)

    • Cloud/data migration and cutover activities

    • Regulated environments (HIPAA, PHI/PII, HITRUST)

  • Exposure to:

    • Microservices, event-driven architectures

    • Vendor/platform integrations

    • Emerging areas (Azure AI, OpenAI integrations)

Skills

API Integration, Azure Devops, Compliance, DevOps, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Cloud, NET Framework, Platform Design, Platform Development, Platform Management, Technology Platforms

Job Description

As a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster, youll support Moderate auto claims involving property damage, bodily injury, and attorneys. In this remote role, youll investigate coverage and liability, evaluate damages and risk, communicate with customers and attorneys, and negotiate fair injury settlements. Youll use sound judgment, empathy, and Allstates claims tools to guide each claim through a fast, fair, and well-documented process while delivering a strong customer experience.

Qualifications

  • Prior represented third-party casualty claim handling experience

  • 3+ years of bodily injury claim handling experience

  • Moderate bodily injury claim handling experience

  • Experience handling claims in Tennessee, Mississippi, Kentucky Preferred - not required

  • Experience using NextGen, Mitchell Decision Point, and Casualty Center preferred

  • Strong phone communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and assess claims accurately

  • Ability to work independently and remotely while managing time efficiently

  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully

  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation

Work Location

  • This position is a remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States

  • This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, or Hawaii

Work Schedule

  • Monday - Friday 8:00AM - 4:30PM EST/CST

Licensing Requirements

  • You may be required to obtain an adjuster and/or appraiser license as a condition of employment

  • If required, licensing may include an additional Department of Insurance background check and must be completed within 60 days of hire

  • If you currently hold an active insurance license, you must terminate all existing appointments before onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments during employment

  • If you are seeking an adjuster role and hold a resident producer license, you must formally surrender that license when instructed by the licensing team

  • The Hiring Manager and Centralized Licensing team will provide support if licensing is required. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and agree to comply with these licensing requirements

Sign-On Bonus Information

  • Candidates with the active license(s) required for this role may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus

  • Eligible licenses may include a Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License

  • Current employees and candidates previously employed by Allstate or its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus

Allstate Benefits

  • Day 1 benefits, including time off, healthcare, retirement, and more

  • Competitive pay, plus support for ongoing development and career advancement

  • Time off programs and resources that support work/life balance

  • Initial and ongoing training to help you succeed in the role

  • Additional benefits may include 401(k)/pension, education reimbursement, and programs that support life outside of work. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more

  • In our virtual environment, employees are expected to be on camera and actively participate during online meetings and training sessions

  • Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this role

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Join a team focused on transforming how the organization manages risk, compliance, and business resilience. As a Product Engineer on the Fusion Governance, Risk, and Compliance Platform, you will design, develop, configure, and integrate enterprise solutions that support critical business functions, including risk management, compliance, auditing, business continuity, internal controls, and third-party risk oversight.

In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create scalable, reliable solutions that improve efficiency and strengthen operational performance. The successful candidate will have experience working with the Fusion platform, Java, Spring Boot, application programming interfaces, and enterprise integrations, along with a passion for automation, continuous improvement, and delivering innovative technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Risk, and Compliance Platform Development

  • Configure, enhance, and support enterprise governance, risk, and compliance platform capabilities that help strengthen risk oversight and business decision-making.
  • Partner with business and technology teams throughout the full solution lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
  • Build and maintain workflows, assessments, questionnaires, forms, dashboards, and reporting solutions that improve efficiency and visibility.
  • Deliver solutions that support risk management, regulatory compliance, internal controls, audit programs, and third-party risk oversight.
  • Investigate and resolve platform issues while collaborating with vendors and implementation partners to deliver effective solutions.
  • Support platform upgrades, new feature releases, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Integration and Solution Development

  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between the Fusion platform and enterprise applications.
  • Build integration services connecting governance, risk, and compliance solutions with finance, human resources, procurement, data, analytics, identity management, and service management systems.
  • Support data migration, transformation, validation, and reconciliation efforts to ensure accuracy and reliability.
  • Deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing integration solutions aligned with enterprise technology standards.

Product Delivery and Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Architects, and business partners to translate business needs into innovative technology solutions.
  • Participate in iterative planning, prioritization, demonstrations, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Transform business requirements into technical designs and actionable development plans.
  • Deliver high-quality solutions that meet business objectives and project timelines.
  • Support user testing, solution adoption, and successful production deployments.

Operational Excellence

  • Provide ongoing production support and timely resolution of application and integration issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical challenges.

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you willprovideexceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide,leveragingvarious platforms and software such as Xactimate andClaimsXVideo Collaboration. Yourexpertisewill be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

  • The Investigator youllconfidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies todeterminecoverage.

  • The Effective Communicatoryoulluse phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process.Youllalso incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on theclaimprogress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants,in accordance withall legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

About the Team


  • Our FinOps team helps technology and product teams better understand what they are spending in the cloud, where that spending is going, and how they can get more value from it. We partner across engineering, product, architecture, finance, and procurement to turn complex cloud-usage data into practical recommendations and measurable outcomes.
  • We are hiring because cloud usage continues to grow, and we need additional technical capability to identify optimization opportunities, automate analysis, and help teams take action.
  • The team plans to expand as we move beyond traditional cloud-cost reporting toward more proactive workload optimization, unit economics, automation, and cost management for emerging technologies such as AI.

What Youll Do


  • In this role, you will help teams understand and optimize the cost of their cloud and containerized workloads. You will analyze usage data, identify opportunities, build lightweight automation, and translate your findings into recommendations that engineering, product, finance, and leadership teams can act on.
  • You do not need to be an expert in every area of FinOps. We are looking for someone with a strong cloud or engineering foundation who enjoys working with data, solving open-ended problems, and learning new areas.

Why You May Be Interested


  • You will have the opportunity to shape how FinOps capabilities are built and delivered, rather than simply operating an established process.
  • You will work directly with cloud, Kubernetes, engineering, finance, architecture, and product teams.
  • You will see the measurable impact of your work through improved cloud efficiency and cost savings.
  • You will have the flexibility to test new ideas, recommend tools, and build practical solutions.
  • You will gain exposure to developing areas such as unit economics, AI cost management, and token-based consumption.
  • You will join a growing team where initiative, curiosity, and continuous learning are valued.

Job Responsibilities


  • Analyze cloud and Kubernetes usage to identify idle capacity, inefficient workloads, cost anomalies, and practical optimization opportunities.
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to evaluate recommendations, explain expected impact, and support implementation.
  • Build lightweight scripts, API integrations, and repeatable workflows that reduce manual analysis and connect relevant data sources.
  • Develop reports, dashboards, forecasts, and cost insights that help teams understand spending trends and plan future cloud usage.
  • Support cloud commitment planning, reservations, savings programs, and other strategies that improve overall cloud-cost efficiency.
  • Help expand FinOps practices through standards, documentation, education, and tools that enable product and engineering teams to take greater ownership of their cloud costs.

Mandatory Qualifications


  • Hands-on experience working with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience analyzing or optimizing cloud infrastructure, containerized applications, or Kubernetes-based workloads.
  • Working knowledge of cloud billing, usage, cost allocation, forecasting, or cost-optimization concepts.
  • Ability to use Python or another scripting language for basic automation, API calls, data preparation, or systems integration.
  • Experience using data to identify trends, investigate issues, and develop clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical and financial information to engineering, finance, product, and leadership audiences.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with FinOps, cloud financial management, technology business management, or cloud-cost optimization.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Apptio Cloudability, VMware CloudHealth, Finout, Adaptive6, or cloud-native cost-management platforms.
  • Experience with Kubernetes cost allocation, workload rightsizing, autoscaling, cluster efficiency, or shared-cost analysis.
  • Experience using SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Datadog, or similar analytical and observability tools.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, developer portals, or engineering automation workflows.
  • Exposure to unit economics, AI cost governance, token consumption, model-selection economics, or FinOps Foundation practices and certifications.

Synonymous titles: Cloud Cost Optimization Engineer, Cloud FinOps Engineer, Digital Cost Management Consultant, FinOps Platform Product Owner, Consumption Analytics Lead, Cloud Economics Consultant

Skills

AI Ops, API Calls, Cloud Economics, Cloud Infrastructure, Cloud Platform, Cost Optimization, IT Cost Optimization, Kubernetes, Scripting, Terraform (Software)

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 98,100.00 - 167,850.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

As the Lead Digital Product Manager for Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) within the Identity and Access Management (IAM) program, you will lead the strategy and execution of enterprise customer identity and access capabilities.

The CIAM team plays a pivotal role in advancing customer identity and access management initiatives across the organization. In partnership with engineering and product leadership, you will define strategic direction, manage roadmaps and performance outcomes, and drive adoption of integrated identity and access solutions that support the enterprise's broader security, digital experience, and transformation goals.

In this role, you will serve as the single accountable product voice for your assigned Digital Product Family, leading and developing a team of Digital Product Managers while partnering closely with Engineering, Data, UX, and Business leaders to deliver measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes.


Key responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end, multi-year product strategy for a digital product family aligned to enterprise priorities.
  • Translate strategy into measurable outcomes using clearly defined KPIs related to growth, quality, efficiency, adoption, automation, and stability.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Digital Product Managers, fostering strong product thinking and outcome ownership.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, UX, Data, Operations, and Business Architecture to deliver integrated end-to-end journeys.
  • Act as the journey-level integrator, proactively managing dependencies across teams and platforms.
  • Share accountability for delivery health, platform stability, risk management, and compliance.
  • Communicate product strategy, progress, risks, and outcomes effectively to senior stakeholders.

Essential Skills

  • Minimum of 5 years experience leading digital product strategy across complex platforms or multiproduct portfolios
  • At least 2 years experience directly leading, coaching, and developing Product Managers or equivalent crossfunctional roles
  • Demonstrated experience influencing senior leaders, with evidence of partnering across Engineering, Data, UX, and Business teams to achieve agreed outcomes
  • Proven experience defining, tracking, and using KPIs (e.g. adoption, efficiency, quality, or financial metrics) to drive product prioritization and decisionmaking
  • Experience operating in a regulated environment, balancing strategic product leadership with handson execution in fastpaced delivery settings

Desirable Skills

  • Domain experience in Customer Identity and Access Management
  • Experience with Ping Identity platform.
  • Experience operating in largescale, enterprise technology environments
  • Familiarity with outcomebased delivery models and productcentric operating models

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$94,400.00 - $155,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

The Sales Executive Team is dedicated to navigating and managing a high performing sales culture in person and/or virtually which contributes to the overall success of the Personal Insurance (PI) business. The team executes on industry-leading sales strategies aligned with business objectives, builds effective relationships with customers, distribution partners and fellow employees, and creates tactical sales plans for profitable growth through extensive product knowledge and state of the art sales and influencing tactics. The team also uses digitally advanced strategies to move the business forward, leads the relationships with our aggregator/networking groups, and partners with the agent to imbed into higher producing revenue streams.

As a Sales Executive, PI, you will manage and develop a moderately complex group of Travelers agency assignments/territories, optimize growth within defined new business, retention and profitability goals and deliver success within Travelers' framework of Corporate values. You will act as a brand ambassador to sell the Travelers value proposition to distribution partners.

This position is an outside sales position where assigned distribution relationships within the geographic territory tend to be best served through an in-person sales strategy.

What Will You Do?

  • Develop and implement comprehensive sales strategies to expand and manage a portfolio of business, with the objective of driving profitable growth.
  • Own assigned territory, including business development, leveraging performance metrics to create annual plans and manage territorial performance.
  • Conduct in-depth agency diagnostics to assess performance and identify growth opportunities.
  • Facilitate agency appointments and build long-term relationships through office visits (both in person and virtual).
  • Prospect, onboard and set performance goals for new agencies, while providing training and support.
  • May pre-qualify accounts as needed.
  • Influence agency partners through effective communication and negotiation skills.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, such as Product and Underwriting to ensure alignment of sales strategies with business objectives.
  • Understand Travelers Enterprise focus and seize opportunities to cross-sell Travelers products by discussing with business partners in other lines. May identify book transfer opportunities.
  • Develop knowledge of competitor products and capabilities and local market trends.
  • Utilize advanced data and analytics for sales decisions and performance measurement, leveraging extensive knowledge of Travelers' systems and platforms to support the sales process.
  • Leverage AI technologies to optimize industry processes, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation, while continuously learning and adapting to emerging AI trends and tools.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in sales, marketing, business or related field.
  • Four or more years of insurance sales or related experience managing a book of business, driving significant sales growth, achieving sales targets, conducting agency diagnostics and utilizing digital sales tools.
  • Certified Insurance Counselor (CIC) (or willingness to pursue).
  • Strong knowledge of Travelers products and general Property & Casualty marketplace.
  • Strong influencing and negotiation skills to encourage agency partners to adopt Travelers products and services.
  • Proven ability to collaboratively build and maintain relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to define goals and priorities and meet these goals in a timely manner.
  • Exceptional organizational skills to manage complex tasks and priorities to meet sales goals and deadlines effectively.

What is a Must Have?

  • Three years of professional experience in sales, sales support or relevant insurance field.
  • Must live in the territory that they manage and have the ability to travel up to 75% of the time.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

Working with us means thriving in a fast-paced environment as we work as a team to create a seamless experience for our guests. From Attractions, to Parking, to Wardrobe, to Park Services, and more, here you can be part of a team that helps make memorable moments for our guests each and every day. Join us for a once in a lifetime opportunity.Bring the fun and excitement of the carnival to life as a Carnival Games Attendant, where youll thrive in a fast-paced, guest-focused environment. In this role, youll engage guests of all ages by soliciting participation, explaining game rules, and playing carnival games with them to create an interactive and enjoyable experience. Youll also handle cash transactions accurately and efficiently, ensuring a smooth and trustworthy process for guests.Through positive interactions and enthusiastic encouragement, youll inspire further gameplay while maintaining a welcoming and energetic atmosphere. Responsibilities:

  • Stocks and organizes the games while following shrink procedures to maintain costs. Cleans the inside and outside of game booths including sweeping, mopping, dusting, wiping counters, cleaning tents, and emptying garbage cans.

Processes guest purchases in a positive and outgoing manner. Monitors and manages appropriate guest play, including advising of rules and restrictions.
  • Verifies starting cash bank and balances out at the end of shift. Accepts cash transactions. Advises lead on need for cash mid-days and completes change requests. Performs closing procedures, including re-stocking and recovery.
  • Promotes and provides extraordinary guest service for both internal and external guests; answers questions and offers information in a courteous manner. Seeks to provide assistance to guests.

Ensures resort-wide security measures are as follows, including the parking lot, theme park, back-of-house, and hotel.

The VP, Business Development is a senior commercial hunter responsible for securing net-new Financial Services client partnerships that drive profitable revenue and EBITDA growth for Assurant. This role is focused on identifying, originating, shaping, negotiating, and closing complex, multiyear commercial agreements with targeted Financial Services prospects across card benefits, retail travel, legal services/insurance, identity theft protection, and adjacent customer value-added services.

This is not a transactional sales role. This is a new-sales leadership role, not an account management or renewal ownership role. The VP will own the external pursuit strategy and full deal lifecycle for prospective clients — from target identification, executive outreach, discovery, solution development, commercial structuring, negotiation support, contracting, and close. The role will partner closely with the appropriate Line of Business leader, Finance, Legal, Product, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to structure economically sound, executable client solutions.

The VP serves as a commercial architect and closer — building senior-level prospect relationships, creating urgency, aligning Assurant's enterprise capabilities to client growth priorities, and positioning Assurant as a strategic partner for new Financial Services clients.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

Financial Services Growth & New Client Acquisition

  • Originate and close new partnerships across targeted net-new Financial Services prospects across card benefits, retail travel, legal services, identity theft protection, and adjacent customer value-added services.
  • Personally build and own a targeted prospecting strategy, including market mapping, target lists, outbound executive outreach, industry networking, referrals, and pursuit prioritization
  • Own the full deal lifecycle: prospecting, discovery, solution design, executive engagement, negotiation, contracting, and close.
  • Build and maintain a disciplined business development funnel, using Salesforce and dashboards to track opportunity health and outcomes.
  • Create account pursuit plans for priority prospects, including stakeholder mapping, value hypothesis, buying triggers, competitive positioning, next-best actions, and path-to-close.
  • Apply disciplined deal qualification to ensure resources are focused on opportunities with strong strategic, financial, operational, and timing fit.

Full Deal Lifecycle Ownership & Close Execution

  • Lead discovery with prospective clients to uncover business priorities, customer experience gaps, revenue opportunities, operational requirements, and decision criteria.
  • Shape differentiated value propositions that connect client needs to Assurant capabilities and clearly articulate client economics, customer value, and Assurant profitability.
  • Drive executive engagement and maintain momentum through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Lead internal deal reviews, opportunity strategy sessions, and close plans to accelerate decision-making and improve conversion.
  • Maintain accountability for moving qualified prospects from first meeting to signed agreement.

Client Expansion & Relationship Deepening

  • Secondary Growth Opportunities: While the primary focus of this role is net-new client acquisition, the VP may identify expansion opportunities within recently acquired or strategically targeted relationships when those opportunities support new revenue, new product adoption, or broader enterprise growth. Ongoing account management, renewal ownership, and day-to-day client relationship management will remain with the appropriate account leadership teams.

Commercial Structuring & Contract Negotiation Partnership

  • Partner with the relevant Line of Business leader on commercial strategy, pricing structure, deal economics, and negotiation approach for prospective client agreements.
  • Lead the business development workstream in client negotiations, while collaborating with the LOB leader, Finance, Legal, Product, Risk, Compliance, and Operations to ensure proposed terms are commercially attractive, legally sound, operationally executable, and aligned to Assurant's financial objectives.
  • Translate prospect requirements into deal structures that balance client outcomes, Assurant profitability, risk management, implementation feasibility, and long-term partnership value.
  • Support negotiation of complex multiyear agreements, including scope, pricing, service levels, performance commitments, implementation timelines, governance, and renewal/expansion pathways.
  • Maintain accountability for progressing opportunities to signed agreement while ensuring appropriate internal approvals and stakeholder alignment.

Solution Leadership & Cross Functional Orchestration

  • Orchestrate internal teams to co-create prospect-specific solutions that are differentiated, executable, scalable, and aligned to Assurant's growth strategy.
  • Partner with Product, Operations, Technology, Legal, Finance, Compliance, and the relevant LOB leader to validate solution feasibility, economics, implementation requirements, and risk considerations
  • Ensure solutions are executable, scalable, and aligned to Assurant's five-year strategy and growth roadmap.
  • Ensure new-client proposals translate clearly into operating models, launch plans, financial assumptions, and contractual commitments.
  • Remove internal barriers, drive decisions, and maintain momentum across matrixed teams during active pursuits.

Enterprise Growth & “Connect the Dots”

  • Champion enterprise-wide growth by connecting Assurant capabilities across divisions to unlock new revenue streams for the business.
  • Lead/participate in cross functional Business Development forums to share best practices, improve funnel efficiency, and accelerate innovation.
  • Bring a P&L mindset to every opportunity, balancing growth, profitability, and long-term partnership value.

Financial Responsibility

  • Accountable for driving Financial Services revenue and EBITDA growth through net-new client acquisition, qualified pipeline creation, conversion of targeted prospects, and launch of newly secured client partnerships.
  • Partners with the relevant Line of Business leader and Finance, Legal, Product, Risk, Compliance, and Operations on commercial structuring, pricing strategy, deal economics, approvals, and negotiation strategy for prospective client agreements.
  • Manages and influences business development–related budgets.

Market Intelligence, Competitive Positioning & Executive Influence

  • Maintain a strong understanding of Financial Services market dynamics, competitive offerings, buyer priorities, and emerging client needs.
  • Develop executive-level narratives and pursuit messaging that differentiate Assurant in competitive new-business opportunities.
  • Represent Assurant externally at client meetings, conferences, industry events, and strategic networking forums to identify and advance new sales opportunities.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and inspire BD talent and matrixed teams, setting a high bar for performance, accountability, and execution.
  • Model Assurant's values and represent the brand with credibility and consistency across Assurant and the Financial Services ecosystem.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • 15+ years of progressive business development, enterprise sales, strategic partnerships, or commercial growth experience.
  • Direct experience selling or structuring complex solutions in Financial Services, card benefits, protection products, retail travel, legal services, identity protection, customer experience, or adjacent regulated-market solutions.
  • Proven hunter profile with experience building target lists, creating outbound pursuit strategies, developing executive relationships, and converting qualified pipeline into signed multiyear contracts.
  • Demonstrated success as a hunter—originating, negotiating, and closing complex, multi‑year commercial deals.
  • Experience partnering with Line of Business leaders, Finance, Legal, Product, Operations, Compliance, and executive stakeholders to structure commercially sound and operationally executable client agreements.
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional teams to design and deliver client specific solutions.
  • Deep experience in complex contracting, deal structuring, and negotiation, including financial, legal, and operational dimensions.
  • Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools to manage pipeline, forecast opportunity progression, inspect deal health, and drive accountability.
  • MBA preferred
  • Ability to rapidly synthesize complex client, market, and enterprise inputs into a clear growth narrative that resonates with clients and aligns internal teams around a shared vision.
  • Demonstrated skill in leading outcomes across highly matrixed organizations by aligning stakeholders, resolving tradeoffs, and driving decisions without direct control.
  • Strong instinct for prioritizing the right opportunities, structuring pragmatic solutions, and making sound tradeoffs in fastmoving, high stakes deal environments with incomplete information.
  • Experience developing executive-level value messaging for competitive pursuits involving complex solutions, regulated environments, or multi-stakeholder buying groups.
  • Ability to travel up to 60% domestically for client meetings, executive presentations, negotiations, and industry events, as business needs require.

Core Competencies:

  • Strategic growth mindset with the ability to connect client needs to enterprise capabilities
  • Advanced commercial and financial acumen, including P&L ownership
  • Executive level communication and influence with C-suite and senior leaders
  • Hunter/closer orientation with a demonstrated ability to personally create, advance, and close new-business opportunities.
  • Strategic pipeline builder with disciplined funnel management, qualification rigor, and forecast accountability.
  • Commercial architect with strong judgment in structuring deals that balance client value, profitability, operational feasibility, and risk.
  • Strong solution orientation—able to go beyond selling to building and delivering
  • High energy, hungry, dynamic, and resilient, with a bias toward action and results
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and drive outcomes across matrixed organizations.

What Success Looks Like in This Role:

  • Net-new Financial Services clients acquired.
  • Qualified new-logo pipeline created, advanced, and converted.
  • Complex multi-year agreements signed with targeted prospects.
  • Measurable revenue and EBITDA contribution from newly secured client relationships.
  • New-client revenue launched across growth product lines.
  • Strong client satisfaction and executive level trust
  • Repeatable, scalable solutions launched through cross functional execution
  • Internal institutional knowledge, high-engagement, and trust
  • Accurate forecasting, disciplined funnel management, and consistent opportunity progression.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Product Security is growing. We are engineering enterprise-wide security solutions that start left instead of just shifting left. Our focus spans AI Security, SaaS Security, API Security, Threat Modeling Agents, Apex Threat Modeling, Code Security in the IDE/Pipelines, and more.

We are seeking a visionary Platform Consultant with deep engineering expertise and strong security architecture experience. In this senior-level role, you will act as a strategic advisor to our engineering teams and organizations, guiding them through complex technical challenges and shaping platform strategies in line with Allstates outcome-based delivery culture. You will embed secure-by-design principles, including rigorous threat modeling from the outset of development, to fortify our platforms from the ground up. You will make clear, well-informed architectural decisions and articulate our security posture and recommendations to senior leadership, ensuring clarity and confidence in the integrity of our solutions.

As a security-focused engineering leader, you will collaborate with teams from Security Operations to implement proactive defenses and risk mitigations, to consulting with data scientists to leverage analytics and AI for enhanced platform capabilities. This cross-functional engagement provides continuous opportunities to influence Allstates engineering community. You will mentor teams in modern engineering practices, champion system-wide best practices (such as Zero Trust architecture and reusable design), and drive the adoption of emerging technologies to improve reliability, performance, and efficiency.

The ideal candidate is a forward-thinking technical leader who seamlessly blends engineering know-how with security vision, inspiring change and driving strategic progress in a dynamic technology landscape. You are unwilling to accept solutions that compromise either developer experience or security integrity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a trusted consultant to engineering teams and organizations, guiding secure platform design and implementation across diverse product domains

  • Communicate clearly and effectively ensuring business and engineering needs are met

  • Foster effective collaborative sessions with teams from different disciplines and leadership levels

  • Embed secure-by-design principles and deep threat modeling practices into the development lifecycle, ensuring security is foundationalnot bolted on

  • Define and communicate Allstates security posture clearly to technical and business leadership, enabling informed decision-making

  • Lead the ideation and implementation of innovative security controls that challenge the status quo and elevate Allstates embedded security maturity

  • Drive forward engineering practices that adapt to evolving technologies, enabling scalable, resilient, and efficient platforms

  • Mentor engineers and platform consultants in systems thinking, reusable design, and outcome-based delivery

  • Influence cross-functional teams through Discovery & Framing sessions, architectural reviews, and strategic planning

  • Promote and enforce architectural standards, simplification, and reuse across the enterprise

  • Actively participate in agile ceremonies and foster a culture of continuous learning and iterative delivery


Job Qualifications

Essential Skills:

  • Extensive experience (8+ years) in software engineering, platform development, or architecture roles, with increasing technical leadership responsibilities in complex enterprise environments

  • Demonstrated success as a high-impact technical advisor to multiple engineering teams, with proven ability to influence architecture direction and mentor engineers in best practices

  • Expert-level knowledge of Agile/XP and DevOps methodologies, including paired programming, test-driven development (TDD), and CI/CD automation, with a track record of using these practices to accelerate delivery and improve quality

  • Hands-on expertise in architecting and delivering large-scale distributed systems, such as cloud-native microservices on Docker/Kubernetes, deployed on modern cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or equivalent), ensuring scalability, high availability, and performance

  • Broad technical proficiency across multiple programming languages and frameworks (especially Java and JavaScript ecosystems), and comfort with modern development tools (e.g., IntelliJ or VS Code, Git/GitHub, Spring Boot) and designing robust RESTful APIs

  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with excellent communication abilities to clearly convey complex technical and security concepts to both engineering teams and senior business leaders

Desirable Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of industry security frameworks and web/API security standards e.g., OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML to guide secure design and development practices

  • Deep expertise in security architecture and secure-by-design practices, including advanced threat modeling, robust identity and access management (IAM) strategies, and Zero Trust architectures with a proven ability to embed these controls at all stages of the development lifecycle

  • Broad technical proficiency across multiple programming paradigms in addition to Java and JavaScript experience, deep experience with procedural (e.g., Go, Rust) and functional (e.g., F#, Elixir, Haskell, Clojure) programming languages is a strong signal of architectural proficiency

  • Technical proficiency with AI tools such as running local models, developing MCP servers, using AI powered development tools like cursor/copilot/claude code/codex/etc. to help drive your work more efficiently and test for effective model deployment strategies

  • Demonstrated expertise in API-first design and specification-driven development (e.g., OpenAPI, Swagger), enabling scalable, discoverable, and reusable services. Proven ability to shape developer experience and accelerate delivery through contract-first approaches, while laying the foundation for AI-assisted development and automated API governance

  • Deep understanding of modern cryptographic principles and protocols (e.g., AES, TLS, Argon2, elliptic curve cryptography), with the ability to evaluate, implement, and advise on secure data protection strategies. Skilled in applying cryptographic techniques to strengthen trust boundaries, safeguard sensitive data, and ensure compliance with enterprise and regulatory security standards

  • Experience with advanced development and testing practices, such as behavior-driven development (BDD) and integrating automated security checks into CI/CD pipelines

  • Familiarity with emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML, knowledge graph solutions, advanced analytics) and their application to improve developer velocity, platform reliability, and security capabilities

  • Exposure to specialized security domains like AI Security, SaaS Security, and API Security, with an understanding of the unique challenges and tools in these areas

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Compensation offered for this role is $160,000 230,000 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

Responsible for creating a comprehensive estimate of damages for 1st and 3rd party material damage claims leading to the proper disposition. This role is utilized as a peer mentor having mastered our processes and obtained technical expertise.

National General is seeking a Material Damage Specialist to evaluate and resolve 1st and 3rd party auto physical damage claims. In this role, you will inspect damages, prepare comprehensive repair estimates, negotiate settlements, and ensure compliance with fair claims practices and company policies.

Depending on experience level, candidates may also serve as a technical resource and mentor to peers, leveraging advanced estimating expertise to support complex material damage losses. This position is fully remote for candidates residing in North Dakota, South Dakota, or Minnesota.

Preferred Experience:

  • Auto physical damage claims handling

  • Writing and reviewing vehicle repair estimates

  • 1st and 3rd party material damage claims

  • Negotiating claim settlements and managing complex files

  • Knowledge of estimating platforms (CCC, Mitchell, Audatex, etc.)

  • Strong customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills

  • Prior field estimating or material damage appraisal experience preferred

Key Responsibilities

Interprets regulatory compliance and fair claims practices

Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files

Applies mastered content in interpretations of all policy types written by the company and assists leadership in formal and ad hoc training

Exhibits mastery estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on 1st and 3rd party material damage losses of all severities

Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.

Job Description

Join the legal frontline and champion the defense for both the insured and the Company! As a Senior Trial Attorney, you'll handle bodily injury, property damage lawsuits, and more, with trials, arbitrations, and mediations. Beyond the courtroom, you'll provide vital counsel to business clients and coordinate between legal teams. Stay ahead of the game by monitoring new laws and regulations, ensuring our strategies remain sharp. Embrace the excitement of constant challenges and victories in this dynamic role!

Key Responsibilities

  • Represents insured individuals and the Company in the defense of bodily injury and property damage lawsuits, subrogation, and uninsured/underinsured motorist cases.
  • Prepares thoroughly for and conducts hearings, trials, arbitrations, mediations, and depositions.
  • Prepares and presents pre- and post-trial motions effectively.
  • Assists colleagues in resolving calendar conflicts in a collaborative manner.
  • Offers counsel to business clients on day-to-day legal matters.
  • Manages projects efficiently, fostering coordination and collaboration among legal teams.
  • Keeps abreast of and evaluates new laws, regulations, and case law; identifies and summarizes relevant issues; collaborates with other areas of the Law and Regulation (L&R) department; provides proactive advice and counsel to business units on the impact of new laws; monitors legal representation.

Education

  • Juris Doctorate and active membership in good standing with the Connecticut State Bar.

Experience

  • 4+ years of proven litigation experience or strong litigation-type skills, such as case strategy development, legal research, and advocacy, with the ability to manage complex disputes and work effectively under pressure.
  • First or second chair jury trial experience is preferred.
  • Proven experience with insurance defense is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, LexisNexis (preferred), and internet research.
  • Strong teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with attorneys, paralegals, and administrative assistants under the guidance of Lead Counsel.
  • Capacity to independently manage an active caseload and meet deadlines.
  • Comfortable working in a remote/hybrid work environment and willing to travel throughout Connecticut, including to courts and legal venues in the Hartford and New Haven area, as needed.

***This role is also eligible for a bonus plan


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.


Explore the Benefits of Joining Allstate's Client Legal Services

  • Exceptional Work-Life Balance: At Allstate, we understand the importance of achieving harmony between work and personal life. Our in-house litigation roles provide more predictable schedules and flexibility, allowing you to excel professionally while enjoying a fulfilling personal life.
  • Holistic Understanding of the Business: As part of the Allstate legal team, you'll gain invaluable insight into our diverse business operations, objectives, and culture. This comprehensive understanding enables you to align legal strategies closely with the company's goals, fostering impactful contributions and strategic partnerships across departments.
  • Direct Client Collaboration: Working in-house at Allstate means collaborating directly with internal stakeholders and business units. This close partnership cultivates deeper client relationships, facilitating a nuanced understanding of their needs and priorities. By providing proactive legal guidance and support, you'll play a pivotal role in driving the company's success.
  • Strategic Influence and Impact: As an integral member of our legal team, you'll have the opportunity to shape strategic decisions and risk management initiatives. Your insights and expertise will inform key business decisions, empowering you to mitigate risks effectively and drive positive outcomes that directly impact Allstate's bottom line.
  • Diverse Legal Challenges: In-house litigation roles at Allstate encompass a broad spectrum of legal work beyond traditional litigation, including regulatory compliance, risk assessment, and dispute resolution. This diversity of challenges ensures continuous professional growth and development, expanding your skill set and enhancing your career trajectory.
  • Professional Growth Opportunities: With ample opportunities for advancement and professional development, you'll have the support and resources you need to reach new heights in your legal career.

Job Description

The Outside Property Consultant II investigates and confirms the facts of loss for advanced homeowner claims. The role determines coverage, damages and otherwise adjusts and negotiates claims within limit of authority. The position creates or audits a comprehensive estimate of damages for first party homeowner claims leading to the proper disposition.

We are hiring for a Property Field Adjuster to support the Kane and Cook County, Illinois territory. This team supports our premier clients and is seeking a seasoned professional with strong communication and customer service skills. In this role, you will handle a variety of property claims, including water-related losses and roof claims, many of which can be high-value and complex in nature.

Key Responsibilities

  • Possesses a deep understanding of the content of all policy types written by the company

  • Possesses strong estimating fundamentals in order to create or audit estimates of damages on first party homeowner losses with complexity

  • Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers across multiple lines

  • Evaluates settlement alternatives by reviewing regulatory compliance and fair claims practices and makes decisions on best option

  • Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files across multiple lines

Job Description

(Northbrook, Illinois Remote position)

Duties: Responsible for the core Ads Manager platform and other user facing apps. Defined top-level product strategy for ads platform, in alignment with broader product and company strategy. Lead all phases of the product life cycle, from inception to introduction into the marketplace, by developing products to meet specific customer needs and to achieve specific cost and success outcomes. Leverage extensive experience in turning mobility insights into actionable marketing campaigns. Deliver and manage external demand and supply sources. Collaborate with go to market teams to ensure platform is delivering efficiently against customer objectives. Oversee team to monitor efficacy of products and use customer and business feedback mechanisms to ensure products are meeting customer needs across each customer segmentation. Drive program vision and goals, paired with business-level priorities translated into features and user stories to populate product backlogs across the product suite covering. Accountable for setting priorities and balancing investments in short-term tactical product improvements with long-term strategic product investments. Conduct user interviews with internal and external users, created user personas, and mapped out different user journeys. Develop product roadmap, present product vision to leadership, write detailed product requirement docs, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and host product townhalls.

Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science or related field (willing to accept foreign education equivalent) plus eight (8) years as Product Manager or related occupation gaining experience in product development in a digitally-oriented environment related to consumer services.

Specific skills/other requirements - Experience must include (quantitative experience requirements not applicable to this section): Engaging in discovery/test and learning activities to quickly validate concepts for backlog investments; Defining and managing KPIs to measure the success of efforts and to inform the overall product strategy; Leading development and recommendations of new techniques and processes to support solutions; Making build, buy, and partner decisions to advance product strategy and maximize KPIs; Monitoring budgets and operational effectiveness and developing strategies for adjusted courses of action; Running an omnichannel ad platform generating over $100 million in revenue; Implementing and managing relationships with external demand and supply partners in the AdTech space; Developing and applying insights derived from mobility data within the advertising technology (AdTech) industry; Creating and managing platform and campaign monitoring tools; Working with Advertising Demand Side Platforms and customer data repositories; and Working across backend software engineering, machine learning engineering, front end web development and data science teams. Position requires Domestic travel across the U.S. required approximately 2 weeks per quarter. Fully remote position with availability in Central Standard Time (CST).
