Job.JobTitle: Lead Technician, Special Effects - Universal Horror Unleashed
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Construction & Skilled Trades, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY

Supports management in the installation, maintenance, configuration, and daily operation of special effects (SFX) systems at Universal Horror Unleashed, including atmospheric, pneumatic, hydraulic, animatronic, water-based, cryogenic, and related effects. Provides work direction to Team Members to support safe, reliable, and high-quality SFX performance within the show environment. Oversees daily shifts, system startup and shutdown procedures, new effects installations and strikes, seasonal reconfigurations, troubleshooting, and related administrative duties. Reinforces company and venue-specific policies, OSHA standards, hazardous material handling procedures, and regulatory compliance requirements. Maintains working knowledge of SFX systems, safety requirements, and operational standards, while addressing concerns and escalating critical safety or technical issues to Technical & Show leadership as needed.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plans, assigns, and directs daily Special FX tasks for SFX Team Members, including pre-show system checks of atmospheric, pneumatic, hydraulic, animatronic, and water-based effects. Communicates performance expectations and supports proper and safe completion of assigned work. Completes required reporting and task management through Maximo to support communication between shifts, Technical Management, and Technical Coordinators.
  • Reinforces company safety guidelines, OSHA standards, applicable state regulations, UHU operating procedures, and safe work practices related to compressed gas systems, pneumatic and hydraulic equipment, chemical effects, atmospheric systems, and hazardous materials. Leads SFX startup and shutdown procedures in compliance with lockout/tagout and hazard communication standards. Supports proper SDS/MSDS documentation, chemical labeling, compressed gas cylinder storage, equipment care, and consumable supply management.
  • Ensures proper completion of work orders and documentation within Maximo. Troubleshoots SFX-related issues involving atmospheric effects, pneumatic and hydraulic assemblies, animatronic mechanisms, water-based effects, scent delivery systems, cryogenic effects, and breakaway prop mechanisms. Executes approved effects changes for daily operations, seasonal offerings, and special events in accordance with approved design, safety parameters, and regulatory requirements. Documents Team Member observations using the Lead Observation Report.
  • Communicates and coordinates SFX system status, operational updates, resource needs, consumable inventory levels, work plans, and technical concerns with Technical & Show leadership, Scenic Dcor & Props, Operations, and affected Team Members to support safe and seamless integration of effects within the show environment. Serves as a primary point of contact between the SFX team and appropriate leadership.
  •   Supports on-the-job training for new SFX Team Members and provides refresher training to existing Team Members. Training areas may include compressed gas handling, pneumatic and hydraulic system operation, chemical effects safety, SDS/MSDS interpretation, system documentation, OSHA standards, and venue-specific safety requirements. Completes required training documentation and assists with assigning training shifts as needed.
  • Maintains current working knowledge of atmospheric effects technology, pneumatic and hydraulic control systems, animatronic mechanisms, fluid effects delivery systems, CO2 and cryogenic effects equipment, and applicable industry safety standards. Performs Technician-level duties as operationally necessary, completes company-required training, and maintains any required licenses or renewals.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned. 

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Individual Contributor  

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws. 

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required. 

  • Previous hands-on experience with the design, installation, maintenance, and operation of special effects systems within the professional entertainment, themed entertainment, or live events industry.
  • Working knowledge of pneumatic and hydraulic system theory, component identification, and safe operation.
  • Must be able to obtain a work card upon employment.
  • Demonstrated experience with atmospheric effects equipment, including fog machines, hazers, CO2 systems, and cryogenic low-lying fog rigs.
  • Familiarity with compressed gas cylinder and cryogenic liquid safety standards, including proper handling, storage, transportation, and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience with animatronic mechanisms, actuator systems, and timing/sequencing of mechanical effects preferred.
  • Ability to read and interpret SDS/MSDS documentation, system schematics, and pneumatic/hydraulic circuit diagrams.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment while providing clear work direction to Team Members.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to coordinate with leadership, Team Members, and partner departments.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • Local and state required licenses including OSHA 10.
  • OSHA 30 General Industry preferred
  • Compressed Gas Association safety training or equivalent preferred.
  • Forklift Operator certification preferred.
  • Applicable state-specific license for compressed gas or hazardous materials handling, if required.
  • Must be able to obtain LVMPD Non-gaming work card upon hire.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree or GED is required; Associate degree or technical degree in Mechanical Technology, Industrial Technology, or a related field preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years of hands-on special effects experience in system installation, operation, troubleshooting, and maintenance is required, including at least 1 year of experience providing work direction to others.
  • Experience in professional entertainment, themed entertainment, live events, or a similar operating environment is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Job.JobTitle: Bilingual Destination Universal Sales Specialist - ROLE LOCATED IN SAN DIEGO
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Hospitality / Tourism / Events, Sales / Business Development
Job.JobDescription:
As a theme park built around a working movie studio, were all about lights, camera, action. Working with us means thriving in a fast-paced environment as we work as a team to create a seamless experience for our guests. From Attractions, to Parking, to Wardrobe, to Park Services, and more, here you can be part of a team that helps make memorable moments for our guests each and every day. Join us for a once in a lifetime opportunity.The Bilingual (English/Spanish) Destination Universal Sales Specialist is a guest-facing role focused on achieving sales goals while delivering a consistently positive guest experience at Universal-branded off-property locations in the South Bay area of San Diego. Success in this role requires strong consultative sales skills, product expertise, and exceptional guest service. As part of a 365-day-a-year sales operation, youll act as an off-site extension of the Universal brand, selling Universal Studios Hollywood ticket products and select third-party offerings. Youll identify opportunities to elevate each guests visit, confidently introducing premium options such as the VIP Experience, to drive incremental revenue while creating memorable experiences.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary admission to Universal Studios Hollywood and all Universal Theme parks
  • Earn complimentary tickets for your friends and family
  • Discounts on food and merchandise
  • Building lifelong friendships
  • Resume building workshops
  • Growth opportunities 
  • Wellness programs

Responsibilities:

  • Sell Universal Studios Hollywood tickets, passes, and approved third-party products using a consultative, guest-focused approach
  • Identify and convert upgrade opportunities, including for guests who previously purchased tickets online
  • Clearly explain product options, pricing, and value propositions to support informed purchase decisions
  • Meet or exceed individual and location sales goals
  • Serve as a welcoming, knowledgeable point of contact at Universal-branded desks
  • Engage guests to understand their plans and recommend enhancements that improve their visit
  • Assist with questions, problem-solving, and guest recovery as needed
  • Act as a brand ambassador, representing Universal Studios Hollywood with professionalism and warmth
  • Foster good working relationships with internal and external partners through honesty and integrity
  • Maintain strong knowledge of Universal offerings, promotions, and ticket policies, as well as of select third-party offerings
  • Accurately process transactions in accordance with standard operating procedures
  • Track sales activity and performance metrics, and communicate results and insights to leadership
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

  • Must have fluency in both English and Spanish
  • Face-to-face sales or customer service experience
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays, with consistent attendance and reliability
  • Ability and willingness to stand for extended periods of time and work in varying environments, including indoors and outdoors
  • Must have professional attire and ensure appearance always represents the company and product

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience selling tickets, experiences, or upgrades within a travel, entertainment, or attraction-based environment
  • Demonstrated consultative sales instinct, including proactively engaging guests and adjusting recommendations in real time to align with their interests and drive successful outcomes
  • Energized by the sales process and its outcomes, with the resilience to stay engaged and positive while working toward goals
  • Strong judgment in balancing sales objectives with authentic service, professionalism, and brand representation
  • Detail-oriented and accurate in tracking sales activity and performance metrics
  • Adaptable and flexible, with the ability to adjust to scheduling changes, or evolving priorities, sometimes on short notice
  • Technical acumen to effectively navigate point-of-sale systems, CRM tools, and other technology required to support sales and reporting

Pay:

  • Starting at $20/hr

Join us for a once in a lifetime opportunity.Play a vital role in creating unforgettable experiences as a Ride Operator, where safety, efficiency, and exceptional guest service are your top priorities. In this fast-paced and guest-facing position, youll be responsible for the safe operation of rides and attractions, ensuring guests are securely and efficiently loaded and unloaded. With a focus on maintaining the highest safety standards, youll provide clear instructions, monitor ride operations, and engage with guests from around the world and of all ages to ensure an enjoyable and memorable visit. Your ability to stay calm under pressure, work collaboratively with team members, and manage high-energy environments will contribute to the seamless operation of our attractions.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary admission to Universal Studios Hollywood and all Universal Theme parks
  • Earn complimentary tickets for your friends and family
  • Discounts on food and merchandise
  • Special events for employees (preview nights for new attractions/events)
  • Building lifelong friendships
  • Resume building workshops
  • Growth opportunities 
  • Wellness programs

Responsibilities:

  • Efficiently loading and unloading guests on to the attraction.
  • Ensuring guests comply with and meet all safety restrictions of the attraction. Demonstrating knowledge of the rides Standard Operating Procedures, which include ensuring guests are safely secured prior to enabling the attraction.
  • Responsible for cleaning and maintaining the attraction facility both guest facing and back of house.
  • Distribute, collect, sort, and clean 3D glasses.
  • Promptly and efficiently ensuring Gate A pass holders are loaded into the attraction. Ensuring guests with special needs are accommodated.
  • Greeting and interacting with guests as they enter and when waiting at the preload. As guests exit the attraction, saying good bye, wishing them a good day etc.
  • Promoting and providing extraordinary guest service for both internal and external guests; answering questions and offering information in a courteous manner as well as seeking to provide assistance to guests.
  • Utilizing themed interaction with the guests to provide a unique and encompassing experience.
  • Understanding and demonstrating the proper use of safety practices and ensuring department standards are maintained and safety policies for the park are upheld.
  • Monitor and maintain a safe and secure environment for both team members and guests of all ages, following all company guidelines and protocols.
  • Identify, de-escalate, and resolve conflicts or disturbances professionally and effectively to maintain a positive atmosphere.
  • Provide a positive and welcoming experience for guests of all ages while maintaining composure during difficult interactions.
  • Maintain a high level of trust and integrity to promote a safe, secure, and welcoming environment for customers and colleagues of all ages.
  • Performing other duties as assigned.

USH Upper Lot Rides and Attractions include:

  • Despicable Me
  • Silly Swirly Fun Ride
  • DreamWorks Theater
  • The Simpson's Ride
  • Wizarding World of Harry Potter
  • The Secret Life of Pets: Off the Leash
  • Fast and Furious: Hollywood Drift

Qualifications:

  • Must be 18 years old or older

Job Demands:

  • Must be able to walk or stand for extended periods of time
  • Must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 lbs, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 lbs with assistance
  • The noise level is generally moderate to high
  • Team Members are subject to a variety of weather conditions, including but not limited to: heat, sun exposure, cold, and inclement weather. Depending on the assigned location, work can be almost exclusively outdoors

Schedule:

  • Must be available to work at least 4 days per week throughout the peak seasons to include a rotation of mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays

Pay:

  • $19.50 per hour (After 1,000 hours worked, pay increases to $23.92/hr)

JOB SUMMARY:

The Hotel Reservations Coordinator for Universal Kids Resort is responsible for managing Guest hotel reservations with accuracy and efficiency, ensuring a smooth booking experience from inquiry to arrival. This role serves as the primary point of contact for Guests making, modifying, or canceling hotel reservations and works closely with the Front Office and Marketing & Sales teams and UDX counterparts to optimize occupancy and Guest satisfaction.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Processes and manages Guest reservations, modifications, or cancellations via phone, email, and online systems for Universal Kids Resort hotel. Identifies Guest reservation needs, appropriate room type, verifies availability and rate, and updates within Windsurfer reservation system.
  • Coordinates with Front Office and Marketing & Sales teams to ensure reservation accuracy. Follows sales techniques to maximize revenue, room inventory controls, channel strategy, and reservation requests.
  • Updates and maintains reservation system with current rates, availability, and guest information, ensuring accuracy and up-to-date records. Revises room blocks to maintain the required number of available rooms.
  • Handles special requests, group blocks, and VIP bookings with attention to detail. Ensures all policies and procedures are being followed and documented for the evolving business.
  • Responds to Guest inquiries and resolves reservation-related issues promptly and professionally. Communicates information regarding special requests or VIP reservations to Front Office leadership as necessary.
  • Assists with reporting, audits, and occupancy tracking as needed. Partners across Front Office, Finance and Marketing & Sales to ensure operational efficiencies and established procedures are being met.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Knowledge of hotel reservation systems (e.g., Opera Cloud, SynXis, Windsurfer, or similar), room types, rate structures, and booking policies.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with Guests, colleagues, and departments while managing multiple tasks with accuracy.
  • Experience in hotel reservations, front office, or customer service roles in a hospitality environment.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and a Guest-focused mindset.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED is required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 1+ years of hotel reservations, front office/desk, Guest service experience is required, experience working with a property management system, preferably Opera Cloud PMS and Windsurfer is preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Description

Under limited supervision and established practices, responsible for the investigation, evaluation, and disposition of Complex Workers Compensation cases of high exposure and severity. Applies established medical management strategies on high dollar complex claims. Has developed high level of knowledge of Workers Compensation claims handling techniques, a full knowledge of LMG claims procedures and is cognizant of new industry trends and claim handling techniques Uses available data to track claims trends and other claim related metrics.

Candidates should be based in Oregon with Oregon Workers Compensation Adjuster License.

The salary range posted reflects the range for the varying pay scale that encompasses each of the Liberty Mutual regions and the overall cost of living for that region.


Responsibilities

  • Investigates claims to determine whether coverage is provided, establish compensability and verify exposure.
  • Resolves claims within authority and makes recommendations regarding case value and resolution strategy to Branch Office Management and HO Examining on cases which exceed authority.
  • Participates in pricing, reserving and strategy discussions with HO Examining and Examining Management.
  • Works closely with staff and outside defense counsel in managing litigated files according to established litigation management protocols.
  • Identifies and appropriately handles suspicious claims and claims with the potential to develop adversely.
  • Identifies and appropriately handles claims with third party subrogation potential, SIF (Self-Insured Fund) and MSA (Medicare Set Aside) exposure.
  • Establishes and maintains accurate reserves on all assigned files.
  • Makes timely reserve recommendations to Branch Office Management and HO Examining on cases which exceed authority.
  • Prepares for and attends mediation sessions and/or settlement conferences and negotiates on behalf of LMG and LMG Insureds.
  • Demonstrates the ability to understand new and unique exposures and coverages.
  • Demonstrates the ability to understand key data elements and claims related data analysis.
  • Confers directly with policyholders on coverage and resolution strategy issues.
  • Coordinates and participates in training sessions for less experienced staff, including both Complex Non-Complex staff.

Qualifications

  • A bachelors degree or equivalent business experience is required
  • In addition, the candidate will generally possess 5-7 years of related claims experience with 1-2 years of experience in complex claims
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint as well as excellent written and verbal communication skills required

About Us

Job.JobTitle: Sr Manager Network Business Ops & Program Management
Job.JobDescription:
Job Description


The Sr. Manager of the Network Business Operations & Program Mgmt. is accountable to lead one or more teams in achieving targeted outcomes/results and capabilities for key strategic initiatives in support of network development, network management and network operations. This position is accountable for implementing sustainable and scalable programs and/or capabilities to ensure best in class Network Management practices with the intent of operational excellence while upholding compliance regulations imparted by multiple regulatory agencies including CMS, AHCA, and NCQA as well as compliance with the Blue Cross Blue Shield Association (BCBSA). This role will be required to work in a fast-paced environment while focusing on the management of multiple projects and/or programs that cross multiple workstreams.

What You Will Be Doing

Strategic Leadership & Portfolio Management

  • Develop and implement network management business strategy aligned with organization-wide goals
  • Own end-to-end accountability for a portfolio of programs, projects, and business processes with cross-functional impact (Operational, Product, Legal, IT, Compliance)
  • Lead complex, major initiatives supporting both tactical and strategic objectives with budget accountability up to ~$3.5M per project

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and develop multi-functional teams to execute operational plans and CPI goals
  • Recruit, motivate, and assess staff performance; build high-performing teams
  • Provide tactical and strategic execution across division and unit levels

Compliance & Regulatory Management

  • Ensure implementation of sustainable programs maintaining best-in-class Network Management practices and regulatory compliance
  • Ensure Network Regulatory Compliance activities: quarterly/annual filings (CMS, NCQA, AHCA), certifications, product/network filings, NSA processes (IDR, COC), and audit coordination
  • Ensure Network Adequacy; coordinate with Network Management on gaps and remediation

Stakeholder Communication & Influence

  • Present network metrics, recommendations, and deliverables to executive leadership on transformational projects
  • Communicate across internal and external audiences; influence stakeholder decisions
  • Coordinate Product and Network Management interests for emerging product lines

Program & Process Administration

  • Coordinate initiative BRS reviews and manage provider-specific requests (roster validation, vendor reporting)
  • Lead development and implementation of project/program documentation as enterprise-wide reference for network programs
  • Manage reporting activities (Compliance, Expansions, Network Adequacy, Member Re-assignments)
  • Lead Network Operations information sessions on new programs and initiatives

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Drive forward thinking approach to provider strategy, identifying opportunities to evolve programs in response to changing provider, member, market, and business needs

  • Design, develop, and implement innovative provider programs and capabilities that improve provider engagement, operational effectiveness, and overall network performance

  • Evaluate existing provider programs and processes to identify opportunities for modernization, simplification, scalability, and measurable improvement

  • Translate emerging business needs, industry trends, and operational insights into future-state strategies and actionable provider solutions

What We Prefer

  • Demonstrated experience developing, launching, or transforming innovative and emerging provider programs, rather than solely administering established network programs
  • Experienced identifying new approaches to provide engagement, collaboration, performance, or network management and translating concepts into scalable programs and operations solutions
  • Strong problem-solving skills, effective interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to develop and maintain strong and effective business relationships
  • Ability to act in a strong consultative and influencer role across all levels of leadership, including executive leaders
  • Ability to balance innovation with operational feasibility, scalability, provider experience, regulatory requirements, and measurable business outcomes.

What We Require

  • 6+ years related work experience
  • 3+ years direct supervisory/management experience
  • Related Bachelor's degree or additional related equivalent work experience

General Physical Demands

  • Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects.

  • Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.

  • Must be able to travel occasionally to multiple locations for work (i.e. travel to attend meetings, events, conferences).

What We Offer


As a Florida Blue employee, you will be at the heart of GuideWell's vision – to lead the nation in transforming health through compassionate, connected, and technology-enabled care that delivers personalized value and empowered living.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days
  • Additional voluntary benefits available; and a comprehensive wellness program


Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Typical Annualized Offer/Hiring Range: $109,300 - $136,600

Annualized Salary Range: $109,300 - $177,600

Final pay will be determined with consideration of market competitiveness, internal equity, and the job-related knowledge, skills, training, and experience you bring.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to cultivating a work experience where everyone feels like they belong and can perform at their best in pursuit of our mission. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

Job.JobDescription:
Job Description

Consultants are seasoned, subject matter experts who apply specialized knowledge, typically as an individual contributor, in matters that require special interpretation or expertise. Incumbents use their discipline-specific and/or institutional knowledge to perform department activities. They participate in and/or lead critical, high-risk, complex initiatives, programs, and projects, have frequent contact with internal and external business partners, facilitate/ influence strategic thinking and direction and influence peers and leaders across the organization to act on issues that have organization-wide impact. Incumbents may directly manage a small number of employees (two or less); the primary function of the role is consulting.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Understands strategic direction of business unit and the organization
  • Provides consultative support to organization management within context of overall strategic objectives and broad policy; typically supports senior management.
  • Provide expertise on and/or lead critical or complex initiatives and projects from concept through analysis and design to operational business readiness and implementation
  • Lead the design and development and/or integration of complex tools, systems, processes, programs, network expansions, etc. that directly impact business decisions and objectives.
  • Advise management on options, opportunities, risks, solutions, cost versus benefits and impacts on business processes, systems, employees, etc. Influence and gain acceptance of ideas and suggestions.
  • Rapidly learn current processes and constraints to develop vision and design of optimal business processes
  • Manage relationships and work successfully across technology and business stakeholders, including peer level through executive level
  • Has frequent contact with internal and external business partners to obtain and share information for influencing decisions, selling concepts, and/or providing advice and counsel that impacts business objectives including provider program initiatives/network compliance efforts and network strategies.
  • Acts as communications lead for department. Expertise in document creation and communications at all levels. Communication includes messaging and presentations to all levels throughout the organization including playbook management for network programs. Acts as spokesperson for leadership, as appropriate.
  • Expert analytical abilities and the ability to use data to “hone in” on and determine the highest value efforts to pursue.
  • May oversee reporting, monitoring, and evaluation activities.
  • May lead, coach, and develop a small staff.
  • Serve as Subject Matter Expert and mentor others.

What We Require

  • 5+ years related work experience in Healthcare, Network Management
  • Related Bachelor's degree or additional related equivalent work experience

What We Prefer

  • Proficiency with Microsoft suite of tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  • Master's degree

The Claims Examiner works with a sense of urgency, understands insurance coverage concepts, and navigates the legal system with the support of counsel to drive strategic outcomes.

Manages all aspects of a moderately complex claims inventory

  • Effectively communicates with policyholders, agents, attorneys, and witnesses to gather information and provide the highest possible level of customer service.

  • Utilizes appropriate resolution tactics (e.g., mediation, negotiation, denial, litigation or offer) to proactively drive outstanding results.
  • Operates within the requirements of related state and/or the governing entity rules and regulations as well as internal claims handling policies and procedures.

This position has no supervisory responsibility

Job.JobDescription:
The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth. This program offers students meaningful, real-world experience while building foundational technical and business skills in a Fortune 500 organization.


Job Purpose

The Claims Operations Intern will gain hands-on experience within residential property claims while learning how different teams contribute to the customer experience and claim lifecycle. Working alongside experienced Claims professionals, the intern will assist with operational activities, participate in cross-functional learning opportunities, and explore areas such as claim processing, quality, compliance, transformation, subrogation, training, and customer service.


In addition to day-to-day business assignments, the intern will complete a summer project focused on a meaningful Claims opportunity or business challenge. The intern will gather information, analyze findings, develop recommendations, and present the project's results to Claims team members and leaders.


This position is designed for a student interested in insurance, business operations, risk management, customer experience, or a related field.



What You Will Do

  • Learn how residential property claims are reviewed, documented, processed, and resolved.
  • Support operational activities involving claim documentation, reporting, workflow management, quality review, and process improvement.
  • Work with Claims professionals across different business areas to understand their responsibilities and contributions to the claim lifecycle.
  • Assist with research, data gathering, analysis, and documentation supporting current business priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve a Claims process, workflow, technology, training approach, or customer experience.
  • Complete a structured summer project with clear objectives, milestones, and measurable deliverables.
  • Present project findings, insights, and recommendations to Claims colleagues and leaders.
  • Participate in team meetings, professional-development activities, mentorship, and the enterprise internship learning program.

What You Will Learn

  • How Claims Operations supports customers and the broader business.
  • How quality, compliance, customer service, technology, and operational processes influence claim outcomes.
  • How different Claims teams collaborate to address business needs and improve the customer experience.
  • How to research a business problem, analyze information, and develop practical recommendations.
  • How to communicate findings and present ideas to business partners and leaders.
  • How to work effectively in a professional, cross-functional environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • You are enrolled in a bachelor's degree program and will have at least one semester remaining following the summer internship.
  • You have an expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2028.
  • You are available to participate in the full internship program from May 17, 2027 through August 7, 2027.
  • You are proficient with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • You possess effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • You demonstrate strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • You can manage multiple assignments and meet established deadlines.
  • You can work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
  • You can handle customer and company information with discretion and confidentiality.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Pursuing a bachelor's degree in business administration, insurance, risk management, finance, communications, operations, or a related field.
  • Interest in claims, insurance operations, customer experience, or process improvement.
  • Previous customer service, administrative, office, or internship experience.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
  • Comfort working in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, procedures, and business needs.
  • Customer-focused mindset with an interest in helping others.
  • Experience using Excel to organize, review, or analyze information.

What Makes You a Good Fit

  • Organized and detail-oriented.
  • Curious and eager to learn.
  • Customer-focused and empathetic.
  • Dependable and accountable.
  • Comfortable asking questions and receiving feedback.
  • Proactive in identifying problems and proposing solutions.
  • Able to balance accuracy with productivity.
  • Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively.

Internship Experience

As a Claims Processing Operations Intern, you will receive:

  • A structured onboarding experience.
  • An assigned manager and opportunities for mentorship.
  • Hands-on assignments that support real business needs.
  • Exposure to experienced Claims and Operations professionals.
  • Professional-development and networking opportunities.
  • Ongoing coaching and performance feedback.
  • A meaningful internship project with an opportunity to present your work.

Remote Opportunity

Job Description

Aon is looking for a Partner, Human Capital M&A Solutions! - Multiple Locations: Chicago, Dallas, Houston, Atlanta or San Francisco

The Practice:

Aon's Human Capital M&A team partners with organizations undertaking global transactions and business transformations, including M&A, divestitures, IPOs and joint ventures. We bring deep global expertise - spanning global benefits, compensation, employment, talent, organization design, culture, due diligence and integration, workforce planning, HR risk assessments, and other strategic people-related projects - to help clients successfully navigate complex deals and transformations. This role reports to the Human Capital M&A Leader, North America.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

The Partner will be based in North America and will be accountable for driving the strategic direction, operational effectiveness and financial performance of complex human capital solutions for clients undergoing significant change events. The Partner will be a senior leader in the Human Capital M&A consulting profession, with deep knowledge across multiple HR fields (e.g., global benefits, compensation, talent, employment, organization design, culture, workforce planning) and a strong understanding of Aon's core businesses. We are looking for leadership that is encouraged by deep content expertise, strong commercial judgment and a desire to drive growth in a fast-paced, deal-focused environment.

The Partner will develop, nurture and maintain executive-level relationships and serve as a trusted advisor to many of Aon's most important clients. Partners at Aon have the capability and expertise to serve as overall engagement leaders and executive sponsors for large, sophisticated, multi-functional client assignments, coordinating across multiple stakeholders, partners and workstreams. This is also a hands-on role where you will take ownership, prioritize the work, and roll up your sleeves on a technical level - from structuring Human Capital M&A workplans and HR due diligence through to designing integration, separation, value creation and value capture plans across the HR operating environment.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Establish and sustain trusted relationships with senior client partners, including C-suite executives and HR leaders.
  • Demonstrate strong executive presence and facilitation skills to lead complex, multi-workstream client engagements and deal programs
  • Exhibit deep knowledge of the complexities and risks associated with global M&A transactions (including diligence, planning and execution across buy-side, sell-side, carve-outs and joint ventures)
  • Convey deep experience and subject matter expertise of Total Rewards and other sectors within the Human Capital space (e.g., global benefits, compensation, talent, HR operating model, culture, organization design, workforce and location strategy).
  • Own the development, commercialization and scaling of differentiated Human Capital M&A solutions, ensuring market relevance, client value, delivery quality and sustainable profitability
  • Connect human capital priorities to transaction objectives, value creation and risk mitigation, and translate strategy into executable workplans
  • Communicate complex human capital and deal issues as clear, actionable recommendations for senior client and Aon leaders
  • Collaborative and highly engaged, able to lead and work effectively with cross-functional teams across Aon and within client organizations
  • Accountable and self-aware, with strong ownership, sound judgment and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced, results-focused environment
  • An influencer who can drive alignment and decision-making across diverse collaborators in both client and internal settings
  • Drive profitable growth through business development, thought leadership, cross-solution collaboration, opportunity origination, proposal development and new client acquisition
  • Mentor and develop colleagues across the practice, helping build the next generation of Human Capital M&A leaders through coaching, feedback and sponsorship!

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Management, Human Resources or other relevant fields
  • Typically 12+ years of relevant consulting and/or industry experience, including significant exposure to global M&A or other complex transaction and transformation environments

Skills: Workforce Strategy, Sales, Risk Management, Report Writing, Project Management, Meeting Facilitation, Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A), Human Resource Management, Financial Analysis, Data Management, Data Analysis, Consulting, Change Management, Business Development, Business Communications, Business Analysis, Budgeting

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon's annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

We Offer You:

Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon's discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance. This role does not accrue vacation. Rather, this role is eligible to take paid time off at the discretion of the employee and management in accordance with company policy and practices. Various other types of leaves of absence; paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies.

  • Develop and maintain medium-term workforce forecasts (up to 6 weeks), including workload, staffing capacity, and shrinkage planning.

Requirements

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Reside in or near Philadelphia, PA area.
  • 2-3 years previous experience as outside adjuster is highly desired.
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

Required Qualifications:

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on either a one to two-story roof.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job

** Please note, you will be required to attend 2-weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX **

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign On Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Job Description

Join Allstate's Data & Analytics Technology team and help build the next generation of enterprise AI and data platforms on Microsoft Fabric.

We are seeking an experienced AI Cloud Platform Engineer to help design, build, and operate scalable, resilient, and high-performance data platforms that power enterprise analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, and advanced data products. This role is responsible for developing and optimizing a Unified Data Analytics Platform using cloud-native Microsoft Fabric technologies.

As an AI Cloud Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and implementing intelligent, automated, and agentic AI-driven solutions that enhance the security, governance, reliability, and operational excellence of the enterprise data platform. You will work closely with analytics engineers, data architects, data scientists, and product teams to deliver innovative capabilities that enable trusted, self-service, and enterprise-scale data consumption.

You'll have the opportunity to influence platform strategy, and deliver solutions that empower data-driven decision-making at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participates in iteration planning to ensure the team shares a common understanding of backlog stories, features, and technical chores.
  • Helps execute the product strategy with customer needs and outcomes as priorities.
  • Works with team members to design scalable systems, applications, and data solutions.
  • Participates in daily site, cross-site, and product team standups.
  • Uses Agentic AI-assisted development capabilities, including GitHub Copilot and similar coding assistants, to accelerate code generation, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while following enterprise governance standards.
  • Contributes to retrospectives by gathering feedback and identifying actionable improvements for the team and product.
  • Supports software products and platforms in production and user environments.
  • Shares knowledge and contributes to the continuous development of the teams collective expertise.
  • Applies paired programming, test-driven development (TDD), and modern software engineering practices to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Establishes and maintains Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and practices.
  • Collaborates on designing and implementing AI-enabled applications, automation workflows, and intelligent developer experiences where appropriate.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and supporting enterprise-scale data platforms and pipelines.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL , and modern data engineering practices.
  • Strong hands-on experience with GitHub, Key vault, and REST API (integration 7 automation).
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure platform, or comparable cloud analytics platforms.
    Experience with Terraform/Jenkins, or comparable CI/CD.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, source control, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automated testing practices.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered engineering tools and Agentic AI-assisted software development practices.
  • Strong understanding of distributed computing, performance tuning, scalability, fault tolerance, and data reliability.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and implementing enterprise data products within Microsoft Fabric.
  • Knowledge of data governance and data quality frameworks.
  • Cloud or data engineering certifications in Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or related technologies.

Experience

  • 3 or more years of experience (Preferred)

#LI-TE1

Skills

Anthropic Claude Code, Cloud Platform, GitHub Copilot, Jenkins (Software), Python (Programming Language), Software Development, Terraform (Software), Terraform on Microsoft Azure

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 85,000.00 - 145,075.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Summit provides independent insurance agents and their clients with market-leading workers' comp insurance and elite customer service. We're growing and currently serve more than 7,000 independent agents and 31,000 policyholders across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic.

Our strength comes from a single-minded focus on workers' comp and a commitment to long-term customer relationships. Summit is who you turn to when you need a specialist who not only knows workers' comp but also gets to know your business and your priorities.

Our field team members are located in every state in which we operate.

Summit is a member of the Great American Insurance Group where our highest goal is for all employees to feel included, respected, and empowered to perform at their best.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Summit's superregional growth continues. We currently serve 17 states. And in 2026, our expansion will include Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, and Washington D.C., with Missouri and additional states to follow.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities

  • This position is a field role within the Charlotte, NC or Greensboro, NC territory.
  • Develops strategic marketing plans, considering agency strengths, competitors, and market conditions.
  • Identifies and secures profitable new business opportunities in target markets and develops and implements strategic plans, resulting in a specified increase in market share.
  • Cultivates and maintains strong relationships with key agencies by providing tailored insurance solutions that meet their specific needs, leading to an increase in agency retention and satisfaction. Educates agencies on product features, market placement, and effective selling techniques.
  • Drives revenue growth by achieving or exceeding sales targets. May develop and execute cross-selling and up-selling strategies
  • Conducts market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats, informing strategic decision-making.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

#LI-Remote

Job Requirements

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

Experience: Generally, a minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic business development, marketing, or a related role. Completion of or continuing progress toward certifications including Associate in Underwriting (AU), Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU), Certified Insurance Counselor (CIC), Program in General Insurance (INS) or Associate of Risk Management (ARM).

Scope of Job/Qualifications: Strong understanding of agency dynamics, marketing, underwriting, and risk management. Demonstrates excellent communication skills and ability to build relationships. Proficiency in interpreting competitive data and industry trends. Ensures compliance with insurance laws and regulations, applying underwriting rules, guidelines, and rating manual standards. Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform decisions. Demonstrated decision-making ability and customer-centric mindset. Position requires frequent day and overnight travel (60% - 80% of time) to visit agents and brokers.

SCI Summit Consulting, LLC

Full-time and eligible part-time employees also enjoy Paid Time Off and paid holidays, a 401(k) plan with company match, an employee stock purchase plan, and commuter benefits.

As a theme park built around a working movie studio, were all about lights, camera, action. Working with us means thriving in a fast-paced environment as we work as a team to create a seamless experience for our guests. From Attractions, to Parking, to Wardrobe, to Park Services, and more, here you can be part of a team that helps make memorable moments for our guests each and every day. Join us for a once in a lifetime opportunity.Join our team as a Park Services Attendant, where youll thrive in a fast-paced environment dedicated to maintaining the cleanliness and appearance of our park. In this role, youll ensure the overall upkeep of park grounds, facilities, parking lots, break areas, and the tram route, contributing to a clean, safe, and welcoming atmosphere for guests and team members alike. Working both independently and collaboratively, youll demonstrate accountability and attention to detail while addressing cleaning needs efficiently. Your ability to interact positively with guests of all ages and team members, along with handling high-pressure situations with professionalism, will help enhance the overall park experience.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary admission to Universal Studios Hollywood and all Universal Theme parks
  • Earn complimentary tickets for your friends and family
  • Discounts on food and merchandise
  • Special events for employees (preview nights for new attractions/events)
  • Building lifelong friendships
  • Resume building workshops
  • Growth opportunities 
  • Wellness programs

Responsibilities:

  • Sweep the park and the queue lines after every show, mop any spills, clean props and trashcans.
  • Empty all trashcans in an assigned area, which includes the restaurants, merchandise stores, attractions, guests walkways and behind the scenes. Replace the liner in trashcans. Compact the trash, transport trash to compactor for disposal. Clean out cart.
  • Set up for special events and other assigned areas, moving and staging of tables, barricades, carpets and umbrellas. Mounting and movement of signage.
  • May operate department specific equipment including carpet cleaner, vacuum, water extractor, floor scrubber, compactor, etc.
  • Understand & comprehend various venues; understand venue areas standard operating procedures
  • Promote and provide extraordinary guest service for both internal and external guests; answer questions and offer information in a courteous manner. Seek to provide assistance to guests, where appropriate.
  • Understand and demonstrate the proper use of safety practices and ensure department standards are maintained and safety policies for the Park upheld.
  • Sweep and inspect the restroom upon request to include: Keep restrooms clean which includes wiping mirrors and countertops, empty trashcans, clean up any toilets or urinals, sweep and mop floors. Maintains organization and stock of toiletries in the restrooms. Keep towels, toilet paper, seat covers, and soap dispensers filled. Report any maintenance concerns.
  • Monitor and maintain a safe and secure environment for both team members and guests of all ages, following all company guidelines and protocols.
  • Identify, de-escalate, and resolve conflicts or disturbances professionally and effectively to maintain a positive atmosphere.
  • Provide a positive and welcoming experience for guests of all ages while maintaining composure during difficult interactions.
  • Maintain a high level of trust and integrity to promote a safe, secure, and welcoming environment for customers and colleagues of all ages.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Job Demands:

  • Must be able to walk or stand for extended periods of time
  • Must regularly lift and/or move up to 25lbs, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 lbs with assistance
  • The noise level is generally moderate to high
  • Team Members are subject to a variety of weather conditions, including but not limited to: heat, sun exposure, cold, and inclement weather. Depending on the assigned location, work can be almost exclusively outdoors

Schedule:

  • Must be available to work at least 4 days per week throughout the peak seasons to include a rotation of mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays

Pay:

  • $19.50 per hour (After 1,000 hours worked, pay increases to $23.92/hr)

Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for coordinating the overall day-to-day operation for Universal Kids Resorts on-site hotel including overall support of all departments reporting to the Director/General Manager. Supports the overall operation by assisting with Team Member communication, training, housekeeping inventory processes, procurement of operating materials/supplies, and the submission/tracking of Purchase Requisitions. Assists with administrative support and liaisons with third-party service documentation, reporting, and overall hotel communications.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assists and supports management in the administrative tasks and responsibilities associated with all departments within the Hotel, including but not limited to the Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage Operations, Culinary, Security, Lost & Found Program, pool, banquet events, and third-party vendors. Supports the Managers in each of the respective departments by coordinating with UDX stakeholders, third-party service providers, and inter-departmental communications.
  • Coordinates with Hotel management for daily staffing requirements, access, and concerns with 3rd party vendors including outsourced laundry, deep cleaning, and various other services. Ensures entry access and regulatory measures are communicated and followed. Resolves and eases sensitive internal/external situations through collaboration across departments in a timely manner to ensure continuous operation.
  • Assists and supports Front Office and Housekeeping with various administrative tasks and responsibilities, including but not limited to the UKR Lost & Found Program, stock operations, and completion of consolidation and transfer requests. Conducts, uploads and research cycle counts, ensuring damaged housekeeping items and special guest requests are recorded properly and timely. Research and resolve unreceived transfers.
  • Analyzes, compiles, updates, and maintains department data on spreadsheets. Completes necessary documentation for hotel supply orders and service requests. Drives communication throughout the hotel and in partnership with UKR theme park for a seamless Team Member experience. Provides appropriate documentation and addresses department inquiries and escalations. Routinely audits Front Office and Housekeeping storage locations to ensure quality and safety standards.
  • Partners with Digital & Technology and other UDX departments in ensuring the seamless operation of Opera Property Management Systems. Supports troubleshooting efforts and communicating system enhancement requests and issues to proper UDX team.
  • Provides clerical support to all Hotel departments by creating communications, presentations, and corresponding materials while maintaining equipment inventory, product assistance, and sourcing requests. Supports Hotel leadership in maintaining all regulatory training tracking, Environmental, Health & Safety training and compliance efforts, and updating standard operating procedures and documentation.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Must be able to identify and resolve problems in a timely manner.
  • Ability to balance multiple tasks at any given time with strong organizational skills.

  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

Job.JobTitle: Technician, Facilities Maintenance - Universal Kids Resort (3rd Shift)
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Construction & Skilled Trades, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for the facilities maintenance of Universal Kids Resort buildings and designated areas. Completes specific work orders, installations, routine/preventative maintenance and repairs as assigned including, but not limited to, masonry, tile, pavers, cubicle partitions, furniture, scenic paint, roofing, and woodwork. Handles daily repair and troubleshooting tasks from Technical Services leadership. Completes special projects and other shop work as directed by Facilities Management to uphold show quality and standards. 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Responsible for the maintenance and repairs for rough in carpentry to include, but not limited to, framing, sheet goods, wood decking and dock work as well as repairing wood metal stud work, and trim work including various moldings, turnings, laminate application, cabinet work, and window and door installation. Consistently provides routine/preventative maintenance in efforts to minimize the number of major repairs required, escalating to Facilities Management to address any major venue concerns when necessary. Ensures work area is clean and safe with tools and materials stored in designated storage areas and materials properly disposed of.
  • Performs routine inspection and maintenance of seating, furniture, restroom stall doors and partitions. Completes repairs and finishing to various walkways and roadways throughout the resort. Manages the preparation and painting of designated areas across UKR by determining color, mixing paint, prepping surface by cleaning, scraping, caulking, applying, putty, and sanding and applying paint. Maintains scenic aesthetic through painting techniques to include brushing, rolling, blending, spraying, and faux finishing based off of original creative intent.
  • Responsible for the installation and repairs to exterior finishes including, but not limited to Dry-Vit, EIFIS and Stucco. Fabricates tooling (molds) when multiple parts are needed. Maintains the roof surfaces of buildings, performs roof, gutter/downspout, window leak and other water infiltration repairs and preventative maintenance, and completes specific work orders for masonry, tile, pavers, and woodwork.
  • Installs and makes repairs to interior wall, floor tiles, coverings made of various materials, and to various commercial hardware, including but not limited to, door closures, panic hardware, mortis and cylindrical locks. Assists with creating, installing and removing specialized signage throughout UKR which may require the use of a High Reach to access.
  • Enters follow-up work orders for all discrepancies found in a timely manner. Documents all findings and work performed throughout the process of troubleshooting and performing repairs. Reports on labor in Maximo for all work performed. Demonstrates the ability to acquire skills in additional disciplines to support a broader range of operational and project needs. 
  • Completes preventative maintenance and show quality checks across the theme park. Trains new Technicians to do work orders, recovery procedures, and processes. Assists with seasonal weather condition sustainment initiatives as directed. 
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Individual Contributor

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.
  • Previous facility maintenance experience is preferred.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED is required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years of experience in general carpentry, construction, or roofing is required, experience within a seasonal/regional theme park is a plus; or equivalent combination of education and experience

 

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Supports management in directing and coordinating activities of Facilities functions and maintenance efforts at the Universal Kids Resort Hotel. Provides work direction and leads the daily tasks of Team Member work to support the completion of assigned work orders, preventative maintenance, routine and emergency repairs, and special projects. Leads the team by overseeing shifts, opening and closing procedures, completion of specific work orders, handling daily trouble calls and completing administrative duties in support of Facilities Management and compliance requirements. The Security Administrator supports daily security monitoring, alert triage, and evidence collection to protect Church Mutual's systems and data. This role executes defined operational tasks, follows runbooks, and develops foundational technical skills essential for cybersecurity operations. This role requires foundational hands-on technical proficiency in core security tools and concepts. Individuals without demonstrated technical capability will not meet expectations at this level.

 

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist in investigating and reporting detected cyber incidents by following established procedures, under close supervision and with frequent guidance.
  • Support system cybersecurity monitoring operations by performing routine checks and escalating issues to senior team members as directed.
  • Participate in basic cyber incident triage to help determine scope and urgency, always working with guidance from experienced analysts.
  • Identify obvious vulnerabilities using provided tools and checklists, and report findings to senior staff for further action.
  • Use computer network defense (CND) tools (such as IDS alerts, firewall logs, and host system logs) to collect data as instructed, without independent analysis.
  • Document incident activities by completing standard forms and logs, ensuring all entries are reviewed by a supervisor.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis by gathering information and assisting senior analysts, rather than conducting independent investigations.
  • Stay informed about cybersecurity threats and best practices through assigned training and regular team briefings.
  • Help maintain the Security Technology stack by performing basic tasks as assigned and under supervision.
  • Respond to active attacks in cloud and on-premises environments by following detailed instructions from senior team members.
  • Provide input on threat protection practices by sharing observations with the team, rather than making recommendations.
  • Report suspected violations of organizational policies to supervisors for further review.
  • Support risk mitigation efforts by carrying out exposure management tasks as directed.
  • Participate in the development of enterprise-wide security architectures and standards by attending meetings and documenting discussions, not by designing solutions.
  • Assist with baseline and risk assessments by collecting data and completing checklists under supervision.
  • Provide basic cybersecurity consultation and participate in enterprise-wide health checks as part of a team, with guidance.
  • Research cybersecurity threats as assigned and assist in responding to incidents by gathering information.
  • Help maintain the enterprise cybersecurity risk register by entering data as directed.
  • Assist with cybersecurity investigations and forensic activities by performing basic data collection and documentation.
  • Support management of intrusion prevention systems and help define endpoint protection policies by executing routine tasks.
  • Triage advanced threat detection (ATD) alerts by following predefined rules and escalating anything unusual.
  • Provide basic advice and assistance to staff on cybersecurity matters, always referring complex questions to senior analysts.
  • Participate in training sessions and stay updated on cybersecurity and communication technologies as part of ongoing development.
  • Level Expectations (Performance and Scope Indicators)

The following outlines how performance is evaluated at this level. These are not additional job responsibilities, but indicators of scope, autonomy, impact, and influence expected of this role.

Scope: Executes clearly defined cybersecurity tasks related to monitoring, alert triage, and data collection. Contributes to incident response, vulnerability management, and security operations under close guidance.

Autonomy: Operates with frequent supervision. Follows documented runbooks. Escalates issues consistently. Expected to develop foundational technical skills but not yet independently solve complex problems.

Impact: Supports the accuracy, speed, and consistency of core security operations. Ensures reliable first-level triage and data gathering that downstream engineers rely on.

People Influence: No formal influence responsibilities. Collaborates as part of the team. May provide peer support but does not mentor.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • Foundational technical fluency in cybersecurity concepts and tools.
  • Ability to interpret basic SIEM/NDR/EDR alerts.
  • Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, identity basics, and endpoint behavior.
  • Ability to execute documented runbooks accurately.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation quality.
  • Degree in CS/IS/Cybersecurity or equivalent experience/training.

Technical Competencies

  • Ability to extract data from basic logs.
  • Familiarity with Defender, Sentinel, or similar tooling.
  • Ability to recognize anomalous behavior and escalate appropriately.

Preferred

  • Security+ or SC-200 coursework/certification.
  • Experience in SOC, IT support, or network operations.

Description

Liberty Mutual has an immediate opening for a Claims Manager II position for our Commercial Insurance Casualty leadership. The Claims Manager II plans, organizes, and directs the Commercial Casualty claims handling activities within an Excess Claims team. In this role, you will achieve superior claims outcomes through effective workforce management, quality service delivery, and the use of technology, data analytics, and processes/programs.

Please note we have in-office requirements of at least twice a month if you reside within a 50-mile radius of any of these Commercial Claims offices: Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; Suwanee, GA; Westborough, MA; or Weatogue, CT. This requirement is subject to change.

Responsibilities

    • Manages team to ensure that adequate resources and technical skills exist to handle complex, high-exposure Excess claims in accordance with Company service standards and expectations.
    • Drive a culture of urgency, accountability, disciplined collaboration, and clear communication.
    • Partner effectively with internal and external stakeholders - including Underwriting, Legal, Reinsurance, Brokers, Insureds, Counsel - to align on claim strategy and achieve optimal outcomes.
    • Model strong leadership and decision-making in a dynamic environment where priorities, exposures, and stakeholders' needs can shift quickly.
    • Actively attracts, develops, and engages talented claims employees while simultaneously addressing employees who are not meeting expectations.
    • Focuses staff on continuous improvement, engaging in the transformation and sustainability efforts, looking for ways to build capabilities, and driving organizational effectiveness.
    • Participates in short to medium-term strategic business planning.
    • Reviews and approves, within assigned authority limits, claim expenses and settlements that exceed the claims employee's authority level appropriately refers claim expenses and settlements that exceed personal authority limits for approval.
    • Monitors and evaluates the claims reserve practices within the office and ensures that actual reserves are accurate and established promptly.
    • Prepares and distributes management reports analyzing and documenting office operations and performance identifies, analyzes and reports on claims processing trends and issues.
    • Maintains awareness of existing and proposed legislation, court decisions and emerging trends in claims litigation to monitor the company's compliance with state and federal legislation.

Qualifications

  • Advanced knowledge of Commercial Claims (Excess and Specialized, General Liability, Environmental, etc.), claims investigation, coverage evaluation, loss assessment, reserving, insurance legal & regulatory environment, claims processes, applications/systems and procedures, medical terminology, and finance
  • Demonstrated ability to direct the work of others, implement strategies and plans created by senior leaders, develop staff, and achieve goals/objectives the right way
  • Other skills required include: planning/organizing work, communication (listening, delivering complex messages, gaining support, promoting collaboration, etc.), diplomacy/tact, business/financial acumen, and adaptability
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and 7+ years of progressively more responsible related work experience
  • Claims Management experience preferred.
  • Complex Commercial Casualty claims experience required.

  • Retire from the office but not from work.
  • Eliminate the office stress and the commute.
  • Choose the work you would like to do now.
