  • Utilize your years of insurance industry knowledge.
  • Be part of our dynamic yet virtual team environment and connect with other experienced insurance professionals like yourself!

HOW TO GET STARTED

WE LOOK FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!

Job Description


The Advanced IT Business Systems Analyst helps client areas achieve their objectives by serving as a resource in the analysis of business and user needs, application of technology solutions. Lead the integration of multiyear projects with the highest levels of risk, complexity, budget dollars and impact to the business. Oversees the preparation of technical documentation including flow charts, models, procedures, user guides, scorecards and reporting. Provides consultation to define and achieve objectives, identify risk, and implement technology solutions. Conducts feasibility studies, prepares user stories/business requirements, and writes system and programming specifications to support the design of possible technology solutions. Provides input into cost estimations and project plans. Supports user acceptance testing, documentation/reporting, and production support. Oversees root-cause analysis and issue resolution for the ongoing operation and maintenance of technology solutions. The Advanced IT Business Systems Analyst possesses extensive knowledge of assigned business area(s) operations and a strong knowledge of the IT systems/applications used. May participate on an agile development team. Assigned to complex projects, systems or initiatives. Advanced IT Business Systems Analysts lead efforts, oversee work results, provide training and serve as a mentor for other IT Business Systems Analysts.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Provides oversight as well as serves as the functional and technical lead during development, implementation, and testing of highly complex projects
  • Drives business architecture design (including Business Process), capability roadmap development and strategy development for the domain
  • Responsible for leading/facilitating business requirements gathering and determining technical impacts
  • Reviews and clarifies user stories and user acceptance criteria with the stakeholders, and works with development lead/technical architect to layout technical design
  • Assumes the role of product owner as necessary
  • Leads the development of system related documentation that includes flow charts, work flow tables, mapping documents, integration specifications and provides system training
  • Develops an extensive understanding of the business unit's function and effectively communicates technical issues and solutions in non-technical terms to the business unit
  • Produces detailed functional requirements and/or user stories, including non-functional requirements
  • Provides oversight for the development of user acceptance criteria, test plans and test cases. Oversees functional/user testing (User Acceptance Testing) and accountable for user sign off of changes
  • Monitors system implementation ensuring user satisfaction and be comfortable with being hands on in support of implemented solutions. – Operational readiness, Implementation/Warranty Support, Production support, Project analytics and reporting


What We Require

  • 4+ years related work experience in Application development and/or systems analysis role

  • Related Bachelor's degree or additional related equivalent work experience IT related field

  • Thorough knowledge of Information Technology fields and computer systems

  • Demonstrated organizational, analytical and interpersonal skills

  • Strong understanding of integration points of assigned business/systems and processes

  • Proven leadership abilities including effective knowledge sharing, conflict resolution, facilitation of open discussions, fairness and displaying appropriate levels of assertiveness

  • Proficient in requirements gathering methodologies and the SDLC

  • Understanding of a variety of architecture standards and ability to apply them in their design work

  • Ability to communicate highly complex technical information clearly and articulately for all levels and audiences
    Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment

  • High critical thinking skills to evaluate alternatives and present solutions that are consistent with business objectives and strategy.

  • Extensive knowledge and experience of systems, subsystems, development methodologies, systems architecture, tools and processes that support the assigned business initiative or system.

  • Experience in applying research methodology to business solutions.

  • Knowledge of systems development concepts and methods

  • Experience with business requirements and business process analysis to ensure IT solutions meet the business needs

  • Experience managing multiple priorities and ability to facilitate adoption of changing priorities

  • Thorough industry knowledge in related business area and understanding of impact on the organization.

  • Demonstrated negotiation skills and ability to build relationships.

  • Excellent communication skills including ability to explain complex technical concepts in a clear and concise manner to audiences with diverse knowledge base.

What We Prefer

  • Experience using Agile methodology Healthcare industry related experience

  • Understanding of payment processing workflows , including authorization, settlement, refunds, payment methods, recurring payments

  • Experience analyzing business requirements and supporting payment processing systems, including payment gateway integrations, electronic payments (ACH and credit/debit cards), recurring payments, and payment transaction lifecycles.

  • Familiarity with payment platforms such as Stripe and payment security standards (PCI DSS) is a plus.

General Physical Demands

  • Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.

  • This position offers a hybrid work arrangement which combines flexibility with in office engagement. Team schedules are determined based on role requirements and business needs. Travel to and from our corporate offices may be required.

Job Description

Job Summary:
Will be responsible for supporting Actuarial Leadership.


Essential Functions:
The essential functions listed represent the major duties of this role, additional duties may be assigned
Managing Actuaries typically manage one or more direct reports and are responsible for their team's work, reviews, and development, as well as being responsible for producing their own work
Managing Actuaries participate in the Actuarial Rotation program which provides the opportunity to rotate to a different team every 3-4 years. Rotations can be internal (core Actuarial, such as Commercial/Medicare pricing and reserves) or external (non-Actuarial teams with Actuarial-related work, such as Segment, Value-Based Provider Analytics, Financial Performance and Analysis, Pharmacy Analytics, etc.)
Support pricing, trend analytics, gross margin reporting, and financial reporting related to ACA, Medicare, Group, Reserves, Segment, and other teams
Actuarial representation on cross-functional workgroups as an active participant

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, make a positive impact in our community, and be rewarded for your success.

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. As a valued team member, you will be eligible for a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, a health savings account with an annual employer contribution, a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous employer match, paid time off plus 11 paid federal holidays, training and professional development programs, tuition reimbursement, reduced fees and rates on certain loan products, and much more!

Ready to lead with confidence and make a meaningful impact? Apply now and become part of our dedicated banking family!

About the Assistant Branch Manager Role

Join Our Dynamic Banking Team and Lead with Excellence!


Are you a motivated leader with a passion for delivering exceptional customer service and driving branch success? We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Assistant Branch Manager to support our Branch Manager in orchestrating the seamless operation of our branch, fostering a trusted environment, and elevating the customer experience. This pivotal role offers the chance to influence our community's financial well-being and grow professionally within a reputable institution.


As the Assistant Branch Manager, you will be the vital right hand to our Branch Manager, overseeing daily operations, supervising staff, and ensuring our branch functions with efficiency, security, and warmth. Your expertise in residential mortgages, IRA services, and personal banking products will empower you to deliver tailored solutions that meet our clients' needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operational Leadership: Stepping into the Branch Manager's shoes during their absence, managing staff, and maintaining smooth day-to-day operations.
  • Team Supervision: Overseeing Head Teller and Teller teams, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.
  • Branch Branding & Growth: Building a strong branch identity, promoting sales initiatives, and championing exceptional customer service.
  • Customer Engagement: Personally, connecting with clients and prospects, resolving issues efficiently, and ensuring satisfaction aligns with our high standards.
  • Compliance & Accuracy: Reviewing and approving transactions such as large check cashing, bank checks, and ledger entries, while maintaining strict adherence to policies.
  • Performance & Standards: Striving to meet and exceed branch performance metrics, focusing on operational controls, security, and regulatory compliance.
  • Professional Development: Continually enhancing your banking acumen and sales techniques through training, workshops, and ongoing education.

This job description is not exhaustive; duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Proven supervisory and leadership experience
  • Strong customer service background
  • Cash handling expertise
  • Excellent verbal communication skills

  • Fluent in English; bilingual a plus
  • Access to reliable transportation
  • Well-organized and adept at managing multiple priorities
  • Team-oriented with the ability to thrive in collaborative environments
  • Ability to lift 10–20 lbs., stand for extended periods.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Previous banking or financial services experience
  • Familiarity with residential mortgages, IRA services, and personal banking products

Schedule

Full-time position with hours aligned to branch operations:

  • Mon–Wed: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM
  • Thu–Fri: 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM
  • Sat: 8:30 AM – 1:00 PM (rotating schedule)
  • Sun: Closed

Employees may need to remain 15–30 minutes after closing. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required. Occasional travel for training, meetings, or branch support.

About the Mortgage Apprentice Role

At Trustco Bank, we are committed to delivering exceptional service and seamless mortgage experiences. The Mortgage Apprentice participates in a structured training and development program designed to prepare individuals for a career in residential mortgage lending. Apprentices gain hands-on experience, formal training, and mentorship while learning the end-to-end mortgage lending process in a banking environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Learn residential mortgage products, policies, and procedures
  • Assist Mortgage Loan Officers with applications and documentation
  • Collect borrower information and supporting documents
  • Conduct pre-qualification data gathering under supervision
  • Maintain loan files and update systems accurately
  • Provide exceptional customer service to borrowers and referral partners

  • Adhere to all compliance, fair lending, and bank regulations

  • Licensing and education costs covered by the Bank (NMLS, Notary, Lending Certificate)

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • High attention to detail and organizational ability
  • Proficiency with basic computer applications

Preferred

  • Associate or Bachelor's degree in business, finance, or related field
  • Sales, banking, or customer service experience
  • Interest in real estate, mortgage lending, or financial services

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive hourly pay during apprenticeship
  • Eligibility for performance incentives in later program phases
  • Full benefits package (medical, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO)

Career Path

Successful completion of the program may result in placement as:

  • Mortgage Loan Originator
  • Branch Manager
  • Residential Lending Specialist

Travel to and from Albany, NY - Loan Center for training and periodic check-ins

Primarily sedentary role involving standard office activities such as computer work, phone communication, and document handling.

Partners closely with business stakeholders and the technical delivery organization to translate business priorities into executable plans and measurable outcomes.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Serve as the senior role and primary functional point of contact for Salesforce initiatives, managing the product backlog and prioritizing work based on business value, strategic objectives, stakeholder needs, and CRM Product Group Steering Committee alignment.

Collaborate with executives, Producers, Sales teams, Sales Operations, customer service, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, shape Salesforce vision and strategy, and coordinate a multi-year product roadmap and adoption plan.

Bring forward significant business value through creative solutioning; proactively identify opportunities to improve delivered CRM products, streamline the Producer experience, increase Producer productivity, strengthen Salesforce adoption, and improve the velocity and close rate of Opportunities.

Own and coordinate product and program execution across Salesforce initiatives, including roadmap sequencing, delivery planning, dependencies, risks, milestones, stakeholder communications, and business readiness.

Delegate facilitation of Agile ceremonies to Scrum Masters while providing Product Owner direction, priorities, decisions, and context needed for effective sprint planning, daily coordination, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous delivery improvement.

Partner closely with Salesforce developers, administrators, technical architects, DevSecOps resources, Salesforce Solution Architects, Business Architects, and other technical partners to ensure solutions meet business requirements and adhere to applicable standards and best practices

Review and approve solution designs from a business and product perspective, ensuring proposed solutions align with the Salesforce roadmap, business requirements, user experience expectations, and intended business outcomes.

Lead and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), business readiness, stakeholder feedback, defect

prioritization, and business acceptance activities to continuously improve the Salesforce platform and support quality releases.

Provide leadership and governance for quality assurance activities, including test strategy, test planning,

regression coverage, release quality, defect management, and coordination between QA, business stakeholders, and technical delivery teams.

Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and outcome measures for Salesforce initiatives, with particular focus on platform adoption, Producer productivity, stakeholder satisfaction, and team engagement.

Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the CRM Product Group and across functional delivery teams.

Lead and directly manage a multidisciplinary team that includes Project Managers, Scrum Masters, Salesforce

Solution Architects, Business Architects, and Quality Assurance professionals, providing clear direction, coaching, support, and accountability for team success.

Exercise full people-management responsibility, including recruiting, hiring, onboarding, goal setting, regular one[1]on-one meetings, performance management, compensation and promotion recommendations, career development, succession planning, and employee engagement.

Manage team capacity and resource allocation across Salesforce initiatives, balancing priorities and aligning Project Managers, Scrum Masters, Architects, and QA resources to the highest-value work.

Provide leadership and direction to Functional Project Team Members like QA, Solutioning, and Scrum Masters; responsible for program and project execution, ensuring plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, scope, and stakeholder communications remain aligned to product priorities and roadmap outcomes.

Present Salesforce product strategy, roadmap, delivery status, risks, and recommendations to business

stakeholders and senior leadership; coordinate changes when priorities, dependencies, or business direction require adjustment.

Act as the functional delivery counterpart to the technical delivery organization, fostering strong collaboration and communication across product, program, architecture, engineering, administration, DevSecOps, quality assurance, Sales Operations, and business leadership.

Manage supplemental and temporary resources and related vendor performance as needed to support delivery capacity and business priorities.

Empower team members to take ownership of their work while maintaining focus on business value, customer outcomes, quality, collaboration, and timely delivery.

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field; or an

equivalent combination of education and experience.

management, or a similar platform leadership role, with significant responsibility for Salesforce strategy, roadmap, backlog, and delivery.

Salesforce Certified Business Analyst

Step into a high-impact Product Manager role supporting Assurant's manufactured housing insurance business, a growing market with meaningful momentum and demand for affordable housing solutions. In this role, you will connect data, market intelligence, customer needs, product performance, and cross-functional execution to keep the product competitive, profitable, and positioned for long-term growth. You will work across the business, from actuarial and IT to account teams, operations, and product support, to move ideas through filings, implementation, launch, and ongoing optimization.

What makes us different?

  • Join a growing, high-momentum manufactured housing business with strong leadership support and expanding demand for affordable housing solutions.

  • Own broad, end-to-end product work across regions and states rather than a narrow or siloed product assignment.

  • Partner with actuarial, IT, account executives, operations, product support, and other business teams to shape competitive insurance products.

  • Bring data, market insights, competitive intelligence, and product judgment together to influence profitability, competitiveness, and long-term product health.

  • Collaborate with a supportive, team-oriented group that shares ideas, leans on each other's strengths, and values analytical thinking.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage starting day one + 401(k) with a 6% company match + Paid time off, holidays, and a volunteer day + Employee wellness and mental health resources

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Manage manufactured home insurance product work end to end, translating product performance, customer needs, market dynamics, and business objectives into clear product priorities and action.

  • Lead filing-related work, including product research, competitive analysis, actuarial partnership, rate considerations, regulatory filing review, compliance readiness, and implementation planning.

  • Review product performance reports, market trends, customer feedback, release documentation, system guides, workflows, specifications, and other product support materials to ensure teams and partners are ready to execute.

  • Use SQL, product data, and business insights to identify opportunities, track the success of implemented solutions, assess market positioning, and recommend product improvements or differentiation strategies.

  • Drive product initiatives from customer problem identification through requirements development, solution definition, user stories, QA, release coordination, launch readiness, and ongoing performance monitoring.

  • Coordinate across actuarial, IT, account executives, operations, product support, and product teams to resolve issues, align priorities, support market-ready fulfillment, and provide a seamless enterprise experience.

  • Support the full product lifecycle, from ideas and validation through launch, optimization, continuous improvement, best-practice sharing, and retirement while building consensus on execution priorities.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • 5+ years of experience in product analysis or product management role.

  • Strong analytical and SQL skills, and experience using product performance data, customer feedback, market trends, or other business insights to identify opportunities and recommend action.

  • Experience leading or owning multiple stages of the product lifecycle, such as requirements development, launch, implementation, performance monitoring, optimization, or retirement.

  • Bachelor's degree in Insurance, Finance, Business Administration, Marketing, Mathematics, or related field preferred.

  • Experience in P&C insurance product management or financial product management space is preferred.


What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?
Remote, US-based role with standard business hours. General office demands.

How much should I expect to travel?
Team get-togethers and in-person meetings approximately 2-3 times per year.

SUMMARY

Responsible for leading the workplace accommodations process, partnering with employees, HR Business Partners, Legal, and business leaders to deliver thoughtful, compliant, and employee-centric solutions. This role will also help drive scalable programs, policies, and resources that support an inclusive workplace while ensuring compliance with applicable employment laws.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and candidates regarding workplace accommodation requests.

Lead interactive discussions by conducting thorough and respectful accommodation intakes with employees, including gathering information about job limitations, essential job functions, and potential workplace solutions.

Manage a high volume of confidential accommodation cases from intake through implementation, documentation, and follow-up.

Evaluate accommodation requests in accordance with applicable ADA requirements and company policies.

Obtain, review, and appropriately manage supporting medical documentation when necessary and permitted.

Identify potential reasonable accommodations and assess their effectiveness, feasibility, and impact on business operations.

Partner with HR and management to evaluate job functions, including assessing the “essential functions" of a role.

Coordinate accommodation-related leave requests with the internal Leave of Absence (LOA) administrator.

Research and recommend appropriate workplace accommodations, assistive technologies, and workplace modifications in partnership with Facilities, vendors, and other cross-functional teams, as needed.

Job.JobTitle: Sr. Director, Internal Consulting, Op Model Transformation
Job.JobDescription:
Job Description

We are seeking a Sr. Director of Internal Consulting to lead central initiatives for Aon. The role starts with building and carrying out a multi-year strategic overhaul of our Operating Model. Reporting to the leadership team of Aon Business Services (ABS), this role leads internal consulting and program management teams. It involves crafting, orchestrating, and scaling the transformation of the enterprise operating model at Aon. The goal is to improve how we deliver value to clients, colleagues, and other interested parties. This role will engage with senior leaders across Solution Lines, Regions, and Functions. It will also lead a cross‑functional group of internal advisors, project managers, and subject matter experts to deliver measurable performance outcomes.

This role is open to a Virtual or Hybrid colleague based in Central or Eastern Time Zone.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Vision

  • Partner with ABS leadership as well as business leaders, key collaborators, and cross-functional partners to advance the vision, objectives, and scope related to operating model transformation efforts
  • Translate strategic priorities into a clear transformation roadmap with defined business outcomes, benchmarks, and value realization targets
  • Apply structured consulting methodologies (e.g., problem framing, analytical reasoning, benchmarking, argument development) to advise recommendations
  • Develop and validate arguments for operating model changes, including financial, operational, and qualitative benefits

Operating Model Design & Alignment

  • Lead the end‑to‑end diagnostic, build and transition of the target operating model across Aon's Business Units, geographic areas, and departments
  • Translate enterprise strategy into detailed organizational framework components, including capabilities, organizational structure, roles and responsibilities, governance models, and cross functional interaction patterns
  • Be responsible for phased implementation, including pilots, scaling strategies, and stabilization, ensuring alignment with regional and solution line needs
  • Build and maintain operating model blueprints, ensuring all components (capability models, interaction models, RACIs, team structures, decision rights, important metrics) integrate across the enterprise

Stakeholder Engagement & Program Leadership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior executives. Provide insight on opportunities, trade-offs, and risks related to the operating model. Ensure agreement and engagement in strategy and roadmap.
  • Shape and deliver a compelling change narrative that articulates the “why,” “what,” and “how” of the transformation for different audiences
  • Work closely with executive sponsors and the PMO to establish and maintain robust governance, decision‑making, and blocking issue mechanisms
  • Partner with Change & Communications teams to define implications of design changes, highlight required behavior shifts, and identify points of resistance or adoption needs
  • Facilitate executive and working‑level forums to align decisions, resolve conflicts, and maintain momentum

People Leadership & Capability Building

  • Recruit, develop, and mentor a high‑performing team members with capabilities in strategy, transformation, operations, change, and analytics
  • Lead a team of internal consultants and business analysts to diagnose current‑state challenges, define solutions, and support implementation
  • Build consulting capabilities within the broader organization by sharing methodologies, tools, and guidelines
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement
  • Bring together and embed lessons learned into subsequent waves of organizational build changes

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Technology, or related field; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) strongly preferred
  • Proven experience in management consulting, internal strategy/consulting or equivalent internal consulting function, including significant experience at the Director level or above
  • Demonstrated experience leading sophisticated, multi‑workstream operating model or large‑scale transformation programs in a global, matrixed organization, including design, process transition and governance framework setup
  • Experience working in or with professional services, insurance, or financial services environments is highly desirable

Skills & Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to build and coach high‑performing, complementary teams and work effectively across cultures and geographies
  • Ability to operate as a generalist across strategy development, organizational framework building, and execution support
  • Ability to roll up the sleeves and problem solve
  • Strong strategic and conceptual abilities; able to connect enterprise strategy to detailed building and implementation
  • Expertise in building operating frameworks, process re‑engineering, and organizational development
  • Excellent collaborator management and influencing skills, including experience engaging C‑suite and senior executives
  • Outstanding ability to present complex topics clearly and build engaging narratives and materials
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities; comfortable with data, financial modeling, and performance metrics
  • Growth mindset toward emerging technologies, with the ability to incorporate AI into daily work and support others in embracing new digital tools with confidence and ease. Proficiency in MS

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Pay Transparency Laws:

The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $225,000 to $275,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant's education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location.

This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon's annual incentive plans in addition to base salary. The amount of any incentive varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon's discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance. This role does not accrue vacation. Rather, this role is eligible to take paid time off at the discretion of the employee and management in accordance with company policy and practices. Various other types of leaves of absence; paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies.

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are:

NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

Summary:

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping employers develop healthier, more engaged, and resilient workforces while serving as a trusted strategic advisor. The role offers the chance to shape and influence the continued growth of a national consulting practice within NFP, an Aon company, collaborating with experienced teams across benefits, analytics, communications, compliance, and vendor management to address complex client challenges. In addition, you will contribute to the development of scalable tools, thought leadership, and consulting best practices that enhance client outcomes and strengthen the overall consulting experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead strategic wellbeing consulting engagements for mid-size and large employer clients, including discovery, planning, recommendations, and ongoing advisory support.
  • Design integrated wellbeing strategies that align health, emotional wellbeing, financial wellbeing, caregiving, culture, communications, vendor solutions, and benefits priorities.
  • Translate client needs, workforce insights, market trends, vendor capabilities, and program results into clear guidance for HR, benefits, finance, leadership, and account team partners.
  • Guide vendor strategy by supporting evaluations, RFPs, implementation planning, performance conversations, and ongoing accountability for client value.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative information to identify priorities, shape recommendations, evaluate progress, and tell a clear story about program impact.
  • Lead client projects and consulting deliverables with strong organization, ownership, follow-through, and readiness for client-facing interactions.
  • Collaborate with account teams, practice leaders, and internal subject matter experts to strengthen client relationships, support retention, and contribute to growth opportunities.
  • Develop and refine scalable resources, frameworks, presentations, and client-facing tools that support consistent national practice delivery.
  • Mentor colleagues, share expertise, and help raise the quality, consistency, and strategic depth of consulting work across the team.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience required; advanced education, certifications, or professional credentials in wellbeing, benefits, HR, public health, or a related field are a plus.
  • Life and Health license strongly preferred, or willingness to obtain within first three months.

Core Competencies

  • Minimum 5+ years of related experience with health and benefits and/or wellbeing required.
  • Minimum 3+ years of employer wellbeing consulting experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience in employer wellbeing, health and benefits, health transformation, employee engagement, or a related consulting/advisory environment.
  • Experience supporting complex employer clients and advising internal or external stakeholders on program strategy, engagement, communications, vendor solutions, or measurement.
  • Strong working knowledge of the employer wellbeing marketplace, including emerging trends, vendor solutions, point solutions, engagement strategies, and integration with benefits priorities.
  • Comfort interpreting data, trends, client context, and partner feedback to develop thoughtful recommendations and practical next steps.
  • Strategic consulting judgment and ability to design practical, client-centered solutions.
  • Executive-ready communication skills, including strong writing, facilitation, and presentation presence.
  • Ability to influence through credibility, preparation, business context, and subject matter expertise.
  • Project leadership, organization, accountability, and comfort handling multiple priorities in a changing environment.
  • Strong listening, adaptability, emotional intelligence, and relationship management skills.
  • Market curiosity, proactive problem-solving, and ownership of work from concept through completion.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and AI, especially PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to create polished client-facing materials.

Travel and Work Environment:

  • Hybrid role with periodic access to the Chicago office for collaboration, planning, and team connection.
  • Ability and willingness to travel periodically (25% of the time) for client meetings, internal collaboration, and practice priorities.

What We Offer:

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $90,000 – $115,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

Job Description

LIA Advisor Consultant – Digital Infrastructure

Role Overview

As a Lender Insurance Advisor & Consultant, you will help clients navigate the evolving risks and opportunities associated with digital infrastructure and emerging technologies. You'll work with lenders, investors, and business leaders to evaluate exposures, strengthen resiliency, and support informed business decisions through insurance and risk advisory solutions.

This role offers the opportunity to work on complex and high-profile engagements across lending, investment, and transaction environments while partnering with professionals across risk, insurance, technology, legal, and financial disciplines. You'll help clients address today's challenges while preparing for what's next in a rapidly changing marketplace.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead consulting engagements that evaluate insurance and risk considerations for technology-enabled businesses and digital infrastructure projects.
  • Assess exposures, review insurance programs, and identify opportunities to strengthen risk management and risk transfer strategies.
  • Support lending, investment, and transaction activities by evaluating operational, contractual, and insurance-related considerations.
  • Deliver actionable insights and recommendations that help clients make confident business decisions.
  • Build strong relationships with clients and serve as a trusted advisor throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Partner with colleagues across Aon to deliver integrated solutions that address client needs and business objectives.
  • Develop clear reports, presentations, and client deliverables that communicate complex information in an understandable and practical way.
  • Contribute to the continued growth of the practice by sharing knowledge, supporting innovation, and staying informed on emerging business and technology trends.

Successful Candidates Typically Bring

  • Experience in risk management, business consulting, insurance brokerage, insurance advisory services, or a related field.
  • Exposure to technology, digital infrastructure, cyber, data, or operational risk environments.
  • Experience supporting client projects, due diligence initiatives, transactions, or complex business decisions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess information and identify practical solutions.
  • Effective project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a collaborative environment.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, relationship management, and report writing capabilities.
  • A commitment to client service, teamwork, continuous learning, and professional growth.

Why Join Aon?

At Aon, you'll have the opportunity to work on complex client challenges, collaborate with colleagues across disciplines and geographies, and help shape solutions in one of the fastest-evolving areas of risk and insurance.

We invest in our colleagues through continuous learning, career development, and opportunities to build expertise across emerging technologies, business risk, and advisory services. You'll be part of a collaborative environment where new ideas are encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and meaningful contributions can make a lasting impact for clients and colleagues alike.

This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon's annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Who We Are

At Juno Search Partners, we believe the right opportunity can make all the difference. We connect talented people with organizations where they can do meaningful work, continue growing, and make an impact. Our approach is personal and relationship-focused, and we take the time to understand what matters to our clients and candidates.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of NFP Corp., an Aon company, Juno combines the feel of a specialized firm with the resources of a larger organization. NFP is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance and a recognized Elite Agency award winner. With more than 8,000 employees globally, NFP provides property and casualty, employee benefits, wealth management, and retirement solutions to clients.

What You'll Do

You'll manage full-cycle searches while building relationships with candidates and clients. Your work will include:

  • Source, screen, interview, and present candidates, supporting searches through offer and close.
  • Develop sourcing strategies using LinkedIn, internal databases, professional networks, job boards, and other recruiting tools.
  • Build relationships with candidates and provide clear communication throughout the recruiting process.
  • Partner with clients to understand their hiring needs and provide relevant market insight and feedback.
  • Keep candidate, client, and search activity current in the firm's CRM/ATS.
  • Support executive searches with research, market mapping, candidate materials, and interview coordination.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to share talent, resources, and recruiting expertise.

Growing relationships is also an important part of the role. You'll connect with prospective clients, participate in weekly lead generation and outreach, build your professional network, and look for opportunities to expand existing partnerships. You'll also have opportunities to represent Juno at client meetings, industry events, and networking activities.

What We're Looking For

There are many ways to build the skills needed for this role. While agency or staffing experience is helpful, we're also interested in candidates whose experience could translate well to search and recruiting.

  • Approximately 3–4 years of recruiting or relevant transferable experience, ideally in a client-facing environment.
  • Ability to communicate and build relationships with candidates, clients, and colleagues.
  • Experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Interest in both recruiting and the business development side of search.
  • Ability to navigate negotiations and challenging conversations.
  • Comfort working in a collaborative environment where priorities can change.
  • Interest in learning, developing new skills, and growing with the business.

If this opportunity interests you but your experience doesn't match every qualification above, we encourage you to apply! We're interested in what you can bring to the team and where you'd like to grow.

What We Offer

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Job Summary

This position oversees actuarial functions with a focus on financial projections of U.S. product liability cashflows. The role focuses on model development, testing, governance and consistency among various model stakeholders. This position leverages in-depth actuarial knowledge and understanding of the business to solve more complex issues and deliver strategic recommendations that align with business objectives. The position performs work independently while receiving guidance from a direct people leader and guiding more junior staff.

Essential Job Functions

  • Collaborates with stakeholders, teams, and other departments to resolve more complex actuarial issues. Guides the preparation of financial projections to enable leadership to assess financial implications and overall impact of business decisions. Accountable for timely and accurate delivery of actuarial deliverables. Interprets data and formulas to extract valuable insights for management. Analyzes operational performance and presents findings and recommendations for optimization. May represent the actuarial department with external stakeholders.
  • Independently develops and implements solutions to more complex actuarial issues. Oversees project workflows, provides robust feedback to stakeholders and management, and ensures timely and effective completion of work. Delivers on plans and priorities while guiding projects and/or teams to achieve successful outcomes and business objectives.
  • Advocates for improvements to assumption formulas, procedures, and programs. Anticipates the impact of changes and ensures recommendations align with broader business objectives.
  • Oversees the integration of new and updated products into financial projection system. Ensures actuarial modeling systems comply with controls and standards including updates for IT, product, and regulatory changes.
  • Stays informed about industry trends, emerging actuarial practices, and regulatory changes to contribute effectively to work within team, department, or across departments. Acts as a subject matter specialist to mentor and train less experienced actuarial staff by providing guidance on fundamental actuarial principles and practices. Performs other duties as assigned.

Physical Actions

Physical Environment

Education Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent is required. Bachelors degree is preferred but not required. Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) or equivalent designation required. Two Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) courses preferred. Life insurance industry experience preferred. Experience with US statutory regulations or IFRS 17 preferred.

Experience Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience working in relevant roles
  • Advance experience working with actuarial projection software like MG-ALFA or equivalent (Axis or Profit)
  • Experience working with Python, R, SAS or similar
  • Strong understanding of actuarial modeling
  • Familiarity with U.S. Life/Annuity product designs and features.
  • Able to analyze complex data, interpret trends, and develop actuarial models and assumptions.
  • Deep understanding on Financial Modeling within Alpha database

Additional Qualification

At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Job.JobTitle: Platform Consultant Cyber Platforms, Data, & Tooling
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

This role sits within Allstate Cyber Operations & Platforms as part of a set of Digital Product Teams responsible for building and operating a cohesive, scalable Security Operations platform ecosystem. This ecosystem spans:

Agentic Cyber Platforms (ACP): Operationalizing AI as a core cyber capability through shared platforms, orchestration patterns, and governance-by-design.

Security Data & Observability (SD&O): Engineering and managing the Security Operations Data Plane, enabling high-fidelity telemetry, analytics, and AI-ready data.

Tooling & Platform (T&P): Ensuring security tooling is integrated, governed, and aligned as part of a unified platform rather than disconnected solutions. Together, these capabilities enable secure, scalable, and intelligence-driven cyber operations by design.

The Platform Consultant defines and drivesarchitecture patterns, integration standards, and ecosystem strategyacross AI platforms, security data, and tooling. This role ensures the environment evolves as acoherent, reusable, and governed platform ecosystem, enabling safe, scalable adoption through well-defined paved roads.


You will translate operational intent intoenterprise-scale platform design, ensuring interoperability between AI systems, data platforms, and tooling while minimizing fragmentation and maximizing reuse.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Standards

  • Define architecture, design patterns, and integration standards across AI, data, and tooling.

  • Establish APIs, data models, security controls, and observability requirements.

Data & AI Enablement

  • Ensure high-quality, structured data for AI (lineage, consistency, readiness).

  • Set standards for safe AI use (explainability, auditability, controlled actions).

Tooling & Integration

  • Design unified integration across tools and platforms.

  • Ensure tools produce consistent, high-quality, AI-ready data.

Paved Roads & Adoption

  • Build scalable, reusable solutions as the default (paved roads).

  • Drive standardization, reduce duplication, andguideadoption.

Strategy & Decision-Making

  • Lead build vs. buy vs. integrate decisions.

  • Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, andgovernance-driven.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner across teams (ACP, SD&O, T&P) for platform alignment.

  • Influence teams to drive simplification, reuse, and consistency.

Essential Criteria

  • A minimum of 5 years software engineering experience in at least 3 programming paradigms toinclude: a) Object-oriented (Java &JavaScriptrequiredand at least one other language) b) Procedural / systems (e.g.Go, Rust, C) c) Functional (e.g.F#, Elixir, Clojure, Haskell)

  • Experience using modern development tools (e.g., IntelliJ or VS Code, Git/GitHub, Spring Boot) and designing robust RESTful APIs

  • A minimum of 3 years hands onexpertisein architecting and delivering large scale distributed systems, such as cloud native microservices on Docker/Kubernetes, deployed on modern cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or equivalent), ensuring scalability, high availability, and performance

  • Demonstrated success as a high impact technical advisor to multiple engineering teams, with proven ability to influence architecture direction and mentor engineers in best practices with proven leadership responsibilities.

  • Expert level knowledge of Agile/XP and DevOps methodologies, including paired programming, test driven development (TDD), and CI/CD automation, witha track recordof using these practices to accelerate delivery and improve quality

Desirable Criteria

  • Experience withagentic AI platforms, governance, and safe-action design

  • Familiarity withsecurity operations ecosystems and analyst workflows

  • Experience with:a) Telemetry and observability systems b) Data lineage, metadata, and data quality frameworks c) Canonical data models and analytics-ready datasets

  • Background intooling integration and platform standardization (golden paths/paved roads)

  • Experience aligningAI, data, and tooling strategies into a unified platform vision

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

#LI-JJ1

Skills

Artificial Intelligence (AI), CI/CD, Cloud Platform, Cross-Functional Leadership, Decision Making, DevOps, IT Solution Design, Java (Programming Language), Platform Architecture, RESTful APIs, Software Engineering, Structured Data, Technical Consulting, Test Driven Development (TDD)

Compensation offered for this role is 134,000.00 - 209,750.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you willprovideexceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide,leveragingvarious platforms and software such as Xactimate andClaimsXVideo Collaboration. Yourexpertisewill be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'llwear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expertyoulllive into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you willaccomplishthat by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youllconfidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies todeterminecoverage.
  • The Effective Communicatoryoulluse phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process.Youllalso incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on theclaimprogress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants,in accordance withall legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solveryoullutilizemultiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, andadditionalsettlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorderyoullprotect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trainedin.Youllaccomplishthis by ensuringtimelyandaccuratedocumentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

  • 2years'previousexperience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
  • Previousexperience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
  • Proficiencyin using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately andexpediteclaimssettlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska,Hawaiior Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

  • Residency within Richmond, VA area is mandatory for this role.
  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch onaone to two-story roof.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youreprovided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in yourday-to-daywork.
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.
  • You willbe requiredto attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place inDallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing anadditionalbackground check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you willbe requiredto secure license(s) within60 daysof hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/orapplicableAppraiser License.

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-onbonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership teamdeterminesthis based on annual work mileage for this location. You maybe requiredto use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as anAllstater,youllenjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

Job.JobTitle: Attack Surface Management Service Lead Consultant - Exposure Intelligence Team
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Role Scope: Attack Surface Management Service Lead Consultant Exposure Intelligence

Allstate Job Profile & Family: Lead Consultant- Threat & Incident Response


Team and overall work scope

  • The team operates within a newly established Exposure Management function in the broader cybersecurity organization, focused on modernizing how the enterprise identifies, prioritizes, and mitigates security vulnerabilities shifting from traditional patch approaches to a more strategic focus on true business risk and exploitability
  • Individual Contributor/ Lead Consultant roles are designed to bring in deep respective domain expertise (network, endpoint, cloud, identity, infrastructure, Databases & Data Stores, Applications, API's, Attack Surface Management etc.) to bridge the gap between security insights and practical remediation strategies
  • The Lead Consultant Attack Surface Management is the SME responsible for discovering, monitoring, and governing the enterprise's internet-facing attack surface, including unknown and unmanaged assets, external exposures, and third-party and subsidiary footprints. As the founding member of the capability, the role establishes ASM practices, applies CTEM principles to tie external findings to real attack paths, and partners with asset owners to drive remediation that measurably reduces exploitable exposure.

Success Measures

  • Expanded and validated coverage of the external attack surface, with fewer unknown or unowned internet-facing assets.
  • Reduced time from discovery of a new external exposure to an assigned owner and completed mitigation.
  • Higher signal quality in external findings, with fewer false positives and more accurate prioritization.

Key Responsibilities (Core + Domain)


Exposure Intelligence (Core)

  • Translate external attack surface findings into exposure intelligence and exploitability-based prioritization.
  • Identify attack paths that start from internet-facing assets, such as exposed services, misconfigurations, expired or weak certificates, and exposed admin interfaces.
  • Produce clear remediation guidance and partner with asset owners to validate closure.


Attack Surface Management (Domain)

  • Own SME coverage for external attack surface discovery and monitoring using EASM and scanning platforms (e.g., Censys, Qualys).
  • Establish asset governance practices, including attribution, ownership assignment, inventory reconciliation, and detection of shadow IT and orphaned assets.
  • Extend visibility to third-party, subsidiary, and cloud-hosted footprints, and partner with Penetration Testing, Product Security, and Exposure Response to operationalize findings.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years in attack surface management, vulnerability management, security operations, or exposure management.
  • Strong understanding of internet-facing infrastructure, including DNS, IP space, certificates, cloud hosting, and common external misconfigurations.
  • Ability to translate technical findings into business risk and practical remediation actions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Censys or comparable EASM platforms, and with Qualys or similar vulnerability scanning tools.
  • Familiarity with asset inventory/CMDB processes, cloud provider connectors, and third-party risk practices.
  • Ability to build a new capability from the ground up, including processes, metrics, and stakeholder buy-in, as the first person in the function.

Skills Attack Surface Management, External Attack Surface Management (EASM), Asset Discovery, Asset Inventory Management, Cloud Security, Network Security, Third-Party Risk Management, Vulnerability Management, Threat and Vulnerability Management

Skills

Asset Inventory Management, Attack Surface Analysis, Cyber Incident Response, Cyber Threat Hunting, IT Security Operations, Network Security, Penetration Testing, Stakeholder Management, Threat and Vulnerability Assessment, Threat and Vulnerability Management, Vulnerability Management

Compensation offered for this role is 100,000.00 - 170,500.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Transports soiled towels to hotel loading dock for third-party cleaning vendor collection while following all established procedures and safety standards.

Description

Global Risk Solutions writes business in more than 20 countries, and the controls behind that business have to hold up everywhere. This role owns a meaningful piece of how we prove they do and how we keep proving it faster, using the AI tools now built into the way our team works.

This is a role for someone who genuinely likes both halves of controls work: the analytical half, where you dig into a process and find the gap nobody else noticed, and the influencing half, where you bring a business owner along without owning their process or their decision. You'll partner with underwriting, claims, compliance and finance leaders across North America, Latin America, Europe and Asia Pacific and with external program partners, where you'll often be the Liberty Mutual voice in the room.

The opportunity

You'll help lead how GRS assures and strengthens its control environment worldwide driving the resolution of audit findings, elevating the quality of account reconciliations, building attestation programs from the ground up, and leading controls audits of our program partners. Alongside all of it, you'll bring a builder's mindset to how the work itself gets done: using GenAI to take on the mechanical lift so more of your time and your team's goes toward judgment, not formatting.

Where you'll make an impact

  • Audit remediation & assurance
    • Serve as GRS's connective tissue with Global Internal Audit keeping findings, action plans and closure evidence moving toward resolution, and escalating where the risk warrants it.

    • Support the external audit process- Coordinating request, resolving open items with external auditor on a timely basis.
  • Controls & attestation quality
    • Raise the bar on the controls framework across GRS strengthening account reconciliations and attestation coverage across entities and extending that same rigor to every project and initiative the business takes on.
    • Turn documentation, process gaps and structural weaknesses into durable fixes.
  • Program partner oversight
    • Plan and lead controls audits of external program partners, testing what they report against what actually happens and following up until remediation is real.
  • AI-augmented analysis
    • Put GenAI to work on reshaping data, drafting first-pass analysis and getting up to speed on technical findings quickly then build repeatable AI workflows the rest of the team can use too.
  • People leadership
    • Coach and develop team members, including across significant time-zone gaps, building their judgment so they can make sound calls independently.

Built around AI, not bolted on

Liberty Mutual is investing heavily in AI across the enterprise, and GRS Financial Controls is one of the places that shift shows up first. This role sits right at that intersection: you'll use GenAI to compress the time spent on mechanical work reshaping files, comparing narratives across entities, drafting the first version of an observation and apply the time you get back to the calls that actually need a human. You'll also help set the pattern for the rest of the team, turning one-off prompts into repeatable processes others can pick up and trust.

What you'll bring

Preferred Qualifications

  • Property & casualty insurance experience programs, reinsurance or surety a plusCPA, CIA, CPCU or an advanced degree in accounting, finance or business
  • Prior people-leadership experience

Qualifications

  • Master's degree/MBA; CPA
  • Requires 7+ years of auditing and accounting experience, 5+ insurance industry experience
  • Knowledge of financial accounting systems, business processes and reporting tools
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills, Strong negotiation skills, Project management skills

Job Description

This is a senior-level technical position in the post-payment provider audit function intended to analyze assigned provider claims for risk of over and under payments to perform onsite and desk reviews in support of the business unit's objective to ensure all incorrectly billed and paid claims are adjusted accordingly to help control medical cost spend. This role requires a clinical certification to independently perform reviews of all assigned provider claims from a clinical, medical coding and provider billing perspective to ensure claims payment integrity. This will include reviews of corresponding medical records and clinical documentation to validate coding (specifically DRG) billing appropriateness. In addition, the role is responsible for ensuring claims are paid according to the provider and member contracts as well as ensuring that standard claims processing guidelines and billing procedures for each type of service and type of provider were followed. Additionally, this role is responsible for interacting directly with providers to coordinate onsite reviews and perform closing meetings with provider executives (CFOs, Managed Care VPs etc.) to present any findings that will result in claim adjustments.

Job duties include but are not limited to:
• Independently perform analysis of high-risk claims on a post-payment basis utilizing clinical, coding and claims processing background to ensure claims are coded, billed and paid correctly
• Leverage clinical and coding expertise to audit high risk claims for inappropriate application of associated Florida Blue policies and industry standard billing and care practices that may impact claims payment (e.g. MCG, LCD, Authorizations, Covered Benefits, Appropriateness of Service Setting). Specifically:
• Independently request and review pertinent medical records to validate/invalidate potential issues identified on high-risk claims
• Determine claim level financial impact based on unique member benefits and provider contract terms and payment policies
• Ensure claims processing compliance with overarching administrative regulations (Federal, State of Florida, BCBS Association etc.)
• Perform claims level analysis of appropriate provider coding and billing practices and/or guidelines
• Plan and maintain an individual audit schedule through coordination and communication directly with provider personnel for onsite reviews as necessary
• Thoroughly document identified issues to support claim adjustments (including supporting medical record, clinical or coding rationale)
• Lead onsite closing meetings with provider executives to communicate and gain agreement on audit findings prior to claim adjustments. Communicate large/impactful audit findings to appropriate internal parties as needed
• Identify and document upstream process gaps driving incorrect payment for remediation and prevention

Job Requirements:
• 5+ years related work experience. Experience Details: Strong familiarity with ICD-9/10, DRG, CPT/HCPCS coding, or experience with and knowledge of multiple provider reimbursement and pricing methodologies (DRG, SPC, OFS, POC, Global Pricing, Per Diem etc.), or demonstrated proficient working knowledge of at least three of the following: medical terminology, claim audit procedures, provider contracts, claims processing procedures and guidelines, provider authorizations, provider billing, medical coding, concurrent review
• Related Bachelor's degree or additional related equivalent work experience
• Hold an active clinical certification (e.g. RN, LPN, PA)
• The ability to travel frequently
• Proficiency/experience working with some of the following Tools/Apps: Diamond, Jiva, APT, EIP, Siebel, ICN, Quest, Contract Management System, Burgess, PPS Pricer, AHA coding Clinic, Encoder, Alineo
• Working knowledge of COB/OPL, Subrogation and Workers' Comp, standard claims adjustment processes and benefit plans
• Working knowledge of personal computer and related software (e.g., Excel, Microsoft Word)
• Demonstrate flexibility in unplanned work and/or project support
• Excellent oral and written communications skills

Preferred:
• Strong analytics experience
• Consulting experience
• Masters Degree
• Professional Medical Coding Certification (CPC, CCS, etc.) within 18 months of hire

General Physical Demands
Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.

This position offers a hybrid work arrangement which combines flexibility with in-office engagement. Team schedules are determined based on role requirements and business needs. Travel to and from our corporate or regional offices may be required.

Job.JobDescription:
Job Description

At Guidewell, we are moving from AI experimentation to becoming a genuinely AI-led organization, and that shift requires more than isolated pilots or point solutions. It requires a foundational capability that can keep pace with the frontier of AI while building the platform, infrastructure, and architecture needed to run it safely and reliably at enterprise scale. This role is being created to build, from the ground up, an enterprise capability that can track and apply frontier AI (model evaluation, agentic AI, multimodal AI, human-AI interaction) while establishing the engineering foundation that lets those capabilities scale across a highly regulated healthcare environment.

This is a builder's mandate. You will not inherit a function, you will design it, staff it, and stand it up, reporting directly to the VP of Applied AI Engineering and Platform and working across four interconnected pillars: AI Research & Applied Intelligence, Infrastructure & Platform Engineering, Developer Platform, and Architecture, Strategy & Standards. The person who takes this role will shape how Guidewell builds AI for years to come.

Key Responsibilities:
• AI Research & Applied Intelligence Establish Guidewell's applied AI research function — continuously evaluating frontier developments in model capability, agentic AI, multimodal AI, and human-AI interaction, and translating them into a prioritized roadmap of applied use cases that create measurable value across the health ecosystem.
• Infrastructure & Platform Engineering Build the AI infrastructure and platform capability - compute, MLOps/LLMOps, model pipelines that allows Guidewell to move AI solutions from prototype into reliable, secure, production-grade operation at enterprise scale.
• Developer Platform Stand up a developer platform and toolchain that gives product and engineering teams self-service access to shared AI capabilities, reducing duplicated infrastructure and shortening the path from idea to production.
• Architecture, Strategy & Standards Define Guidewell's AI architecture and engineering standards that lets AI scale safely across a regulated healthcare environment without slowing delivery.
• Strategy & Executive Partnership Partner with the VP of Applied AI Engineering and Platform, and with senior stakeholders across Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Data, Security, Legal/Compliance, and the business, to shape and continuously evolve Guidewell's AI engineering and research strategy.

Key Requirements:
• Related Bachelor's degree or additional related equivalent work experience
• 7+ years' related work experience
• 5+ years' direct supervisory/management experience
• Significant experience leading AI/ML platform, infrastructure, or applied AI engineering organizations at enterprise scale with a track record that includes hands-on architecture work, not just oversight.
• Experience architecting and operating agentic AI platforms in production: orchestration/agent frameworks, tool-access and identity controls, evaluation gates, observability, and deployment pipelines at real scale.
• Deep expertise in a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar) and its infrastructure-as-code, container/serverless, CI/CD, and multi-region resilience practices, with a track record of making that infrastructure both secure and cost-efficient.
• Experience establishing evaluation-first LLMOps practices (regression testing, tracing, human-in-the-loop oversight) for systems that have to hold up under regulatory, clinical, or audit scrutiny.
• Demonstrated experience building and leading engineering organizations from the ground up, including across distributed or global delivery models.
• Strong executive communication and credibility to partner with senior technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred:
• Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-sensitive industry - healthcare, financial services, or similar and translating requirements like HIPAA or SOX into concrete engineering standards.
• Experience redesigning established business or clinical workflows as agent-driven processes, rather than simply automating individual tasks within them.
• Experience building reusable platform components that let product teams assemble AI capability from proven building blocks instead of starting from scratch each time.
• Experience setting technical direction on emerging agentic AI and orchestration techniques as they mature and converting what works into lasting platform standards.
• A background that spans deep hands-on technical architecture and organizational leadership comfortable operating at both altitudes.
• Direct exposure to health plans, providers, clinical operations, or government health care programs.

General Physical Demands

  • Ability to handle situations in a calm, courteous and professional manner

Education and/or Experience:
