Job Description

Captive Client Leader | Aon Captive & Insurance Management (ACIM)

Are you a client leader who turns strong relationships into long‑term strategic value?

Do you thrive in complex client environments where success depends on judgment, influence, and cross‑functional collaboration?

Join us to help clients make better captive and risk financing decisions!

This is a virtual role with the flexibility to work virtually across the U.S.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

This role exists to strengthen client outcomes through consultative captive leadership. As a Captive Client Services Director, you will act as the principal interface between captive clients and Aon, ensuring clients receive high‑quality service, strategic insight, and access to the right expertise across the business. You will help clients make better decisions about captive performance, risk financing strategy, and long‑term value creation.

Typical activities include:

  • Leading strategic client engagement for a portfolio of captive clients, acting as the primary relationship lead for senior executives
  • Running annual account planning discussions aligned to client priorities, service requirements, and commercial objectives
  • Coordinating strategy check‑ins with subject matter experts to provide external perspectives, market insight, and forward‑looking recommendations
  • Reviewing stewardship reports, performance data, and service metrics to find opportunities for improvement and additional value creation
  • Orchestrating internal teams across domiciles, Global Capability Centres, and wider Aon businesses to deliver integrated client outcomes
  • Finding opportunities to strengthen client relationships, improve account profitability, and expand relevant Aon services
  • Translating technical, financial, and performance information into clear client narratives and actionable recommendations
  • Coaching and supporting more junior colleagues to strengthen client leadership capability and consistency of service delivery
  • Maintaining delivery discipline across service schedules, governance commitments, and regulatory requirements

How this opportunity is different

This role is differentiated by the level of client influence, strategic ownership, and cross‑functional coordination involved. You will operate as the central connector between captive clients and Aon, bringing together expertise from across the organization to support better client decisions and stronger long‑term partnerships.

The role is shifting from transactional service delivery toward consultative client leadership. Success depends on your ability to deeply understand client priorities, proactively find opportunities, and build value through strategic conversations, insight‑led communication, and effective orchestration of Aon capabilities.

You will help shape the future‑state client leadership model within ACIM, supporting a more proactive, data-driven, and commercially focused approach to client engagement.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Demonstrated advisory client engagement, building deep understanding of client priorities, challenges, and risk financing objectives and operating as a trusted advisor
  • Strong strategic and commercial thinking, connecting client strategies, commercial opportunities, and Aon capabilities to create measurable value and support profitable growth
  • Confirmed ability to orchestrate expertise across a matrixed organization, influencing without formal authority and aligning teams around shared client objectives
  • Track record of owning client service delivery, managing service schedules and stewardship activity, and maintaining high standards of execution and governance
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn technical information, market insight, and performance data into compelling narratives for senior collaborators
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous or evolving situations, with sound judgment, learning agility, and the ability to draw on specialist expertise when needed
  • Experience leading, coaching, or mentoring colleagues to build capability and consistent client leadership standards across teams
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business, finance, risk management, or a related field.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share, and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Milwaukee, WI
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

This is a field adjuster role in Milwaukee, Wi area.

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on all property claims types, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

Previous experience in construction estimating or as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.

Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof.

Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

#LI-MMS

Customer Service, Flexibility, Negotiation, Property Insurance Claims, Time Management

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Position Overview


We are seeking a Vended Application Lead Consultant Engineer to join our Network Security engineering team. This role will provide technical leadership for the engineering, automation, deployment, and lifecycle management of enterprise network security platforms.


The ideal candidate will bring a strong foundation in networking and network security, combined with experience applying modern software engineering and infrastructure automation practices to infrastructure platforms. This individual should be comfortable working with technologies such as Palo Alto Networks or comparable enterprise firewall platforms, while also having hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, Ansible, APIs, and automation frameworks.


This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who can bridge traditional infrastructure engineering with a modern, automated approach to managing network security services.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a lead engineer and technical resource for enterprise network security platforms and vended applications.
  • Engineer, maintain, and improve firewall and network security infrastructure across enterprise environments.
  • Develop and promote an Infrastructure as Code approach for provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate infrastructure configuration, validation, testing, and deployment.
  • Develop automation using Ansible, APIs, scripting, and related automation technologies.
  • Design solutions that reduce manual operational activities and improve the consistency and repeatability of infrastructure changes.
  • Provide technical leadership for Palo Alto Networks firewall technologies or comparable enterprise firewall/security platforms.
  • Partner with networking, cloud, application, security, and infrastructure teams to design and implement secure connectivity solutions.
  • Troubleshoot complex network and security issues across application, network, firewall, and cloud environments.
  • Establish engineering standards, reusable automation patterns, and technical best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, resiliency, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in product lifecycle activities including upgrades, platform modernization, capacity planning, vulnerability remediation, and technology refreshes.
  • Lead technical implementation efforts and provide engineering guidance to other members of the team.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and engineering standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong background in network engineering and network security.
  • Strong understanding of core networking concepts including:
    • TCP/IP
    • Routing
    • Subnetting
    • NAT
    • DNS
    • VPN technologies
    • Network segmentation
    • Load balancing and application connectivity
  • Experience engineering or supporting enterprise firewall platforms, preferably Palo Alto Networks or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code concepts, practices, and tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with Ansible for infrastructure configuration and automation.
  • Experience developing or supporting CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure or application deployments.
  • Experience integrating infrastructure platforms through REST APIs or other programmatic interfaces.
  • Working knowledge of scripting or programming languages used for automation, such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure problems across multiple technology domains.
  • Ability to translate technical requirements into scalable and supportable engineering solutions.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, operations, application, and security teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls, Panorama, or related Palo Alto technologies.
  • Experience managing network security infrastructure in public cloud environments such as AWS or Azure.
  • Experience with source-control platforms and development workflows such as Git.
  • Experience with CI/CD and automation platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, or similar technologies.
  • Experience working with enterprise IT service management and change-management processes.
  • Experience creating reusable automation frameworks rather than one-off scripts.
  • Experience working in an environment adopting product-oriented engineering and DevOps practices.
  • Experience modernizing traditional infrastructure platforms through automation and Infrastructure as Code.

What Were Looking For

We are looking for more than someone who knows how to configure a firewall. The successful candidate will be an engineer who understands networking deeply and approaches infrastructure as an engineering product that can be automated, tested, version-controlled, and continuously improved.

They should be comfortable moving between troubleshooting a complex network connectivity issue, developing an Ansible automation workflow, reviewing a CI/CD deployment pipeline, and helping determine the future technical direction of the platform.


Core skill profile


Networking & Security: Strong networking fundamentals with enterprise firewall/security experience.

Infrastructure as Code : Experience managing infrastructure through repeatable, version-controlled automation.

Automation: Strong Ansible experience supplemented by scripting and API integration.

CI/CD: Experience applying software delivery practices to infrastructure deployment and configuration.

Firewall Platforms: Palo Alto experience is preferred, but strong experience with comparable enterprise firewall platforms is also valuable.

Technical Leadership: Ability to lead engineering efforts, establish standards, mentor others, and drive modernization of the platform.

Skills

Automation, Automation Tools, Azure Devops, Defect Resolution, ERP Applications, Functional Designs, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Integration Testing, Issue Management, Network Automation, Network Security Engineering, Palo Alto Networks Panorama, Red Hat Ansible

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 98,100.00 - 167,850.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. Job Description

Senior Consultant I - Network Security Engineering

Join our Network Security Engineering team and help secure and modernize critical enterprise infrastructure. As a Senior Consultant I, you will engineer, support, automate, and maintain network security platforms that protect the organization while improving reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

We're looking for an experienced engineer with a strong foundation in networking and network security who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and leveraging automation to drive better outcomes. You'll work with technologies such as enterprise firewall platforms, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, scripting, and automation frameworks to streamline operations and enhance platform performance.

This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership, works independently, and delivers high-quality engineering solutions with limited oversight. You'll troubleshoot complex network and security issues, implement infrastructure improvements, support automation initiatives, and contribute ideas that help advance the team's engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engineer, support, and maintain enterprise network security platforms, including Palo Alto Networks and related security technologies.
  • Design, implement, test, and validate network security solutions across enterprise and cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex network, firewall, routing, connectivity, and application communication issues.
  • Develop and maintain automation using scripting, APIs, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and configuration management tools.
  • Build and support CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployment, testing, validation, and configuration management.
  • Create automated pre- and post-change validation processes to improve reliability, consistency, and operational efficiency.
  • Integrate security platforms with monitoring, deployment, and operational tooling to enhance visibility and automation.
  • Identify and automate repetitive operational tasks to reduce manual effort and improve platform scalability.
  • Support platform lifecycle initiatives, including upgrades, vulnerability remediation, technology refreshes, and modernization efforts.
  • Partner with network, cloud, security, and application teams to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable solutions.
  • Contribute to technical reviews, process improvements, and engineering best practices while operating within established architecture and security standards.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, scripts, and automation.
  • Provide technical assistance and knowledge sharing to other members of the team.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong background in network engineering and network security.
  • Strong understanding of core networking technologies and concepts, including: TCP/IP, Routing, Subnetting, NAT, DNS, and application connectivity
  • Experience engineering, implementing, or supporting enterprise firewall and network security platforms.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code concepts, practices, and version-controlled infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience developing scripts and automation for infrastructure engineering and operational use cases, including areas such as: Infrastructure change implementation, Configuration management, Pre-change and post-change validation, Infrastructure monitoring and health checks, Data collection and reporting, Operational troubleshooting, API-driven infrastructure management
  • Working knowledge of scripting or programming languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Experience working with REST APIs or other programmatic interfaces to interact with and automate infrastructure platforms.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, or working with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure configuration and deployment.
  • Experience using source control and version-control practices, such as Git-based development workflows.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure, network connectivity, and security issues.
  • Ability to independently analyze technical requirements and implement solutions within established architecture and engineering standards.
  • Ability to take ownership of assigned technical work and drive it through implementation and validation with limited oversight.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across infrastructure, security, networking, cloud, and application teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Ansible for infrastructure configuration, deployment, orchestration, or automation.
  • Hands on experience with Palo Alto Networks Firewalls and Panorama or similar firewall platforms.
  • Experience supporting network security infrastructure within AWS, Azure, or other public cloud environments.
  • Strong understanding, VPN technologies, Network segmentation, and load balancing
  • Experience with CI/CD and automation technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Experience developing reusable automation frameworks, modules, or tooling for infrastructure engineering.
  • Experience working within enterprise change-management and IT service-management processes.
  • Experience working in a DevOps or product-oriented engineering environment.
  • Experience modernizing traditional infrastructure platforms through automation and Infrastructure as Code.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Digital Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of security-focused products that protect enterprise data assets and deliver security-by-design capabilities that enable data discovery, governance, protection, compliance, and responsible data use across the enterprise. This role will own the lifecycle of critical security tools and platforms, utilized by the enterprise. The ideal candidate combines strong product management expertise with a deep understanding of security principles, DevSecOps practices, and modern engineering workflows. Additionally, the candidate will leverage AI-driven capabilities to optimize workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance efficiency across security operations and product management processes.

This role requires forward-thinking and strategic planning to anticipate future security needs, define measurable outcomes, and ensure products deliver long-term value. Success will be measured by risk reduction, improved data governance maturity, increased adoption of security controls, enhanced user experience and compliance adherence.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Define Product Strategy & Vision:Establishand communicate the vision, roadmap, and success metrics for security products aligned to enterprise risk posture and compliance requirements.
  • Set Clear Outcomes:Define what success looks like for each product, including measurable KPIs.
  • Plan for Scalability & Future Needs:Anticipateevolving security threats and compliance requirements. Design products that scale and adapt to future enterprise needs.
  • Incorporate AI for Efficiency:Identifyopportunities to integrate AI into daily workflows to automate repetitive tasks, improve decision-making, and maximize efficiency.
  • Data Governance & Stewardship: Partner with business and technology stakeholders to enforce governance standards, data ownership models, stewardship processes, and policies that improve data quality, protection, and accountability across the enterprise.
  • Manage Product Development:Collaborate with engineering and security teams to design and deliver secure-by-default capabilities integrated into developer workflows and experiences that support data discovery, classification, DLP, access governance and lifecycle management. Maintain backlog, write and groom user stories, and drive iterative releases using Agile methodologies.
  • Enable Data-Driven Decisions:Define and monitor KPIs to measure adoption, effectiveness, and risk reduction. Leverage analytics and reporting to inform prioritization, validate assumptions, and optimize product outcomes.
  • Stakeholder Communication:Lead product ceremonies and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs to engineering leadership, security teams, and partners.


Essential Skills

  • Minimum of 5years' experienceconductingproduct scoping, discovery,framing,owningand managing a backlog(in agility or similar tools)of productsfor a digital product team.
  • Minimum of 1year ofexperienceoperatingas a coach partnering & mentoring earlyintrade product management peers acrossa broader technologyorganization.
  • Strong understanding of security principles, secure SDLC practices, and the design of applications and platforms that enable data protection, governance, compliance, and risk management.
  • Demonstrated ability to define success metrics (KPIs/OKRs), makedata-drivendecisionsand plan strategically for longterm product impact.
  • Proven experience inAgile product delivery (backlog management, ceremonies, iterative releases)
  • Understanding of modern software development practices, automation, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and security controls required to support data protection and governance outcomes.


Desirable Skills

  • Experience with data discovery, classification, labeling, DLP, DSPM, access governance, privacy, retention, and regulatory compliance initiatives.
  • Understanding of modern data ecosystems including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, OneDrive, Azure, AWS, GCP, SaaS platforms, data warehouses, and AI/ML environments.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, CSSLP, CISSP, CCSP, CDMP, CIPM) or equivalent experience.
  • Knowledge of AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Cursor) and ability toleveragethem for productivity gains.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior MongoDB Database Platform Engineer to join the Database Engineering team and help build, operate, and modernize our enterprise MongoDB platform. This role will be responsible for the design, implementation, automation, security, performance, high availability, backup and recovery, and operational support of MongoDB environments spanning on-premises infrastructure and MongoDB Atlas Platform as a Service (PaaS).

The ideal candidate will have deep MongoDB expertise, strong Linux administration skills, hands-on experience with replica sets, sharded clusters, high availability and disaster recovery, and the ability to partner effectively with application, infrastructure, security, SRE, network, and cloud engineering teams.

MongoDB Platform Engineering

Design, build, deploy, administer, and support enterprise MongoDB environments across production and non-production landscapes, including on-premises deployments and MongoDB Atlas PaaS.

Lead MongoDB installation, configuration, patching, version upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle management activities.

Design and operate MongoDB replica sets and sharded clusters, including appropriate topology, storage, networking, and capacity configurations.

Define and maintain MongoDB engineering standards, reference architectures, build procedures, operational controls, and best practices.

Participate in architecture reviews and advise application teams on data modeling, indexing, scalability, resilience, connectivity, and operational readiness.


High Availability and Disaster Recovery

Design and support highly available MongoDB solutions using replica sets, elections, read preferences, write concerns, and multi-site or multi-region architectures.

Implement and maintain disaster-recovery strategies for both on-premises MongoDB and MongoDB Atlas deployments.

Plan and execute failover, recovery, regional resiliency, and disaster-recovery tests.

Work with stakeholders to define, validate, and maintain recovery time and recovery point objectives.


Backup and Recovery

Design, implement, and operate enterprise MongoDB backup and recovery solutions for on-premises and MongoDB Atlas environments.

Administer snapshot, continuous backup, point-in-time recovery, retention, restore, and recovery-validation processes using MongoDB-native and enterprise tooling.

Conduct regular restore testing and support disaster-recovery exercises to verify recoverability.


Performance and Reliability

Monitor database availability, capacity, health, replication, storage, and performance across on-premises and MongoDB Atlas environments.

Analyze and optimize queries, indexes, aggregation pipelines, schema and data models, connection behavior, and database configurations.

Troubleshoot complex production incidents, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventive actions.

Drive database reliability, observability, capacity planning, and operational excellence initiatives.


Security and Compliance

Implement MongoDB security controls, access-management standards, and least-privilege practices.

Manage roles and privileges, authentication, authorization, encryption in transit and at rest, auditing, key management, and credential-management integrations.

Configure and support Atlas security capabilities, including private connectivity, network access controls, identity integration, and organizational access governance.

Support compliance reviews, vulnerability remediation, security assessments, and evidence requests.


Automation and DevOps

Develop automation for MongoDB provisioning, configuration, deployment, patching, validation, monitoring, and routine operations.

Use Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, source control, APIs, and CI/CD practices to improve consistency and repeatability.

Partner with engineering teams to expand safe self-service capabilities and reduce manual operational effort.


Platform Operations and Technical Leadership

Provide support for mission-critical production and non-production MongoDB environments across on-premises and MongoDB Atlas PaaS.

Participate in on-call rotations, major incident response, change management, and problem management.

Create and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, standards, architectural documentation, and operational procedures.

Mentor engineers, review technical solutions, and provide technical leadership for MongoDB platform initiatives.


Required Qualifications

10+ years of database administration, database engineering, or data-platform engineering experience.

8+ years of hands-on MongoDB administration and engineering experience supporting mission-critical production environments.

Strong Linux administration experience; RHEL or a comparable enterprise Linux distribution is preferred.

Deep understanding of MongoDB architecture, storage engine behavior, replication, sharding, configuration, security, maintenance, and performance tuning.

Hands-on experience with MongoDB replica sets, sharded clusters, high availability, disaster recovery, backup and recovery, point-in-time recovery, and capacity planning.

Hands-on experience administering or engineering MongoDB Atlas, including cluster deployment, scaling, backup, monitoring, networking, access management, and migration activities.

Strong skills in MongoDB query analysis, indexing, aggregation pipelines, schema and data modeling, and workload optimization.

Proven ability to troubleshoot complex database, operating system, storage, network, and connectivity issues in production environments.

Experience planning and executing database upgrades, migrations, patching, platform changes, and production releases.

Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and work effectively across organizational boundaries.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience with MongoDB Enterprise Advanced and MongoDB Ops Manager for on-premises database lifecycle management, monitoring, backup, and automation.

Experience designing or operating hybrid MongoDB platforms spanning on-premises environments and MongoDB Atlas across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform.

Experience with MongoDB migration and synchronization tooling such as mongodump/mongorestore, MongoDB Database Tools, Atlas Live Migration, or MongoDB Relational Migrator.

Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or native MongoDB and Atlas monitoring capabilities.

Experience with Infrastructure as Code and delivery tools such as Terraform, GitHub, GitLab, or CI/CD pipelines.

Nice to have: hands-on experience using Ansible to automate MongoDB installation, configuration, patching, validation, and repeatable operational tasks.

Exposure to other database technologies such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, or Neo4j.

Experience leading technical initiatives, mentoring team members, and influencing enterprise platform standards.


Desired Attributes

Strong ownership, accountability, and customer focus.

Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and drive technical initiatives to completion.

Strong collaboration, documentation, and communication skills.

Experience working in large-scale, highly available, and regulated enterprise environments.

Job Description

You'll take the lead in writing estimates and guiding customers through the repair or total loss process, using a mix of in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication. No two days are the samewhether you're evaluating damage on-site or collaborating with body shops and service providers, you'll enjoy a fast-paced, hands-on role that keeps you engaged and on your toes.

If you're looking for a career that blends technical know-how, customer service, and the freedom of field work, this is your chance to thrive in a role where your expertise truly matters.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You have 3-5 years' experience in auto collision estimating using CCC or Mitchell
  • You have a High School Diploma or a GED
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write precise and comprehensive estimates
  • Comfortable with utilizing technology and various platforms for claims processing
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills to manage multiple assignments effectively
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements

A day in the life of the Field Auto Damage Appraiser, and what it takes to do the job!

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder Your Eye for Detail Keeps Everything on Track- In this role, youll ensure claims are documented accurately and in line with policy agreements. As you handle each case, youll maintain clear, timely records in our claims system (which well train you on). Your attention to detail helps keep the process smooth, organized, and transparent from start to finish.

Work Location

Company Car
